title: HVAC Retrofit Project Manager
description:
**Who we are?**
**About Johnson Controls**
Johnson Controls, a global leader in thermal management, mission-critical building systems, energy efficiency, and decarbonization, helps customers wuse energy more productively, reduce carbon emissions, and operate with the precision and resilience required in rapidly expanding industries such as data centers, healthcare, pharmaceuticals, advanced manufacturing, and higher education.
  
  
For more than 140 years, Johnson Controls has delivered performance where it really matters. Backed by advanced technology, lifecycle services, and an industry-leading field organization, we elevate customer performance, turn goals into real-world results, and help move society forward.
  
  
Visit johnsoncontrols.com for more information and follow @Johnsoncontrols on social platforms.
  
  
**Job Summary**
We are seeking an experienced
**HVAC Retrofit Project Manager**
to lead the execution and delivery of HVAC projects. The ideal candidate should have strong expertise in
**chiller installation, testing, commissioning, and project execution**
, with the ability to manage project schedules, resources, stakeholders, and site teams to ensure successful project delivery.
  
  
**What will you do?**

* Manage the complete lifecycle of HVAC projects from project initiation to handover.
* Lead the installation, testing, commissioning, and startup of:
* Water-Cooled Chillers
* Air-Cooled Chillers
* HVAC Systems
* Cooling Towers
* Pumps and Associated Equipment
* Coordinate with clients, consultants, contractors, and internal teams to ensure smooth project execution.
* Develop project plans, schedules, manpower deployment plans, and budgets.
* Monitor project progress, quality, safety, and compliance with contractual requirements.
* Conduct site meetings and provide project status updates to management and customers.
* Manage project risks and proactively resolve technical and execution challenges.
* Ensure timely procurement and delivery of project materials and equipment.
* Support project billing, cost control, variation management, and collections.
* Ensure compliance with EHS and quality standards throughout project execution.

**What we look for?**

* Bachelor's Degree in Mechanical Engineering or related discipline.
* Project Management certification (PMP/PRINCE2) is an added advantage.
* 8-15+ years of experience in HVAC project execution and project management.
* Strong hands-on experience in chiller installation, testing, and commissioning.
* Proven experience managing large commercial, industrial, healthcare, data center, or infrastructure HVAC projects.
* Experience in handling multiple projects simultaneously.

**Technical Skills**

* Chiller Installation & Commissioning
* HVAC Systems
* Pumps & Hydronic Systems
* Cooling Towers
* HVAC Controls Integration
* Project Scheduling and Planning
* Site Execution Management
* Testing & Commissioning
* Vendor & Contractor Management
* Cost Control & Budget Management

**Key Competencies**

* Project Leadership
* Stakeholder Management
* Customer Relationship Management
* Problem Solving & Decision Making
* Team Management
* Communication & Negotiation Skills

**Preferred Candidate Profile**

* Demonstrated experience in successfully delivering HVAC projects with a focus on chiller systems.
* Strong technical expertise in installation, testing, troubleshooting, and commissioning of chillers.
* Ability to lead cross-functional teams and manage multiple stakeholders.

**What We Offer**
We offer a challenging and exciting position as part of a global, multi-industrial corporation. Joining us provides a stimulating work environment, career development opportunities, and the chance to make a significant impact on society.
  
  
**Diversity & Inclusion**
Our dedication to diversity and inclusion stems from our core values. We lead with integrity and aim for a future aligned with our customers' vision for success. Our culture fosters engagement, innovation, and collaboration, ensuring every employee contributes to our collective mission.

title: Founder's Office- Program Management
description:
**About OneMetric**
OneMetric (formerly Growtomation) is a revenue enablement partner for B2B teams. We build revenue engines end to end: the systems and data teams run on, the GTM execution that drives demand, closed deals and retention, and the AI that makes the entire engine faster and smarter.
  
  
As an Elite HubSpot Partner, we work with high-growth companies across the US and globally. We start with the real revenue problem, not the tool. While most companies buy technology, GTM execution and AI solutions from separate vendors, we bring them together into one connected revenue engine.
  
  
**Who We're Hiring For**
We're looking for a Founder’s Office – Program Management professional to work closely with our founders on strategic initiatives that drive business growth and operational excellence.
  
  
This role is suited for someone who can move between strategy and execution, take ownership of ambiguous problems, and drive cross-functional initiatives from idea to implementation. You could be working on customer expansion, service and offer packaging, new growth opportunities, or improving how the business operates.
  
  
We're particularly interested in candidates with prior experience across sales, marketing, business analysis, or program management, who have recently graduated from a top B-school or Tier 1 engineering colleges who have worked in program management or similar cross-functional roles.
  
  
**What You'll Do**

* Strategic Initiatives: Work directly with founders to identify, structure, and drive strategic business initiatives from concept to execution.
* Customer Expansion: Identify opportunities to grow existing accounts, improve customer value, and support expansion initiatives.
* Offer & Service Packaging: Work on structuring and packaging service offerings to improve positioning, differentiation, and commercial outcomes.
* Program Management: Own cross-functional projects, define milestones, coordinate stakeholders, track progress, and ensure timely execution.
* Business Analysis: Analyse business performance, customer data, and operational metrics to identify opportunities, uncover bottlenecks, and recommend improvements.
* Growth Initiatives: Support new business opportunities, GTM initiatives, and experiments that can unlock growth.
* Cross-functional Collaboration: Work with Sales, Marketing, Delivery, Customer Success, and other teams to turn strategic priorities into actionable plans.
* Founder’s Office Support: Prepare business reviews, build presentations and reports, conduct research, and provide structured recommendations to support decision-making.
* Process Improvement: Identify operational inefficiencies and build scalable processes, frameworks, and systems as the business grows.

****What we're looking for****

* Experience: 3–5 years of relevant professional experience in program management, business analysis, consulting, sales, marketing, or strategy and operations.
* Education: Preference for recent graduates from leading B-schools, particularly IIMs and ISB. Candidates from other reputed Tier 1 institutions will also be considered.
* Program Management: Experience driving cross-functional initiatives, managing multiple workstreams, and delivering outcomes with limited supervision.
* Business Acumen: Ability to understand business models, identify growth opportunities, and connect strategic decisions to commercial outcomes.
* Analytical Thinking: Comfort with data, business metrics, structured problem-solving, and translating insights into actionable recommendations.
* Communication: Strong written and verbal communication skills, with the ability to work effectively with founders and senior stakeholders.
* Ownership & Execution: Someone who takes initiative, thrives in ambiguity, and can move from problem definition to execution without waiting for detailed instructions.
* Versatility: Comfortable switching between strategic thinking, detailed analysis, stakeholder coordination, and hands-on execution.

****Why join OneMetric?****

* Work directly with founders: Get exposure to high-impact business decisions and strategic priorities.
* Own meaningful initiatives: Take responsibility for projects that influence growth, customer expansion, and business performance.
* Build across functions: Develop a broad understanding of strategy, GTM, operations, and commercial decision-making.
* Make an impact: Work in a growing business where initiative, problem-solving, and execution directly contribute to outcomes.

****Ideal Candidate Profile****
The ideal candidate
**has 3–5 years of relevant experience across strategy, sales, marketing, business analysis, consulting, or program management,**
along with an academic background from a Tier 1 institution.
**We particularly prefer recent graduates from IIMs or ISB**
who bring prior work experience and a strong understanding of business fundamentals.
**We’re also open to engineers from top-tier colleges with experience driving cross-functional programs or strategic initiatives**
. Above all, we’re looking for someone who is analytical, commercially minded, comfortable working directly with founders, and capable of turning ambiguous business problems into structured plans and actionable outcomes.

title: Senior Manager - Procurement Change Delivery
description:
**About The Opportunity**
Job Type: Permanent
  
  
Application Deadline: 05 November 2026
  
  
**Title Senior Manager- Procurement Change Delivery**
**Department**
Global Procurement
  
  
**Location**
India (Gurgaon)
  
  
**Reports To**
Associate Director - Procurement Operational Performance

We’re proud to have been helping our clients build better financial futures for over 50 years. How have we achieved this? By working together - and supporting each other - all over the world. So, join our team and feel like you’re part of something bigger.
  
  
**About Your Team**
You will be part of our Global Procurement function which has c.130 staff based across the UK, India, Continental Europe, and Asia Pacific, managing $800m of spend across 26 countries.
  
  
The Procurement Operational Performance team is responsible for driving operational excellence across Procurement by leading, supporting and delivering strategic performance objectives through two specialist teams:
  
  

* Procurement Systems & Tooling, responsible for the operation, support, governance and continuous improvement of Procurement technology, ensuring systems remain stable, effective and aligned to business needs.
* Procurement Development, responsible for leading strategic transformation initiatives, managing the Procurement change roadmap and ensuring successful implementation and embedding of change into business-as-usual operations.

Together, these teams enable Procurement to operate efficiently today while building the capabilities required for the future.
  
  
**About Your Role**
As the Senior Manager for Procurement Change Delivery, you will be responsible for managing change and delivering key projects across Global Procurement.
  
  
The role will require an understanding of end-to-end Procurement functions and processes, Procurement systems and tools, experience in change and project management, and a proven track record in successfully deploying and embedding new and enhanced processes and technology to achieve defined benefits and outcomes.
  
  
Key responsibilities include:
  
  

* Manage a portfolio of change initiatives across Procurement throughout the Change Lifecycle

+ Lead, manage, develop and support the Procurement Change Delivery - Assistant Manager
+ Champion and adhere to the Procurement Change Management framework, and contribute to it’s ongoing evolution
+ Lead and manage the delivery of large & small scale change projects, ensuring alignment with business objectives and project governance

+ Work hand in hand with Procurement Systems and Tooling team, all impacted teams across Procurement and key stakeholders including external parties (e.g. technology solution providers), FIL internal technology teams, business SMEs and Procurement leadership throughout the project lifecycle to successfully deliver change
+ Lead various project management calls and meetings across cross functional delivery teams
+ Lead the articulation of benefits/costs and the development of business cases working closely with the business

+ Use appropriate tools and governance techniques to monitor, report and manage project status, budgets, risks, issues, mitigation strategies and changes to scope and schedule
+ Lead the identification and management of project risks and problems, determine solution options and gain consensus from relevant decision makers on action plans
+ Lead the development and execution of effective stakeholder management and communication throughout the project lifecycle
+ Lead the execution of Change Impact assessments and ensure that robust and effective business readiness plans are in place and executed
+ Represent projects at various governance forums within Procurement and across the broader FIL organisation
+ Own, maintain and enhance Procurement Change Management tools developed using PowerApps, PowerBI and Power Automate

**About You**
You are a collaborative individual with a positive can-do attitude. You can work independently and as part of a team, with proven organisation skills and an ability to multitask by managing projects and activities concurrently.
  
  
You’ll bring;
  
  

* MBA/BBA and/or B-Tech Graduate
* 8+ years of experience in the Procurement domain with a good knowledge of Procurement related processes and functions that may include Sourcing, Supplier Management, Contract Management, Purchase to Pay, Third Party risk management, Due diligence, Supplier onboarding
* 8+ years of experience in delivering Change
* Knowledge of Procurement technology solutions e.g. ProcessUnity, Oracle Fusion, Contract Management systems
* Experience in developing solutions using MS Power Apps/Automate/BI
* Strong track record of delivering positive business outcomes through process and technology enhancements
* Awareness of risk management concepts and processes, ideally in FS or other regulated industry
* Stakeholder Management - Ability to work in a global environment with people across the globe in different time zones and with different cultures
* Ability to collate & challenge requirements gathering, and be able to effectively communicate how requirements will be accommodated in future process or technical solutions
* Ability to positively challenge stakeholders when necessary, and to identify alternative solutions when needed
* Strong verbal and written communication skills, and the ability to communicate complex issues simply.
* Technical mindset, and a natural interest in and aptitude for learning about new tools and systems
* Willingness to learn, and evidence of building and applying knowledge
* Strong understanding of change management practices including governance, project management, planning, communications etc
* Experience in process mapping and analysis

**Feel rewarded**
For starters, we’ll offer you a comprehensive benefits package. We’ll value your wellbeing and support your development. And we’ll be as flexible as we can about where and when you work – finding a balance that works for all of us. It’s all part of our commitment to making you feel motivated by the work you do and happy to be part of our team. **H&B Consulting - RxPharma**

The Senior Pharmacy Clinical Pharmacy Consultant will lead accurate and timely compilation of data and financial analysis on mid-sized and large, complex pharmacy projects
  
  
A significant part of this role is to be a key contributor for projects while developing and growing intellectual capital and driving operational efficiencies

**Note: Applicants should be flexible working in shifts (3:00 pm - 12:00 am) and most work will be during normal local business hours.**
**What you need to have:**
  
  

* Doctorate of Pharmacy (PharmD) or Bachelor of Science in Pharmacy degree
* Licensed pharmacist in country/state of residence
* Excellent project management and interpersonal skills
* Strong English oral and written communication skills
* Proficient in Microsoft suite of programs (Outlook, Word, Excel, PowerPoint, Teams, OneNote)
* Minimum 8 years of relevant experience

**What makes you stand out?**

* Adaptable communicator, facilitator, influencer and problem solver
* High attention to detail
* Good relationship skills, Proven ability to work on own initiative as well as in a team
* Ability to multi-task and prioritize time effectively
* Masters in Business Administration (MBA)
* Pharmacy benefit management (PBM) or managed health care experience
* Understanding of the US healthcare industry, including pharmacy claim payment systems

**Why join our team?**

* We help you be your best through professional development opportunities, interesting work and supportive leaders.
* We foster a vibrant and inclusive culture where you can work with talented colleagues to create new solutions and have impact for colleagues, clients and communities.

title: Senior Program Manager
company: Foundation for Advancing Science and Technology - India
description:
**Job Title: SPM – Government Policy and Programs**

**Foundation for Advancing Science and Technology**

**Background**

We live in a world of fast-paced innovation today, driven by exponential progress in science and technology (S&T) and the growth of vibrant ecosystems to commercialize research. India must aspire to be a top 3 S&T Nation, where the first two places are occupied by US and China today. To do so, India needs to be at the forefront of research:
**the creation of new knowledge (research) and its translation to economic and social goods**
. This is imperative for long-term industry differentiation and competitiveness, National security, and self-reliance to attain our socio-economic goals.

The time for India to revive its S&T agenda is now or never. We have the economic size, the talent pool, a large market size and a vibrant startup ecosystem to both invest in research and be able to translate S&T knowledge into economic value. For India to be a global leader, exponential S&T growth needs to go hand-in-hand with economic growth and social progress.

While the West has traditionally dominated global S&T, many Asian countries such as Japan, Korea and Taiwan have made rapid progress in the past, and China has dramatically scaled its S&T prowess to become #2 in the world behind USA. India's Contribution is relatively dwarfed - its high impact research output is ranked 1oth, with US & China being the top 2, no Indian university shows up in top 100 research rankings, with just 1 company in world's top 50 innovative companies.

**Way of Work**

The
**Foundation for Advancing Science and Technology (FAST India)**
is a non-profit institution of excellence dedicated to catalyse India's journey to a top 3 S&T Nation. We identify that the major stakeholders for S&T include the government, the research institutions and the industry. There are systemic challenges with how these actors today work, such as size of ambition, right incentives, resource allocation and efficiency. Our way of working is to identify these challenges, develop and vigorously advocate policy solutions and best practices to address them. We also identify high-leverage projects that can have an outsized impact on the ecosystem, and run programs with stakeholders, where we lend our team of experts, to make sure best practices are used and the program is impactful. At maturity, we see the ecosystem develop the virtuous cycle of research funding, new breakthrough research, translation into economic value, and re-investment. While we build the

ecosystem, we also look forward to build a strong narrative of S&T leadership in India and create political salience around it.

In a short period of time, FAST has started engagements with the
**Office of PSA (Govt of India), Department of Science and Technology, Ministry of Electronics and Information Technology, Capacity Building Commission of India and Banaras Hindu University**
, among others.

Our projects span easing procurement for scientists, re-envisaging government and industry financing of research, fixing institutional grant management process, shaping sectoral missions, simplifying government procurement etc. Our current body of work includes partnerships with
**Niti Ayog**
on driving measures for ease of doing science, initiatives on industry academia collaboration , thought leadership on Research Linked Incentives, and operationalising R&D Hub spoke models to accelerate India's R&D impact.

At
**Department of Science and Technology,**
FAST has co partnered on shaping and operationalising
**Anusandhaan National Research Fund**
and
**Research Development and Innovation Fund**

FAST has conducted a
**state of sector report**
on Industrial R&D benchmarking Indian industry players across six sectors and comparison versus global peers while highlighting opportunities to increase R&D intensity, and patent, publications outcomes.

FAST's current efforts include understanding the
**R&D landscape of the pharmaceutical sector**
in India and highlighting opportunities to accelerate innovation through various policy interventions. FAST is leading efforts to increase industry participation in R&D, and finding pathways to improving the research translational effectiveness at our institutions. We have produced multiple succinct policy briefs for the governmental and institutional sector.

We also run India's largest non-profit science festival in India called the
**India Science Fest**
, which has seen an audience of 50,000 people over the last three years. We also support and co-ordinate a
**Science Book Fellowship**
to spur public science books in India.

**Leadership**

FAST India is founded by Varun Aggarwal, who is a successful entrepreneur and researcher, and Ashish Dhawan, a private equity investor turned philanthropist. Varun built and sold India's largest job assessment company, Aspiring Minds and wrote a book on the science ecosystem of India. Ashish Dhawan is the chairperson of Ashoka University, a leading liberal arts university in India, and Central Square Foundation, and is passionate about promoting science in India.

FAST's advisory board is chaired by Prof.Tarun Khanna, the Jorge Paulo Lemann Professort at the Harvard Business School. The advisory board includes Prof VijayRaghavan ( Ex Principal Scientific Advisor), Ramesh Mangaleswran ( Ex Mckinsey), Saurabh Srivastava ( Ex Chairman Nasscom ), Dr Soumya Swaminathan(ex World Health Organisation), Dr Ramgopal Rao( Group Vice Chancellor BIT Pilani), Thomas Barlow, Shantanu Rastogi( MD General Atlantic Partners India). FAST's advisory council includes Sanjay Sarma, Dr. Swaminathan Sivaram (IISER), Venkatesh Narayanamurti (Harvard

Univ), Kris Gopalakrishnan, Kiran Mazumdar-Shaw, Ajay Mehta, Abhishek Goel, Vijay Chandru (IISc), Samir K. Brahmachari and Gagandeep Kang.

**Pre-reading**

Varun's talk on his book explaining India's S&T ecosystem and the need for change

Keynote Remarks and Panel Discussion at India Science Fest about why India needs to invigorate its S&T ecosystem Policy and best practices briefs by FAST

**Responsibilities**

FAST India is looking for a
**Senior Program Manager**
to support its government policy and program engagements at a pivotal moment in our growth. This role will be central to advancing India's position at the forefront of global innovation by sustaining partnerships with government bodies like Niti Aayog, Department of Science and Technology, ANRF etc and supporting the policy design and implementation efforts of identified policies and programs. Reporting to the CEO- FAST, and working closely with the FAST leadership team, the candidate would drive research work to identify policy interventions to accelerate India's innovation effort and their implementation of agreed actions through PMU resources aligned and deployed with the government bodies. Following are the responsibilities of the candidate:

The key responsibilities of the SPM (Policy Reforms) include, but are not limited to:

**1. Provide analytical depth in policy intervention design and develop their execution plans.**

The Senior Program Manager will collaborate with partners to iteratively design, develop, and frame decision options that resolve challenges in science, technology, and innovation strategy. The SPM will help design operational interventions that can catalyse and accelerate Indian STI ecosystems.

The SPM will support the leadership team with research and insight, recommending an appropriate approach for diverse policy questions.

**2. Build and Sustain Partnerships**

The Senior Program Manager will develop a strong partnership with government organisations.

**3. Government Interface**

He/she would be a key interface with the government organisations like Niti Aayog, ANRF, State Departments or Line Ministries where the PMU has been deployed, and manage the program implementation

**4. Project and Program Management**

The Senior Program Manager would develop a clear roadmap for implementation and execution of agreed deliverables with the government. This would include development of project plan/workplans, and KPI's for the agreed scope of work

**5. Program Monitoring, Reporting and Control**

He/She would develop appropriate metrics, and dashboards and publish periodic reports and updates on the PMU progress, to the FAST and Government team members

**6. Opportunity Identification and feedback to shape priorities**
He/she would identify additional opportunities through the PMU to help further FAST's goals of increasing R&D impact in the country.

**7. Governance and Compliance**

The Senior Program Manager would ensure adherence to government protocols and legal frameworks

**8. Arrange Policy briefs, organise roundtables etc**

The Senior Program Manager would prepare background analytics and policy briefs for policy roundtables, conferences, summits, workshops etc as needed to

Working closely with FAST India's leadership, the Senior Program Manager will help expand the organisation's capabilities and influence, playing a key role in shaping programs, partnerships, and the narrative that positions FAST India as the go-to institution for enhancing R&D in the country.

**Skills and Competencies Required:**

**1. Ability to Provide Analytical depth to shape policy interventions and recommendations**

Should have strong analytical capability and mature thinking to determine appropriate policy recommendations that can accelerate innovation impact

**2. Ability to build partnerships**

Ability to
**forge and manage partnerships**
with government leaders.

**2. Ability to understand policy Strategic Acumen and Analytical skills**

Understand the national Science and Technology policies, government programs Should be able to identify and prioritise the opportunities to support the government efforts in line with the national needs and FAST's vision and plans

title: Senior Associate / Assistant Manager, Strategic Initiatives (Founder's Office)
description:
**Senior Associate / Assistant Manager, Strategic Initiatives (Founder's Office)**

**The Short version**

**Who we're looking for:**
A sharp, high-intensity problem solver with 3 to 6 years of experience, who cares deeply about education and is happiest when handed a messy problem with no playbook.

**What the role is about:**
You'll work directly with our CEO on the strategic priorities that will shape Kraftshala's next phase of growth, across admissions, training, placements, tech, partnerships, and scale, and you'll own each one from start to finish.

**Why you should apply:**
You'll work on some of the hardest and most critical problems in the company, alongside people with extraordinary expertise in skilling and training. There's a lot to learn here, and plenty of room to grow.

**About Us:**
Kraftshala is India’s largest skilling institution in terms of marketing placements, with a 94% placement rate, and we are gunning to become the world’s largest career launchpad, across domains.

We’re backed by a number of eminent investors including ex-unicorn startup founders and CXOs of global giants like RedBus, NoBroker, Nestlé, and Performics.

**The Detailed Version**

Our goal is simple: drive placements. That takes stellar admissions, training and placement processes, strong technology and deep partnerships across the ecosystem, and keeping all of it stellar as our programs grow. This role exists to solve the cross-functional problems that get in the way of that, working alongside the founder as priorities shift.

**Responsibilities & Metrics to Measure:**

* Take ambiguous, high-priority problems from the founder, break them down, find root causes using data, and turn them into a clear plan with owners and timelines.
* Spot where our programs risk slipping into mediocrity as they scale, across learner outcomes, placement quality and delivery standards, and fix the gaps at a system level.
* Run small, quick experiments on problem areas as they come up, share what worked and what didn't, and change course when the data or priorities shift.
* Act as the founder's thinking partner through sharp analyses, decision memos and reviews, and turn solved problems into repeatable processes that teams can run on their own.

**Top Grading**

* **Proactiveness:**
  An A-Player spots the next problem before being told and moves on it, whereas a B-Player waits for direction and does well only once the task is clearly defined.
* **Intensity & Focus:**
  An A-Player attacks the most important problem with urgency until it's solved, whereas a B-Player spreads effort thin and lets momentum fade after the first push.
* **Structuring Ambiguity:**
  An A-Player turns a vague, messy problem into a clear problem statement, hypothesis and plan, whereas a B-Player either waits for clarity or jumps into action without a frame.
* **Iterative Learning:**
  An A-Player tests fast, learns from what didn't work and changes course without ego, whereas a B-Player sticks to the original plan even when the data says otherwise.
* **Cross-functional Influence:**
  An A-Player gets teams they don't manage to move by building trust and making a clear case, whereas a B-Player leans on the founder's name to get things done.
* **Adaptability:**
  An A-Player shifts gears calmly when priorities change and carries the learnings forward, whereas a B-Player treats every change as a disruption and loses pace.
* **Passion for Education:**
  An A-Player believes in the cause of education and finds ways to drive change, whether through learner outcomes, access to opportunity, better systems or shifting mindsets, whereas a B-Player sees education as just another sector to work in.

**Ideal Candidate**

You have 3 to 6 years of experience solving real problems end-to-end. You might come from consulting, strategy, a founder's office or business operations, or from any role where you've had to work through varied, unstructured problems with no fixed playbook.

* A clear, genuine interest in education is a must. Prior exposure to the sector, whether through edtech, skilling or teaching, is a strong plus.
* You've taken an ambiguous problem, given it structure, and delivered a measurable result, ideally while working across teams you didn't directly manage.
* You're looking to build deep context and grow with us over the long term, not a short stint.

**Location**

Delhi / Gurugram

Know more about Kraftshala's philosophy, culture and investors here.

title: Oracle Fusion - Tax Technology Services II
description:

**add greater impact to clients**
by
**combining technology and tax technical**
resources to uncover insights and smarter solutions for navigating an increasingly complex global environment.
  
  
**Work you’ll do**

As you build your career with us in Oracle within our Tax ERP team, you will be helping our clients to design, develop and implement systems architecture that best meets their business needs, in the rapidly changing tax and legal landscape.

You would be required to coordinate with the UK engagement leaders and clients to implement ERP Tax solutions in Oracle.
  
  
To be successful in this role, you should be able to align the global Tax and Legal landscape with the business’ activities and proposed wider business processes. You will be the lynchpin between the Tax Function and IT Function, ensuring that we build the best Oracle design for Tax for the client. This will require the ability to explain complex terms to a variety of different stakeholders, and in a way that is relevant to each stakeholder group.
  
  
**Your Team**

We are a fast-growing team with a super-growth ambition. We undertake Oracle Cloud implementations in ERP, and these need a combination of Tax knowledge and Oracle solution design capabilities. Tax in Finance Transformations is a key differentiator for our practice globally.
  
  
As a Tax-focused Oracle Consultant, you will be part of the tax workstream on our engagements. You will have plenty of opportunities to work on large-scale projects as part of complex business transformations. You will work with a wide range of colleagues and clients around the world, exposing you to cutting edge tax technology work in a strategic, commercial, and business context. You will find opportunities to apply an impressive range of broad consulting and functional skills that will enhance your career.
  
  
**Key Responsibilities**

* Knowledgeable about the Oracle applications functionality, with experience in Oracle Tax, in Cloud and/or eBS

* Work as part of the project team to analyse the client’s tax and business requirements and build the optimal Oracle Tax design or supplement with the right mix of alternative technology solutions such as indirect tax determination engines, indirect tax compliance technology, or offline processes
* Work alongside the project team to assess the key tax touchpoints across the end-to-end business processes and address the client’s particular tax requirements
* Work with the project team to document new requirements, finalize system design, complete system integration testing and support user acceptance testing
* Able to think logically while solving problems and present clear recommendations to our clients as part of suggested resolution
* Work with Oracle Support to address system issues/ bugs and present a workable solution which addresses the client’s requirement
* Provide regular updates to key stakeholders on product development processes, costs and budgets, achievements against plan etc.
* Mentor and train junior colleagues in the team
* Participate in development and delivery of training sessions either to the client or internally across the team
* Work effectively in diverse teams within an inclusive team culture where people are recognized for their contribution
* Continually research current and emerging functionality (Oracle or others) and propose changes as part of Deloitte’s Oracle offering
* Help build internal efficiencies and accelerators for the proposition

**Required-**

* MBA or Chartered Accountant or bachelor’s in finance/ technology from reputed University with overall experience in Finance, Accounting and/ or Taxation
* Proficient in Oracle Fusion (experience of 4-7 years in Fusion & eBS combined) and/ or Oracle eBusiness Suite for Tax
* Experience in project implementation lifecycle (requirements gathering, design, build, test, go-live and support) with at least 2-3 end-to-end implementations of Oracle ERP for tax
* Client-facing experience required i.e., experience in handling clients on day-to-day basis during requirement gathering to User Acceptance Testing phase
* Basic accounting knowledge
* Ability to understand client requirements, develop and suggest appropriate solution or workarounds in Oracle
* Able to work with Oracle support to flag/fix issues – raising SRs and conducting OWC to explain problems and discuss workarounds
* Proficient in preparing client-ready project deliverables i.e., requirement framework documents, key design decision documents, configuration documents, functional specification documents, test scripts and training guides
* Has knowledge of configuration migration through “Rapid Implementation Spreadsheet” and data migration through Oracle tools like ADFDi, Desktop Integrator, FBDi templates
* Proficient in planning work as per deadline and coordinating with the team to complete work within stipulated deadline
* Comfortable communicating with members from other workstreams and able to collaborate to discuss and test solutions which has cross-workstream dependencies
* Equipped with basic presentation skills, has an analytical approach to issues and able to analyse queries and respond to questions
* Superior verbal and written communication skills in English

**Preferred**

* Some knowledge of SQL script, OTBI and/ or BI Publisher would be preferable
* Experience of other Oracle modules and processes, and knowledge of tax touchpoints in other Oracle modules e.g., Payables, Receivables, Fixed Assets, General Ledger, Consolidation

Deloitte’s purpose is to make an impact that matters for our people, clients, and communities. At Deloitte, purpose is synonymous with how we work every day. It defines who we are. It enables us to leverage different ways of thinking, ideas and perspectives, and bring more creativity and innovation to help solve our clients’ most complex challenges. At Deloitte, professionals have the opportunity to work with some of the best and discover what works best for them. Here, we prioritize professional growth, offering diverse learning and networking opportunities to help accelerate careers and enhance leadership skills. Our state-of-the-art DU: The Leadership Center in India, located in Hyderabad, represents a tangible symbol of our commitment to the holistic growth and development of our people. Explore DU: The Leadership Center in India .
  
  
**Benefits To Help You Thrive**
At Deloitte, we know that great people make a great organization. Our comprehensive rewards program helps us deliver a distinctly Deloitte experience that helps that empowers our professionals to thrive mentally, physically, and financially—and live their purpose. To support our professionals and their loved ones, we offer a broad range of benefits. Eligibility requirements may be based on role, tenure, type of employment and/ or other criteria. This role is particularly well-suited to a self-starting, experienced and motivated Security Delivery Manager, who is commercially-aware, service-oriented and has a proven record of accomplishment in service delivery management, service management and/or customer success.
  
  
The Security Delivery Manager will be the face of Rackspace’s security services, delivering excellent customer service for our customers. Core delivery areas will include service delivery management, operational governance, contractual management, and financial performance.
  
  
**Key Accountabilities**

* Service Delivery Management

+ Oversight of customer onboarding and service transition.

+ Identify and drive opportunities to grow assigned accounts, in collaboration with the wider account team(s)
+ Solicit customer feedback ,testimonials, case studies and references to support both Customer Success and continuous improvement initiatives.

+ Regular engagement with internal service providers
+ Managing the performance of internal teams
+ Driving customer outcomes through service delivery teams
+ Assist in the development of policies and standards with specific regard to service design, service transition, service management and continuous service improvement.

+ Be the subject matter experts for your customers’ security contracts.

+ Ensure the required teams are engaged for key contractual milestones e.g renewals.

+ Monitor and manage the financial performance for your assigned customers contracts.
+ Forecast financial performance throughout the life of the service.
+ Highlight key commercial levers that may affect financial performance to key internal stakeholders.
+ Where possible, identify and deliver financial performance enhancing measures.

**Skills & Experience**

* Should have 5+ years’ experience in service delivery management, service management and/or customer success; ideally within a managed security services (MSSP) environment.
* Experience in monitoring and improving service performance.
* Managing key stakeholders both internal and external, understanding expected outcomes
* Experience of working with public cloud environments such as Azure, AWS and Google Cloud Platform.
* Experience of common service management standards such as ITIL or ISO 20000; as well as service transition.
* Knowledge of common project management practices such as Prince II, Agile and SCRUM; ideally in a DevOps-centric environment.
* Knowledge of security standards (good practice) such as NIST, ISO27001, CIS (Center for Internet Security), OWASP and Cloud Controls Matrix (CCM) etc
* Ideally, you will have experience delivering managed security services such as Attack Surface Management, Managed Detection & Response, Managed Extended Detection & Response and/or Defensive Security Services.
* A highly self-motivated and proactive individual who wants to learn and grow and has an attention to detail.
* Highly organised and detail oriented. Ability to prioritise, multitask and work under pressure.
* An individual who shows a willingness to go above and beyond in delighting the customer.

From edge to core to cloud, we operate the infrastructure, data layer, and software integration to deliver business outcomes with the predictable cost, reliability, security, and compliance that regulated and mission-critical environments demand. Though we’re all different, Rackers thrive through our connection to a central goal: to be a valued member of a winning team on an inspiring mission. We bring our whole selves to work every day. And we embrace the notion that unique perspectives fuel innovation and enable us to best serve our customers and communities around the globe. title: Delivery Lead, Internal Financial Controls
description:
**Delivery Lead – Internal Financial Controls**
Gurugram, Haryana, India
  
  
As a Delivery Lead of Internal Financial Controls, you will be leading the complex IFC framework project workstreams and provide technical and delivery leadership for the design and implementation of sustainable controls across insurance and finance processes.
  
  
The role supports a project to strengthen the design, documentation and sustainability of internal financial control arrangements across insurance and finance processes. The successful candidate will combine risk and controls expertise with sound judgement, credible challenge and clear written communication.
  
  
**What You’ll Be DOING**
What will your essential responsibilities include?
  
  

* Lead complex IFC projects and workstreams, setting delivery approaches and translating programme objectives into executable plans through implementation readiness and handover.
* Own the translation of IFRS financial statement risks into control design principles.
* Facilitate design workshops with Finance, Operations, Technology and process owners to ensure proposed controls address risks and can operate sustainably.
* Provide expert advice and credible challenge in complex situations, influencing senior process owners and escalating material decisions, dependencies and barriers through programme governance.
* Assess the impact of process, system, data and organisational change on control design and implementation sequencing.
* Maintain oversight of delivery plans, milestones, interdependencies, risks and evidence requirements.
* Ensure deliverables are internally consistent and suitable for review by Group IC, external auditors and senior governance forums.
* Coach team members and business stakeholders on risks, control design, evidence standards and methodology application.
* Support programme leadership through status reporting, decision papers and recommendations.
* Understand end-to-end processes, relevant systems, data flows, hand-offs and financial statement impacts before proposing control changes.
* Assess IFRS financial statement risks and translate them into relevant financial statement assertions and process outcomes.
* Design sustainable controls with clear ownership, frequency, evidence, escalation and retention requirements.
* Apply AXA Group Internal Control methodology pragmatically while maintaining alignment with required standards.
* Distinguish control design or coverage issues from documentation enhancements and evidence limitations.
* Produce complete and consistent documentation capable of withstanding Group IC and external auditor scrutiny.
* Support development of standards, training, action tracking and the embedding of enhanced ways of working.
* Provide expert advice in complex situations and communicate difficult concepts in a way that influences stakeholders to adopt appropriate solutions.

You will report to Senior Risk Governance Manager.
  
  
**What You Will BRING**
We’re looking for someone who has these abilities and skills:
  
  
**Required Skills And Abilities**

* Robust understanding of insurance business processes, including underwriting, claims, reinsurance, technical accounting, finance and reporting.
* Ability to understand IFRS financial statement risks and related financial statement assertions.
* Ability to translate risks into precise, practical and testable control objectives.
* Demonstrated experience designing sustainable controls rather than simply documenting existing activities.
* Working knowledge of SOX, ICFR or comparable internal financial control frameworks and risk-to-control mapping.
* Ability to apply group methodology proportionately and pragmatically while documenting judgement.
* Confidence to challenge process owners and senior stakeholders constructively and credibly.
* Excellent written communication skills with the ability to produce concise, evidence-based documentation suitable for governance and assurance review.
* Robust analytical skills, attention to detail and ability to manage dependencies across multiple workstreams.
* Ability to assess financial statement coverage and maintain clear mapping between balances, processes, risks, controls and financial statement assertions.
* Practical understanding of process narratives, walkthroughs, risk and control matrices, design and operating effectiveness testing and quality assurance expectations.
* Awareness of technology dependencies relevant to financial reporting, including critical financial applications, IT general controls, end-user computing and outsourced service providers.
* Ability to maintain consistency across process documentation, testing evidence and risk and control systems with a clear audit trail and disciplined version control.
* Robust change delivery and stakeholder communication skills.

**Desired Skills And Abilities**

* Significant experience in SOX/ICFR consulting, Internal Control, technical accounting, finance transformation or insurance process improvement.
* Experience leading complex internal control, control design or finance change workstreams within a large, regulated or multinational organisation.
* Insurance industry experience supported by a practical understanding of accounting and reporting processes.
* Experience within a Big Four or specialist consulting firm, Internal Control function, technical accounting or finance transformation environment, or as an insurance process SME.
* Relevant professional qualification or equivalent experience in accounting, audit, risk, controls or finance.
* Ability to build effective working relationships across cultures, functions and levels of seniority.
* Demonstrated accountability for delivery, quality of outputs and stakeholder engagement.

**Who WE are**
AXA XL, the P&C and specialty risk division of AXA, is known for solving complex risks. For mid-sized companies, multinationals and even some inspirational individuals we don’t just provide re/insurance, we reinvent it.
  
  
How? By combining a comprehensive and efficient capital platform, data-driven insights, leading technology, and the best talent in an agile and inclusive workspace, empowered to deliver top client service across all our lines of business − property, casualty, professional, financial lines and specialty.
  
  
With an innovative and flexible approach to risk solutions, we partner with those who move the world forward.
  
  
Learn more at axaxl.com
  
  
**What we OFFER**
**Inclusion**
AXA XL is committed to equal employment opportunity and will consider applicants regardless of gender, sexual orientation, age, ethnicity and origins, marital status, religion, disability, or any other protected characteristic. At AXA XL, we know that an inclusive culture and enables business growth and is critical to our success. That’s why we have made a strategic commitment to attract, develop, advance and retain the most inclusive workforce possible, and create a culture where everyone can bring their full selves to work and reach their highest potential.
*It’s about helping one another — and our business — to move forward and succeed.*

* Five Business Resource Groups focused on gender, LGBTQ+, ethnicity and origins, disability and inclusion with 20 Chapters around the globe.
* Robust support for Flexible Working Arrangements
* Enhanced family-friendly leave benefits
* Named to the Diversity Best Practices Index
* Signatory to the UK Women in Finance Charter

Learn more at axaxl.com/about-us/inclusion-and-diversity. AXA XL is an Equal Opportunity Employer.
  
  
**Total Rewards**
AXA XL’s Reward program is designed to take care of what matters most to you, covering the full picture of your health, wellbeing, lifestyle and financial security. It provides competitive compensation and personalized, inclusive benefits that evolve as you do.
  
  
We’re committed to rewarding your contribution for the long term, so you can be your best self today and look forward to the future with confidence.
  
  
**Sustainability**
At AXA XL, Sustainability is integral to our business strategy. In an ever-changing world, AXA XL protects what matters most for our clients and communities. We know that sustainability is at the root of a more resilient future. Our 2023-26 Sustainability strategy, called “Roots of resilience”, focuses on protecting natural ecosystems, addressing climate change, and embedding sustainable practices across our operations.
  
  
**Our Pillars**

* Valuing nature: How we impact nature affects how nature impacts us. Resilient ecosystems - the foundation of a sustainable planet and society – are essential to our future. We’re committed to protecting and restoring nature – from mangrove forests to the bees in our backyard – by increasing biodiversity awareness and inspiring clients and colleagues to put nature at the heart of their plans.
* Addressing climate change: The effects of a changing climate are far-reaching and significant. Unpredictable weather, increasing temperatures, and rising sea levels cause both social inequalities and environmental disruption. We're building a net zero strategy, developing insurance products and services, and mobilizing to advance thought leadership and investment in societal-led solutions.
* Integrating ESG: All companies have a role to play in building a more resilient future. Incorporating ESG considerations into our internal processes and practices builds resilience from the roots of our business. We’re training our colleagues, engaging our external partners, and evolving our sustainability governance and reporting.

title: Project Manager / Senior Project Manager
description:
**About Sirion**
Sirion is the world’s leading
**AI–native Contract Lifecyle Management (CLM) platform**
, transforming the end-to-end contracting journey for enterprises. With Agentic AI at the core, the platform’s extraction, conversational search, and AI-enhanced negotiation capabilities have revolutionized contracting across Fortune 500 companies like IBM, Coca Cola, Citi and GE. With more than 800 employees across the globe, Sirion comprises a team of AI engineers, legal experts and researchers who are working relentlessly to build reliable and trustworthy CLM for businesses of tomorrow. Recognized by Gartner, IDC, and Spend Matters as a consistent CLM leader, Sirion sets the innovation benchmark for the category.
  
  
For more information, visit
**www.sirion.ai**
.
  
  
**Power the Future of AI & Why This Role Matters**
The Partner Success Project Manager (PSPM) is the nerve centre of Sirion's visibility into partner-led implementation health. This role is deliberately not a classical project manager role, instead, the PSPM is a skilled in CLM domain, whose core contribution is ensuring that accurate, timely, and actionable information flows between partner project teams, Sirion's internal functions, and regional leadership.
  
  
The PSPM operates across multiple concurrent engagements, maintaining a real-time pulse on each project's status, proactively identifying patterns that signal risk, and escalating issues before they become crises. This role rewards structured thinking, sharp communication instincts, and the ability to synthesize complexity into clear, decision-ready insight.
  
  
**How You’ll Make an Impact**
**Project Portfolio Tracking & Metrics Oversight**

* Maintain a real-time, accurate view of all active partner-led implementation projects within the assigned portfolio — covering milestone status, go-live dates, open risks, blockers, and key decisions pending.
* Define and track a standardized set of project health metrics across the portfolio, including milestone adherence rate, risk density, open action item age, and escalation frequency.
* Develop and maintain a project health dashboard that provides the Regional Partner Success Leader and Regional Partner Delivery Lead with an at-a-glance view of portfolio status.
* Conduct weekly portfolio sweeps, reviewing updates from partner project teams and flagging discrepancies between reported status and observed delivery signals.

**Proactive Reporting & Stakeholder Communication**

* Prepare and distribute structured project status reports for each active engagement on a regular cadence (weekly / bi-weekly), tailored to the intended audience — ranging from working-level updates to executive summaries.
* Translate raw project data into clear, concise, and visually effective reports that highlight what matters: what is on track, what is at risk, what decisions are needed, and what is overdue.
* Proactively surface emerging risks and issues to the Regional Partner Delivery Lead and Regional Partner Success Leader before they escalate, with supporting context and recommended escalation paths.
* Maintain a rolling decisions log across each engagement, tracking open decisions, owners, and due dates to prevent stalled progress caused by unresolved choices.
* Prepare briefing materials for governance meetings, including project dashboards, risk summaries, and action item trackers.

**Liaison Between Partner Project Teams and Sirion Internal Teams**

* Serve as the coordination point between partner project teams and Sirion's internal functions — including Product Support, Technical Consultants, Enablement, CS Ops, and Legal/Commercial teams — ensuring requests are routed correctly and responses are tracked.
* Chase open actions from Sirion-side stakeholders, ensuring that partner teams are not left waiting for Sirion inputs that are blocking their delivery progress.
* Attend partner project team meetings (as observer or participant) to maintain firsthand visibility into delivery dynamics, emerging risks, and team sentiment.
* Facilitate information flow between the Regional Partner Delivery Lead and the partner's day-to-day delivery team — translating feedback from design reviews and toolgates into clear action items with owners and timelines.
* Coordinate logistics for governance meetings, design review sessions, and toolgate checkpoints — owning agendas, minute-taking, and action item distribution.

**Escalation Management & Issue Triage**

* Maintain a clear escalation log across the portfolio, tracking the nature of each escalation, the escalation path taken, and the resolution timeline.
* Triage incoming issues from partner teams, assessing urgency, determining the appropriate Sirion owner, and ensuring timely acknowledgement and response.
* Follow up on open escalations with relevant Sirion stakeholders until resolution is confirmed and the partner team is updated.
* Monitor recurrence patterns in issues across projects — identifying systemic problems (e.g., product gaps, knowledge deficiencies, process failures) and flagging them for structural remediation.

**Governance Preparation & Cadence Management**

* Prepare materials for all governance cadences — weekly internal team syncs, monthly partner review meetings, and ad-hoc escalation calls — including status decks, risk registers, and action item logs.
* Distribute meeting agendas in advance, capture minutes and action items during sessions, and circulate post-meeting summaries within 24 hours.
* Track action items from governance meetings to closure, chasing owners proactively when deadlines are approaching or missed.
* Maintain a governance calendar for each active engagement, ensuring all cadences are scheduled, attendees are confirmed, and materials are ready on time.

**Skills & Experience You Bring to the Table**

* 10–15 years of experience in project coordination, delivery operations, PMO, or program management support in an enterprise technology environment.
* Experience in CLM domain is mandate
* Proven ability to track and report on multiple concurrent projects simultaneously without losing accuracy or detail.
* Strong written communication skills — able to produce clear, concise status reports, executive summaries, and risk briefs that non-technical stakeholders can act on immediately.
* High attention to detail and comfort working with structured data, spreadsheets, dashboards, and project tracking tools.
* Confident interpersonal skills — able to chase actions and follow up with senior internal and partner stakeholders professionally and persistently.
* Demonstrated ability to identify patterns and signals in project data that indicate emerging risk, before they surface as formal issues.

**Commitment to Diversity and Inclusion**
Sirion is an equal opportunity employer committed to fostering a diverse and inclusive workplace. We do not discriminate based on race, color, gender, religion, national origin, ancestry, age, disability, medical condition, genetic information, military or veteran status, marital status, pregnancy, gender identity, sexual orientation, or any other protected characteristic. Reasonable accommodations are provided as required by law.

title: Manager - Digital transformation (MarTech)
description:
**About OneMetric**
OneMetric (formerly Growtomation) is a revenue enablement partner for B2B teams. We build revenue engines end to end: the systems and data teams run on, the GTM execution that drives demand, closed deals and retention, and the AI that makes the entire engine faster and smarter.
  
  
As an Elite HubSpot Partner, we work with high-growth companies across the US and globally. We start with the real revenue problem, not the tool. While most companies buy technology, GTM execution and AI solutions from separate vendors, we bring them together into one connected revenue engine.
  
  
**Who We're Hiring For**
We're looking for a Manager - Digital transformation (MarTech) who combines marketing operations expertise, technical depth and a strong understanding of how B2B companies run programs such as Account-Based Marketing (ABM) and demand generation.
  
  
This role sits at the intersection of business consulting, marketing technology and revenue operations. You'll work directly with CMOs, CROs, CEOs and other senior stakeholders to understand the business challenges driving their need for technology, translate those challenges into executable game plans, and partner with our technology and delivery teams to bring those solutions to life.
  
  
This isn't a pure consulting or project management role. You'll need to understand how businesses operate, how their marketing and sales programs work, and how the right technology architecture and execution can drive measurable outcomes.
  
  
If you enjoy solving complex business problems, designing connected technology solutions and working closely with senior stakeholders, this role is for you.
  
  
**What You'll Do**

* Business Discovery & Consulting: Lead discovery conversations with CMOs, CROs, CEOs and other stakeholders to understand business goals, GTM motions, operational challenges and the underlying problems driving technology requirements.
* Solution Strategy & Planning: Translate business challenges into clearly defined problem statements, solution approaches and executable game plans, working with Solution Architects and the technology execution team to define scope, priorities and implementation plans.
* MarTech & RevOps Solutions: Design and implement technology setups across Marketing, Sales and Customer Experience (CX), ensuring systems, workflows and data connect to support business objectives.
* ABM & Demand Generation Enablement: Understand how B2B companies plan and execute ABM and demand generation programs, and translate these requirements into scalable technology solutions, workflows and measurement frameworks.
* Technology Stack & Integration: Work hands-on with marketing and revenue technology platforms, including HubSpot, Salesforce, and ABM and intent platforms such as Clay, Demandbase, 6sense, Influ2 and Contact Level, to enable integrated GTM execution.
* Cross-functional Execution: Partner with Solution Architects, Delivery, Customer Success and other internal teams to translate the agreed game plan into technical requirements, implementation roadmaps and measurable outcomes.
* Client & Stakeholder Management: Build trusted relationships with senior client stakeholders, facilitate working sessions, communicate recommendations and manage expectations throughout solution design and delivery.
* Engagement Governance: Maintain visibility into project scope, timelines, dependencies and risks. Identify gaps early, resolve execution blockers and ensure the delivered solution addresses the original business problem.
* Continuous Improvement: Develop discovery frameworks, solution playbooks and repeatable approaches that improve consulting quality, implementation efficiency and client outcomes.

****What success looks like****

* Senior stakeholders trust you to understand their business challenges and recommend solutions beyond simply implementing a tool.
* Business problems are translated into clear, technically feasible execution plans.
* Marketing, Sales and CX technology setups work together to support ABM, demand generation and broader revenue objectives.
* Solution Architects and delivery teams have the business context and requirements needed to execute effectively.
* Client engagements remain aligned with business outcomes, with measurable improvements in operational efficiency, GTM execution and revenue performance.

****What we're looking for****

* Experience: 5–8 years in MarTech, Marketing Operations, Revenue Operations, solutions consulting or technology implementation, ideally within a B2B SaaS, MarTech or consulting environment.
* Business Consulting: Experience conducting discovery with senior stakeholders, identifying root causes and translating business challenges into actionable solution plans.
* MarTech & RevOps Expertise: Strong understanding of how B2B Marketing, Sales and Customer Experience teams operate, including their processes, data flows and technology requirements.
* ABM & Demand Generation: Practical understanding of B2B demand generation and ABM programs, including how technology enables targeting, campaign orchestration, engagement and performance measurement.
* Technology Implementation: Demonstrated experience implementing or architecting technology setups for Marketing, Sales and/or CX teams, including workflows, integrations, data structures and process automation.
* Platform Knowledge: Strong hands-on knowledge of HubSpot and familiarity with tools such as Salesforce, Clay, Demandbase, 6sense, Influ2 and Contact Level. Experience with multiple platforms across the MarTech and ABM ecosystem is a plus.
* Stakeholder Management: Confidence working with CMOs, CROs, CEOs and cross-functional teams, translating between business priorities and technical execution.
* Execution & Ownership: Ability to turn strategy into a practical implementation plan, manage competing priorities and stay accountable for outcomes.
* How you think: Curious about how businesses work, technically sound, commercially aware and comfortable navigating ambiguity without relying on a fixed playbook.

****Why join us****

* Solve real business problems: Work directly with senior leaders to address business challenges through technology and execution.
* Bridge strategy and implementation: Own the journey from discovery and solution planning to implementation alongside experienced technical teams.
* Work across the revenue ecosystem: Gain exposure to leading MarTech, CRM, ABM and AI platforms and complex B2B GTM environments.
* Join a top-tier ecosystem: As a HubSpot Elite Partner, we work with ambitious businesses and a strong technology ecosystem.
* Grow with the business: Be part of a growing team where ownership, problem-solving and impact create opportunities to take on more responsibility.
* Outcomes over hours: We care about the quality of your thinking, what you build and the outcomes you drive.

title: Program & Strategy Manager
description:

Gurugram

(US Business Hours)

Executive Team, Product, Engineering, GTM, Customer Success, Finance

**About Spyne**

Spyne is building the AI operating system for automotive retail. Starting with visual merchandising and expanding into conversational AI, Spyne helps dealerships move inventory faster, respond to buyers instantly, and run more of their operations with AI.

Founded by operators from Amazon, Cox, and OYO, Spyne has grown 30x in under three years and powers dealerships across the US. Its products, Studio AI and Vini AI, are coming together into a full-stack Retail AI platform for modern dealerships.

Spyne is expanding its business and exploring new opportunities to drive growth, build new revenue streams, and strengthen its position in the automotive retail ecosystem. We are looking for a high-agency generalist to work closely with the VP – Business and turn strategic priorities into executable business initiatives.

As a Program & Strategy Manager within the New Business team, you will operate at the intersection of strategy, business operations, analytics, and execution. You will identify opportunities, build business cases, structure programs, and drive cross-functional initiatives from concept to measurable outcomes.

This is a hands-on role for someone who can move seamlessly between a spreadsheet, a strategy discussion, a customer conversation, and an execution plan. You will be expected to bring structure to ambiguity, challenge assumptions with data, and take ownership of getting things done.

**What You'll Do**

* **Drive new business initiatives:**

* **Build business cases and financial models:**
  Conduct market sizing, competitive analysis, pricing research, unit economics, and financial modelling to evaluate opportunities and support investment decisions.
* **Enable business growth:**
  Work with business leaders to identify growth levers, improve commercial effectiveness, evaluate customer segments, and develop strategies to improve revenue, margins, and retention.
* **Drive data-backed decision-making:**
  Build analytical frameworks, dashboards, and business reviews to track performance, identify gaps, and translate insights into actionable recommendations.
* **Explore partnerships and new markets:**
  Evaluate strategic partnerships, vendor opportunities, distribution models, and market-entry strategies that can accelerate business growth.
* **Build with AI and automation:**
  Use tools such as ChatGPT, Claude, Cursor, and other AI-powered platforms to automate workflows, analyse data, prototype solutions, and improve execution speed.
* **Create executive-ready communication:**
  Develop strategy documents, business reviews, presentations, and decision memos that communicate complex problems and recommendations clearly to senior leadership.
* **Build scalable operating mechanisms:**
  Establish processes, governance frameworks, and performance metrics that improve execution discipline and help new initiatives scale efficiently.

**Who Will Do Well Here**

* **Experience:**
  3–6 years in management consulting (MBB or equivalent), corporate strategy, business operations, a high-growth startup, or a founder's/business office role.
* **Strong business acumen:**
  Ability to understand business models, identify growth opportunities, and connect strategic decisions to commercial outcomes.
* **Analytical rigour:**
  Strong Excel/Google Sheets skills, financial modelling, market research, and the ability to build and defend assumptions with data.
* **End-to-end ownership:**
  Demonstrated experience taking a project or initiative from problem definition through execution and measurable results, rather than stopping at recommendations.
* **Cross-functional leadership:**
  Ability to influence stakeholders across teams, manage competing priorities, and drive outcomes without relying solely on formal authority.
* **AI-first mindset:**
  Hands-on experience using AI tools to improve productivity, automate work, analyse information, or build functional prototypes.
* **Structured communication:**
  Strong written and verbal communication skills, with the ability to distil complex analysis into clear recommendations and actionable plans.
* **Comfort with ambiguity:**
  A proactive, resourceful approach to solving open-ended problems in a fast-moving environment.
* **Commercial orientation:**
  Ability to balance strategic thinking with practical considerations such as revenue potential, cost, feasibility, and time to impact.

**Why This Role?**

* **Build what's next:**
  Work on new business opportunities that can meaningfully shape Spyne's next phase of growth.
* **High-impact ownership:**
  Take responsibility for important business initiatives, with direct visibility into decisions and outcomes.
* **Work across the business:**
  Gain exposure to strategy, commercial operations, product, finance, partnerships, and market expansion.
* **Learn by executing:**
  Move beyond presentations and recommendations to build, launch, and scale real business initiatives.
* **Accelerate your growth:**
  Develop the strategic, analytical, and execution capabilities required to grow into business leadership, general management, or strategy and operations roles.

**If you enjoy solving ambiguous business problems, building structured plans from scratch, and turning ideas into measurable outcomes, this role offers the opportunity to help shape Spyne's next chapter of growth.**

title: Senior Manager - Risk Management (Merchant Operations)
description:
**Job Description**
**You Lead the Way. We’ve Got Your Back.**
At American Express, our culture is built on a long history of innovation, shared values and Leadership Behaviours, and an unwavering commitment to back our customers, communities, and colleagues. We operate with a strong risk mindset while continuously improving how we serve merchants and manage critical business processes.
  
  
Here, your voice and ideas matter, your work makes an impact, and together we help define the future of American Express.
  
  
**How Will You Make Impact In This Role.**
Merchant Account Operations & Resilience supports critical merchant-data, operational-risk, remediation, and transformation activities. Accurate merchant data and effective operational processes are essential to pricing, servicing, risk management, reporting, and decision-making.
  
  
The Senior Manager, Risk Management will lead a team focused on
**Merchant Hierarchy process transformation, enterprise remediation, and strategic program delivery**
.
  
  
The role will identify opportunities to simplify and uplift hierarchy review processes using AI, automation, analytics, workflow solutions, and operating-model improvements. It will also lead or support complex remediation and cross-functional programs by bringing strong governance, execution discipline, change management, and leadership visibility.
  
  
The successful candidate will combine operational experience, program leadership, analytical fluency, transformation thinking, stakeholder management and people leadership. The role will partner closely with teams responsible for ongoing Merchant Hierarchy governance and day-to-day hierarchy reviews.
  
  
**Responsibilities**
**Key Responsibilities**
**Drive Merchant Hierarchy process transformation**

* Develop and execute a prioritized roadmap to simplify, standardize, automate, and modernize Merchant Hierarchy review processes in partnership with the teams responsible for governance and operational delivery.
* Translate operational pain points into structured improvement opportunities that reduce manual effort, improve turnaround times and data quality, strengthen controls, and create scalable capabilities.
* Coordinate cross-functional partners, dependencies, decisions, operating-model changes, and adoption activities required to deliver sustainable enterprise-wide process uplift.

**Advance AI, automation, and analytics**

* Identify and prioritize opportunities to use AI, automation, analytics, workflow tools, external data, and emerging technologies to improve operational processes and outcomes.
* Partner with Product, Technology, Analytics, and Operations teams to evaluate solutions and progress them from problem definition through implementation, adoption, and benefits measurement.
* Ensure new capabilities address clear business needs and are supported by appropriate data, controls, ownership, governance, and performance monitoring.

**Lead remediation and strategic program execution**

**Strengthen stakeholder partnerships and team effectiveness**

* Lead and develop a high-performing team with strong capabilities across program governance, remediation, operational transformation, analytics, automation, and stakeholder management.

**Qualifications**
**Minimum Qualifications:**

* Experience leading complex, cross-functional programs in a global or highly matrixed organization.
* Strong program-governance capability across planning, ownership, dependencies, risk management, escalation, and outcome measurement.
* Experience within operations, servicing, risk, controls, remediation, transformation, or another operationally intensive environment.

* Demonstrated ability to collaborate and influence senior partners without direct authority.
* Proven people-leadership experience, including setting direction, coaching talent, and building team capability.
* Strong proficiency in Microsoft Excel and PowerPoint.

**Preferred Qualifications**

* Experience within merchant operations, onboarding, account maintenance, servicing, pricing, payments, or a related function.
* Knowledge of merchant account structures, hierarchy processes, data enrichment, or Know Your Customer processes.
* Experience delivering operational transformation, AI, automation, workflow, analytics, or technology-enabled process improvements.
* Experience supporting operational-risk events, corrective-action plans, remediation, or control-enhancement programs.
* Familiarity with analytical and visualization tools such as SQL, Python, Tableau, Power BI, or comparable platforms.
* Experience working across multiple markets or global teams.

**Critical Factors To Success**

* Apply strong program governance and execution discipline across transformation and remediation initiatives.
* Convert AI, automation, analytics, and process-improvement opportunities into scalable and sustainable operational capabilities.
* Deliver measurable improvements in efficiency, data quality, controls, and operational outcomes.
* Bring structure, transparency, and accountability to complex cross-functional programs.
* Build trusted partnerships and influence decisions without direct authority.

**Leadership Behaviors**
The successful candidate should consistently demonstrate the American Express Leadership Behaviours by:
  
  

* Defining What Winning Looks Like: Establishing clear priorities, outcomes, delivery plans, and success measures.
* Putting Enterprise Thinking First: Balancing business value, merchant and customer outcomes, colleague impact, operational feasibility, and the control environment.
* Making Collaboration Essential: Building trusted partnerships while maintaining clarity on ownership, accountability, and decision rights.
* Seeking and Providing Coaching and Feedback: Strengthening team capability through regular, candid, and actionable development conversations.
* Communicating Frequently, Candidly, and Clearly: Providing transparent information on progress, risks, issues, dependencies, benefits, and required actions.
* Making Decisions Quickly and Effectively: Evaluating alternatives and balancing speed, business value, data, implementation effort, risk, and sustainable outcomes.

* Leading with a Digital and Improvement Mindset: Challenging how work is performed and identifying scalable opportunities to simplify, automate, and improve operational outcomes.

**About Us**
At American Express, our culture is built on a 175-year history of innovation, shared values and Leadership Behaviors, and an unwavering commitment to back our customers, communities, and colleagues. From delivering differentiated products to providing world-class customer service, we operate with a strong risk mindset, ensuring we continue to uphold our brand promise of trust, security, and service.

Here, your voice and ideas matter, your work makes an impact, and together, you will help us define the future of American Express.

We back you with benefits that support your holistic well-being so you can be and deliver your best. This means caring for you and your loved ones' physical, financial, and mental health, as well as providing the flexibility you need to thrive personally and professionally:
