title: Program Manager, BXT-SE
description:
**Description**
Join Amazon’s Employee Services team and help make a difference for all Amazonians! We are seeking an experienced Program Manager to own and oversee the operations of Amazon's Medical Clinics across 40+ office locations in India. In this high-impact role, you will be responsible for ensuring continuous, uninterrupted availability of clinical services — including on-site medicines and qualified nursing staff — at every clinic, at all times. You will manage vendor and staff transitions seamlessly, drive standardization and compliance across sites, and partner with a broad set of stakeholders spanning Procurement, GREF (Global Real Estate & Facilities), clinical teams, local site leaders, and HR partners. This is a role for a self-starter who thrives on operational excellence, ambiguity, and scaling employee health services across a large, geographically distributed footprint.
  
  
Note - This is a contract only role.
  
  
Key job responsibilities
  
  
Clinic Operations Oversight: Own end-to-end operations of medical clinics across 40+ Amazon office locations in India, ensuring consistent service quality, availability, and compliance with applicable regulations and Amazon standards.
  
  
Continuity of Care: Guarantee uninterrupted availability of essential medicines, medical supplies, and nursing/clinical staff at all clinics at all times, including proactive planning for demand, stock-outs, and coverage gaps.
  
  
Transition & Change Management: Plan and manage all staff and vendor transitions (onboarding, offboarding, replacements, contract changes) with zero disruption to clinic availability or employee experience.
  
  
Vendor Management: Partner with Procurement to select, onboard, and govern clinical service and pharmacy vendors; monitor SLAs, service quality, and contractual compliance, and drive corrective action where needed.
  
  
Stakeholder Collaboration: Work cross-functionally with Procurement, GREF, clinical teams, local site leaders, and HR partners to align on clinic setup, facilities readiness, staffing, and service delivery.
  
  
Standardization & Scale: Develop and implement standardized processes, playbooks, and mechanisms to ensure consistent clinic operations across all locations, and to scale efficiently as the footprint grows.
  
  
Compliance & Risk: Ensure clinics operate in accordance with local statutory, medical, and licensing requirements; identify and mitigate operational and clinical risks.
  
  
Metrics & Reporting: Define, track, and report on key operational metrics (availability, staffing coverage, medicine stock levels, incident response, employee utilization/satisfaction) and drive data-informed improvements.
  
  
Escalation Management: Serve as the primary escalation point for clinic-related operational issues, resolving them promptly and implementing preventive measures.
  
  
A day in the life
  
  
You start your day by reviewing the operational dashboard across all 40+ clinics — checking overnight incidents, medicine stock levels, and any staffing gaps flagged by site teams. You spot that a clinic in Hyderabad has a nurse on unplanned leave; you coordinate with the vendor and HR partner to arrange immediate backup coverage so there's no service interruption.
  
  
Work with Procurement on any contractual needs, a pharmacy vendor and align on SLAs for medicine replenishment timelines. You then sync with GREF on facilities readiness for clinic, ensuring the spaces meet clinical requirements and licensing standards.
  
  
meet with the clinical team to review a new standardized triage protocol, connect with a local site leader across India who have concerns about clinic timings/availability/Medicines. You update your weekly metrics report — tracking availability, staffing coverage, and stock.
  
  
You wrap up by documenting a transition plan for an upcoming vendor change at three sites, ensuring a smooth handover with no disruption to employees relying on the clinics.
  
  
Note - This is a contract only role.
  
  
**About The Team**
Team administers benefits for 58 countries and supports ~1.5MM employees (997K US and 522K non-US). The major service areas include: (1) benefits administrative services, (2) MyBenefits product support, (3) shared quality services; (4) Employee Investment Services (EIS) administration, (5) U.S. regulatory work, (6) benefits reconciliation and (7) US Benefit services
  
  
Note - This is a contract only role.
  
  
**Basic Qualifications**

* Bachelor's degree or above
* 4+ years of program or project management experience
* Knowledge of Microsoft Office products and applications

**Preferred Qualifications**

* Experience in conducting investigative work, including claimant, witness, and target employee interviews, investigative data analysis, and production of investigative documentation
* Experience developing policies and supporting documentation
* Experience managing confidential and sensitive employee information and adherence to strict confidentiality standards

title: Clinical Trial Project Manager
description:
We are seeking an experienced
**Clinical Trial Project Manager (CPM)**
to lead cross-functional study teams in the execution of Phase I–IV clinical trials. The CPM is responsible for the overall operational management, planning, implementation, and close-out of clinical studies according to defined scope, timeline, budget, and regulatory standards. This role acts as the central hub of communication between clinical study teams, Contract Research Organizations (CROs), vendors, investigators, and regulatory authorities to ensure high-quality data integrity and participant safety.

Key Responsibilities1. Project Management & Trial Leadership

* Drive the full lifecycle of clinical trials from study start-up through database lock, clinical study report (CSR) completion, and trial close-out.
* Develop, maintain, and execute comprehensive
  **Project Management Plans (PMP)**
  , cross-functional timelines, resource allocation, and milestone schedules.
* Lead cross-functional study team meetings (e.g., Clinical Research Associates, Data Managers, Biostatisticians, Medical Writers) to ensure operational alignment.
* Monitor project status against key performance indicators (KPIs) and drive proactive risk mitigation and contingency planning.

2. Vendor & Site Management

* Oversee selection, contract negotiation, onboarding, and ongoing performance management of third-party vendors and CROs.
* Coordinate site feasibility, selection, activation, and investigator meetings alongside clinical site monitoring teams.
* Manage vendor Service Level Agreements (SLAs) and track performance metrics to ensure contractual deliverables are met on time.

3. Financial & Resource Management

* Manage multi-million dollar trial budgets, accurately track monthly project accruals, forecast expenditures, and review vendor invoices.
* Identify scope changes and steward the evaluation, negotiation, and implementation of vendor change orders.

4. Quality Assurance, Compliance & Inspection Readiness

* Ensure all trial activities comply with ICH-GCP, FDA/EMA regulations, local regulatory requirements, and company Standard Operating Procedures (SOPs).
* Maintain continuously updated Trial Master Files (TMF/eTMF) to preserve inspection readiness throughout the trial lifecycle.
* Manage protocol deviations, track Corrective and Preventive Action (CAPA) plans, and support internal audits or regulatory inspections.

Requirements & QualificationsEducation & Experience

* **Bachelor’s Degree**
  in Life Sciences, Nursing, Pharmacy, Healthcare Administration, or related scientific discipline (Master’s or PharmD preferred).
* **4–6+ years**
  of direct experience in clinical trial operations within a CRO, biotechnology, or pharmaceutical company.
* Minimum
  **2+ years**
  in a project management or trial management leadership capacity.
* Strong track record of managing multi-center or global Phase II–III clinical studies.

**About iFOREST**

iFOREST is an independent, not-for-profit research and innovation organisation established in 2019. Our mission is to identify, promote and scale up solutions for critical environment-development challenges in India and other developing regions across Asia and Africa.

We focus on regional priorities to accelerate environmental action at the sub-national level, while influencing national policies and plans to support these efforts. By drawing on our resources and expertise, we aim to address regional needs, strengthen national action and contribute to global solutions.

Our work involves independent, evidence-based research, developing innovative solutions, convening stakeholders to build consensus, and partnering with think tanks, civil society organisations, government agencies, philanthropies and industry leaders.

**The Clean Energy Programme**

The iFOREST Clean Energy Programme focuses on accelerating equitable renewable energy growth in India by supporting clean energy deployment in underserved states, especially in the eastern and northeastern regions.

The programme supports state governments through policy and regulatory reform, implementation strategies, techno-economic assessments, investment facilitation and institutional capacity building. Its focus states include Odisha, Assam, Jharkhand, Chhattisgarh, West Bengal and Uttar Pradesh. The work prioritises land-neutral technologies such as floating solar, agri-PV, rooftop solar, storage and green hydrogen.

The Programme Lead / Senior Programme Associate will drive research, policy advisory and implementation activities under the Clean Energy Programme. The Programme Lead will anchor delivery of the programme, working closely with the Director across research, engagement, technical support and implementation, and will manage teams and workstreams. The Senior Programme Associate will lead the execution of key assignments, particularly on industrial renewable energy adoption, demand aggregation and investment mobilisation in Uttar Pradesh and other priority states.

Around 10 years of relevant experience for the Programme Lead, and 5–7 years for the Senior Programme Associate, in research, strategy consulting, advisory, programme implementation or policy engagement focused on the renewable energy sector.

title: HVDC Project Director
description:
**Job Description Summary**
The Project Director – HVDC is responsible for the overall leadership and successful execution of major HVDC transmission projects within GE Vernova Grid Solutions. The role has full accountability for project performance across EHS, Quality, Schedule, Cost, Cash, Risk, Contract Management, and Customer Satisfaction.
  
  
As a senior leader within the project organization, the Project Director drives execution excellence across the full project lifecycle, from contract handover through engineering, procurement, manufacturing, construction, commissioning, and final acceptance. This role ensures strong alignment with GE Vernova’s operational rigor, compliance standards, and customer commitments while leading complex, cross-functional, and international project teams.
  
  
The Project Director plays a critical role in delivering strategic grid infrastructure projects that support the energy transition, power system reliability, and grid modernization.
  
  
**Job Description**
**Key Responsibilities**

* Project Ownership and Execution Leadership
* Lead the end-to-end execution of large and complex HVDC projects in accordance with contractual obligations and GE Vernova business objectives.
* Own overall project results including safety, quality, on-time delivery, cost performance, cash collection, margin protection, and customer satisfaction.
* Define and implement the project execution strategy, governance model, and operating rhythm.
* Ensure disciplined execution across all project phases including engineering, sourcing, manufacturing, transport, site activities, erection, commissioning, and handover.
* Drive execution excellence through structured reviews, clear accountability, and proactive issue resolution.
* Customer and Stakeholder Leadership
* Act as the senior point of contact for the customer on all project execution matters.
* Build strong and trusted customer relationships, ensuring transparent communication and effective escalation management.
* Lead executive customer reviews, project governance meetings, and strategic discussions.
* Manage interfaces with utilities, TSOs, consortium partners, subcontractors, suppliers, local authorities, and other external stakeholders.
* Represent GE Vernova professionally in high-impact customer and partner engagements.
* Commercial, Financial, and Contractual Management
* Own project financial performance including revenue, profitability, cost control, billing milestones, cash flow, and forecast accuracy.
* Ensure effective management of project changes, claims, variation orders, contingencies, and contractual risks.
* Partner closely with finance, legal, commercial, and contract management teams to protect GE Vernova’s interests and optimize project outcomes.
* Drive strong project review discipline, including estimate-at-completion, risk exposure, cash forecasting, and recovery planning where required.
* Ensure compliance with contractual obligations, governance requirements, and internal approval processes.
* Risk and Opportunity Management
* Lead project risk and opportunity management with a proactive and data-driven approach.
* Ensure identification, assessment, mitigation, and monitoring of key technical, operational, commercial, and schedule risks.
* Direct the implementation of mitigation and recovery plans for critical project issues.
* Escalate significant risks and execution challenges in a timely and structured manner.
* Promote a culture of anticipation, transparency, and ownership across the project team.
* Cross-Functional Integration
* Lead a multidisciplinary project team across engineering, project management, sourcing, logistics, manufacturing, construction, commissioning, finance, contract management, quality, and EHS.
* Ensure strong integration and alignment between global and regional teams involved in project delivery.
* Drive effective interface management across internal functions, subcontractors, and customer organizations.
* Ensure smooth coordination between project execution and key support functions to maintain delivery performance.
* Foster collaboration across matrixed and geographically dispersed teams.
* EHS, Quality, and Compliance
* Champion GE Vernova’s safety-first culture and ensure EHS is embedded in all project activities.
* Drive compliance with GE Vernova standards, customer requirements, applicable regulations, and industry codes.
* Ensure robust quality planning, assurance, and execution across all project phases.
* Promote a culture of integrity, compliance, and operational discipline.
* Ensure lessons learned, quality feedback, and continuous improvement actions are captured and applied.
* Governance, Reviews, and Operational Rigor
* Establish strong project governance and ensure regular operating reviews, performance tracking, and transparent reporting.
* Lead internal project reviews with business leadership and provide clear visibility on performance, risks, actions, and decisions needed.
* Use project controls and KPIs to drive execution rigor and informed decision-making.
* Ensure timely and accurate reporting of schedule, cost, risk, progress, and cash metrics.
* Support implementation of standard work, best practices, and continuous improvement initiatives across Grid Solutions project execution.
* Team Leadership and Capability Building
* Lead, develop, and inspire high-performing project teams in a global matrix environment.
* Set clear expectations for accountability, execution discipline, customer focus, and teamwork.
* Coach senior project leaders and functional managers to strengthen project execution capability.
* Build an inclusive, performance-oriented culture aligned with GE Vernova values and leadership expectations.
* Support talent development, succession planning, and knowledge transfer across the organization.

**Required Qualifications**

* Bachelor’s degree in Electrical Engineering, Power Systems Engineering, Mechanical Engineering, Civil Engineering, or related technical discipline.
* Typically 15+ years of experience in project execution, with substantial leadership responsibility in major transmission or energy infrastructure projects.
* Proven record of delivering large and complex projects involving multiple interfaces, international teams, and demanding customer requirements.
* Prior success in senior project leadership roles such as Project Director, Program Director, Senior Project Manager, or Head of Project Execution.
* Significant project leadership experience in HVDC, FACTS, substations, transmission, grid systems, or large EPC infrastructure projects.
* Project Management certification such as PMP, IPMA, or equivalent will be an added advantage.
* Experience working in multinational project environments and matrix organizations.
* Experience with consortium projects, utility customers, TSOs, and complex EPC contract models.
* Familiarity with GE Vernova or comparable governance, project controls, and compliance frameworks is an advantage.

**Technical And Leadership Skills**

* Deep understanding of HVDC project delivery, transmission technologies, and complex grid infrastructure execution.
* Strong financial, commercial, and contractual management capability.
* Executive-level customer engagement and stakeholder management skills.
* Strong project governance, planning, and performance management capability.
* Ability to lead in complex, ambiguous, and fast-changing project environments.
* Strong communication, negotiation, influencing, and decision-making skills.
* Ability to drive accountability and execution across matrixed teams.
* High level of operational rigor and results orientation.

**Success Measures**

* Strong EHS performance across all project phases
* Delivery of HVDC projects in line with committed schedule, budget, quality, and cash targets
* Effective management of risk, opportunities, claims, and contract obligations
* Positive customer feedback and strong relationship outcomes
* Robust governance, forecasting accuracy, and execution transparency
* High-performing, engaged, and accountable project teams
* Successful project commissioning, acceptance, and closeout

title: Construction Manager
description:
Hi,

Greetings from Peoplefy Infosolutions !!!

We are hiring for one of our reputed client based in
**Noida/ Pune/ Navi Mumbai**
.

We are looking for candidates with 14+ years of experience.

**Education: B.E./ B. Tech (Electrical/Mechanical)**

**Job Description:**

The Construction Manager will take the ownership of leading the project from inception till handover. He / She would lead a team of resources from varied technical backgrounds and also a team of other project stakeholders that would include architects, vendors, and contractors and manage the project throughout the complete lifecycle through seamless delivery of an end to end Project Management scope.

**Key Responsibilities**

**1. Project Charter**

* Understand the project requirements from the client and develop a detailed Project Charter that would include a broad strategy for delivering the Project Management Scope, identification of key stakeholders who would be required from the project inception till closure, define the procurement plan that is merged with the baseline schedule and spell out critical milestones that would be the guiding factor for successful project completion
* Align all the key stakeholders with the Charter and prepare a draft Project Execution Plan
* Collaborate with clients team and prepare a project matrix clearly defining the process for flow of information and internal approval process

**2. Project Planning**

* Provide inputs with regards to sequencing of activities in the master schedule to include design reviews, drawing delivery schedule, procurement, equipment delivery and installation, construction sequencing and testing & commissioning plans
* Guide the project Planning Manager / Engineer in finalizing the Master Schedule in the inception stage (after acceptance of Project Charter) and then finalizing the detailed project schedule in the final design concept stage (before commencement of Procurement activities)

**3. High level budgeting and costing**

* Develop high level budget based on available details and with support from planning, civil and MEP teams during the inception stage and update the costing during different stages of the project ie from concept stage to vendor / supplier finalization.
* Establish unit rates for materials and labor based on current market data and historical benchmarks
* Regularly update cost database to reflect trends and regional price fluctuations

**4. Tendering & Bid Support**

* Lead the tendering process by developing contractor / subcontractor scopes, bid assumptions, relevant tender clauses and risk allowances
* Analyze tender documents, drawings, and specifications to determine labor, material, and equipment requirements
* Suggest clients on tender clarifications, tender event schedule and evaluate technical submissions by vendors / suppliers in line with clients requirements
* Carry out vendor / supplier evaluation (with support from project teams) with respect to technical details and project delivery
* Take ownership of the Tender Event Schedule right up to the award of contract

**5**
.
**Value Engineering & Cost Optimization**

* Plan for Value Engineering workshop during the concept design and then before design finalization stage of the project
* Identify opportunities to reduce cost by suggesting alternate materials, or design modifications.
* Guide the planning and design management teams to update on schedule, delivery status and change management

**6. Coordination & Collaboration**

* Coordinate with team members during all the stages of the project to ensure plans are updated as per project status
* Proactively involve in the Risk Management scope and suggest mitigation measures as and when a risk is identified so as to keep the project timelines and cost intact
* Collaborate with the clients team through regular exchange of information, periodic updates and meetings, keeping them informed about the progress at different stages of the project and raising red flags as and when attention is required that needs early resolution
* Coordinate with design teams to ensure design / drawing delivery is as per agreed schedule and support the team in case their delivery is getting affected due to inputs and approvals from required stakeholders
* Collaborate with construction contractor right from their onboarding stage and through the construction process for a seamless execution as per plan, desired quality standards and within assigned project budget
* Conduct regular reviews with key stakeholders to ensure risks are identified proactively and mitigated, project delivery plans are intact and identification of bottlenecks and early resolution
* Conduct site visits, resolve RFIs, and ensure design intent during construction
* Provide support to the respective teams in Factory Acceptance Tests (FAT) and Site Acceptance Tests (SAT) if these activities are part of our scope

**7. Change Management**

* Prepare a detailed change management process that is defined at the beginning of the project, approved by client and accepted by all stakeholders
* Ensure the updates on change management are included as part of periodic report to the client
* Review the changes that arise during different project stages with regards to the impact on cost, quality and timelines and ensure if the impact can be minimized through any value engineering initiative before it is submitted for approval to the client

**8. Contract Administration**

* Ensure a draft contract is prepared as per project requirement and shared with the clients team for their approval
* Study and prepare a draft response to any queries that arise from contractor / vendor / suppliers with regards to understanding of the contract as well as during their delivery period
* Support the clients team in case of any legal issues or arbitrations raised by contractor / vendor / suppliers during their respective contract periods and help in preparing draft responses in line with related contract clause

**9.**
**Project Handover and Closeout**

* Coordinate with Design, Contractor and Vendor / Supplier teams with regards to their respective project timelines and ensure timely closure of their scope as per agreed timelines
* Support project teams to develop a detailed Handover Document to include financial closure that is reviewed and checked in line with the project cost to completion (as per updates during the project life-cycle)

**10. Continuous Improvement**

* Coordinate with all stakeholders to capture lessons learnt and review operational feedback that can be included as a process / project delivery improvement plan for subsequent projects

**Interested candidates for above position kindly share your CVs on-**

***sneh.ne@peoplefy.com***

Thank you,

Sneh

* Coordinate guest house accommodation, electricity bills, rent payments, transportation, vehicle deployment, and other site-related expenses.

* Coordinate with service providers, landlords, transport vendors, and facility management teams to resolve administrative issues.

* Prepare daily, weekly, and monthly MIS reports related to billing, expenses, manpower, vendor payments, and pending activities.
* Maintain systematic physical and digital records of project correspondence, approvals, invoices, and commercial documents.
* Regularly update billing trackers, payment trackers, expense statements, and document registers.
* Assist the Project Manager in preparing project progress reports, commercial summaries, and management updates.
* Ensure timely submission of required reports to Head Office and concerned departments.
* Maintain proper records for internal reviews, audits, and management reporting.

**D. Coordination and Follow-up**

* Coordinate with Project Managers, Site Engineers, Procurement, Stores, Finance, HR, Commercial, and Head Office teams.
* Follow up on pending bills, payment approvals, vendor documentation, and administrative requirements.
* Ensure timely escalation of unresolved billing, documentation, and administration issues that may affect project progress.

* Ensure effective communication between the project site and Head Office for smooth project operations.

* Graduate in Commerce (B.Com), Business Administration (BBA), or any relevant discipline.

description:

Ten 11 Hospitality Private Limited is a leading hospitality company operating premium executive lounges across airports and railway stations in India. As we continue to expand our footprint, we are looking for an experienced **Project Manager** to lead and coordinate new lounge development, fitout projects, renovations, and engineering execution across multiple locations.

**About the Role**

We are seeking a highly analytical, self-driven, and technically adept Project Manager to independently lead and execute fitout projects for our luxury transit lounges across India. Operating as a oneperson department, this individual will hold 100% accountability for taking projects from raw site handover to operational go-live. You will act as the single bridge between external Architects, MEP Consultants, Contractors, Railway/Transit Authorities, and our internal leadership.

**This is a travel-heavy, execution-focused role requiring rigorous technical control over Auto CAD drawings, BOQs, vendor quotations, project paperwork, and milestone timelines. REQUIRED SKILLS & TECHNICAL COMPETENCIES**

* Advanced AutoCAD Proficiency: Ability to independently open, edit, verify dimensions, overlay MEP layers, and audit CAD files.
* GANTT Chart & Project Tracking: Expertise in MS Project, Primavera, or advanced Excel GANTT tracking tools.
* BOQ & Commercial Acumen: High numerical accuracy to spot discrepancy in line items, unit rates, material specifications, and contractor claims.
* Documentation Rigor: Meticulous approach to maintaining project files, RA bill measurement sheets, work orders, change orders, and site delay logs.
* Vendor & Stakeholder Management: Firm, assertive communication style to manage tough contractors, architects, and site workers independently.
* Adaptability & High Mobility: Willingness to travel at short notice to project sites across India and work within strict nightblock windows often required at railway

**KEY RESPONSIBILITIES**

* AutoCAD Review, Drawing Validation & Technical Coordination
* Drawing Audits: Thoroughly review, validate, and mark up architectural, interior layout, elevation, and MEP (Mechanical, Electrical, Plumbing, HVAC) drawings in AutoCAD.
* Site Feasibility: Conduct preliminary site surveys at railway stations/transit hubs across India to verify structural feasibility, service connection points (water, drainage, power loads), and space constraints.
* Architect & Engineer Management: Coordinate directly with external architectural firms, structural consultants, and MEP engineers to ensure design intent matches commercial viability and operational workflows.
* BOQ Scrutiny, Quotation Analysis & Cost Control
* BOQ Auditing: Rigorously scrutinize Bills of Quantities (BOQs) provided by architects and contractors to prevent overestimation, duplicate line items, or inflated rates.
* Vendor Quotation Analysis: Prepare comparative statement sheets (Csheets) analyzing contractor and vendor quotes (civil, interior, HVAC, kitchen equipment, electrical, plumbing).
* Cost Negotiation: Drive aggressive value engineering and rate negotiations with vendors and general contractors to protect project budgets without compromising quality.
* Project Scheduling & Tracking (GANTT Analysis)
* Master Project Timelines: Develop and track master project schedules using GANTT charts (MS Project / Primavera / Excel) for every active lounge site.
* Critical Path Management: Monitor lead times for critical longlead items (commercial kitchen equipment, HVAC chillers, specialized lighting) to prevent fitout delays.
* Milestone Reporting: Provide weekly Scurve charts, milestone completion reports, and delayvariance analyses to executive leadership (COO/Directors).
* Paperwork, Documentation & Statutory Approvals
* Contract & Paperwork Management: Draft and finalize vendor work orders, purchase orders, scopeofwork (SOW) documents, payment milestone terms, and SLA agreements.
* Measurement & Billing Audit: Conduct physical site verification of work completed before authorizing contractor running bills (RA Bills) and final handovers.
* Authority Approvals: Manage sitelevel paperwork, safety clearances, work permits, and coordination required by Railway/Station authorities, IRCTC, or airport operators.
* OnSite Supervision & Contractor Quality Control (PanIndia Travel)
* Frequent Site Inspections: Travel extensively to active sites across North, West, and South India to supervise civil, interior, and MEP execution quality.
* Snagging & Handover: Conduct multipoint snag lists before operational handover to the Lounge Manager and ensure rectifications are completed within target windows.

**Experience & Qualifications**

* **Bachelor’s Degree / Diploma in Civil Engineering OR Architecture (B.Arch).**
* **Certification in Project Management (PMP / CAPM) or MS Project is a strong advantage.**
* **Experience: 6 to 10 years of hands-on experience in interior fit-out project management.**
* **Industry Background: Must have experience in Retail Store Expansion, Hotel Fit-outs, Restaurant/QSR Chains, Commercial Interiors, or Airport/Railway Lounge Construction.**
* **Execution Style: Demonstrated track record of operating as an independent project lead / sole project coordinator.**

**Required Skills**

* GANTT Chart & Project Tracking: Expertise in MS Project, Primavera, or advanced Excel GANTT tracking tools.

* Strong understanding of **architectural drawings, working drawings, and shop drawings**.
* SHOULD BE A MULTI TASKER

title: Strategy Associate- Clinical
description:
Strategy Associate – Clinical Services,

Research & Evaluation

Department: CEO’s Office

Location: Kolkata, West Bengal

Employment Type: Full-Time

Experience: Minimum 5 years

Compensation: Up to ₹10 LPA

Qualification: MA/MSc in Psychology

Role Overview

India Autism Center (IAC) is building an integrated ecosystem of clinical services, vocational

development, research, training, and residential living for individuals on the autism spectrum

and their families.

We are looking for a Strategy Associate with a background in psychology, research, and

programme evaluation to strengthen strategic performance monitoring across IAC, with a

specialist focus on clinical services, vocational programmes, the training academy, learning and

development, and research.

You will play a key role in evaluating programme effectiveness, service quality, implementation

progress, resource utilisation, and outcomes. The role will combine quantitative and qualitative

analysis with structured performance reviews to identify gaps, assess underlying causes,

recommend improvements, and monitor follow-through.

Key Responsibilities

1. Strategic Performance Monitoring

● Monitor departmental plans, programmes, and organisation-wide strategic priorities

against agreed objectives, deliverables, quality standards, resource requirements,

budgets, and timelines.

● Review progress across clinical services, vocational programmes, the training academy,

learning and development, and research.

● Monitor relevant indicators such as programme milestones, service quality, participant

outcomes, staff training effectiveness, research deliverables, and implementation

progress.

● Identify deviations from planned outcomes, analyse underlying causes, and track agreed

corrective actions.

2. Strategic Evaluation & Review

● Develop or apply monitoring and evaluation frameworks, performance indicators,

evaluation criteria, and reporting mechanisms across departments, programmes,

projects, and strategic initiatives.

● Assess programme implementation, service quality, participant outcomes, training

effectiveness, research progress, and adherence to established standards, as

applicable.

● Review relevant workflows, documentation, assessment processes, referral pathways,

follow-up mechanisms, and service continuity within the scope of established protocols.

● Identify recurring gaps, implementation bottlenecks, and opportunities for improvement;

prepare evidence-based findings and recommendations.

● Coordinate internal reviews and audits where required, document observations, and

track agreed corrective actions through closure.

3. Policies, Systems & Process Implementation

● Identify gaps in organisational and programme systems and support the development of

appropriate structures, policies, SOPs, workflows, indicators, and accountability

mechanisms.

● Map and evaluate programme workflows, participant journeys, research processes,

training pathways, and service-delivery mechanisms.

● Monitor the adoption and effectiveness of established processes across relevant

departments.

● Evaluate the implementation of evidence-based practices and staff development

initiatives, where applicable.

4. Risk Monitoring & Management

● Monitor risks relating to programme implementation, service quality, documentation,

research milestones, staff capacity, resource constraints, and delivery timelines.

● Maintain relevant risk registers and track mitigation plans in collaboration with

accountable teams.

● Identify emerging risks, recurring quality concerns, and deviations from established

standards.

● Escalate material concerns to the leadership and monitor agreed mitigation actions

through closure.

● Respect confidentiality, ethical research requirements, and responsible handling of

participant and organisational data.

5. Research, Data Analysis & Leadership Reporting

● Consolidate quantitative and qualitative data from relevant departments and assess its

completeness, consistency, and usefulness for decision-making.

● Analyse participant feedback, programme outcomes, service-quality indicators, training

results, research milestones, and other relevant evidence.

● Prepare dashboards, evaluation reports, management summaries, and presentations for

departmental and organisation-wide reviews.

● Translate findings into clear insights and practical recommendations for leadership.

6. Cross-functional Coordination & Accountability

● Work with clinical, vocational, training, research, learning and development, and

operational teams to review performance and understand implementation challenges.

● Facilitate periodic reviews, document agreed actions, identify accountable owners, and

monitor completion against deadlines.

● Identify dependencies between programme teams and other organisational functions

that may affect delivery.

● Escalate persistent performance gaps, unresolved actions, and material risks through

the established reporting structure.

Key Outcomes

● Reliable evidence on programme effectiveness, service quality, research progress, and

organisational performance.

● Stronger visibility into departmental progress against agreed objectives, quality

standards, resource requirements, and timelines.

● Early identification of implementation gaps, risks, and recurring performance issues.

● More consistent use of monitoring and evaluation frameworks and evidence-based

recommendations.

● Stronger implementation of organisational systems, documentation standards, and

improvement actions.

● Timely, accurate reports that support leadership decisions and continuous improvement.

Must-have Requirements

● 5 years of relevant experience in monitoring and evaluation, programme evaluation,

research, quality assurance, clinical or educational operations, or service-quality

management.

● MA/MSc in Psychology or a related discipline.

● Demonstrated ability to interpret quantitative and qualitative data and evaluate

programme or organisational performance.

● Experience preparing reports, reviewing processes, documenting findings, and

recommending improvements.

● Strong analytical, research, documentation, communication, and

stakeholder-coordination skills.

● Proficiency in spreadsheets, data analysis, and reporting tools.

● Ability to work collaboratively with multidisciplinary teams and follow through on agreed

actions.

● Understanding of confidentiality and ethical handling of sensitive information.

Preferred Skills

● Experience with monitoring and evaluation frameworks, logic models, outcome

measurement, or programme evaluation.

● Familiarity with clinical, educational, vocational, psychosocial, or disability-service

settings.

● Exposure to research methodologies, statistical analysis, and qualitative data analysis.

● Knowledge of quality assurance, service standards, assessment protocols, or

evidence-based practices.

● Experience evaluating training, competency development, or programme

implementation.

● Experience working in healthcare, education, research, non-profit, or social-impact

organisations.

About India Autism Center

India Autism Center is a not-for-profit organisation building a comprehensive ecosystem of

support, training, research, and lifelong residential living for individuals on the autism spectrum

and their families. IAC works towards greater independence, dignity, belonging, and quality of

life for individuals and families across India.

title: Plant Superintendent- PJM Area

**Plant Superintendent**

PROENERGY is an engineering, R&D, and manufacturing powerhouse. The company addresses every need for fast-start power generation: turbine and package manufacturing, turnkey project execution, power purchase agreements, and asset lifecycle care for turbines and plants. Where others see impossible energy challenges, PROENERGY provides innovative aeroderivative solutions.

PROENERGY delivers fast-start, dispatchable power solutions from worldwide centers for aeroderivative excellence. We are investing more than $1 billion through 2028 in infrastructure to serve our customers.
  
  
**In Sedalia, Missouri,**
our 600,000 sq ft Center for Excellence in Manufacturing—a world-class investment in fast-start power and the only campus of its kind in the world—is growing by 40 percent.
  
  
**In Houston, Texas,**
our 500,000 sq ft Center for Excellence in Lifecycle Care features a Level-IV depot and aero repair facility, which executes comprehensive services for aeroderivative engines under one roof.
  
  
In
**Kansas City**
, we have an office with an Engineering team that supports our sought-after solutions for turnkey projects and contracted power.
  
  
And our
**worldwide service centers**
ensure local service expertise near our customers. Our expanding service footprint includes Phoenix, Buenos Aires, New Brunswick, and additional locations in Europe, Australia, and Southeast Asia.
  
  
**Our Philosophy**
We take care of our people and strive to make a positive difference for the world. We offer competitive pay, excellent benefits that include Medical, Dental, Vision, and Life/Disability Insurance at minimal cost to the employee, 10 paid holidays, paid time off, and a 401K plan. If you are looking for a rewarding career and possess specialized knowledge and quality-oriented problem-solving skills, we encourage you to apply today.
  
  
**Position Summary**
The Plant Superintendent serves as the interface between the asset owner (Origin Mine) or their agent, ProEnergy Services, and the plant O&M team to accomplish the safe operation of the asset while achieving reliability and availability goals. The Plant Superintendent is fully accountable for financial planning and control, provision of resources, compliance with regulatory requirements, and various communication and reporting requirements within the contractual terms of the O&M Agreement. Additionally, the plant Superintendent will manage the daily operations of the plant, directs the implementation of the Operating Plan, identifies those areas which may need improvement or further development, and is responsible for overseeing the maintenance and repair of plant facilities and equipment.
  
  
**Reports To:**
Director O&M
  
  
**Work Location:**
PJM Area
  
  
**Position Responsibilities**

* Develop long term operation plans and align daily activities to these objectives.
* Achieve safety, financial, reliability, availability and efficiency goals.
* Establish effective and sustainable operations.
* Establish a culture of compliance with contractual and regulatory requirements.
* Establish effective maintenance and outage planning and execution.
* Establish a culture of innovation and continuous improvement.
* Provide excellent customer satisfaction.

**Essential Job Functions**

* Build a strong team of motivated people to achieve business goals.
* Establish and maintain effective relationship with contacts to include the owner, the public and co-workers.
* Manages contract compliance requirements to include plant permits and related data collection and record keeping.
* Manages compliance with federal, state and local regulations, laws and practices.
* Interprets company policies to workers and enforces safety regulations.
* Reads, understands, and ensures compliance with all plant safety and regulatory procedures.
* Initiates plans to motivate workers to achieve work goals.
* Establish work management practices and monitor KPIs to ensure the process achieves plant goals.
* Establish budgets and control operating costs within budgetary constraints.
* Coordinate site activities with commercial function to optimize financial performance and risk.
* Collaborate with other PES plant Superintendents, Plant Managers, and company subject matter experts to coordinate activities and identify and spread best practices.
* Provide and utilize various financial, production, process and performance reports.
* Reviews purchase orders for parts, ensuring budgetary constraints are maintained.
* Establish procedures to procure and protect spare parts
* Contract services appropriate to achieve reliability and availability goals.
* Implements changes in working conditions and use of equipment to increase efficiency of plant or work crew.
* Reads, understand and assist staff with the use of technical manuals and system piping and instrumentation diagrams.
* Prepares or reviews work orders for required preventative and corrective maintenance.
* Assists workers in proactively identifying failing equipment and diagnosing malfunctions in machinery and equipment.
* Interprets specifications, blueprints, and job orders to workers, and assigns duties.
* Establishes or adjusts work procedures to meet maintenance schedules.
* Recommends and implements measures to improve methods, equipment performance, and quality of service.
* Analyzes and resolves work problems or assists workers in solving work problems.
* Directs workers engaged in dismantling, assembling, and installing industrial machinery.
* Develop schedules and estimates worker hour requirements for completion of job assignment.
* Create and maintain monthly production and performance report for owner
* Leads recruitment effort for Operations employment candidates and assures complete and proper professional safety training and orientation for the OMT members.
* Takes the lead in investigating and resolving all forced outages and operating irregularities. Reviews and makes recommendations to improve equipment availability, performance, and reliability.
* Develops and oversees training and qualification programs to maximize the effectiveness of the Operational staff. Provides overall coordination for Operational departments training and development including budgeting and scheduling.
* Develops plans for the execution of planned outages. Ensures that work performed by plant personnel and contractors is planned and progresses as scheduled to meet performance and cost objectives.
* Oversees a comprehensive maintenance program that includes preventive, predictive and corrective maintenance programs in accordance with PES, manufacturer and industry practice and as indicated by equipment and system performance, maintenance records and safety requirements. Continually evaluates the maintenance program and adjusts conditions to optimize maintenance cost effectiveness, work quality, outage time and availability. Reviews maintenance actions taken on work order forms.
* Reviews and improves operational & maintenance processes and ensures that personnel adhere to established procedures and practices. Develops action plans to align employee accountabilities and conduct with operational processes.

**Required Qualifications**

* Bachelor’s degree and six to eight years related experience; or equivalent combination of education and experience.
* Technical competence including understanding software, hardware, networks, etc.
* Ability to analyze and resolve problems in a logical and effective manner.
* Experience with operations and maintenance of LM6000.
* US work authorization is a precondition of employment. The company will not consider candidates who require sponsorship for a work-authorized visa.
* Successful candidate will need to satisfactorily complete pre-employment drug screen and background check.

**Additional Requirements/Expectations**

* Communicate clearly and concisely, both orally and in writing.
* Proficient in the use of various MS Office Suite programs, including Word, Excel, PowerPoint, and Outlook.
* While performing the duties of this position, the employee is frequently required to sit, stand, walk, communicate, reach and manipulate objects.
* Duties involve moving materials weighing up to 10 pounds on a regular basis such as files, books, office equipment, etc., and may infrequently require moving materials weighing up to 40 pounds.
* Manual dexterity and coordination are required while operating equipment such as computer keyboard, calculator, and standard office equipment.
* Specific vision abilities required by the job include close vision and the ability to adjust focus.
* Usual office working conditions: noise level in the work area is typical of most office environments with telephones, personal interruptions, and background noises.

It is PROENERGY’s policy to provide equal opportunity in employment to all its employees and applicants for employment without regard to race, color, religion, sex, pregnancy, age, disability, national origin, marital status, ancestry, medical condition, military status, or any other characteristic protected by State or Federal law.

title: Deployment Strategist
description:
**Job Description**
About the Team
  
  
The FDE (Forward Deployed Engineering) team is a new, strategic initiative sponsored from the CEO and Founders down. Our mission is to win C-suite-sponsored, high-value AI opportunities by selling and delivering outcomes, not just a platform.
  
  
You will be part of the founding team, embedded with our most strategic customers from the very first sales call, all the way through to a production-ready solution. You will be the "product manager" for the customer's problem, responsible for the "why" and "what," while our FDEs (Engineers) will be your partners responsible for the "how."
  
  
Role Description
  
  
As a Deployment Strategist (DS), you are the critical bridge between a customer's multi-million-dollar business problem and Databricks' technical solution. You are a product manager for the field, owning the technical and product direction of the engagement from initial discovery through production launch and adoption.
  
  
You will build C-suite trust, perform deep discovery to map the customer's political and technical landscape, and scope the value. You will define the Minimum Viable Product for a pilot, write the PRD that guides the engineering team, and manage the project to a successful landing. You will also lead technical discovery, shape solution architecture with FDEs, and ensure that each proposed solution can move from prototype to production.
  
  
This role requires a rare combination of executive presence, deep product thinking, technical depth, and a hands-on delivery mindset.
  
  
The impact you will have
  
  

* C-Suite Scoping & Value Definition: Partner with Sales to perform deep discovery, map the customer's organization, quantify the business value of $10M+ problems, and define the pilot, including its MVP, success criteria, and timeline.
* End-to-End Product Ownership: Author the PRD, prioritize the engineering backlog, manage scope, and act as the primary hands-on QA tester. Translate business requirements into clear data, integration, security, and operational requirements that engineers can build against.
* Technical Solution Leadership & Delivery: Drive the FDE build team through an agile delivery process, manage stakeholders from the C-suite to individual engineers, and unblock technical or organizational issues. Lead technical discovery and design reviews. Understand the customer's data flows, integrations, platform constraints, and operational environment; pressure-test architecture choices; and identify technical risks early.
* Solution Launch & Landing: Own the "Day 0" launch, manage the war room, and drive the solution from launch to full adoption by capturing user feedback, iterating, and proving the defined business value. Own production readiness across data quality, testing, security, performance, and operations. Work with the team to diagnose issues and drive them to resolution.
* Strategic Handoff & Growth: Scope the ongoing maintenance plan, create customer documentation/training, and leverage your trusted advisor status to identify the next high-value FDE engagement. Codify reusable solution patterns and bring field insights back to Product and Engineering.

What we look for
  
  

* Executive Presence & Communication: You are a trusted advisor with strong executive presence and excellent communication skills. You are confident and humble, can build rapport quickly, and can help senior stakeholders make difficult decisions.
* Product Judgment & Delivery: You can define what to build and why, write strong product requirements, prioritize engineering work, manage scope, and lead complex agile software projects from an ambiguous problem to a measurable outcome.
* Technical Fluency & Architecture Judgment: You understand modern data and AI architectures, including cloud platforms, data pipelines, data models, distributed systems, APIs, security and governance, machine learning, and generative AI application patterns. You can lead architecture discussions, evaluate trade-offs, and pressure-test technical decisions.
* Hands-on Technical Ability: You are proficient in at least one language such as Python, Java, or SQL. You can explore data, work in notebooks, read and review code and pipelines, build or adapt prototypes, and contribute meaningfully to troubleshooting.
* Relevant Experience: Typically 7+ years of experience delivering complex, customer-facing data, analytics, AI, or software engagements, or equivalent experience as a founder or technical builder. You have helped deliver data, machine learning, or generative AI systems into production and understand the integration, operational, and adoption challenges that appear in real environments. Experience in a high-growth technology company, forward-deployed organization, or leading consultancy is valuable. You enjoy working onsite with customers (often 25-50%, sometimes higher) to drive delivery.

**About Databricks**
Databricks is the Data and AI company. More than 20,000 organizations worldwide — including adidas, AT&T, Bayer, Block, Mastercard, Rivian, Unilever, and 70% of the Fortune 500 — rely on the Databricks Data + AI Platform to build and scale data and AI apps, analytics and agents. Headquartered in San Francisco with 30+ offices around the globe, Databricks offers a unified platform that includes Genie, Lakebase, Agent Bricks, Lakeflow, Lakehouse, and Unity Catalog. To learn more, follow Databricks on LinkedIn, X, YouTube, and Instagram.
  
  
**Benefits**
At Databricks, we strive to provide comprehensive benefits and perks that meet the needs of all of our employees. For specific details on the benefits offered in your region click here.
  
  
Our Commitment to Diversity and Inclusion
  
  
At Databricks, we are committed to fostering a diverse and inclusive culture where everyone can excel. We take great care to ensure that our hiring practices are inclusive and meet equal employment opportunity standards. Individuals looking for employment at Databricks are considered without regard to age, color, disability, ethnicity, family or marital status, gender identity or expression, language, national origin, physical and mental ability, political affiliation, race, religion, sexual orientation, socio-economic status, veteran status, and other protected characteristics.
  
  
Compliance
  
  
If access to export-controlled technology or source code is required for performance of job duties, it is within Employer's discretion whether to apply for a U.S. government license for such positions, and Employer may decline to proceed with an applicant on this basis alone.

title: Supply Chain Manager
description:
**Position Title:**
Supply Chain Manager

**Location:**
West Bengal, India

**Experience Required:**
7–10 years

**CTC:**
35 - 45 LPA

**Role Purpose**

The Supply Chain Manager will own the end-to-end supply chain and production planning for the Beauty, Cosmetic, Perfumes, Alcohol business, from production planning and vendor coordination through to finished-product availability. The role will build and manage the vendor ecosystem, including international suppliers, align production with business projections and sales requirements, and ensure that products are available at the right time and in the right quantities. The role is highly execution-oriented and requires strong ownership of timelines, vendors, inventory, production schedules and cross-functional coordination.

**Key Responsibilities**

**Demand & Production Planning**

* Translate business projections, collection plans and sales forecasts into production requirements.
* Develop production plans based on expected demand, launch calendars, channel requirements and supplier lead times.
* Work closely with sales and merchandising teams to understand current and anticipated demand.
* Anticipate production requirements well in advance based on long lead-time components and international sourcing dependencies.
* Maintain visibility on production pipeline, committed quantities, expected receipts and potential supply gaps.
* Identify risks to product availability and proactively develop mitigation plans.

**End-to-End Vendor Management**

* Own relationships with domestic and international vendors involved in the supply chain.
* Identify, evaluate and onboard vendors in collaboration with relevant internal stakeholders.
* Manage vendor negotiations around timelines, quantities, quality, costs and commercial terms.
* Establish vendor performance standards and review vendor performance regularly.
* Build strong relationships with international suppliers and manage communication across time zones and geographies.
* Ensure vendor adherence to agreed production and delivery timelines.

**Production & Component Coordination**

* Coordinate production of fragrance bottles, packaging components and other relevant product components.
* Track component-level production and identify dependencies that may affect finished-product timelines.
* Maintain detailed production trackers covering purchase orders, quantities, production status, quality approvals, dispatches and expected delivery dates.
* Coordinate with manufacturing/production partners to ensure timely completion of orders.
* Work with R&D and product teams during product development and transition from sampling to commercial production.

**Inventory & Availability**

* Establish appropriate inventory norms based on demand, lead times and business requirements.
* Monitor inventory levels and identify potential overstock, understock and stock-out situations.
* Develop replenishment plans based on sales velocity and production lead times.
* Ensure alignment between inventory availability and planned launches across channels.

**Cross-Functional Coordination**

* Work closely with R&D, CPO, merchandising, retail, finance, HR and other relevant teams.
* Coordinate production plans with collection launch calendars.
* Align with sales teams on market requirements, upcoming demand and changes in projections.
* Work with Finance on purchase commitments, costing, working capital and vendor payments where required.
* Ensure supply-chain readiness for new launches and collection drops.

**Cost & Process Optimisation**

* Track product and component costs and identify opportunities for cost optimisation.
* Support costing exercises and vendor negotiations.
* Identify opportunities to reduce lead times, improve MOQ economics and optimise inventory.
* Build scalable supply-chain processes, trackers and SOPs for the new fragrance business.

**International Supply Chain**

* Manage international vendor relationships and associated production timelines.
* Coordinate international shipments and ensure visibility on expected arrival dates.
* Work with relevant internal teams on documentation, logistics and import-related dependencies.
* Build contingency plans for critical international suppliers and long-lead components.

**Key Deliverables / Success Metrics**

* Production readiness for all planned launches
* On-time-in-full delivery from vendors
* Production lead-time adherence
* Inventory availability and stock-out levels
* Vendor performance
* Inventory turns / working capital efficiency
* Production cost optimisation
* Accuracy of demand-to-production planning
* Successful execution of new product launches

**Ideal Candidate**

* 5–8 years of experience in supply chain, sourcing, production planning or vendor management.
* Experience in fragrance, beauty, cosmetics, Alcohol, premium consumer goods or a highly design-led product environment preferred.
* Strong experience managing vendors, preferably including international suppliers.
* Experience working with long-lead-time components and production cycles.
* Strong understanding of demand planning, inventory management and production scheduling.
* Excellent stakeholder and vendor management skills.
* Strong analytical and Excel capabilities.
* Comfortable working in a start-up/0-to-1 environment where processes need to be built from scratch.
* Willingness to travel internationally/domestically for vendor management where required.

**Preferred Background**

Candidates from fragrance, cosmetics, beauty, premium consumer goods, fashion accessories, jewellery, Alcohol or other businesses involving complex vendor and component ecosystems may be considered.

title: Manager, Internal Controls
description:
**Job Description**
The
**Manager, Internal Controls**
will be based in
**India**
. In this position, you will report to the Head of Internal Controls. Nextpower is seeking a Manager, Internal Control to lead the company’s SOX and internal controls work across assigned business processes. This role manages and develops a team of internal controls professionals while partnering with Finance, Accounting, IT, Operations, Legal, and external auditors. The manager sets team priorities, oversees routine operating plans and costs, and guides risk assessments, control design and testing, remediation, and readiness efforts. The role requires sound judgment, strong knowledge of business processes and financial reporting, and the ability to turn control requirements into practical solutions.
  
  
Watch “Culture is our Passion” to learn more about us
  
  
**We Are Looking For Someone Who Demonstrates**

* Passionate drive to innovate and create
* Integrity to the core
* Enthusiastic customer focus
* Consistent interactive teamwork
* Desire for continuous improvement and top performance.

**Here Is a Glimpse Of What You Will Do**
**People leadership and team operations**

* Manage, coach, and develop a team of internal controls professionals; set clear goals, assign work, review quality and timeliness, provide ongoing feedback, and support performance and career development.
* Plan and allocate team capacity against monthly and routine operating plans; monitor milestones, workload, and costs, and raise resource or schedule risks with leadership.
* Apply company policies consistently, address routine team matters, and recommend improvements to procedures and practices within the function.

**SOX program and control environment**

* Lead and contribute to SOX risk assessments, annual planning and scoping, readiness activities, and the ongoing maturity of the SOX program.
* Oversee assigned process areas and ensure the team understands related business activities, risks, controls, company policies, and applicable accounting and reporting requirements.
* Guide process walkthroughs, tests of design, and tests of operating effectiveness; review workpapers and documentation for accuracy, completeness, and consistency.
* Partner with process owners to evaluate existing processes, identify control gaps and improvement opportunities, and design practical controls that address risk and exposure.
* Assess new projects, systems, and process changes for SOX impact; coordinate with cross-functional partners to define and complete readiness actions.
* Maintain accurate SOX documentation, including process narratives, flowcharts, risk-control matrices, and evidence of control performance.

**Issues, remediation, and partnership**

* Evaluate audit findings and control deficiencies; analyze relevant facts, assess potential impact, and develop and track remediation plans with SOX leadership and accountable stakeholders.
* Coordinate with internal and external auditors and support requests related to SOX, internal controls, and financial reporting.
* Explain control requirements, findings, and recommendations to process owners, peer groups, and leaders; build cooperation and influence timely action across functions.
* Monitor progress against commitments, resolve routine execution issues, and escalate significant risks, delays, or resource needs.

**Governance and continuous improvement**

* Stay current on relevant SOX, PCAOB, COSO, U.S. GAAP, and public-company reporting requirements and emerging practices.
* Recommend updates to team procedures and control practices based on changes in the business, systems, risks, and applicable requirements.

**Here Is Some Of What You Will Need (required)**

* Bachelor’s degree in accounting, Finance, Business Administration, or a related field, or equivalent practical experience.
* (10-12) years of related experience in accounting, external or internal audit, SOX, or internal controls, preferably across public accounting and corporate environments.
* Experience directly managing or formally leading employees, including assigning work, coaching, providing feedback, and supporting performance and development.
* Working knowledge of SOX 404, internal control frameworks such as COSO, audit requirements including PCAOB standards, and U.S. GAAP.
* Experience assessing business process risks, designing or evaluating controls, leading walkthroughs and control testing, documenting results, and driving remediation.
* Ability to analyze complex or incomplete information, exercise sound judgment, and interpret requirements to recommend appropriate procedures and actions.
* Strong communication and presentation skills, with the ability to explain technical control matters and gain cooperation from cross-functional partners.
* Demonstrated ability to organize team work, manage multiple timelines, and deliver against recurring plans

**Here Are a Few Of Our Preferred Experiences**

* CPA, CIA, or other relevant professional certification.
* Experience supporting a public company’s SOX program through growth, system implementation, acquisition, or process transformation.
* Experience with internal controls over financial reporting across finance, accounting, IT, or operational processes.

title: Strategic Initiatives Associate
description:
Strategic Initiatives Associate

SVECTOR | Ahmedabad, Gujarat (On-site) | Full-time | Monday to Saturday

Experience: 0–4 years. Exceptional fresh graduates are encouraged to apply.

Reports to: Founder-CEO

About SVECTOR

SVECTOR is a technology company building intelligence infrastructure for enterprises and institutions. We develop software systems that help organizations understand complex information, improve decision-making and execute critical business processes. Our initiatives span enterprise intelligence, talent and leadership decision systems, healthcare, industrial technology, financial intelligence and defensive intelligence.

We work on problems where technology must do more than generate information. It must help people understand what is happening, decide what to do and turn decisions into measurable outcomes.

About the Role

We are hiring a Strategic Initiatives Associate to work closely with company leadership on selected product, technology and business initiatives. This is an early-career role for someone curious, capable and dependable who wants to understand how a technology business runs while taking direct responsibility for meaningful work.

You will take assigned objectives, work out a practical approach, bring the right people together and carry the work through to a verified result. You will work across engineering, product and business teams on things like investigating a product issue, understanding a customer requirement, preparing a business analysis, coordinating a pilot or moving an initiative from planning into execution.

This is not a role defined by attending meetings, preparing presentations or passing instructions between departments. The goal is to contribute directly to work that produces results. Experience in an identical role is not required.

What You Will Do

Project execution

• Understand the objective, constraints and importance of each assigned initiative.

• Break objectives into activities, deliverables, owners and milestones.

• Coordinate with engineering, product and business stakeholders.

• Spot delays, dependencies and gaps early, and resolve blockers within your authority.

• Follow up on commitments and keep progress, pending actions and open issues visible.

• Check completed work against its original requirements.

• Prepare short progress summaries and flag decisions that need leadership attention.

You are expected to understand the work you coordinate. Collecting updates or maintaining a tracker without understanding the problem is not enough.

Product and technical-business work

• Use SVECTOR's software products to understand their real capabilities and limits.

• Understand customer workflows and the problems customers expect the product to solve.

• Investigate reported issues and tell defects apart from unclear requirements and new feature requests.

• Turn business and customer needs into clear problem statements, requirements, user stories and acceptance criteria.

• Work with engineers to understand constraints, dependencies and possible approaches.

• Support demos, testing, customer pilots and implementation, and confirm delivered work meets the requirement.

You are not being hired as a full-time software developer, but strong technical literacy matters. You should be comfortable with concepts such as APIs, databases, integrations and data flows, and willing to learn what you do not yet know.

Research and analysis

• Research companies, industries, technologies and business opportunities.

• Compare competitors, products, technical approaches and tools.

• Study enterprise customers and the environments they operate in.

• Review reports, specifications and original source material.

• Prepare decision briefs and recommendations that state what is known, what the evidence is, what remains uncertain and what to do next.

We expect you to go beyond the first search result, verify important claims, check numbers and explain your reasoning. We value independent thinking over long documents full of generic observations.

Business and customer initiatives

• Research prospective customers and decision-makers, and prepare background for key discussions.

• Support demos, discovery calls and technical-business presentations.

• Turn customer feedback into specific product or business actions.

• Help with proposals and solution briefs, and coordinate pilot follow-ups.

• Join customer meetings and speak with external stakeholders when authorized.

There is no individual sales quota. Pricing, contracts and financial commitments stay subject to leadership approval.

Leadership support and AI tools

• Prepare briefing notes and short memos for important discussions.

• Record decisions, commitments and open questions, and keep actions tied to owners.

• Use AI tools and modern software for research, document analysis and repetitive workflows, and check their output against reliable sources.

Using AI does not remove your responsibility to understand your own work. An unverified AI-generated document that you cannot explain is not an acceptable deliverable. You will also follow company rules on confidential information and data handling.

Who You Are

• Curious: you want to understand a hard problem, not avoid it.

• Accountable: a task is done when there is an outcome, not when you have sent a message. You are honest about obstacles and mistakes.

• Structured: you break problems down, test assumptions and reach reasoned conclusions, even under uncertainty.

• Clear communicator: excellent written and spoken English, with precise emails, briefs and summaries.

• Technically curious: you enjoy learning how software is built and used. Coding experience helps but is not required.

• Reliable: you respect deadlines and confidentiality, know when you need approval, and accept feedback well.

Qualifications

• 0–4 years of relevant experience. Internships, independent projects, research, entrepreneurship or full-time work all count.

• A bachelor's degree in Computer Science, Engineering, IT, AI, Data Science, Business Analytics, Economics, Management or a related field is preferred. Other backgrounds are considered where projects show the capability. No MBA required.

• Experience in product operations, business analysis, technical consulting, software development, strategic research or project execution is relevant.

We care about work you have actually completed: a product or technical project, an internship where you solved a real problem, a research assignment with a defensible conclusion, or an initiative where you took responsibility beyond your assigned work. Tell us your own contribution, the decisions you made and the results.

This role is not an administrative or personal-assistant job, a software engineering job focused on production code, a pure consulting role or a senior management position. It is an execution-oriented role centered on product understanding, research, problem-solving and completing assigned initiatives.

What Success Looks Like

• First 30 days: learn the products, workflows and priorities, and complete initial research and product assignments accurately.

• Days 31–60: own a defined initiative, prepare an execution approach and keep progress visible.

• Days 61–90: carry an initiative to an agreed result or a documented handover.

Hiring Process

1. Application review

2. Initial discussion

3. Practical assessment: a realistic research, product or business task. AI tools may be used where permitted, but you must be able to explain and verify your work.

4. Leadership interview

Full-time, on-site in Ahmedabad, Monday to Saturday. Schedule, compensation and joining terms are confirmed before a formal offer. If anything about the role or location does not match your expectations, please raise it in the first discussion.

Send your resume with a short note covering:

1. Your strongest example of ownership: what you did, which decisions you made and what happened.

2. Why you are interested in technology, research, product understanding and business execution.

title: Software Engineering Manager
description:

Software Engineering Manager

Technology

CTO

8+ years
  
  
**Location:**
Ahmedabad, India (Remote option Available)
  
  
**Company Introduction**
Genea was built on a foundation of listening to and serving our commercial real estate customer’s needs starting with our flagship Overtime HVAC product. Over the years, we’ve earned the trust and loyalty of 21 of the top 25 largest commercial real estate companies in the US and continue to prove our value to them every day. Our clients depend on us to develop value-added technology solutions to solve other pain points in their operations. We have grown our product portfolio to serve the complex and expanding needs of property teams.
  
  
Genea is a family of solutions are designed to improve commercial real estate operations through cutting-edge technology. Revolutionize access control, streamline overtime HVAC, and economize submeter billing. Our host of cloud-based, automated solutions are built to cut costs, reduce admin times, and maximize the tenant experience.
  
  
Experiencing enormous growth with aggressive expansion plans, Genea is expanding a Software Development and Operations center in India and is looking for dynamic engineering leaders, who can become part of this already successful growth story, and partner in creating a world class team and products.
  
  
We are fully remote since pre-COVID times. We're US-based, with a development centre in Ahmedabad, India.
  
  
**Job Overview**
Genea is looking for a Engineering Lead to help grow our development team. You will participate in the full SDLC from preliminary system analysis to testing and deployment. This hybrid-engineering role includes building high quality and fully performing software that meets quality and software development standards alongside a great team.
  
  
**What you would do, day-to-day?**

* Drive team efforts
* Have a keen eye on code quality with code scalability, maintainability, readability in mind
* Have a solution-oriented mindset and high load capacity system in mind
* Estimate work, delegate work
* Manage the people on a large engineering team to keep them aligned and focused on achieving the team’s goals
* Drives the design, strategy, and execution of software development projects to support product roadmaps
* Lead technology architecture and development as per product needs
* Oversee the daily activities and progress of multiple SCRUM teams
* Monitor, and continuously update, team metrics for measurement of engineering and operational excellence. Ensure a consistent, regular process for assessment of goals and improvement of deliveries
* Lead many SCRUM teams through estimating engineering effort to build new features and fix prior mistakes
* Collaborate with Product Managers on new products and new features
* Implement data driven approach to execution to drive transparency

* 8+ years of total experience and 3+ years of relevant work experience as team lead
* Experience in microservice and event driven architecture
* Proficient in backend technologies, preferably JavaScript, but we’re open to other technologies
* Proficient in frontend technologies, preferably React, but we’re open to any other JavaScript - based frameworks like Angular, Vue, etc
* Proficient in database technologies like MongoDB or RDBMS (We use PostgreSQL)
* Excellent understanding of software development life cycles (SDLC) with experience guiding teams through planning, development, and rollout using best in industry agile practices
* Having experience in work estimation and delegation is preferable
* Understanding of testing practices like writing unit/integration test cases
* Strong Articulation skills - Ability to write/explain complex problems over email or call
* Obsession for excellence - Should strive for being excellent at work in terms of quality and speed
* Professionalism - Sincere, Integrity, Commitment, Ownership
* Strategic thinker with the ability to formulate product and business strategies
* Prior experience in managing multi-disciplinary teams of manager, senior engineers simultaneously working on multiple projects and technologies
* Strong cross-functional collaboration and influencing skills at high levels
* Possess innate customer service skills including the ability to be empathetic, accurate, compassionate, responsive, resourceful, and conscientious
* Strong relationship management, strategizing, project management, problem solving, and change management skills
* Experience working with AWS is highly preferable. We work with AWS services like EC2, S3, Lambda, CloudWatch, SNS, RDS, SQS.
