* Opportunity to work directly with the Chief Technology Officer and other Executives
* Opportunity to help create and lead a strong team of engineers and lead innovation and creation of best-in-class products

* Strong participation in engineering strategies and product deliveries
* Opportunity to work with cross geography teams and travel as necessary
* Participate in creating a fun, smart, passionate multi-cultural and merit-driven team
* You will be challenged and encouraged to broaden your and your team’s skills including access to personal development courses and learning platforms

title: Senior NetSuite Integration Architect
description:
**About the Company:**

Relay Human Cloud is a young & dynamic company that helps some of the top US-based companies to expand their team internationally. Relay is a truly global company having its operations in US, India, Honduras, and Mexico (We are also adding a few more countries soon). Our core focus is to enable companies to connect with the best international talent. Relay helps its clients in majorly following areas: Accounting & Finance, Administration, Operations, Space Planning, Leasing, Data Science, Data Search, Machine Learning and Artificial Intelligence etc. Relay India operates from Ahmedabad and Vadodara offices. The principals and founders of Relay Human Cloud have been focused on delivering high-quality operations in cutting-edge companies for their entire careers.

**Job Summary:**

We are seeking a hands-on Senior Manager – Enterprise Integration & Data Architecture with strong NetSuite integration expertise to design, develop, and maintain enterprise integrations, APIs, EDI, and data pipelines. The ideal candidate will have strong technical skills and a solid understanding of distribution, inventory, order processing, and accounting workflows. This role focuses on hands-on implementation, troubleshooting, and long-term technical ownership rather than project management.

**Responsibilities:**

**Enterprise integration architecture**

* Design and maintain the company's enterprise integration architecture, including approved patterns for APIs, EDI, webhooks, SFTP, files, native connectors, events, and batch processing.
* Define source and target systems, authoritative data boundaries, field mappings, timing, sequencing, validation, error handling, retry, reconciliation, security, and support ownership for each interface.
* Avoid uncontrolled point-to-point connections, duplicated business logic, and integrations that create parallel systems of record.
* Maintain architecture diagrams, interface inventories, mapping specifications, decision records, and runbooks while determining which existing interfaces should be retained, redesigned, replaced, or retired.

**NetSuite integration engineering**

* Design, build, test, deploy, and support integrations between NetSuite and internal or external systems.
* Develop deep knowledge of the NetSuite record, transaction, permission, and posting models so interfaces create valid operational and accounting results.
* Work with applicable NetSuite capabilities such as REST web services, SuiteTalk, RESTlets, SuiteScript, SuiteQL, SuiteAnalytics Connect, web services, and token-based authentication.
* Use Oracle integration technologies where appropriate, establish reusable engineering patterns, and challenge partner-proposed designs before owning the deployed solution and support model.

**Customer vendor and external ecosystem integration**

* Support EDI and API connectivity for customers, broadline distributors, vendors, logistics providers, marketplaces, payment services, websites, and other business partners.
* Design mappings and workflows for relevant documents such as purchase orders, acknowledgments, advance ship notices, invoices, inventory updates, item data, pricing, and order status.
* Support vendor onboarding, customer enablement, item synchronization, pricing exchange, order ingestion, fulfillment status, and other digital transaction flows while keeping partner-specific rules documented and controlled.
* Build repeatable onboarding patterns that reduce the cost and time required to connect new customers, vendors, and acquisitions.

**Data architecture ownership and governance**

* Help define company's enterprise data architecture with NetSuite as the authoritative transactional platform for the processes it owns.
* Establish clear boundaries for transactional, master, analytical, historical, reference, and external application data.
* Partner with business and application owners to define authoritative sources, data ownership, approval rights, stewardship, quality rules, and lifecycle requirements.
* Design governed data pipelines, transformation logic, shared definitions, and reconciliations so critical item, pricing, costing, inventory, margin, customer, vendor, and financial logic remains transparent and auditable.

**Legacy discovery migration and transition**

* Inspect legacy applications, databases, scripts, interfaces, files, and automated jobs to identify embedded business rules and technical dependencies.
* Document why existing functionality exists before replacing it, separating requirements that must be preserved from obsolete workarounds and technical debt.
* Support extraction, transformation, mapping, cleansing, conversion, validation, and reconciliation with repeatable utilities and control totals that preserve financial, operational, and referential integrity.
* Plan retirement, archival, access, and support arrangements for legacy data and applications that will not move into the future environment.

**Analytics data services and application enablement**

* Support the architecture and ongoing operation of NetSuite Analytics Warehouse and related analytics capabilities where adopted.
* Define the appropriate roles of NetSuite native reporting, governed analytical platforms, Power BI, and other reporting tools so business logic is not recreated inconsistently.
* Design data models and pipelines that provide trusted reporting and reconcile to source transactions.
* Support approved extension platforms for internal tools, portals, and workflows, and enable automation or AI only through governed data, controlled interfaces, clear ownership, and appropriate human review.

**Testing monitoring security and operational support**

* Develop and execute unit, integration, end-to-end, performance, failure-mode, cutover, and reconciliation testing with documented acceptance criteria.
* Implement logging, automated alerts, transaction tracing, exception queues, retry mechanisms, dashboards, and escalation procedures so failures are visible and actionable.
* Perform hands-on production troubleshooting and root-cause analysis across systems, data, network, authentication, mapping, sequencing, and business-rule layers.
* Apply secure access and data protection while establishing standards for source control, code review, automated testing, environment separation, deployment, versioning, rollback, documentation, and change control.

**Long term architecture ownership**

* Become a primary internal owner for enterprise integrations, data pipelines, interface standards, and supporting technical documentation.
* Work side by side with implementation-partner engineers during design and build activities rather than receiving knowledge only at the end of the program.
* Build internal support capability, reduce unnecessary dependence on external consultants, and prioritize technical debt and enhancements based on business value, reliability, control risk, total cost, and operational impact.
* Create scalable patterns that support growth, acquisition integration, customer and vendor enablement, analytics, automation, and future digital services

**Qualifications:**

* More than 7 years of enterprise application integration, software engineering, data engineering, or related technical experience.
* Meaningful hands-on experience integrating with NetSuite and working with its records, transactions, permissions, APIs, or scripting capabilities.
* Strong knowledge of REST and SOAP services, JSON, XML, SQL, SFTP, webhooks, authentication, and modern integration patterns.
* Experience designing, building, testing, deploying, monitoring, and supporting production integrations and data pipelines.
* Experience with data mapping, transformation, migration, reconciliation, master data, and data-quality controls.
* Strong troubleshooting and root-cause-analysis skills across applications, interfaces, data, security, and business processes.
* Experience with API security, token-based authentication, source control, code review, testing, deployment, environment management, and operational documentation.
* Ability to understand order-to-cash, procure-to-pay, inventory, fulfillment, and accounting impacts in addition to technical specifications.
* Ability to evaluate and challenge consultant or vendor recommendations and assume ownership of the resulting design.
* Strong written communication and willingness to remain hands-on throughout implementation and long-term operation of the environment.

**Preferred Qualifications**

* Experience with Oracle Integration Cloud (OIC), NetSuite Integration Platform, and other Oracle integration technologies.
* Experience with SuiteTalk, SuiteScript, RESTlets, SuiteQL, SuiteAnalytics Connect, or NetSuite Analytics Warehouse.
* Knowledge of EDI standards and third-party integration processes.
* Experience in food distribution, wholesale distribution, retail, logistics, or other transaction-intensive industries.
* Experience modernizing Microsoft Dynamics GP or custom legacy applications.
* Familiarity with Oracle APEX, Power BI, cloud data platforms, workflow automation, or document processing.
* Experience with multi-entity environments, acquisitions, and high-volume order and inventory transactions.

**Why Join Relay Human Cloud? ✨**

🌍 Opportunities to work with global clients

🤝 Dynamic and collaborative work environment

⚖️ Excellent work-life balance – 5-day workweek

🩺 Comprehensive health & accident insurance

🌴 Generous paid time off and holidays

🍽️ Complimentary lunches & dinners

🏆 Quarterly, Semi-Annual & Annual recognition, rewards, and giveaways

📚 Employee development programs – Communication, Soft Skills, and more

🎉 Vibrant cultural events – Fun Fridays, Month-End Celebrations, Sports Tournaments, and Festival celebrations

🎯 Excellent Employee Referral Program

**Job Summary:**

The role will be closely aligned with the commercial function, providing expert advice on contract reviews, commercial risk management, bid strategies, cost forecasting, and financial performance under NEC contracts, particularly NEC PSC. The successful candidate will work with project and bid teams to identify commercial risks and opportunities, develop robust commercial strategies, and ensure compliance with contractual requirements and cost management principles.

**Pre-contract activities**

* Review tender documentation, contracts and associated commercial terms.

* Prepare contract risk assessments and advise project teams on proportionate mitigation measures.
* Support bid development, pricing strategies and commercial submissions.
* Develop fee proposals, cost estimates and financial models.

**Cost management**

* Analyse project costs and identify commercial risks and opportunities.

* Identify, evidence and challenge Disallowed Cost where applicable.
* Support cost forecasting, earned value analysis and cost-to-complete assessments.

**Essential Requirements**
**Qualifications and professional status**

* Degree qualified in Quantity Surveying, Commercial Management, Construction Economics or an equivalent discipline.
* Chartered Quantity Surveyor (MRICS) or demonstrably progressing towards chartership.

**Experience**

* Experience in cost forecasting, financial reporting and project commercial management.

**Technical knowledge**

* Strong understanding of NEC PSC contract mechanisms and good contract administration practice.
* Good understanding of Defined Cost, the Schedule of Cost Components and the Shorter Schedule of Cost Components.
* Working knowledge of Disallowed Cost, compensation events, early warnings and change management procedures.
* Ability to interpret contractual obligations and communicate commercial risks clearly to non-commercial colleagues.

**Systems And Analytical Skills**

* Advanced Microsoft Excel skills and confidence working with complex data sets.
* Strong capability in cost modelling, scenario analysis and financial analysis.
* Experience developing forecasting models, commercial reports and management information.
* High levels of numerical accuracy, quality control and attention to detail.
* Competence across Microsoft 365 and relevant commercial management systems.

**Flexible working**
At Mott MacDonald, we support our staff to create work-life balance which works for them and welcome candidates looking for career flexibility. We are open to discussing flexible working at interview stage.

title: Quality Management Executive
description:
Job Description – Head, Quality Management Systems (QMS)

Company: Eastface Packaging – A Division of Sahitya Mudranalaya Pvt. Ltd.

Location: Ahmedabad, Gujarat

Department: Quality

Designation: Head – Quality Management Systems (QMS)

Reporting To: Plant Head / Management

Industry: Printing & Packaging – Folding Cartons / Mono Cartons

Experience - Minimum 2 - 3 years

**Salary - 40-45k per month

For applications send cv on codasyncs.hrbp1@gmail.com with a request to fix an appointment**

Role Purpose

The QMS Head will be responsible for developing, implementing, maintaining, and continuously improving the Quality Management System at Eastface Packaging.

The role will ensure that manufacturing operations, documentation, quality controls, hygiene systems, traceability, customer requirements, and regulatory processes comply with applicable standards including ISO, BRCGS Packaging Materials, GMP, FSC and customer-specific requirements.

The QMS Head will act as the key owner of quality-system compliance and will coordinate closely with Production, Quality Control, Stores, Purchase, Maintenance, HR, Prepress and senior management.

Key Responsibilities

1. Quality Management System

\* Develop, implement and maintain the company’s Quality Management System.

\* Establish and maintain SOPs, work instructions, policies, formats, registers and quality records.

\* Ensure effective document control and revision control across departments.

\* Ensure all processes are performed according to approved procedures and specifications.

\* Periodically review the effectiveness of the QMS and recommend improvements.

\* Ensure proper implementation of change-control procedures.

2. BRCGS & Certification Management

\* Lead implementation and maintenance of BRCGS Packaging Materials certification requirements.

\* Ensure continuous readiness for announced and unannounced audits.

\* Coordinate ISO, BRCGS, FSC and other certification audits.

\* Conduct regular gap assessments against applicable certification standards.

\* Ensure corrective actions arising from certification audits are completed within defined timelines.

\* Maintain records and evidence required for certification and surveillance audits.

3. Internal Audits

\* Develop the annual internal-audit schedule.

\* Conduct and coordinate internal audits across all departments.

\* Identify non-conformities, observations and opportunities for improvement.

\* Issue audit reports and monitor corrective and preventive actions.

\* Verify effectiveness of CAPA implementation.

\* Escalate recurring or critical non-conformities to management.

4. CAPA & Root Cause Analysis

\* Manage the company’s Corrective and Preventive Action system.

\* Lead root-cause analysis for:

\* Customer complaints

\* Internal quality failures

\* Audit non-conformities

\* Process deviations

\* Repeated production defects

\* Use structured problem-solving techniques such as:

\* 5 Why Analysis

\* Fishbone / Ishikawa Analysis

\* Pareto Analysis

\* Risk Assessment

\* Track CAPA closure and verify effectiveness.

5. Customer Complaints & Quality Requirements

\* Coordinate investigation of customer quality complaints.

\* Prepare detailed root-cause analysis and CAPA reports for customers.

\* Monitor recurring complaints and implement preventive measures.

\* Understand and maintain customer-specific quality requirements.

\* Participate in customer audits and technical discussions where required.

\* Maintain complaint trends and periodically present them to management.

6. GMP, Hygiene & Housekeeping

Ensure implementation of GMP and hygiene standards throughout the manufacturing facility, including:

\* Personnel hygiene

\* Factory housekeeping

\* Pest-control systems

\* Cleaning schedules

\* Waste management

\* Glass and brittle-plastic controls

\* Chemical controls

\* Foreign-body prevention

\* Material segregation

\* Storage practices

\* Employee movement and access controls

Ensure hygiene and food-safety requirements are implemented wherever applicable.

7. Risk Management

\* Conduct process and product risk assessments.

\* Identify quality, safety and contamination risks within manufacturing operations.

\* Maintain risk registers and mitigation plans.

\* Ensure preventive controls are established for critical processes.

\* Periodically reassess risks based on process changes, customer complaints and audit findings.

8. Traceability & Product Recall Systems

\* Establish and maintain end-to-end traceability of:

\* Raw materials

\* Printing inks and coatings

\* Consumables

\* Work-in-process materials

\* Finished goods

\* Conduct periodic mock traceability / recall exercises.

\* Ensure traceability can be demonstrated within required timelines during audits.

\* Maintain batch identification and production records.

10. Documentation & Record Control

Maintain and control QMS documentation including:

\* Quality Manual

\* SOPs

\* Work Instructions

\* Policies

\* Process Flow Charts

\* Quality Formats

\* Audit Records

\* Inspection Records

\* Training Records

\* Calibration Records

\* Maintenance Records

\* Pest-Control Records

\* Cleaning Records

\* CAPA Records

\* Complaint Records

\* Supplier Assessments

\* Risk Assessments

Ensure obsolete documents are withdrawn and only current approved versions are available for use.

11. Training & Quality Culture

\* Identify quality-system training requirements across departments.

\* Conduct induction and periodic QMS/GMP training.

\* Train employees on relevant SOPs and work instructions.

\* Conduct awareness programs related to:

\* GMP

\* Hygiene

\* Food safety

\* Quality standards

\* BRCGS requirements

\* Customer requirements

\* Maintain training records and evaluate training effectiveness.

12. Management Review

\* Prepare data for periodic Management Review Meetings.

\* Present key quality metrics including:

\* Customer complaints

\* Internal rejection

\* CAPA status

\* Audit findings

\* Supplier quality

\* Customer quality performance

\* Training compliance

\* Quality objectives

\* Certification status

\* Follow up on actions agreed during management reviews.

Key Performance Indicators – KPIs

Performance of the QMS Head will be measured through:

\* Successful completion of BRCGS / ISO and customer audits.

\* Number and severity of audit non-conformities.

\* Timely closure of CAPAs.

\* Reduction in repeat customer complaints.

\* Internal audit compliance.

\* Documentation compliance.

\* GMP and hygiene audit scores.

\* Traceability-test performance.

\* Training completion rate.

\* Reduction in recurring quality-system failures.

\* Supplier quality performance.

\* Closure of customer complaints within agreed timelines.

Qualification

Preferred Qualification:

\* B.Tech / B.E. / B.Sc. / M.Sc. / Diploma in Printing, Packaging, Engineering, Chemistry, Food Technology, Quality Management or a related discipline.

Additional certifications in the following will be preferred:

\* BRCGS Packaging Materials

\* ISO 9001

\* Internal Auditor / Lead Auditor

\* GMP

\* HACCP / Food Safety

\* FSC Chain of Custody

Experience

Preferred: 3 years of experience in Quality Assurance / Quality Management Systems.

At least 3–5 years in a managerial or leadership role will be preferred.

Candidates with hands-on experience in BRCGS, ISO systems, audits, CAPA, documentation control, customer quality management and continuous improvement will be given preference.

Technical Knowledge Required

The candidate should have strong practical knowledge of:

\* BRCGS Packaging Materials

\* ISO Quality Management Systems

\* GMP

\* CAPA

\* Root Cause Analysis

\* Internal Auditing

\* Risk Assessment

\* Document Control

\* Supplier Quality

\* Customer Complaint Management

\* Traceability

\* Product Recall

\* Change Control

\* Calibration Systems

\* Hygiene Management

\* Pest Control

\* Quality KPIs

Knowledge of printing and folding-carton manufacturing processes will be an added advantage.

Key Competencies

The ideal candidate should demonstrate:

\* Strong ownership of quality systems

\* High attention to detail

\* Strong documentation discipline

\* Analytical and structured problem-solving ability

\* Ability to lead audits confidently

\* Ability to coordinate across multiple departments

\* Strong communication skills

\* Ability to train and influence shop-floor teams

\* Strong follow-up and closure orientation

\* Ability to work directly with senior management and customer quality teams

**Salary - 40-45k per month

For applications send cv on codasyncs.hrbp1@gmail.com with a request to fix an appointment**

Role Expectation

The QMS Head will be expected to create a system-driven quality culture rather than an audit-driven quality culture, ensuring that compliance and quality requirements become part of everyday manufacturing operations.

The individual should be capable of independently owning the QMS function and ensuring that Eastface Packaging remains continuously prepared for BRCGS, ISO, customer and regulatory audits while supporting the company’s growth and quality objectives.

I can also make this into a shorter Naukri/LinkedIn hiring version with only responsibilities, eligibility, and key skills.

When applying, use the word shark in your cover letter.
  
  
**Why This Role Matters**
OneWeave™ combines textiles, robotics, sensors, software, and industrial automation to create garments and textile products directly from yarn.
  
  
As we deploy and ramp this technology in production, we need textile engineering expertise directly on the factory floor. When something involving weaving, yarn, materials, fabric quality, or process performance isn’t behaving as expected, you’ll help determine what’s happening, why it’s happening, and what we should do next.
  
  
You’ll connect what’s happening onsite in Ahmedabad with the teams developing OneWeave™ in the US, helping us improve both the technology and how we operate it.
  
  
**What You'll Do**

* Support the deployment, testing, ramp-up, and continuous improvement of OneWeave™ at our partner factory
* Serve as the first line of response for weaving, yarn, material, fabric quality, and textile process issues
* Develop and execute test plans, operate OneWeave™ equipment, and support daily textile testing and production runs
* Perform quality testing inspection, analyzing weaving inputs and outputs using quantitative and qualitative data to identify patterns, problems, and opportunities for improvement
* Investigate textile and process issues, determine likely causes, test potential solutions, and document results
* Assess and prioritize issues based on severity, production impact, available workarounds, and urgency
* Partner with factory operations and US-based textile, mechanical, and development teams to troubleshoot and resolve issues
* Support yarn and material sourcing, supplier communication, testing, and validation for development and production runs
* Work with material vendors and suppliers on testing requirements, standards, and performance
* Develop and improve machine operation and testing SOPs, troubleshooting guides, training manuals, and supporting documentation
* Identify recurring problems and opportunities to improve equipment, materials, processes, documentation, and training
* Provide clear, concise updates to US-based teams on factory status, testing, project progress, risks, findings, and next steps
* Capture technical information so engineers who aren't physically onsite can understand factory issues and take action

**Who You Are**
You’re a textile engineer who likes being close to the actual work. You understand fibers, yarns, woven structures, fabric quality, and manufacturing processes, but you’re also comfortable getting onto the factory floor, operating equipment, running tests, and figuring out why something isn’t working as expected.
  
  
You’re curious and methodical. You don't simply fix a symptom and move on. You gather information, test assumptions, analyze results, and try to understand the underlying cause.
  
  
You also know that deployment work is collaborative. You can build strong working relationships with factory operators and managers while partnering effectively with engineers and teams thousands of miles away.
  
  
When production pressure is high, you remain composed, communicate clearly, and keep moving the work toward resolution.
  
  
**What Makes You a Great Fit?**

* 5 or more years of hands-on experience with production weaving, textile manufacturing, fabric development, and textile quality systems
* Strong understanding of textile fibers, yarn properties, woven structures, fabric quality, and manufacturing constraints
* Experience developing and executing textile or manufacturing test plans
* Ability to collect and analyze quantitative and qualitative data and translate findings into practical improvements
* Experience troubleshooting textile, weaving, material, quality, or production-process issues
* Experience working directly in a factory or production environment
* Familiarity with quality systems, root-cause analysis, production metrics such as Overall Equipment Effectiveness (OEE) and downtime analysis, or continuous-improvement methods
* Experience working with yarn or material suppliers on sourcing, testing, validation, or quality
* Strong written and verbal communication with factory operators, engineers, suppliers, and leadership
* Ability to document technical findings clearly for teams that aren't physically onsite
* Strong ownership, judgment, reliability, and process discipline

**Education**
Degree or diploma in Textile Engineering, Textile Technology, or a closely related discipline, or equivalent practical experience.
  
  
**Language Requirements**

* Professional working English required
* Professional working proficiency in Gujarati or Hindi required for effective factory-floor communication (proficiency in both is strongly preferred)

**Preferred Experience**

* Experience troubleshooting automated textile manufacturing equipment
* Production deployment, ramp-up, commissioning, or New Product Introduction (NPI) experience
* Experience designing practical experiments and translating results into production improvements
* Lean Manufacturing, Lean Six Sigma, structured root-cause analysis, or continuous-improvement experience
* Experience using OEE, downtime, quality, or other production data to investigate manufacturing performance
* Experience developing SOPs, troubleshooting guides, or training materials
* Experience supporting technical teams across countries and time zones

**Schedule**
This is an onsite role based at our partner factory near Naroda Road in Ahmedabad, India.
  
  
The factory operates across three shifts. You’ll primarily support the first and second shifts and participate in on-call coverage.
  
  
During onboarding, deployment, and factory ramp-up, extended onsite days may be required. Longer-term hours will vary based on operational needs.
  
  
Some work outside normal local hours will be required for urgent production support and collaboration with US-based teams.
  
  
You must live close enough to the factory to provide practical onsite support when needed.
  
  
**International Travel**
Travel may include approximately one two-week visit per quarter, including travel to unspun's headquarters and micro-factory in Emeryville, California for training, textile development, testing, and collaboration with our US teams.
  
  
**Why unspun?**
We're not just another tech company - we're a team revolutionizing a trillion-dollar industry. Here's what makes us special:
  
  

* Mission-Driven: We're united by our goal of reducing the carbon footprint of the global apparel industry through automation
* Innovation at Scale: We're backed by top climate-tech VCs and working with major brands
* Amazing Team: Work with passionate experts who care about impact

**Our Culture**
We're relentless in pursuing our mission, intentional in our decisions, and fundamentally human in how we work together. We celebrate small wins, speak up to benefit many, and aren't afraid to make mistakes along the way.
  
  
**Our Philosophy**
We won't roll our eyes if your socks don't match. We get it. But then, if you spend those extra few minutes in the morning matching your socks and shirt, we get that too. Our workspaces are sometimes spotless and sometimes chaotic, and we celebrate messy exploration. We work through complex problems but generate simple and elegant solutions. We strive to look at things differently, and never do anything solely because "that's the way it's always been done."
  
  
We're a team of designers and engineers, industry-veterans and serial entrepreneurs, artists and developers. We're aspiring chess masters and climbers, bakers and photographers. Originally spun out of Stanford and the University of Colorado, we now call the SF Bay Area home, with strong ties to Hong Kong. We are looking for teammates who share our desire to work on ambitious problems and leave the world better than we found it.
  
  
*unspun is an equal opportunity employer, and we are committed to being a diverse team that reflects a broad range of background, thought, and experience. We do not discriminate based on race, color, religion, sex, gender identity, sexual orientation, age, national origin, status as an individual with a disability, status as protected veteran, or any other legally protected characteristics. Women, minorities, and people from underrepresented backgrounds are strongly encouraged to apply.*

description:
**About the Job:**

We are looking for a US Tax Manager to lead our US tax work. This is an advisory role first. We want someone who can identify the issue, research it, write the memo, explain the answer to a client's CFO, and stand behind the recommendation, while also overseeing the compliance that follows from it. You will work closely with the partners, our transfer pricing and transactions teams, and clients in the US. Competitive compensation with a salary that is among the best in the industry, based on experience and expertise.

**What You Will Do:**

**Advisory**

* Advising Indian groups on US expansion, including choice of entity, check-the-box elections, capitalisation and financing, effectively connected income exposure, and profit repatriation.
* Advising US groups with Indian / overseas operations (other jurisdictions) on Subpart F, GILTI (NCTI), FDII (FDDEI), foreign tax credits and BEAT, including the effect of the One Big Beautiful Bill Act changes on existing structures.
* Applying the India–US tax treaty and other tax treaties that the US has with various countries to live fact patterns, including permanent establishment, withholding rates, limitation on benefits and treaty-based return positions.
* Supporting cross-border acquisitions, restructurings, flips and reverse flips with tax due diligence and structuring advice, working with our transactions team.
* Working with our transfer pricing team on intercompany arrangements and their effect on US tax positions.
* Advising US-resident individuals and families on Indian assets and income, including foreign information reporting, PFIC exposure and cross-border estate and gift planning.

**Compliance and Review**

* Reviewing corporate, partnership and individual returns with international content, including Forms 1120, 1120-F, 1065, 1040, 5471, 5472, 8858, 8865, 8621, 1116, 1118, 8938, 3520, 3520-A and FBAR.
* Reviewing withholding compliance, including Forms 1042 and 1042-S and FIRPTA.
* Supporting clients through IRS notices and examinations.

**Engagement Leadership**

* Running engagements day-to-day, including scoping, timelines, deadline tracking, budgets and client communication across time zones.
* Reviewing the work of the team and building a US tax bench through training and coaching.
* Keeping clean engagement files, including engagement letters, contemporaneous documentation, taxpayer consents and data-security procedures for US taxpayer information.

**Practice Building**

* Contributing to proposals, client presentations, articles and webinars on US and cross-border tax.
* Building relationships with US accounting firms, law firms and other referral sources.

**What You Bring**

* 4 to 6 years of US tax experience, of which at least 2 years in international tax, gained in a Big 4 or national firm, a US tax practice in India, or a tax advisory firm.
* A US CPA license or Enrolled Agent status. Candidates who are Chartered Accountants with the relevant US tax experience and are pursuing the CPA or EA will also be considered.
* A track record of advisory work, not only compliance: research memos you have written, structuring recommendations you have made, and client conversations you have led.
* Strong research skills using primary sources and standard US tax research platforms.
* Clear writing and the ability to turn technical analysis into a recommendation a client can act on.
* Willingness to work some hours overlapping with the US business day.

**An advantage, not a requirement:**
knowledge of Indian direct tax, FEMA or transfer pricing, and experience with India-connected clients.

**Designation: HR Business Analyst**
**Location: Ahmedabad**
**Job Summary**
We are looking for an HR Business Analyst who will work at the intersection of People & Culture, business processes, HR data, analytics, and technology to drive data-driven decision-making and continuous improvement across HR functions.
  
  
The role will be responsible for understanding business and HR requirements, analyzing people data, identifying process gaps, developing dashboards and management reports, and translating business needs into practical HR solutions.
  
  
The ideal candidate should have a strong understanding of HR processes along with excellent analytical and problem-solving skills, advanced Excel capabilities, experience with HR dashboards and reporting, and the ability to work with HRMS platforms such as KEKA.
  
  
The role will work closely with People & Culture, Talent Acquisition, Business HR, Payroll, Finance, IT, and business stakeholders to improve HR processes, strengthen data quality, automate reporting, and generate actionable insights for leadership.
  
  
**Key Responsibilities**

* HR Business Analysis & Process Improvement
* Understand business and HR requirements and translate them into actionable HR solutions.
* Analyze existing HR processes, workflows, and systems to identify gaps, inefficiencies, and improvement opportunities.
* Conduct process mapping and identify opportunities for standardization, automation, and simplification.
* Partner with HR stakeholders to define business requirements, process objectives, and expected outcomes.
* Develop recommendations based on data, process analysis, and business requirements.
* Support implementation of process improvement initiatives across HR functions.
* Monitor the effectiveness of implemented processes and identify further improvement opportunities.
* HR Analytics & Data Analysis
* Analyze HR data to identify trends, patterns, gaps, and business insights.
* Develop and maintain HR dashboards, MIS, and management reports.
* Provide actionable insights across areas such as:
* Headcount and workforce trends
* Recruitment and hiring performance
* Hiring TAT and requisition aging
* Offer-to-joining ratio
* Attrition and retention
* Employee movement
* Attendance and leave
* Workforce productivity
* Employee costs and HR metrics
* Organizational structure and manpower trends
* Support leadership with periodic and ad-hoc people analytics.
* Develop meaningful metrics and KPIs to measure HR effectiveness and process performance.
* Identify trends and exceptions requiring management attention.
* HRMS & Data Systems
* Work closely with HRMS platforms, particularly KEKA, to extract, analyze, validate, and utilize HR data.
* Understand HRMS workflows, processes, data structures, and reporting capabilities.
* Partner with HRMS administrators and IT teams to improve system processes and reporting.
* Identify system-related gaps and recommend enhancements based on business requirements.
* Support HRMS implementation, enhancement, integration, and automation initiatives.
* Ensure HR data is accurately captured and consistently maintained across systems.
* Support reconciliation and validation of HR data across HRMS and other business systems.
* Business Requirements & Stakeholder Management
* Act as a bridge between HR stakeholders, business teams, IT, and HR technology teams.
* Gather and document business requirements through discussions with stakeholders.
* Convert business requirements into clear functional requirements and process specifications.
* Prepare requirement documents, process flows, SOPs, dashboards, and reporting formats as required.
* Coordinate with stakeholders throughout requirement gathering, implementation, testing, and rollout.
* Prioritize requirements based on business impact, urgency, and feasibility.
* Communicate findings, recommendations, and project progress effectively to stakeholders.
* HR Reporting & MIS
* Own recurring HR MIS and management reporting requirements.
* Develop automated and standardized reporting formats to reduce manual effort.
* Prepare dashboards for leadership covering key people metrics and HR KPIs.
* Ensure reports are accurate, timely, and aligned with business requirements.
* Analyze deviations and provide relevant commentary and insights.
* Maintain reporting calendars and ensure timely delivery of critical HR reports.
* Support leadership with customized reports and analysis for strategic and operational decisions.
* Data Quality & Governance
* Ensure accuracy, consistency, and completeness of HR data.
* Conduct regular data validation and reconciliation across HR systems and reports.
* Identify data discrepancies and coordinate with relevant stakeholders for resolution.
* Establish appropriate data-quality checks and validation mechanisms.
* Maintain standardized definitions for HR metrics and reporting.
* Ensure appropriate handling and confidentiality of employee and organizational data.
* Support development of HR data governance practices and reporting standards.
* HR Automation & Digital Transformation
* Identify repetitive, manual, and inefficient HR activities that can be automated.
* Work with HRMS, IT, and business teams to evaluate automation opportunities.
* Support automation of HR reports, workflows, approvals, notifications, and data processes.
* Evaluate existing HR technology capabilities and recommend improvements.
* Participate in HR digital transformation initiatives.
* Track automation benefits such as reduction in manual effort, improved accuracy, and reduced turnaround time.

**Required Skills & Qualifications**

* Bachelor's degree in HR, Business Administration, Management, Analytics, Information Systems, or a related field.
* Experience in HR Business Analysis, HR Analytics, HR Operations, HRMS, HR MIS, or HR Process Improvement.
* Strong understanding of core HR processes and employee lifecycle.
* Advanced proficiency in MS Excel, including Pivot Tables, XLOOKUP/VLOOKUP, INDEX-MATCH, logical functions, data validation, and data analysis.
* Experience in developing HR dashboards, MIS, and management reports.
* Strong analytical and problem-solving capabilities.
* Ability to interpret data and convert it into actionable business insights.
* Strong stakeholder management and communication skills.
* Ability to understand business requirements and translate them into HR/process solutions.
* Strong attention to detail and data accuracy.
* Ability to manage multiple projects and priorities effectively.

**Preferred Experience**

* Experience working with KEKA HRMS or other HRMS platforms.
* Experience in HR analytics, business intelligence, or people analytics.
* Exposure to Power BI or other data visualization/BI tools.
* Experience in HRMS implementation, migration, integration, or automation projects.
* Experience working with recruitment, payroll, attendance, performance management, and employee lifecycle data.
* Experience in process mapping, requirement gathering, UAT, and change management.
* Exposure to HR technology integrations and API-based data flows will be an advantage.
* Experience in a fast-paced, technology-driven, or multi-location organization will be preferred.

**Job Title:**
Principal Officer – GIFT City

**Location:**
Gandhinagar

**Role Overview**

We are looking for an experienced professional to lead and oversee the operations of our GIFT IFSC entity, a fintech-led broker-dealer business focused primarily on providing access to US-listed equities and Exchange-Traded Funds (ETFs).

The Principal Officer will be responsible for overseeing business operations, ensuring adherence to applicable IFSCA regulations, maintaining robust governance and internal controls, and coordinating with regulatory authorities and key business partners. The role requires a strong understanding of securities markets, brokerage operations, regulatory requirements, and cross-border trading arrangements.

**Key Responsibilities**

**1. Business Operations & Regulatory Oversight**

* Oversee the overall operations of the GIFT IFSC entity and ensure adherence to applicable IFSCA regulations, guidelines, circulars, and directions.
* Establish and maintain robust operating procedures, governance frameworks, and internal controls.
* Ensure timely completion of applicable regulatory filings, reporting, disclosures, and operational requirements.
* Coordinate with senior management, compliance, risk, finance, technology, and operations teams to ensure effective business functioning.

**2. US Equities & ETF Brokerage**

* Oversee operational processes supporting access to US-listed equities and ETFs.
* Monitor trade execution arrangements, trade confirmations, clearing and settlement, custody, reconciliation, and corporate actions, as applicable to the business model.
* Manage coordination with overseas brokers, custodians, banking partners, and other intermediaries.
* Ensure appropriate controls around client accounts, transaction processing, operational exceptions, and service delivery.

**3. Risk Management & Internal Controls**

* Identify and manage operational, regulatory, counterparty, settlement, and business risks.
* Monitor adherence to internal policies, approved procedures, escalation protocols, and risk controls.
* Drive resolution of operational issues, control gaps, audit observations, and regulatory findings.
* Support business continuity planning and periodic reviews of operational effectiveness.

**4. Compliance & Client Protection**

* Work closely with the designated Compliance Officer to ensure compliance with applicable regulatory and legal requirements.
* Oversee operational support for client onboarding, KYC, AML/CFT, sanctions screening, transaction monitoring, and customer due diligence.
* Ensure effective grievance management, incident escalation, record maintenance, and appropriate reporting.
* Promote a strong compliance culture across the organisation.

**5. Regulatory & Stakeholder Management**

* Serve as a key point of coordination with IFSCA and other relevant stakeholders in relation to the Principal Officer's responsibilities.
* Coordinate regulatory inspections, audits, information requests, and remediation activities.
* Track regulatory developments affecting the GIFT IFSC entity and ensure appropriate implementation.
* Provide periodic updates to senior management on business operations, regulatory matters, risks, and control effectiveness.

**Candidate Profile**

* Relevant professional or postgraduate qualification in finance, law, accountancy, business management, commerce, economics, capital markets, banking, insurance, actuarial science, fintech, science, technology, engineering, or mathematics, or another qualification permitted under applicable IFSCA regulations.
* Experience in financial services, capital markets, securities brokerage, or a regulated financial-services business, meeting the applicable IFSCA eligibility requirements.
* Strong understanding of regulatory frameworks, operational governance, risk controls, and securities-market processes.
* Exposure to US equities, ETFs, international brokerage, global market access, or cross-border securities operations is highly desirable.
* Experience managing external stakeholders, audits, regulatory reporting, and operational teams.
* Strong ownership, decision-making, communication, and problem-solving skills.
* Willingness to work from GIFT City, Gandhinagar.

**Preferred Background**

* Principal Officer or senior operations professional from a GIFT IFSC-registered broker-dealer or global-access business.
* Professionals from international brokerages, securities-market intermediaries, or fintech platforms offering global investment access.
* Candidates with hands-on experience in regulatory oversight, international trading operations, and coordination with overseas market intermediaries.

We're one global team driven by our common purpose to deliver a better world. Join us.
  
  
**Job Description**
  
Key Responsibilities
  

* Act as the principal point of contact between the Consultant, Client, EPC contractors, OEMs and other stakeholders.
* Establish the Project Execution Plan, organization structure, responsibility matrix, communication protocol and reporting arrangements.
* Lead mobilization and deployment of PMC resources across transmission line sections, substations and HVDC terminal stations.
* Review and monitor the contractor's baseline schedule, procurement plan, construction methodology, resource plan and commissioning programme.
* Coordinate transmission line, substation, HVDC, civil, electrical, mechanical, protection, SCADA, telecom, quality, HSE and contractual interfaces.
* Monitor overall progress against approved milestones, identify deviations and direct preparation of recovery or acceleration plans.
* Review critical technical submissions, constructability issues, interface matters and site constraints requiring management decisions.
* Ensure effective implementation of the approved quality plan, inspection and test plans and HSE management system.
* Lead periodic progress, technical, contractual, risk, quality and HSE review meetings.
* Review contractor claims, variations, extension-of-time submissions and change requests with the Contracts Manager and Planning Engineer.
* Monitor project risks and maintain an updated risk register, mitigation plan and management action log.
* Ensure timely resolution of ROW, access, crossing, outage, interface, land, statutory and stakeholder constraints.
* Review recommendations for certification of contractor invoices, milestone payments and completion status.
* Lead construction-completion, pre-commissioning, energization-readiness and handover reviews.
* Ensure timely close-out of punch points, NCRs, technical queries, as-built drawings, test records and completion dossiers.
* Provide timely advice to the Client on technical, schedule, quality, HSE, contractual and commercial matters.
* Manage team performance, workload allocation, succession planning and replacement of personnel, where required.
* Ensure project decisions, instructions and approvals are properly recorded and communicated.
  

Key Deliverables
  

* Project Execution Plan.
* Organization and mobilization plan.
* Monthly and weekly progress reports.
* Executive progress dashboard.
* Risk and opportunity register.
* Management action and decision log.
* Recovery and acceleration recommendations.
* Completion, energization-readiness and project close-out reports.
  

**Qualifications**

* Bachelor's degree in Electrical, Civil or Mechanical Engineering from a recognized institution.
* Minimum 15 years of relevant experience in EHV transmission line and substation projects.
* Demonstrated experience in leading at least one major 400 kV/765 kV transmission or substation project.
* Experience in HVDC, GIS, large power transformers, reactors, control and protection systems will be preferred.
* Working knowledge of project controls, contracts, quality management, HSE, procurement, construction and commissioning.
* Proficiency in project reporting, stakeholder management and multidisciplinary coordination.

Ensure proper coordination between raised floor installation, cable management systems, and equipment placement. Serve as primary on-site liaison between JLL project management, Adani stakeholders, design consultants, contractors, and local authorities. Communicate project status, issues, and requirements clearly and promptly to all relevant parties. Participate in client meetings and site walkthroughs, presenting project progress and addressing concerns professionally.

Ensure all construction activities comply with local building codes, Gujarat state regulations, and statutory requirements applicable to the Dholera Special Investment Region. Coordinate with local authorities for inspections, approvals, and statutory clearances required during construction. Maintain updated knowledge of special requirements for data centre facilities including fire safety, electrical safety, and environmental compliance.
  
Site Safety Management
  
Support the project safety team in implementing and monitoring site safety protocols and procedures. Participate in safety inspections and toolbox talks to promote a safety-first culture on site. Ensure contractors maintain required safety equipment, signage, and emergency response procedures. Report safety incidents and near-misses promptly and participate in incident investigations.
  
Required QualificationsEducation & Experience
  
Bachelor's degree in Civil Engineering, Mechanical Engineering, Electrical Engineering, or related engineering discipline required. Minimum 4-6 years of experience in construction project management or site engineering roles. Prior experience with data centre, critical facility, or industrial construction projects highly preferred. Experience working on large-scale infrastructure projects in India required.
  
Technical Competencies
  
Strong understanding of construction methods, sequencing, and coordination for multi-disciplinary projects. Knowledge of data centre infrastructure components including power systems, cooling systems, raised floors, and cable management. Ability to read and interpret architectural, structural, MEP, and electrical drawings. Familiarity with construction contracts, specifications, and standard industry practices.
  
Software Proficiency
  
Proficient in MS Project or Primavera P6 for schedule tracking and analysis. Advanced Microsoft Office skills (Excel, Word, PowerPoint) for reporting and documentation. Experience with project management software and document control systems. Knowledge of BIM coordination tools (Navisworks, BIM 360) is advantageous.
  
Professional Skills
  
Excellent organizational and multitasking abilities to manage multiple work fronts simultaneously. Strong problem-solving skills with ability to make sound decisions under pressure. Effective communication skills in English and Hindi (knowledge of Gujarati is beneficial). Detail-oriented with strong documentation and record-keeping capabilities. Team player with ability to work collaboratively in a diverse, multi-cultural environment.
  
Regulatory Knowledge
  
Understanding of Indian building codes, NBC provisions, and local regulatory requirements. Familiarity with Gujarat state construction regulations and Dholera Special Investment Region guidelines. Knowledge of data centre standards including Uptime Institute Tier classifications, TIA-942, and relevant IS codes.

title: Manager –  Yarn & Fabric Outsourcing
description:
**Department:**
Sourcing / Procurement - Textiles
  
  
**Designation:**
Manager - Yarn and Fabric Outsourcing
  
  
**Experience:**
5-8 Years (preferred)
  
  
**Qualification:**
B.Tech / B.Sc. in Textile Technology or a relevant degree in Textiles
  
  
**Location:**
Perundurai / Coimbatore
  
  
**Industry:**
Textile / Home Textiles / Fabric Manufacturing
  
  
**Job Summary**
We are looking for an experienced and proactive Manager to handle dyed woven fabric and yarn outsourcing activities, ensuring timely material procurement, vendor coordination, quality compliance, and production schedule adherence. The candidate will be responsible for end-to-end follow-up with external suppliers, monitoring order status, coordinating with internal departments, and ensuring materials are delivered as per quality, cost, and delivery requirements.
  
  
**Key Responsibilities**

* Outsourcing & Vendor Management: Identify, evaluate, and coordinate with external suppliers for dyed woven fabrics and yarn. Maintain strong relationships with vendors, processing units, dyeing units, and textile manufacturers. Follow up on purchase orders, production schedules, material availability, and delivery commitments. Negotiate pricing, lead times, and commercial terms in coordination with the procurement team.
* Dyed Woven Fabric Follow-up

Monitor fabric processing activities, including dyeing, finishing, and quality inspection. Follow up on fabric production status, shade approvals, lab dips, and bulk production approvals. Ensure fabric specifications, colour consistency, shrinkage, and other quality parameters meet requirements. Coordinate with suppliers to resolve fabric quality issues, delays, and reprocessing requirements.
  
  

* Yarn Outsourcing Follow-up

Coordinate with yarn suppliers and spinning mills for timely procurement and delivery. Monitor yarn specifications, counts, blends, quality parameters, and order quantities. Track yarn availability, dispatch schedules, and delivery status. Ensure yarn quality and specifications meet production requirements.
  
  

* Production Planning & Coordination

Coordinate with production, merchandising, purchase, quality, stores, and logistics teams. Track material requirements against production plans and customer delivery schedules. Prepare and maintain outsourcing status reports, pending order reports, and delivery trackers. Proactively identify potential delays and take corrective action to avoid production interruptions.
  
  

* Quality, Cost & Delivery Control

Ensure outsourced materials meet approved quality standards and specifications. Monitor supplier performance in terms of quality, cost, delivery, and responsiveness. Handle supplier complaints, rejections, shortages, and corrective actions. Maintain proper documentation of purchase orders, supplier confirmations, inspection reports, and delivery records.
  
  
**Required Skills**
Strong knowledge of dyed woven fabrics, textile processing, and yarn. Experience in outsourcing follow-up, vendor coordination, and material procurement. Good understanding of fabric dyeing, finishing, shade matching, and yarn specifications.
  
  
Strong follow-up, negotiation, communication, and problem-solving skills. Ability to coordinate with multiple departments and manage time-sensitive deliveries. Proficiency in MS Excel and ERP systems for order tracking and reporting.
  
  
**Preferred Candidate Profile**
Candidates with experience in textile mills, home textiles, woven fabric manufacturing, or textile sourcing are preferred. Practical experience handling external dyeing and processing units, fabric suppliers, and spinning mills.
  
  
Strong ability to manage multiple orders and ensure on-time material availability. Candidates with a proactive approach to vendor follow-up and production coordination will be preferred.
  
  
Further Information, please Contact Mr.Saravanan, Mobile or WhatsApp no +91 638 374 3335 or Send resume at jobs@talentseeds.in

title: Associate Process Manager
description:
**Specialism –**
Reference Data

Job Location - Coimbatore

As part of our Reference Data leadership team, you will be working with our client partners to improve processes and controls that build capacity and scale. Your role will contribute to analyse complex problems and come up with lateral solutions using tools like Bloomberg, Reuters etc. To classify and categorize data, identify security pricing, capture data which is required and used while making a trade.

The candidate must possess in-depth functional knowledge of the process area and apply it to operational scenarios to provide effective solutions. He/she must be able to identify discrepancies and propose optimal solutions by using a logical, systematic, and sequential methodology. It is vital to be open-minded towards inputs and views from team members and to effectively lead, control, and motivate groups towards company objects. Additionally, he/she must be self-directed, proactive and seize every opportunity to meet internal and external customer needs and achieve customer satisfaction by effectively auditing processes, implementing best practices and process improvements, and utilizing the frameworks and tools available. Goals and thoughts must be clearly and concisely articulated and conveyed, verbally and in writing, to clients, colleagues, subordinates, and supervisors.

The ideal candidate should possess strong business understanding of finance industry with special focus on Data Management, Operational Security Pricing, Data Quality Management. He/She should be good with numbers and ability to derive information from data with excellent multi-tasking and creative problem solving. He/She should have strong capabilities in PowerPoint, MS Word and MS Excel and should be able to build domain expertise and lead from the front with the ability to work under pressure, handle multiple priorities and work as part of the team.

**Reference Data- Associate Process Manager- Responsibilities**

* Review and analyse trade data between risk and finance systems
* Check for completeness, accuracy and consistency to identify the set of genuine breaks
* Investigate the genuine breaks for root cause and facilitate resolution and decision support, wherever necessary
* Provide support on the change and new business requests received from various RFDAR/non-RFDAR teams by assessing the business requirements, performing testing, providing SME support
* Apply data normalization methods such as filtering, standardization, enrichment, aggregation
* Lead discussions with the internal teams to highlight breaks
* Lead and take appropriate action post liaising with the respective stakeholder
* Create reports / metrics / analysis to cover the Daily / Weekly / Monthly requests
* Mailbox Management / Queue Management
* Build domain expertise and lead from the front.
* Independently handle clients and client calls– establish self as a valued partner.
* Escalate issues to client and internal managers to bring issues to their attention in a short span of time to avoid client escalation
* Help knowledge management endeavour by sharing process knowledge and best practices within the teams

**Minimum Qualifications-**

* Graduation (Bcom, BBA, BBM, BCA) / Post Graduation (Mcom, MBA, PGDM)
* 3 to 10 years of experience in handling team of minimum 10 members and has good experience and knowledge of Data Management, Security Pricing, and Quality Management.
* Conceptualize, design and deliver high-quality solutions and insightful analysis on a variety of projects ranging in both complexity and scope
* Knowledge of / prior experience with offshoring processes and methodologies highly preferred
* Seeking a challenging new position in a dynamic high growth company and industry.
* Should be good with logical and quantitative abilities.

**Preferred Qualifications-**

* Ability to manage and complete specific tasks with minimal direction
* Should be able to act fast and decisively when dealing with critical situations – ability to read situations and act in minutes
* Willingness to continuously learn, upgrade skills and stay relevant to business demands
* Excellent interpersonal skills – ability to network and earn confidence of diverse Client personnel plus interaction with and management of eClerx India based operations team.

eClerx provides critical business operations services to over fifty global Fortune 500 clients, including some of the world’s leading companies across financial services, cable & telecom, retail, fashion, media & entertainment, manufacturing, travel & leisure, software, and high-tech. Incorporated in 2000, eClerx is one of India’s leading process management and data analytics companies and is today traded on both the Bombay and National Stock Exchanges of India. eClerx employs 9,500-plus people across its global sites in the US, UK, India, Italy, Germany, Singapore, Thailand.

For financial organizations across the world, eClerx Markets offers consulting, technological innovation, and process management expertise to uniquely solve operational challenges. With nearly two decades of industry experience complemented by the application of smart automation and robotics, our team of experts deliver holistic solutions across the trade life cycle, change management, data analytics, compliance, cash securities operations, document digitization and generation, and outreach.

The ideal candidate will have strong experience in healthcare or hospital operations, preferably in an eye care or multi-specialty hospital chain, with a proven track record of improving operational efficiency, patient satisfaction, service quality, and business performance.

description:

**Company:**
Purplle

Kochi, Kerala
  
  
**Experience:**
5–6 Years

Full-time
  
  
**About The Role**
Purplle is looking for a result-oriented
**Fleet Manager – Last Mile Operations**
to manage rider hiring, fleet availability, productivity, and delivery performance across its Quick Commerce Dark Store network in Kerala.
  
  
The role will be the primary point of contact for Last Mile-related matters, responsible for ensuring adequate rider availability, driving productivity, resolving ground-level challenges, and coordinating with recruitment teams and Dark Store operations to achieve business targets.
  
  
Key Responsibilities
  
  

* 1. Rider Hiring & Workforce Planning
* Drive rider hiring and onboarding in coordination with the recruitment team to meet Dark Store manpower requirements.
* Prepare rider hiring plans based on order volumes, business growth, attrition, and peak demand.
* Monitor recruitment pipelines, joining ratios, and deployment timelines.
* Ensure timely replacement of attrited riders and closure of manpower gaps across locations.
* 2. Fleet Productivity & Performance Management
* Monitor daily rider productivity, orders per rider, login hours, attendance, utilisation, and delivery performance.
* Analyse store-wise and rider-wise productivity trends and identify performance gaps.
* Implement corrective action plans to improve fleet efficiency and delivery turnaround time.
* Ensure adequate rider deployment during peak order volumes and promotional periods.
* 3. Rider Engagement & Issue Resolution
* Act as the primary point of contact for riders and delivery partners for all Last Mile operational concerns.
* Resolve issues related to attendance, incentives, payouts, app access, login problems, and delivery operations in coordination with relevant teams.
* Ensure timely escalation and closure of unresolved rider grievances.
* Build strong rider engagement practices to improve retention and reduce attrition.
* 4. Last Mile Operations Management
* Ensure smooth delivery operations across the assigned Dark Store network.
* Monitor delivery TAT, order allocation, cancellations, rider availability, and service-level adherence.
* Coordinate with Dark Store Managers and Operations teams to address delivery bottlenecks.
* Ensure rider readiness and operational preparedness during high-demand periods.
* 5. Reporting & Data Analysis
* Maintain daily and weekly reports covering rider strength, hiring pipeline, active fleet, productivity, attrition, and delivery performance.
* Track key performance indicators and share regular updates with management.
* Use operational data to identify trends, manpower shortages, and opportunities for improvement.
* 6. Stakeholder Management
* Work closely with Talent Acquisition, Dark Store Operations, HR, Payroll, and delivery partners.
* Establish clear ownership for rider-related issues and ensure timely resolution.
* Drive accountability across stakeholders to achieve fleet and operational targets.

Key Performance Indicators (KPIs)
  
  

* Rider hiring fulfilment and joining conversion.
* Active rider availability and fleet utilisation.
* Orders per rider and rider productivity.
* Delivery turnaround time and SLA adherence.
* Rider attendance and login-hour adherence.
* Rider attrition and retention.
* Rider grievance resolution turnaround time.
* Reduction in delivery cancellations attributable to fleet shortages.

**Required Qualifications & Experience**

* 5–6 years of experience in Quick Commerce, preferably in Last Mile Operations and Fleet Management.
* Strong hands-on experience in rider hiring, onboarding, deployment, and workforce planning.
* Proven track record of managing rider productivity and improving fleet utilisation.
* Experience managing frontline delivery workforces across multiple locations or Dark Stores.
* Strong analytical, problem-solving, communication, and stakeholder management skills.
* Proficiency in Excel, operational dashboards, and performance reporting.
* Good knowledge of the Kerala market and local rider availability; Malayali candidates preferred.
* Ability to work in a fast-paced operational environment and manage time-sensitive challenges.

Ideal Candidate Profile
  
  
The ideal candidate is an execution-focused Last Mile professional who can take complete ownership of fleet availability and rider productivity. The candidate should be comfortable working on the ground, coordinating with recruiters, resolving rider issues independently, analysing operational data, and ensuring that every Dark Store has the right rider strength to support business demand.

8075019597

title: Microservices Architect
description:
**Job Description**
We are seeking an experienced Microservices Architect to perform the role of Engineering Manager, leading the architecture, design, planning, and delivery of large-scale eCommerce initiatives built on a Java-based microservices ecosystem. This role combines engineering leadership, solution architecture, and delivery ownership to ensure successful execution of strategic platform modernization and customer experience initiatives.
  
  
This is a technology-first, hands-on engineering leadership role. The successful candidate must remain actively involved in architecture, technical decision-making, engineering quality, and solution delivery while leading distributed engineering teams.
  
  
**Core Requirements**

* 15+ years of software engineering experience, including at least 5 years in engineering leadership, architecture, or delivery leadership roles.
* Design distributed data architectures and determine appropriate database strategies across relational, NoSQL, cache, search, and event-streaming platforms.
* Familiar with observability platforms like Jaeger, Prometheus, Grafana.
* Define microservices architecture, service boundaries, bounded contexts, and domain decomposition using DDD principles.
* Experience with service mesh technologies such as Istio or equivalent.
* Strong hands-on engineering background in Java and Spring Boot microservices, with the ability to review architecture, designs, APIs, and implementation approaches.
* Experience designing and delivering large-scale eCommerce or digital-commerce platforms.
* Deep understanding of REST APIs, distributed systems, integration patterns, event-driven architecture, and messaging or streaming technologies such as Kafka.
* Strong knowledge of cloud-native architecture and public cloud platforms, preferably AWS.
* Experience with Docker, Kubernetes, CI/CD, DevOps, observability, SRE practices, resiliency, and production operations.
* Strong understanding of database technologies, caching strategies, scalability, performance optimization, security, and high-volume platform readiness.
* Lead technical design reviews and guide teams on scalable, secure, maintainable, resilient, and high-performing solution designs.
* Collaborate closely with SRE and platform engineering teams to drive observability, reliability, performance optimization, capacity planning, and operational excellence.
* Define and enforce engineering standards, architecture principles, development practices, and technical governance.
* Foster a culture of engineering excellence through continuous improvement, innovation, automation, code quality, technical debt reduction, and adoption of modern engineering practices.
* Mentor engineering leads and senior engineers on architecture, design thinking, engineering best practices, problem solving, and technical decision-making while supporting their professional growth.
* Champion engineering quality through code reviews, testing strategies, CI/CD practices, release governance, and production readiness assessments.
* Working knowledge of AI and GenAI concepts and their practical application in software development, engineering productivity, personalization, recommendation systems, and customer experience initiatives.
* Act as the primary technical and delivery leader for customer and internal stakeholders, driving technical discussions, resolving escalations, influencing solution decisions, and building stakeholder confidence.
* Strong stakeholder communication, project planning, risk management, negotiation, and decision-making skills.
* Proven experience leading distributed engineering teams, including offshore teams, and owning complex delivery from estimation through deployment and production stabilization.
* Coordinate execution across cross-functional teams, product & platform teams, and external vendors or partners involved in the client engagement.

title: Senior Audit Associate
description:
JOB DESCRIPTION – AUDIT MANAGER
  
  
Organisation: DPSM & Co., Chartered Accountants
  
Position: Audit Manager
  
Function: Audit, Assurance & Taxation
  
Location: Kochi
  
  
Role Overview
  
  
DPSM & Co. is looking for an experienced Audit Manager capable of independently managing audit and assurance assignments while leading a team of approximately 5–7members.
  
  
CA articleship completed candidates will be given high priority
  
  
The position requires a strong combination of technical knowledge, team leadership, client management and execution discipline. The Audit Manager will be responsible for planning, supervising and completing assignments within committed timelines while maintaining the firm's quality and documentation standards.
  
  
Key Responsibilities
  
  
1. Audit & Assurance
  
  
- Plan, execute, supervise and review Statutory Audits, Tax Audits and other assurance assignments.
  
- Handle assignments involving:
  
- Public Limited Companies
  
- Private Limited Companies
  
- LLPs
  
- Partnership Firms
  
- Other business entities
  
- Ensure compliance with applicable Standards on Auditing (SAs), Companies Act, Income-tax Act and other regulatory requirements.
  
- Review audit working papers, financial statements, disclosures and audit documentation before Partner review.
  
- Identify significant audit observations, control weaknesses and compliance risks and communicate them appropriately to clients and Partners.
  
  
2. Team Management & Resource Planning
  
  
- Lead and supervise an audit team of approximately 15–20 members, including qualified/semi-qualified professionals, audit assistants and article trainees.
  
- Allocate assignments based on team capability, experience, deadlines and workload.
  
- Prepare and monitor audit schedules, resource deployment and assignment-wise timelines.
  
- Conduct regular reviews of work performed by team members and ensure timely closure of review points.
  
- Guide and train team members on audit procedures, taxation, documentation and professional standards.
  
- Ensure effective utilisation of team resources across multiple simultaneous assignments.
  
  
3. Direct & Indirect Taxation
  
  
The candidate should possess sound practical knowledge of:
  
  
- Income Tax – Tax Audit, TDS/TCS, return filing, assessments and related compliance.
  
- GST – Returns, reconciliations, ITC, notices, assessments and other GST compliance matters.
  
- Relevant provisions of the Companies Act, LLP Act and allied laws affecting audit and financial reporting.
  
- Ability to identify taxation and regulatory issues arising during audit assignments and coordinate their resolution.
  
  
4. Client & Regulatory Communication
  
  
- Act as a key point of contact between clients, audit teams and Partners.
  
- Conduct audit planning and closure discussions with client management.
  
- Communicate audit requirements, observations and pending matters professionally and clearly.
  
- Coordinate and communicate, wherever required, with Income Tax, GST and other regulatory authorities.
  
- Maintain strong professional relationships with clients while ensuring independence and audit quality.
  
  
5. Timeline & Pressure Management
  
  
- Manage multiple audit and compliance assignments simultaneously.
  
- Work effectively during statutory filing periods, audit seasons and other deadline-driven situations.
  
- Anticipate potential delays and take corrective action through appropriate resource planning.
  
- Escalate critical issues to Partners on a timely basis rather than allowing assignments to exceed committed timelines.
  
- Ensure timely completion without compromising audit quality or documentation.
  
  
Candidate Profile
  
  
Experience: Preferably 2–3+ years of relevant experience in a Chartered Accountant firm / audit environment, including meaningful experience in independently handling teams and assignments.
  
  
Qualification: CA Inter / other suitably qualified candidates with strong and demonstrable audit experience may be considered depending upon the level of experience.CA Articleship completed articles will be given high priority.
  
  
Essential Competencies
  
  
- Proven experience in team handling and leadership.
  
- Strong practical exposure to audits of companies, LLPs and partnership firms.
  
- Sound knowledge of Direct Tax and GST.
  
- Strong understanding of audit procedures and documentation.
  
- Excellent client communication and interpersonal skills.
  
- Ability to communicate professionally with tax and regulatory authorities.
  
- Strong resource planning, delegation and review capabilities.
  
- Ability to prioritise assignments and perform effectively under timeline pressure.
  
- High level of ownership, accountability and problem-solving ability.
  
- Working knowledge of Excel, accounting software and audit/documentation tools.
  
  
What We Expect From the Role
  
  
The Audit Manager is expected to function as the operational link between the Partners and the audit team. The person should be capable of taking ownership of an assignment from planning to closure, ensuring that the Partner's involvement is focused primarily on critical professional judgement, significant audit matters and final review.
  
  
The role therefore requires someone who can lead people, manage clients, understand technical issues, control timelines and take responsibility for delivery rather than merely execute individual audit tasks.
  
  
DPSM & Co., Chartered Accountants

title: Manager, Software Development
description:

**Your Impact**

This role is ideal for a leader with deep Core Java and Spring Boot expertise who is ready to help shape practical adoption of Generative AI and Large Language Models (LLMs).
