title: Staff Software Development Engineer in Test
description:
From Fivetran’s founding until now, our mission has remained the same: to make access to data as simple and reliable as electricity. With Fivetran, customer data arrives in their warehouses, canonical and ready to query, with no engineering or maintenance required. We’re proud that more organizations continue to leverage our technology every day to become truly data-driven.
  
  
**About Us**
Fivetran and dbt Labs are bringing together two industry-leading companies with a shared mission: helping organizations unlock the full value of their data.
  
  
Together, we’re delivering the data infrastructure layer that helps organizations move, transform, and trust their data — from the moment data moves, through every transformation, to the context teams and AI systems rely on.
  
  
Fivetran helps organizations automate data movement across the systems, clouds, engines, and tools they rely on. dbt Labs pioneered analytics engineering, helping teams transform data into reliable, governed insights. Together, we support thousands of organizations as they build a trusted foundation for analytics, AI, and better business decisions.
  
  
As we bring our teams and technology together, we’re building on the strengths of both companies while continuing to deliver the products and experiences our customers know and trust. It’s an exciting time to join us: we’re creating a company with the scale, talent, and technology to help more organizations put their data to work with greater speed, confidence, and impact.
  
  
During this transition period, you may see references to both Fivetran and dbt Labs throughout our recruiting process as we integrate our teams, systems, and career sites.
  
  
**About The Role**
As a Staff SDET, you’ll lead from the front– owning shared automation infrastructure, influencing release quality strategy, and driving initiatives that span teams and systems. This role sits at the intersection of hands-on engineering, architectural leadership, and org-wide quality influence.
  
  
You will architect and scale automation utilities/libraries, design and build internal tools that improve developer productivity and test efficiency, and establish testing strategies that ensure high-confidence releases across business-critical systems. You will work cross-functionally across teams and domains to influence quality culture, mentor engineers, and drive initiatives that shape how Fivetran builds and ships software. In addition, this role emphasizes leveraging AI driven solutions to accelerate testing, enhance developer productivity, and improve operational insights, making Fivetran’s quality practices smarter, faster, and more scalable.
  
  
This role requires deep technical expertise, architectural foresight, and the ability to scale impact beyond code through systems thinking, tool building, and strategic alignment.
  
  
**Technologies You’ll Use**

* Languages & Frameworks: Java (17+), JUnit, REST Assured, Shell scripting; Python (optional)
* Infrastructure & Tooling: Docker, Kubernetes, Terraform, Bazel, Buildkite
* Cloud & Platform: AWS, GCP, Azure
* Observability & Monitoring: Grafana, Prometheus, Datadog
* CI/CD & Automation: Jenkins, CircleCI, GitHub Actions
* Data & Testing:ELT pipelines, test automation utilities, whitebox testing strategies
* Databases: SQL and NoSQL databases (e.g., Postgres, MongoDB)

**What You’ll Do**

* Lead the architecture of internal tools, libraries, and utilities for test automation and benchmarking, enabling scalable quality solutions across teams and domains.
* Define and evolve quality strategies covering testability, release readiness, performance, and reliability.
* Drive cross-org quality initiatives to improve execution speed, observability, and feedback loops.
* Identify systemic risks in business-critical systems and implement robust validation strategies.
* Mentor engineers, influence design for testability, and champion best practices across the org.
* Collaborate with engineering and product leaders to align testing priorities with platform and business objectives.

**Skills We’re Looking For**

* 8+ years of experience in the software industry with a focus on building test automation frameworks, tools, and infrastructure at scale.
* Experience defining and driving code quality for tests (review processes, efficiency, maintainability).
* Writes critical or common code shared across multiple teams.
* Identifies and designs fixes for critical issues concerning core parts of the product.
* Contributes to and enforces department-wide coding standards.
* Identifies major improvements in product to improve quality and resilience.
* Identifies and fixes performance, scalability, and reliability gaps in tests and test frameworks.
* Defines testing efficiency and reporting strategies.
* Defines guidelines for product releases, including quality gates and readiness criteria.
* Expert in design principles and applying them to test architecture.
* Strong knowledge of OOP (preferably Java)
* Hands-on experience with cloud platforms (AWS, GCP, Azure).
* Experience with CI/CD systems (Buildkite, Jenkins, GitHub Actions, CircleCI), modern build tools (Bazel, Maven, Gradle), and observability platforms (New Relic, Datadog, Prometheus, Grafana).
* Strong background in infrastructure and container orchestration (Docker, Kubernetes, Temporal).
* Strong understanding of data engineering concepts, and large-scale distributed systems.
* Demonstrated ability to drive initiatives across multiple teams and influence business-critical systems.
* Strong written and verbal communication skills to support complex technical discussions.
* Knowledge of ELT pipelines, including testing data integrity, schema evolution, and pipeline reliability.
* Demonstrated ability to incorporate AI techniques to improve test efficiency, defect detection, and productivity.
* Experience evaluating and adopting emerging quality engineering practices (e.g., shift-left testing, chaos engineering, autonomous testing).

**Perks And Benefits**
100% employer-paid medical insurance- Generous paid time away from work, including paid vacation or flexible/unlimited vacation depending on role and country, plus paid sick time, inclusive parental leave, paid holidays, including a year-end Global Week of Rest, and volunteer days off.

- Access to an innovative mental health support platform that offers personalized care and resources in areas such as: therapy, coaching, and self-guided mindfulness exercises for all covered employees and their covered dependents.
\*May vary by country and worker type - please reach out to your recruiter for more information
  
  
*Click here to learn more about Fivetran's Benefits by Region.*
We’re honored to be valued at over $5.6 billion, but more importantly, we’re proud of our core values of Get Stuck In, Do the Right Thing, and One Team, One Dream. Read about us in Forbes.
  
  
Fivetran brings together high-quality talent across the globe to make data access as easy and reliable as electricity for our customers. We value and recognize that our customers benefit from having innovative teams made of people from many backgrounds, experiences, and identities. Fivetran promotes diversity, equity, inclusion & belonging through attracting, recruiting, developing, and retaining a diverse workforce, not only because it is the right thing to do, but because it helps us build a world-class company to better serve our customers, our people and our communities.

title: Senior Software Engineering Manager
description:
Job Title: Senior Software Engineering Manager
  
  
Req ID: 63818
  
  
Job Function: Software Engineering
  
  
Posting Start Date: 21/10/2026
  
  
Posting End Date: 28/10/2026
  
  
Division: BT International
  
  
Job Location: IND-Bengaluru-RMZ Ecoworld
  
  
Advertised Salary: Competitive
  
  
**Accountabilities**

* Own Service Management Engineering: Lead the end-to-end engineering, integration, and evolution of ITSM, ITOM, Order Management, and Managed Services platforms for BTI, driving business process improvement, end-to-end process optimisation, and service workflow simplification to eliminate inefficiencies, reduce complexity & improve operational effectiveness.
* Drive Service Delivery and Assurance: Engineer integrated service capabilities that improve end-to-end service visibility, fulfilment, monitoring, incident management, problem resolution, and service restoration, delivering a more seamless and reliable customer experience.
* Deliver Customer and Service Migrations: Own technical solution design and engineering delivery for customer and service migrations, ensuring migration readiness, data and integration integrity, operational acceptance, and minimal customer disruption.
* Embed SAFe and Agile Engineering Delivery: Partner with Service, Product, Architecture, and Engineering teams across Agile Release Trains to translate business priorities into service enablers, solution increments, and release plans. Drive alignment across teams, manage dependencies, and accelerate value realisation through iterative delivery.
* Accelerate AI-led Service Transformation: Drive the adoption and industrialisation of AI, intelligent automation, and predictive service capabilities through OpsFabric. Enable proactive fault detection, intelligent incident triage, faster diagnosis and resolution, reduced manual effort, and improved customer and operational experiences.
* Drive Service Landscape Simplification: Lead engineering initiatives leveraging BTI AI solutions to simplify and modernise the Customer Experience (CX) and Service IT landscape, rationalising platforms, reducing duplication and technical debt, streamlining processes, improving agility & cost efficiency.
* Ensure Engineering Excellence and Platform Resilience: Establish and enforce engineering standards across architecture, APIs, integrations, security, observability, testing, release management, and operational readiness. Drive improvements in availability, scalability, performance, recoverability, and technical quality.
* Own In-life Engineering Governance: Provide clear accountability for the technical management and communication of production incidents, problems, and production releases (PRs). Coordinate stakeholders, manage risks and escalations, drive root-cause resolution, and ensure timely, transparent communications and effective service restoration.
* Strengthen Cross-functional Leadership: Build strong partnerships across BTI, BT UK, Service Operations, Product, Architecture, Cyber Security, and delivery partners to align priorities, resolve blockers, manage dependencies, and maintain accountability for outcomes.
* Drive Continuous Improvement and Operational Automation: Identify opportunities to eliminate repetitive activities, optimise service processes, improve engineering productivity, and shift from reactive support towards proactive, data-driven service management
* Measure and Deliver Business Outcomes: Define and track engineering and service KPIs, including customer experience, service availability, incident resolution, migration success, release quality, automation adoption, platform performance, and cost-to-serve. Use insights to prioritise investments and demonstrate measurable business value.
* TSA/RTSA Engineering Dependencies: Manage technical dependencies on BT UK-owned service tools under TSA and enable BT UK journeys through BTI-owned platforms under RTSA, ensuring continuity, clear ownership, effective risk management, and delivery against transition commitments for Service Ops.

**Skills Required**
This role requires a doer who can think strategically, engineer pragmatically, collaborate across boundaries, and deliver relentlessly - connecting technology, process, people, and AI to create a simpler, smarter, and more reliable service experience for Telco B2B customers.
  
  

* Technically credible: Understands the technology deeply enough to challenge designs, guide engineering decisions, and help solve complex problems hands-on.
* Business outcome focused: Understands that technology is an enabler and consistently looks for ways to improve customer experience, simplify processes, and deliver measurable value.
* Execution oriented: Uses SAFe and Agile practices pragmatically to align teams, manage dependencies, overcome blockers, and get solutions into production.
* Change agent: Is curious, proactive, resilient, and willing to challenge the status quo—turning emerging technology, particularly AI, into practical improvements in how services are delivered and assured.

**The skills you’ll need to succeed:**

* Technology & Engineering Expertise: Strong knowledge of ITSM, ITOM, Order Management, and Managed Services platforms, modern architecture, APIs, cloud, integration, DevSecOps, and platform reliability, with the ability to translate business needs into robust, scalable engineering solutions.
* AI, Innovation & Process Transformation: Understanding of AI, GenAI, AIOps, intelligent automation, and predictive analytics, with the ability to apply emerging technologies to simplify business processes, optimise service workflows, and improve customer experience and operational efficiency.
* Execution Excellence & SAFe Delivery: Practical experience with SAFe and Agile delivery, translating strategy into executable roadmaps and backlogs, coordinating cross-functional teams, managing dependencies, and driving solutions from design through production.
* Hands-on Engineering & Problem Solving: A proactive, go-getter mindset with strong analytical and troubleshooting skills; willing to get into technical detail, challenge the status quo, remove blockers, and take end-to-end ownership of outcomes.
* Collaboration & Stakeholder Leadership: Ability to work across Product, Service, Architecture, Engineering, BTI, and BT UK teams, influence without authority, manage complex dependencies, and communicate technical issues and decisions clearly.
* Service Reliability, Governance & Continuous Improvement: Strong understanding of service assurance, incident and problem management, production releases, operational resilience, security, and risk management, with a focus on improving service quality and reducing recurring issues.
* Business Outcomes & Delivery Accountability: Track record of delivering measurable improvements in customer experience, service availability, migration success, automation, engineering productivity, and cost efficiency, balancing immediate delivery needs with long-term technology strategy.
* The defining ethos: Think like a product owner, engineer like a technologist, deliver like an Agile team, and measure success through customer and business outcomes. Treat Service Management platforms not simply as tools to maintain, but as products to continuously evolve - using engineering, data, and AI to make services smarter, simpler, and more customer-centric

**Experience Required**
A track record of combining hands-on engineering credibility, product ownership, and operational accountability - using SAFe to mobilise teams and AI to improve service outcomes, while maintaining consistently strong service levels.
  
  

* Service Management Technology & Architecture
* AI, GenAI & Intelligent Automation
* Business Process Optimisation & CX Improvement
* SAFe, Agile Delivery & Backlog Prioritisation
* Hands-on Engineering & Technical Problem Solving
* Service Level Management & Operational Resilience
* End-to-End Solution Integration & Migration
* DevSecOps, CI/CD & Engineering Excellence
* Stakeholder Management & Cross-functional Leadership
* Outcome Ownership & Data-driven Decision-making
* Continuous Improvement & Technology Simplification
* Proactive Leadership, Accountability & Execution
* Product Engineering & Platform Ownership

**Leadership Accountabilities**
**Leading inclusively and safely**

* Build an inclusive, collaborative engineering culture where Product, Service, and Engineering teams are empowered to contribute, challenge ideas, and deliver their best work.
* Embed security, resilience, quality, and operational risk management into engineering decisions, ensuring innovation does not compromise service levels or customer trust.

**Owning outcomes**

* Take end-to-end accountability for Service Management product roadmaps, engineering delivery, platform performance, and service levels.
* Translate customer and business priorities into measurable outcomes, balancing continuous innovation with service stability, reliability, and operational excellence.
* Proactively manage risks, dependencies, and escalations across BTI, BT UK, and partner teams, ensuring commitments are delivered and issues resolved.

**Growth mindset**

* Champion continuous learning, experimentation, and adoption of emerging technologies, particularly AI and intelligent automation, to improve customer experience and service performance.
* Encourage teams to challenge the status quo, learn from failures, simplify processes, and continuously improve engineering practices and service outcomes.

**Customer first**

* Champion customer needs throughout the product engineering lifecycle, using customer feedback, service insights, and operational data to identify opportunities to improve CX.
* Drive seamless, proactive, and differentiated service experiences, ensuring engineering priorities deliver tangible improvements in service quality, responsiveness, and customer satisfaction.

**Collaborating for impact**

* Bring Product, Service, Architecture, and Engineering teams together through SAFe to align priorities, manage dependencies, and accelerate delivery of shared outcomes.
* Build strong partnerships across BTI and BT UK, fostering transparency, constructive challenge, and collective accountability for service performance and transformation.

**Driving innovation and simplification**

* Lead the evolution towards a product-led Service Management engineering organisation, with clear platform ownership, roadmaps, reusable capabilities, and continuous delivery.
* Drive AI-led transformation, automation, and service landscape simplification to reduce complexity, improve productivity, and make service experience a competitive differentiator.

**Delivering Through Others**

* Set clear direction, empower teams to make decisions, and establish accountability for engineering quality, delivery commitments, and service outcomes.
* Combine strategic leadership with a hands-on approach to problem-solving, removing blockers and enabling teams to deliver reliable services and sustained business value.

**Key decisions**
**Recommend (R):**
Develop engineering options, roadmaps, technical solutions, and investment proposals.
  
  
**Agree (A):**
Obtain mandatory agreement from relevant Architecture, Security, Risk, Service, or commercial authorities where required.
  
  
**Perform (P):**
Lead or coordinate engineering teams to implement approved decisions and deliver outcomes.
  
  
**Input (I):**
Consult Product, Service Operations, BT UK, and other stakeholders affected by the decision.
  
  
**Decide (D):**
Make final decisions within the role’s delegated authority; escalate material business, funding, contractual, or risk exceptions to the designated decision-maker.
  
  
**Being trusted: Our code**
Compliance with all BT Group policies is mandatory and applies to all BT Group employees. Policies can be accessed via the Policy Portal and should be adhered to in-line with Standards of Behaviour Policy & Procedure and the Being trusted: our code.
  
  
**About The Role**
The Senior Software Engineering Manager oversees software engineering activities, shaping the strategic direction of the software engineering practice to deliver the roadmap that supports BT's commercial strategy through cross functional business partnering.
  
  
**What You’ll Be Doing**

* Leads engineering teams critical to the organisation's performance through the delivery of high-quality code within time and budget standards/requirements
* Mentors, coaches, and manages several teams to develop current and future team capabilities and ensure performance in delivering the most impactful features to both internal and external users of the BT team
* Leads the team in adopting relevant new technologies, tools, methods and processes that progressively advances service capabilities to its different stakeholders
* Ensures timely releases from teams by overseeing compliance with key release quality metrics
* Operates as an SME within own field of expertise, driving technical decisions, technology choices and contributes to group level discussion around architecture for a wide range of high performance products, capabilities, and platforms, effectively balancing short-term impact with long-term transformation
* Oversees the team in developing an ambitious and compelling technical roadmap to meet the needs of the business, engineering organisation and defined technology strategy
* Oversees engineering and operational excellence initiatives, implementing metrics and processes for regular assessment and improvement through the implementation of processes and tools supporting multiple platforms
* Ensures team standards of engineering and operational excellence are upheld, establishing metrics and processes for regular assessment and improvement through the creation and implementation of processes and tools supporting multiple platforms
* Drives an engineering culture that supports innovation and creativity while delivering high quality products with predictability and reliability
* Builds 'best-in-class' engineering for services by ensuring that the services and the components are well-defined and modularised, secure, reliable, diagnosable, actively monitored and reusable
* Leads the evaluation and implementation of high-quality tools and automation processes to support continuous delivery and developer productivity
* Ensures the development and adoption of a DevOps mindset across the engineering teams
* Leads the implementation of continuous improvement opportunities to improve the software engineering team processes

**Essential Skills / Experience**
**Desirable Skills / Experience**
**Our Package**
At BT International, our purpose is to keep the world connected. As part of BT, we build on almost 180 years of innovation and expertise to deliver secure connectivity and digital services to some of the world’s leading multinational businesses and organisations. Our customers trust us to safeguard their data, drive their digital transformation and keep their businesses running. With colleagues on the ground across the world and supporting customers wherever they need to operate, BT International offers a truly global experience. Whether it’s about providing cloud connectivity, helping organisations collaborate, or enabling innovation in cybersecurity and digital services, you’ll be part of a team that shapes how businesses succeed in a world that is being transformed by AI. If you have the drive and ambition to make an impact on a global stage, BT International is where it happens.

title: BPI Project Specialist, Cyber & Data Resilience
description:
The Cyber BPI Project Specialist is a full-time role responsible for coordinating and driving the day-to-day execution of business process improvement initiatives across CDR. The position will bring structure, visibility, and delivery discipline to cross-functional projects focused on process simplification, standardization, automation, data quality, operating-model improvement, and measurable business outcomes.
  
  
Based in Bangalore, this role will report to the Lean Six Sigma Black Belt Leader and/or the overall Cyber BPI Program Manager, subject to the final program structure. The Project Specialist will work closely with workstream leaders, process owners, Cyber operations teams, technology and platform partners, and global delivery stakeholders to maintain plans, manage dependencies, resolve issues, and move initiatives from analysis through implementation and sustainment.
  
  
Key Responsibilities
  
  
Project Planning and Delivery
  
  

* Develop and maintain integrated project plans, milestones, deliverables, dependencies, and implementation schedules for assigned BPI initiatives.
* Coordinate day-to-day execution across business, operations, technology, data, and change-management workstreams.
* Track actions, decisions, risks, issues, assumptions, and dependencies, ensuring owners and due dates are clear.
* Proactively identify delivery gaps or schedule risks and escalate them with practical options and recommendations.
* Drive follow-through on commitments and maintain strong execution discipline across project teams.
* Support initiatives from discovery and design through implementation, stabilization, handoff, and closure.

BPI Program Governance and Reporting
  
  

* Prepare clear, accurate project status reports, dashboards, leadership updates, and decision materials.
* Maintain core project artifacts, including plans, RAID logs, action trackers, decision logs, governance calendars, and benefits trackers.
* Coordinate governance meetings, prepare agendas and materials, document decisions, and monitor resulting actions.
* Ensure project information is current, consistent, and transparent across workstreams and stakeholder groups.
* Support portfolio-level reporting by consolidating progress, risks, dependencies, resource needs, and upcoming milestones.

Process Improvement Support
  
  

* Partner with the Lean Six Sigma Black Belt Leader and process owners to support current-state assessments, process mapping, root cause analysis, and future-state design.
* Coordinate workshops, stakeholder interviews, working sessions, pilots, and implementation-readiness activities.
* Help translate improvement recommendations into sequenced workplans, accountable owners, and measurable deliverables.
* Support development and maintenance of SOPs, process documentation, controls, training materials, and handoff plans.
* Monitor adoption and sustainability actions after implementation and surface areas requiring additional intervention.

Benefits, Metrics, and Controls
  
  

* Coordinate the definition and tracking of project KPIs, baselines, targets, and expected benefits.
* Work with initiative owners and finance or data partners to maintain supporting evidence for productivity, quality, cycle-time, capacity, cost, and other operational improvements.
* Monitor performance against agreed measures and flag variance, data-quality concerns, or benefit-realization risks.
* Ensure control plans, ownership, and ongoing reporting requirements are documented before project closure.

Stakeholder and Change Coordination
  
  

* Build productive working relationships across CDR service lines, Cyber operations, IT, platform teams, and global delivery locations.
* Coordinate stakeholder communications, change-impact activities, training, and implementation readiness.
* Adapt communications to the audience, providing concise executive summaries as well as detailed working-level updates.
* Facilitate alignment across teams with different priorities and help drive timely resolution of open decisions.

title: AI Quality Engineer
description:
Celonis is the trusted platform to industrialize Enterprise AI. At our core is the Celonis Context Model — which combines process data, business knowledge, and intelligence into a living digital twin of the enterprise that AI can actually understand, turning AI's operational blind spots into operational clarity. World's leading companies trust Celonis and its global ecosystem of partners to make their AI agents, people, systems, and processes work together, achieving transformational outcomes. We believe there's a massive opportunity to unlock global productivity and sustainability by giving AI the context to understand how every business process really works. Join our mission to make processes work for people, companies, and the planet.
  
  
**The Team:**
You will join the
**Sailfin Accounts Receivable (AR) Team**
, a product engineering team within the Finance & Accounting domain. We build and maintain an enterprise-grade AR product used by global customers.
  
  
The team works with modern engineering practices, AI/ML capabilities, automation, and deep integrations across platforms such as Salesforce, Celonis, and other enterprise systems.
  
  
This role sits at the intersection of
**Quality Engineering + AI-driven automation + enterprise data integration**
.
  
  
**The Role: ()**
We are looking for an
**AI Quality Engineer**
who can build next-generation intelligent automation and quality frameworks. This role goes beyond traditional QA—it combines strong automation engineering, enterprise integration understanding, and AI-assisted quality improvement. You will architect automation frameworks, drive end-to-end quality strategy, and build smart testing capabilities powered by LLMs and AI agents.
  
  
Most importantly, you will test
**the bridge between the world’s #1 CRM (Salesforce) and the world’s #1 Process Mining platform (Celonis)**
—a complex, data-heavy integration that powers enterprise decision-making.
  
  
**The work you’ll do:**
  
  

+ Architect the Automation Foundation
+ Design, build, and maintain a scalable, modular automation framework from scratch using Playwright (JavaScript/TypeScript).
+ Establish reusable utilities, reporting systems, abstraction layers, and extensible test modules.
+ Drive Full QA Strategy
+ Own and execute QA strategy across:

- Frontend/UI
- Backend/API
- Data validation

+ Implement robust test coverage across the end-to-end workflow.
+ Integration Quality Specialist
+ Validate data integrity between Salesforce and Celonis.
+ Identify edge cases involving:

- complex business logic
- process mining models
- multi-step data transformations

+ Ensure consistency across pipelines, APIs, and event flows.
+ Performance & Load Testing
+ Lead performance engineering efforts using tools like k6 or JMeter.
+ Ensure the integration performs reliably under large enterprise-scale data volumes.
+ AI-Driven Quality Engineering
+ Leverage LLMs and AI tools to:

- auto-generate test cases
- summarize failures
- enable root-cause analysis
- build intelligent test assistants

+ Support the shift from manual testing to AI-first Quality Engineering.

**The qualifications you need:**

* 6 years of experience in technical QA roles on high-scale web applications.
* Strong hands-on experience with Playwright (async patterns, state management, debugging, custom fixtures).
* Solid understanding of:

+ QA methodologies
+ regression strategies
+ risk-based testing
+ CI/CD pipelines (GitHub Actions preferred)

* Strong knowledge of API testing, data validation, and automation best practices.

AI / LLM Skills
  
  

* Experience using LLM-powered QA tools (Copilot, Codeium, test generators).
* Ability to use LLMs or Python scripts to automate repetitive quality tasks.

Plus Factors (Big Advantage)
  
  

* Experience working with Salesforce, Apex, or Salesforce data models.
* Understanding of Celonis or other process mining / data transformation platforms.
* Experience with performance testing tools like k6, JMeter, or Locust.
* Exposure to enterprise data pipelines or ETL validation.

**Why This Role Is Unique**
This is not a typical QA role.
  
  
You will be validating a
**mission-critical integration between two global platforms (Salesforce ↔ Celonis)**
that must remain stable, accurate, and high-performing for Fortune 500 customers.
  
  
You will also be part of the journey of transforming QA using
**AI, LLMs, and autonomous agents**
, making quality engineering faster, smarter, and more predictive.
  
  
**What Celonis can offer you:**

* Pioneer Innovation: Work with the global leader in Process Mining and the Process Intelligence Graph to shape the future of AI-driven business operations.
* Ownership from Day 1: Every full-time Celonaut is an owner, receiving Restricted Stock Units (RSUs) and merit-based refresh grants.
* Unrivaled Family Support: Benefit from our inclusive parental leave policy—24 weeks of fully paid leave for primary carers and 12 weeks for supporting carers, available from your first day of employment.
* Work-Life Integration: Enjoy Unlimited PTO (in applicable regions) and generous PTO globally, as well as a flexible hybrid work model that balances remote focus with vibrant office collaboration.
* Continuous Growth: Elevate your skills through our 70-20-10 learning framework, mentorship programs, and access to a dedicated learning platform.
* Holistic Well-being: Prioritize your health with subsidized Wellhub memberships, mental health counseling, and dedicated Wellness Weeks that prioritize work/life balance.
* Drive Sustainability: Participate in annual Impact Days, where you receive paid time off to volunteer for community and environmental causes with your local office, or virtually.
* Global Inclusion & Belonging: Find community through our Inclusion Think Tank and participate in our annual Inclusion Days, ensuring every voice is heard and valued.
* Value-Driven Impact: Join a mission-led organization where our core values—Live for Customer Value, The Best Team Wins, We Own It, and Earth Is Our Future—drive every decision.

**About Us:**
Celonis is the trusted platform to industrialize Enterprise AI, empowering organizations to analyze, design, and operate AI-driven processes. The Celonis Platform is powered by the Celonis Context Model, which combines process data, business knowledge, and intelligence to create a living digital twin of the enterprise that AI can understand — turning AI’s operational blind spots into operational clarity. Industry-leading companies around the world trust Celonis and its global ecosystem of partners to make their AI agents, people, systems, and processes work together, achieving transformational outcomes. Celonis is headquartered in Munich, Germany, and New York City, USA, with more than 20 offices worldwide.
  
  
Get familiar with the Celonis Process Intelligence Platform by watching this video.
  
  
**Celonis Inclusion Statement:**
At Celonis, we believe our people make us who we are and that “The Best Team Wins”. We know that the best teams are made up of people who bring different perspectives to the table. And when everyone feels included, able to speak up and knows their voice is heard - that's when creativity and innovation happen.
  
  
**Your Privacy:**

By submitting this application, you confirm that you agree to the storing and processing of your personal data by Celonis as described in our Privacy Notice for the Application and Hiring Process.
  
  
**Use of Artificial Intelligence Tools**
We rely on an artificial intelligence tool to match the information from your resume to the relevant Celonis job descriptions. This processing is limited to the information provided in your resume or in your candidate profile. The tool is only used for support in parts of the job application process, including to facilitate the identification of the relevant Celonis Jobs for candidates and recruiters. title: Forward Deployed Implementation, Associate (BLR)
description:
Alchelyst is a client solutions and infrastructure partner for private markets asset managers. Purpose-built for the expanding demands and sophistication of global private markets, the firm offers a comprehensive managed service offering that can support GPs, private wealth funds and investors. Alchelyst has offices in the US, Ireland, UK, Luxembourg and India.
  
  
**Role**
AURUM, Alchelyst’s proprietary technology platform, is designed to automate fund administration processes at scale. Its core features work out of the box, and the platform is flexible enough to adapt to each client’s needs. The Forward Deployed Implementation team makes sure AURUM works for every client, from day one and every day after. The role has two parts:
  
  

* Implementation: Onboarding new clients onto AURUM. This means understanding their fund structures, reporting needs, and operating model, then working with operations and technology teams to configure the platform so clients go live smoothly.
* Adoption and tactical solutions: Extending AURUM to client-specific, complex and exception-driven cases. The team sits alongside operations teams to understand these cases and works with the technology team to deliver tailored solutions quickly, so that AURUM becomes part of how operations works every day.

We are seeking an experienced techno-functional professional with 5-10 years of experience in fund administration, either as a fund accountant or as a business analyst on fund accounting systems.
  
  
The ideal candidate combines deep knowledge of private markets fund accounting with a strong grasp of technology. They’ll support new client implementations and lead engagements with operations teams to identify, define, prioritize and deliver tactical solutions on AURUM.
  
  
**Key Responsibilities**
****Client Implementation****

* Support the onboarding of new clients onto AURUM, from requirements gathering through configuration, testing and go-live.
* Work with clients, operations and technology teams to understand fund structures, reporting needs, and operating models, and translate them into platform setup.
* Coordinate data migration, validation, and parallel runs so clients transition onto AURUM with confidence.
* Serve as a day-to-day point of contact for new clients during onboarding, keeping implementations on track and raising risks early.

****Operations Engagement & Adoption****

* Work closely with fund accounting, investor services and reporting teams to observe current workflows, identify manual workarounds and understand where standard AURUM features do not fully meet the need.
* Work with Operations leads to drive adoption of AURUM, helping teams understand how the platform can support their day-to-day processes
* Track adoption across teams and processes, and escalate barriers to adoption with clear, actionable recommendations.

****Use Case Analysis & Solution Design****

* Analyze client-specific and non-standard use cases, including bespoke fund structures, waterfall and allocation logic, non-standard investor reporting and exception handling.
* Determine whether each use case is best addressed through configuration, a tactical build, a workflow change or a roadmap item for the core product.
* Write clear business requirements, functional specifications, user stories and acceptance criteria that enable the technology team to build robust solutions
* Design solution approaches with the technology team, balancing speed of delivery with scalability, control and maintainability.

****Delivery & Prioritization****

* Own and prioritize the tactical backlog for assigned operations areas based on business impact, risk, effort and client commitments.
* Work in short delivery cycles with developers, product owners and QA to move solutions from requirement to production quickly.
* Lead user acceptance testing with operations, including test scenario design, data preparation, parallel runs and sign-off.
* Support go live activities including cutover, training, user guides and hypercare support.

****Product Feedback & Standardization****

* Identify recurring patterns across tactical requests and recommend which should be generalized into core AURUM features.
* Provide structured feedback to the product team on usability, feature gaps and operational pain points.
* Maintain a library of reusable solutions, configurations and playbooks to speed up future delivery.

****Governance****

* Report on delivery progress, adoption metrics and benefits realized (hours saved, errors reduced) to senior stakeholders.
* Ensure solutions meet internal control, audit and data governance requirements, with appropriate documentation and change management.

**Required Qualifications**

* Bachelor’s degree in commerce, Accounting, Finance, Information Systems, or a related field. CA, CPA, ACCA, CFA (any level) or an MBA in Finance would be an advantage.
* 5-10 years of experience in fund administration or private markets, as a fund accountant, business analyst, or in a techno-functional role on fund accounting systems.
* Strong understanding of private markets fund accounting, including capital calls, distributions, management fees, carried interest and waterfalls, NAV calculations, investor allocations, and financial and investor reporting.
* Experience gathering requirements from operations users and translating them into functional specifications and user stories for technology teams.
* Hands-on experience implementing, configuring or supporting fund accounting platforms such as Investran, Geneva, eFront, Allvue, LemonEdge, FIS, or similar.
* Working knowledge of SQL for data analysis, validation and troubleshooting.
* Experience leading UAT and supporting system go-lives in an operational environment.
* Ability to manage multiple priorities and make sound trade-offs between speed, quality and scope.
* Excellent communication and stakeholder management skills, with the credibility to work with both senior operations staff and engineers.

**Preferred Qualifications**

* Experience in Private Equity, Private Credit, Real Estate, Infrastructure or Fund of Funds administration.
* Experience working in Agile delivery teams and with tools such as Jira, Confluence or Azure DevOps.
* Exposure to workflow automation, low-code platforms, or scripting (e.g., Python, Power Automate).
* Experience with reporting and visualization tools such as Power BI or Tableau.
* Experience with data integrations, file-based imports and exports, or APIs between fund accounting and third-party systems.
* Prior experience in a change management, transformation or process re-engineering role.

**What Success Looks Like**

* Within 1–3 Months: Develop a strong understanding of AURUM, the client implementation process, and existing operational workflows, identify non-standard use cases and manual workarounds outside AURUM, and establish priorities for improvements in collaboration with operations and technology teams.
* Within 4–9 Months: Deliver prioritized solutions within agreed timelines, translate operational needs into clear requirements that minimize rework, and ensure solutions progress through UAT with minimal defects. Demonstrate increased AURUM adoption and reduced reliance on manual workarounds outside AURUM. Support new client implementations through to a smooth go-live.
* Within 9–12 Months: Track and report the impact of delivered solutions, including hours saved, errors reduced and improved turnaround times. Identify recurring tactical solutions and work with the product team to incorporate them into core AURUM features.
* Ongoing: Continuously identify opportunities to improve operational efficiency, strengthen AURUM adoption and enhance workflows. Where applicable, support junior team members in developing the skills and confidence to work independently through guidance and review.

title: Senior UX Designer
description:
**About Us**
Automation Anywhere is the leader in Agentic Process Automation (APA), transforming how work gets done with AI-powered automation. Its APA system, built on the industry’s first Process Reasoning Engine (PRE) and specialized AI agents, combines process discovery, RPA, end-to-end orchestration, document processing, and analytics—all delivered with enterprise-grade security and governance. Guided by its vision to fuel the future of work, Automation Anywhere helps organizations worldwide boost productivity, accelerate growth, and unleash human potential.
  
  
**Sr. UX designer**
**Location : Bangalore (Onsite)
  
  
Exp - 4+ Years**
**COME JOIN US**
Exciting opportunity: Automation Anywhere is looking for a Senior UX Designer to join our team. 🚀 and shape how knowledge workers will adopt and leverage Agentic Process Automation (APA) to transform life, business, and the global economy.
  
  

* Agentic Automation – Position the role around orchestrating AI agents, automation, systems, and human decision-making, not just designing workflows.
* AI-Native Design – Make AI usage an expectation. We need designers who leverage AI to learn, prototype, and iterate faster while maintaining strong product judgment.
* Senior Ownership – Emphasize solving ambiguous problems, influencing direction, building systems, and driving experiences from concept to ship, beyond wireframes and mockups.

At Automation Anywhere, we believe that people who have time to create, think, and discover build great companies. Our intelligent process robots transform the way businesses operate, delivering complex business and IT work across a range of processes including procure-to-pay, quote-to-cash, HR administration, claims processing, and thousands of other front and back-office processes.
  
  
**How You Will Contribute**
The job of a Senior User Experience Designer is to envision how people experience our products and bring that vision to life in a way that feels inspired, refined and even magical. In a UX Designer role, you’ll take on complex tasks and transform them into intuitive, accessible, and easy-to-use designs for users around the world —ranging from novice to sophisticated users. Achieving this goal requires that you collaborate closely with teams of Designers, Researchers, Engineers, and Product Managers throughout the design process—from crafting user flows and
  
  
wireframes to building user interface mock-ups and prototypes. At each stage, you will anticipate what our users need, advocate for them, and ensure that the final product surprises and delights them.
  
  
We strive to learn and understand our users’ needs, behaviours, and emotions to gather insights that inform product strategy and design. Our UX teams include designers, researchers, visual designers, and technical designers who are passionate about quality, usability, and simplicity. We work on collaborative teams to solve complex challenges and craft experiences that highlight our products’ unique capabilities and personalities.
  
  
**What You Will Do**

* Storytelling and problem framing for a diverse audience of stakeholders, helping them envision experience opportunities.
* Articulate user journeys with scenarios, storyboards and presentations, low and high-fidelity mocks, detailed interaction specs, and prototypes to effectively communicate interaction and design ideas.
* Build strong relationships, influence and partnerships with leaders inside and outside their core product team to efficiently implement user experiences that are cohesive, inclusive, and well-informed.
* Contribute to UX vision and strategy, generating buy-in and operationalizing the strategy across larger teams and timelines.
* Raise the bar for product quality across our products by advocating for user cantered product roadmaps, investments in last-mile refinement and polish, and insights driven by user research.

**YOU HAVE…**

* 4+ years of experience designing and shipping software user experiences.
* A portfolio of UX-focused work samples for web and mobile applications that demonstrate your design thinking.

AND…
  
  

* Experience collaborating with and influencing Product Management and Engineering counterparts.
* Experience conducting UX research to amplify research and design impact.
* Expertise with design tools (e.g., Claude, Figma, etc.) to produce wireframes and high-fidelity mockups.
* Working knowledge of HTML, CSS, and JavaScript.
* Having a Portfolio is mandatory.

All unsolicited resumes submitted to any @automationanywhere.com email address, whether submitted by an individual or by an agency, will not be eligible for an agency fee.

title: Staff Software Engineer
description:
**About Us**  
Visa is a world leader in payments technology, facilitating transactions between consumers, merchants, financial institutions and government entities across more than 200 countries and territories, dedicated to uplifting everyone, everywhere by being the best way to pay and be paid.

At Visa, you'll have the opportunity to create impact at scale — tackling meaningful challenges, growing your skills and seeing your contributions impact lives around the world.

Join Visa and do work that matters – to you, to your community, and to the world. Progress starts with you.

**Job Description**

Join Visa’s Technology Organization, a dynamic community of problem solvers and innovators dedicated to redefining the future of commerce. We manage one of the world’s most advanced processing networks, handling over 65,000 secure transactions per second across 80 million merchants, 15,000 financial institutions, and billions of individuals.

In this senior role, you will drive the development of generative AI (GenAI) solutions. You will provide technical leadership across teams to define and enforce best practices, bring a product-driven mindset, and ensure our GenAI platforms and applications are robust, scalable, and aligned with business needs. This role requires a hands-on leader with a passion for AI innovation, strong mentorship skills, and deep expertise in Python, LangChain, Azure cloud services, and vector databases.

Key Responsibilities:

Technical Architecture & System Design

* Work with architects to design and implement core components of GenAI systems, including LLM agent orchestration, retrieval-augmented generation (RAG) pipelines, prompt-engineering frameworks, and model fine-tuning workflows. Make sound architectural decisions, evaluate alternative approaches, and ensure solutions meet enterprise expectations for performance, reliability, scalability, and security.

Hands-on Solution Development

* Lead end-to-end development of GenAI solutions from concept through production. Prototype and build critical components in Python, integrate large language models and frameworks such as LangChain, and operationalize embeddings, vector stores, and RAG pipelines. Ensure AI systems address real-world use cases and deliver measurable business impact.

Cross-Functional Collaboration

* Drive cross-team alignment, influence architectural decisions across departments, and champion adoption of AI in high-value use cases. Ensure GenAI initiatives remain aligned with the broader enterprise technology strategy.

Technical Leadership & Mentorship

* Provide senior technical leadership and mentorship to engineers at all levels. Conduct code reviews, support pair programming, guide architectural discussions, and lead micro-teams or pods to deliver complex features. Foster a collaborative, inclusive, and learning-oriented engineering culture.

Engineering Excellence

* Establish and enforce coding standards, rigorous testing practices, and high-quality documentation. Drive consistent adoption of CI/CD pipelines and strengthen secure coding practices. Maintain high test coverage and ensure solutions meet enterprise expectations for security, reliability, performance, and compliance. Apply strong engineering fundamentals end-to-end by writing clean, maintainable, well-tested code; following modern design patterns; implementing robust unit, integration, and functional tests; and ensuring operational reliability through monitoring, observability, and resilient error handling. Review code developed by other engineers and provide actionable feedback to ensure adherence to best practices.

Agile Project Leadership

* Lead and actively participate in Agile/Scrum ceremonies, including sprint planning, backlog refinement, and retrospectives. Manage work through Jira, optimize deployments via CI/CD pipelines (for example, Jenkins), remove execution blockers, and maintain alignment across teams to ensure timely delivery of GenAI features.

Product Mindset & Innovation

* Identify opportunities where GenAI can create user value or improve internal workflows. Propose, design, and deliver innovative AI-driven features and enhancements. Anticipate future business needs, develop proof-of-concepts, and transition them into scalable, production-ready solutions while balancing rapid experimentation with sound architecture.

Responsible AI & Governance

* Ensure all GenAI solutions adhere to responsible AI principles. Integrate privacy, fairness, safety, and security considerations throughout the development lifecycle. Partner with governance, legal, and security teams to establish guardrails and standard practices for the safe enterprise deployment of large language models.

Continuous Learning & Thought Leadership

* Stay current with emerging advancements in AI and machine learning, including new LLMs, vector database technologies, open-source frameworks, and cloud AI capabilities. Evaluate and adopt techniques that strengthen the platform, and represent the GenAI team in knowledge-sharing forums while communicating innovations to broader engineering groups and leadership.

Visa requires at least 3 days in office, expectations of these days will be confirmed by your Hiring Manager.

**Qualifications**

Basic Qualifications

* 5+ years of relevant work experience with a Bachelor’s Degree or at least 2 years of work experience with an Advanced degree (e.g. Masters, MBA, JD, MD) or 0 years of work experience with a PhD, OR 8+ years of relevant work experience.

Preferred Qualifications:

* 5+ years of relevant work experience with a Bachelor’s Degree or at least 2 years of work experience with an Advanced degree (e.g. Masters, MBA, JD, MD) or 0 years of work experience with a PhD, OR 8+ years of relevant work experience.
* 7+ years of software development experience, including substantial hands-on work in AI/ML or GenAI projects (preferably 2–3 years focused on building applications with LLMs or related technologies). Prior experience as a technical lead or senior engineer is expected, with a demonstrated ability to guide teams through complex, ambiguous projects.
* Education
* Bachelor’s degree in Computer Science, Engineering, or a related field. A Master’s degree or PhD in AI/ML or a related specialization is a plus, or equivalent hands-on experience building AI systems at scale.
* Technical Expertise
* In-depth understanding of large language models and generative AI techniques, including prompt engineering, model fine-tuning, embeddings, and retrieval-augmented generation for knowledge-based systems. Proven ability to design and build systems that incorporate LLMs, agent workflows, or NLP services. Experience building AI agents capable of multi-step reasoning or tool use is a strong plus.
* Programming Skills
* Advanced proficiency in Python for AI/ML development, with familiarity in Java or other object-oriented languages. Experience using GenAI frameworks and libraries—such as LangChain, CrewAI, or OpenAI-compatible APIs—to develop and integrate AI capabilities. Strong understanding of data structures and algorithms, with the ability to write efficient, production-quality code.
* Cloud & Infrastructure
* Hands-on experience with cloud platforms (Azure, AWS, or GCP) and deploying AI solutions at scale. Knowledge of containerization and microservices architectures is beneficial. Experience working with vector databases or similar technologies for embedding storage and semantic search is required.
* Agile & DevOps
* Strong understanding of Agile methodologies and experience working in Scrum teams. Proficiency with tools such as Jira for project tracking and CI/CD pipelines (for example, Jenkins and Git-based workflows) for automated build and deployment. Comfort with test-driven development, continuous integration, and continuous delivery practices is expected.
* Leadership & Communication
* Excellent leadership and communication skills, with a track record of mentoring engineers and influencing teams beyond direct ownership. Ability to set technical direction, gain stakeholder buy-in, and clearly communicate complex technical concepts to product managers, partners, and senior executives.
* Problem-Solving & Strategic Vision
* Demonstrated ability to tackle ambiguous problems and decompose them into actionable plans. A forward-looking mindset to anticipate challenges and opportunities in the GenAI space, balancing short-term delivery with long-term architectural and strategic investments.

**Visa is an EEO Employer**

Qualified applicants will receive consideration for employment without regard to race, color, religion, sex, national origin, sexual orientation, gender identity, disability or protected veteran status. Visa will also consider for employment qualified applicants with criminal histories in a manner consistent with EEOC guidelines and applicable local law.

title: Software Quality Engineer – Automation & AI
description:
To make electronics, you need chips, wafers, transistors, reticles, and... To make these, you must see, test and manufacture them at scale—faster and better than ever before. That's where KLA comes in. Whether you're early in your career or an experienced professional, you'll solve complex challenges, work alongside brilliant minds and help shape the future of technology.
  
  
**Group/Division**
The Semiconductor Products and Customers (Semi PC) business unit designs, builds and sells KLA’s product portfolio to help chip manufacturers meet high-quality standards for technologies like AI, data centers, automotive and electronic devices. Our inspection, metrology, and analytics systems detect and monitor defects across logic and memory chips, specialty semiconductors, wafers, reticles, advanced packaging, process equipment and materials. We also develop technologies for specialty processes, IC substrates, and PCB manufacturing, including etch and deposition, component inspection, and imaging and analytics. The Film and Scatterometry Technology (FaST) division delivers industry-leading metrology solutions essential to advanced semiconductor manufacturing. Its portfolio includes systems for measuring film thickness, critical dimensions, composition, and resistivity—key to developing and scaling next-gen IC processes. FaST partners closely with customers from early R&D through high-volume production, ensuring performance and process alignment.
  
  
**What You'll Do**
In this role, you will play a key part in advancing business priorities by delivering high-impact work across your area of expertise.
  
  
**Key Responsibilities**

* Qualify new and existing software products and features through functional, regression, performance, reliability, and system-level testing.
* Design, develop, and execute test plans, test cases, and validation strategies to ensure high product quality.
* Analyze test results and publish qualification reports, recommendations, training materials, and Best Known Methods (BKMs).
* Collaborate with Algorithm, System Engineering, Applications Engineering, Product Management, Manufacturing, Marketing, and Customer Support teams across global locations.
* Assess automation feasibility and develop automated test solutions, frameworks, and tools to improve test coverage and efficiency.
* Participate in all phases of the software development lifecycle, including requirements analysis, design reviews, deployment, troubleshooting, and customer support.

**AI & Innovation Responsibilities**

* Leverage Generative AI and AI-powered tools to improve test design, execution, defect analysis, reporting, and documentation.
* Develop AI-enabled utilities, applications, and productivity tools for engineering and quality workflows.
* Explore and implement solutions using Large Language Models (LLMs), AI agents, and modern AI frameworks.
* Drive AI adoption within the SQE organization by identifying, prototyping, and deploying high-impact use cases.
* Utilize AI and data analytics techniques to improve quality insights, root cause analysis, and engineering productivity.

**Desired Skills**

* Strong programming skills in Python, C#, C++, or Java.
* Experience with software testing, automation frameworks, and quality engineering methodologies.
* Exposure to AI/ML concepts, Generative AI, Prompt Engineering, AI agents, or AI application development is preferred.
* Strong analytical, problem-solving, communication, and collaboration skills.

**Additional Requirements**

* Represent SQE in product lifecycle reviews, key program meetings, and cross-functional initiatives.
* Willingness to travel to customer fabrication facilities for use-case understanding, software deployment, and troubleshooting support as required.

**Minimum Qualifications**
Master's Level Degree and 0 years related work experience; Bachelor's Level Degree and related work experience of 2 years
  
  
**About KLA**
We provide advanced inspection tools, metrology systems, process solutions, and computational analytics that make electronics possible, tackling complex challenges. From electron and photon optics to machine learning and data analytics, we seek perfection at the most fundamental level of matter in the universe. If you want to make electronics that push industries forward and make the world a better place, join us.
  
  
**Use of AI Statement**
At KLA, our interviews seek to understand your individual skills, problem-solving approach and authentic thinking. To ensure a fair and consistent evaluation, the use of AI, recording tools or other technologies to generate, suggest or provide responses during interviews—whether virtual or in person—is not permitted unless explicitly approved in advance as part of a reasonable accommodation or invited by the interviewer. Use of these tools may interfere with our ability to evaluate your individual qualifications and affect your candidacy. KLA is committed to advancing innovation through responsible AI, and we value candidates who share this mindset.
  
  
*We offer a competitive, family friendly total rewards package. We design our programs to reflect our commitment to an inclusive environment, while ensuring we provide benefits that meet the diverse needs of our employees.*
*KLA is proud to be an equal opportunity employer.*

description:

* Comprehensive health and life insurance and well-being benefits, based on location
* Pension / Retirement benefits
* Paid Time Off and Personal/Family Care, and other leaves of absence when needed to support your physical, financial, and emotional well-being.
* DTCC offers a flexible/hybrid model of 3 days onsite and 2 days remote (onsite Tuesdays, Wednesdays and a third day unique to each team or employee).

**The Impact You Will Have In This Role**
As we modernize our Middleware platforms, we are also transforming the way we deliver and support them. With a strategic shift toward 100% Infrastructure as Code (IaC), we are building a fully automated, scalable, and resilient delivery model. To support this evolution, we are seeking skilled Automation Test Engineers who can rigorously validate and certify our infrastructure code ensuring it is defect-free, reliable, and aligned with our IaC goals. This role will focus on validating middleware components (e.g., Tomcat, MQ, WebSphere) through automated test frameworks, ensuring configuration integrity, and supporting continuous integration and deployment (CI/CD) pipelines.
  
  
**Your Primary Responsibilities**

* Design, develop, and execute automated test scripts for middleware platforms using tools such as Chef InSpec, Jenkins, Ansible and custom frameworks
* Validate middleware configurations across environments (on-prem and cloud) based on infrastructure standards
* Collaborate with Product DRIs, Automation Developers, and Infrastructure teams to translate requirements into testable automation scenarios
* Maintain and enhance test coverage for regression, integration, and system validation across Tomcat, MQ, WAS, and RDQM
* Analyze test results, log defects, and work with engineering teams to resolve issues.
* Participate in Agile ceremonies and contribute to backlog grooming and sprint planning.
* Support Day 2 operations testing and readiness validation for middleware deployments

**Qualifications**

* Minimum of 4 years of related experience
* Bachelor's degree preferred or equivalent experience

**Talents Needed For Success**

* 3+ years of QA Testing experience with at least 2 years hands on Test Automation Experience
* Experience using Java, TestNG, JUnit, and Selenium.
* Hands-on experience with Git and Bitbucket is needed.
* Thorough Understanding of the Software Testing Life Cycle (STLC)
* Proficient in all phases of testing including planning, design, execution, defect tracking, and reporting
* Skilled in designing, developing, and executing automated test scripts using tools such as Chef InSpec, Jenkins, Ansible, and custom-built frameworks
* Familiar with Git for source code management and experienced in setting up Continuous Integration/Continuous Deployment (CI/CD) pipelines to streamline test automation workflows Knowledge of automation standard and best practices including experience with XPath axes and CSS selectors
* Should know the Defect Management using ALM and Agile/Scrum management through JIRA, Defect Triaging, Defect Status Reporting and Tracking
* Develop, maintain, and implement functional and automated test scripts using Java and testing frameworks.
* Sound knowledge of regression testing, Smoke & Sanity testing, compatibility testing, system functional testing, user acceptance testing etc.
* Experience in build tools such as Maven, adding dependencies, maintaining pom.xml file is required.
* Ability to write simple to medium complexity SQL queries.
* Ability to interpret technical designs and specifications and design automated solutions accordingly.
* Excellent problem-solving skills and attention to detail
* Excellent written and verbal communication skills
* Positive relationship and collaboration skills.

Actual salary is determined based on the role, location, individual experience, skills, and other considerations. We are an equal opportunity employer and value diversity at our company. We do not discriminate on the basis of race, religion, color, national origin, sex, gender, gender expression, sexual orientation, age, marital status, veteran status, or disability status. We will ensure that individuals with disabilities are provided reasonable accommodation to participate in the job application or interview process, to perform essential job functions, and to receive other benefits and privileges of employment. Please contact us to request accommodation.

title: Data Product Engineer
description:
At U.S. Bancorp India, we’re on a journey to do our best. We believe it takes all of us to bring our shared ambition to life, and each person is unique in their potential. A career with U.S. Bancorp India gives you a wide, ever-growing range of opportunities to discover what makes you thrive at every stage of your career. Try new things, learn new skills and discover what you excel at—all from Day One.
  
  
**Job Description**
The Data Product Engineer is responsible for designing, developing, and operating scalable, reusable, and trusted data products that power business intelligence, advanced analytics, AI/ML solutions, and operational decision-making. This role combines modern data engineering practices with product thinking to build high-quality data assets that are discoverable, governed, and reusable across the enterprise. The engineer partners with business stakeholders, product managers, architects, data scientists, and platform teams to deliver data products that align with strategic business outcomes.

title: Application Test Environments Lead Tech Analyst - Assistant Vice President
description:
This is a seasoned technical professional responsible for providing end‑to‑end application support & testing for Citi’s strategic platforms, with a strong focus on Non‑Production environments (DEV / SIT / UAT ) and Testing / DevOps-enabled delivery models.
  
  
This role applies in‑depth disciplinary knowledge to support complex applications, contributes to continuous improvement of operational processes, and partners closely with Development, DevOps, Quality Assurance, Infrastructure, and Release Management teams.
  
  
The individual demonstrates strong analytical, problem‑solving, and communication skills, and operates with a moderate level of autonomy while influencing outcomes through expertise and judgment.
  
  
The role has a direct impact on application stability, release readiness, testing effectiveness, and time‑to‑market, ensuring that technology platforms meet business expectations and Citi’s risk and control standards.
  
  
**Key Responsibilities**

* Provide Level 2 / Level 3 technical and business support for Citi applications across Non‑Production environments, ensuring availability, stability, and readiness for testing and deployments.
* Manage, maintain, and support application platforms and their operating environments post‑development lifecycle, with emphasis on environment stability, configuration consistency, and functional integrity.
* Perform Start‑of‑Day / End‑of‑Day checks, ongoing health monitoring, and regional handovers across global support teams.
* Conduct same‑day risk checks and reconciliations to ensure environment and application integrity.
* Support and troubleshoot CI/CD pipelines across Non‑Production environments, including build failures, deployment issues, rollback scenarios, and promotion defects.
* Participate actively in application releases, including deployment coordination, validation, verification, and post‑release stabilization.
* Work closely with DevOps and Development teams to enable automation, reduce manual intervention, and improve deployment reliability.
* Support deployment dry runs, rehearsal activities, and environment readiness assessments ahead of major releases.

**Monitoring, Stability**

* Proactively monitor applications using tools such as ITRS Geneos, Splunk, Kibana, and similar platforms.
* Assess the risk and business impact of application and environment incidents, escalating appropriately in line with SLAs and Citi incident management standards.
* Perform root cause analysis (RCA) and drive preventive actions to reduce recurring issues.
* Ensure logging, alerting, storage, and archiving procedures are implemented and functioning correctly.

Act as a technical liaison between business users, developers, infrastructure teams, and third‑party vendors.
  
  

* Support applications running on Linux platforms, databases (Oracle, SQL Server, MongoDB), middleware, and web/application servers (WebSphere, WebLogic).
* Provide middleware support including MQ, NDM, and SFTP configurations.
* Support batch scheduling and workload automation using Autosys.
* Develop and maintain support documentation, runbooks, and deployment procedures.
* Contribute to defining and improving operating standards, support processes, and controls.
* Identify opportunities to optimize application performance, efficiency, and operational effectiveness.
* Actively participate in post‑implementation reviews to ensure release objectives are met.
* Serve as a subject matter expert (SME) for assigned applications and environments.
* Provide coaching and guidance to junior analysts, contributing to team capability uplift.
* Exercise sound judgment and autonomy while operating under Citi’s risk, compliance, and control framework.
* Ensure decisions demonstrate consideration for Citi’s reputation, regulatory obligations, and client impact.

**Qualifications Required**

* 7+ years of experience in QA / Testing, Application Support, Production Support, or Technical Operations roles.
* Strong experience supporting Non‑Production environments in fast‑paced delivery models.
* Hands‑on experience with Linux operating systems.
* Proficiency with databases (Oracle, SQL Server, MongoDB).
* Experience supporting web and middleware platforms (WebSphere, WebLogic, MQ, NDM, SFTP).
* Working knowledge of CI/CD pipelines and DevOps delivery practices.
* Experience using monitoring and logging tools (Geneos, Splunk, Kibana or equivalent).
