title: Process & Requirements Analyst - VP
description:
Join us as a “
**Process & Requirements Analyst-VP**
” and help us deliver a simpler, better and more balanced experience for our colleagues and leaders across the world.
  
  
As the Process & Requirements Analyst, you will play a critical role in transforming the bank through disciplined business analysis, requirements management and process design across complex change initiatives. You will independently facilitate stakeholder discussions, capture and translate complex business needs into clear documentation, map current-state journeys and shape practical future-state designs. You will identify pain points, dependencies and testing scenarios, and translate business requirements into functional requirements for technology delivery teams. Working confidently with global stakeholders and cross-functional teams, you will simplify ambiguity, challenge assumptions and maintain end-to-end traceability from business need through design, configuration, validation and testing. You will also partner with Change and Training leads to ensure launch collateral connects the new solution to the agreed requirements and intended benefits.
  
  
To be successful as a “Process & Requirements Analyst-VP”, you should have experience with:
  
  
**Required Skills**

* Critical Reasoning, Curiosity & Attention to Detail: Must have strong analytical skills, be specific, tenacious, curious and quick to learn, with a focus on crystallizing requirements and problem statements. Should be proactive, ask the right questions, probe for clarity, and move at pace. You can look across requirements, connecting the dots across a broad set of requirements, to support creation of a coherent design solution.
* Business Analysis and Requirements Management: Independently facilitates complex stakeholder discussions, captures and analyses business needs, and translates them into clear, prioritised and traceable business and functional requirements.
* Process Mapping and Improvement: Creates clear current-state and future-state process maps, identifies pain points, dependencies and improvement opportunities, and uses tools such as Blueworks, Visio or comparable process mapping applications.
* Ability to work in dynamic, fast paced, agile environment. You are a really fast learner, understanding different information quickly, assimilating new information and being able to represent that clearly and coherently, in a manner that others, not involved, can understand.
* You are solutions oriented, credible with colleagues, People Leaders and senior leaders able to work across centres of excellence, colleague support, HR tech and the journey experience team, creating one coherent, aligned set of requirements and designs.
* Technology Change and Governance: Uses Jira to manage requirements, traceability, governance and version control across design, build and testing activities, and works effectively with technology delivery teams.
* Testing and User Acceptance: Defines realistic positive and negative test scenarios from requirements and process analysis, understands key dependencies and supports thorough user acceptance testing.
* Strategic Requirements Leadership: Translates strategic objectives into clear business outcomes, capability needs and prioritised requirements, ensuring alignment across multiple initiatives and stakeholder groups.
* Senior Stakeholder Management and Influencing: Builds trusted relationships with senior leaders, constructively challenges assumptions, facilitates evidence-based decisions and secures alignment where priorities or perspectives differ.
* Portfolio Prioritisation and Dependency Management: Assesses value, urgency, risk and delivery complexity to support prioritisation, while identifying and managing cross-functional dependencies, constraints and impacts.
* Risk, Controls and Design Governance: Embeds risk and control considerations into requirements and solution design, establishes clear decision records and traceability, and ensures appropriate governance throughout the delivery lifecycle.
* Benefits and Outcome Focus: Defines measurable outcomes and acceptance criteria, links requirements to intended benefits and uses evidence to confirm that delivered solutions address the original business need.

**Additional Skills**

* Business English and Multinational Experience: Highly experienced in writing detailed specifications in business English and working with global stakeholders; experience supporting United Kingdom-based teams is highly desirable. Experience in Human Resources, Workday or process transformation environments is also desirable.

**Leadership Capabilities**

* Lead Through Ambiguity: Provides structure and direction in complex or uncertain situations, makes sound decisions with incomplete information and maintains momentum while key issues are resolved.
* Cross-functional Leadership: Leads virtual and cross-functional teams through discovery, design and validation activities, clarifying accountabilities and creating an environment in which challenge and collaboration are encouraged.
* Decision Facilitation and Conflict Resolution: Surfaces trade-offs, resolves competing priorities and facilitates timely decisions, escalating material risks or unresolved issues with clear options and recommendations.
* Coaching and Capability Building: Coaches analysts and delivery colleagues, sets quality standards, provides constructive feedback and shares practical methods that strengthen requirements and process analysis capability.
* Executive Communication: Communicates complex information in a concise and compelling way, tailoring messages for senior audiences and presenting clear insights, impacts, recommendations and decisions required.
* Accountability for Delivery Quality: Sets expectations for quality, pace and governance, monitors progress and intervenes early to address gaps, ensuring requirements remain coherent, testable and aligned to agreed outcomes.

**Basic/ Essential Qualifications**

* Bachelor’s degree

You may be assessed on critical reasoning, business analysis, requirements management, process mapping, stakeholder engagement, change and transformation, risk and controls, business acumen, strategic thinking, and digital and technology skills. Assessment may include a process-flow exercise or case-study discussion focused on gathering requirements, structuring delivery activities, managing stakeholders and supporting project execution.
  
  
This role will primarily be based in Chennai, India, with Pune accepted as a secondary location.
  
  
Core hours for this role are 10:00 AM to 7:00 PM IST, with flexibility required for key afternoon meetings. There is a policy to attend the office 3 days in a week on Monday, Tuesday and Wednesday of every week.
  
  
  

* Purpose of the role

To support the organisation, achieve its strategic objectives by the identification of business requirements and solutions that address business problems and opportunities.
  
  
**Accountabilities**

* Identification and analysis of business problems and client requirements that require change within the organisation.
* Development of business requirements that will address business problems and opportunities.
* Collaboration with stakeholders to ensure that proposed solutions meet their needs and expectations.
* Support the creation of business cases that justify investment in proposed solutions.
* Conduct feasibility studies to determine the viability of proposed solutions.
* Support the creation of reports on project progress to ensure proposed solutions are delivered on time and within budget.
* Creation of operational design and process design to ensure that proposed solutions are delivered within the agreed scope.
* Support to change management activities, including development of a traceability matrix to ensure proposed solutions are successfully implemented and embedded in the organisation.

**Vice President Expectations**

* To contribute or set strategy, drive requirements and make recommendations for change. Plan resources, budgets, and policies; manage and maintain policies/ processes; deliver continuous improvements and escalate breaches of policies/procedures..
* If managing a team, they define jobs and responsibilities, planning for the department’s future needs and operations, counselling employees on performance and contributing to employee pay decisions/changes. They may also lead a number of specialists to influence the operations of a department, in alignment with strategic as well as tactical priorities, while balancing short and long term goals and ensuring that budgets and schedules meet corporate requirements..
* If the position has leadership responsibilities, People Leaders are expected to demonstrate a clear set of leadership behaviours to create an environment for colleagues to thrive and deliver to a consistently excellent standard. The four LEAD behaviours are: L – Listen and be authentic, E – Energise and inspire, A – Align across the enterprise, D – Develop others..
* OR for an individual contributor, they will be a subject matter expert within own discipline and will guide technical direction. They will lead collaborative, multi-year assignments and guide team members through structured assignments, identify the need for the inclusion of other areas of specialisation to complete assignments. They will train, guide and coach less experienced specialists and provide information affecting long term profits, organisational risks and strategic decisions..
* Advise key stakeholders, including functional leadership teams and senior management on functional and cross functional areas of impact and alignment.
* Manage and mitigate risks through assessment, in support of the control and governance agenda.
* Demonstrate leadership and accountability for managing risk and strengthening controls in relation to the work your team does.
* Demonstrate comprehensive understanding of the organisation functions to contribute to achieving the goals of the business.
* Collaborate with other areas of work, for business aligned support areas to keep up to speed with business activity and the business strategies.
* Create solutions based on sophisticated analytical thought comparing and selecting complex alternatives. In-depth analysis with interpretative thinking will be required to define problems and develop innovative solutions.
* Adopt and include the outcomes of extensive research in problem solving processes.
* Seek out, build and maintain trusting relationships and partnerships with internal and external stakeholders in order to accomplish key business objectives, using influencing and negotiating skills to achieve outcomes.

All colleagues will be expected to demonstrate the Barclays Values of Respect, Integrity, Service, Excellence and Stewardship – our moral compass, helping us do what we believe is right. They will also be expected to demonstrate the Barclays Mindset – to Empower, Challenge and Drive – the operating manual for how we behave.

title: Sr Quality Engineer
description:
Fanatics Commerce is the global leader in licensed sports merchandise, operating a vertically integrated platform that designs, manufactures, and delivers officially licensed apparel, jerseys, headwear, and collectibles for major leagues, teams, and events worldwide. With more than 900 e-commerce sites and a global omnichannel presence across digital, in-venue, and retail, Fanatics Commerce reaches fans in over 180 countries and powers official fan experiences for many of the world's most iconic sports properties.
  
  
At Fanatics, we bring our BOLD Leadership Principles to life every day - building championship teams, obsessing over fans, acting with entrepreneurial speed, and delivering with a determined and relentless mindset.
  
  
As we continue to scale our global platform, the Senior Quality Engineer will play a critical role in embedding quality across Supply Chain, FinTech/Payments, and ERP platforms throughout the software delivery lifecycle.
  
  
**Role Overview**
We are seeking a hands-on Senior Quality Engineer to independently own testing activities and strengthen quality across our Supply Chain, FinTech/Payments, and ERP platforms. Working closely with software engineers and product managers, this role identifies risks early, improves testability, and embeds quality into requirements, design, development, and release practices. The Senior Quality Engineer delivers business and fan impact through BOLD leadership and execution excellence, leveraging data, automation, and AI-enabled insights.
  
  
**How Will You Drive Impact**
Success is measured by the ability to deliver results through BOLD capabilities and measurable outcomes.
  
  
Team & Leadership Impact (Build Championship Teams)
  
  

* Partner with development and product teams during refinement and design to challenge ambiguous requirements, define testable acceptance criteria, and identify edge cases and integration risks before implementation begins.
* Contribute to shared QE standards, review automation code for test design and maintainability, and mentor teammates on continuous testing, shift-left, and AI-assisted testing practices.
* Collaborate with developers on appropriate unit, component, API, and integration coverage to drive shift-left and continuous testing practices across the team.

Fan & Customer Impact (Obsessed with Fans)
  
  

* Build end-to-end automated tests for critical business journeys including order, fulfillment, payment, and ERP/finance posting flows to protect reliability for end customers.
* Perform focused exploratory and manual testing for complex workflows, boundary conditions, and scenarios requiring human judgment to catch issues before they reach production.
* Validate data accuracy and consistency across services, databases, and integrated systems — including reconciliation checks — to ensure customers experience accurate, trustworthy transactions.
* Define, maintain, and report quality metrics and dashboards covering defect trends, escaped defects, and release readiness to support confident delivery decisions.

Innovation & Problem Solving (Limitless Entrepreneurial Spirit)
  
  

* Apply LLMs and AI-assisted or agent-based (including MCP-based) workflows to test scenario generation, test data creation, automation implementation, maintenance, and failure triage, reviewing generated tests for correctness and meaningful assertions.
* Test AI/LLM-powered features where applicable, validating output quality and behavior with evals and non-deterministic testing approaches, and evaluate AI self-healing and visual testing tools for fit.
* Investigate flaky tests, diagnose failures using logs, API responses, and queries, and work with developers on root causes and regression prevention to continuously improve pipeline reliability.
* Contribute experience in performance, resilience, and security testing for critical flows, bringing a proactive lens to systemic risk reduction.

Ownership & Execution (Determined & Relentless Mindset)
  
  

* Independently own test strategy, planning, estimation, test data, execution, defect triage, and quality reporting for the team — identifying dependencies and escalating risks early.
* Design, build, and maintain reusable automation frameworks and suites for APIs, web applications, integrations, and data validation, keeping coverage aligned with business risk and system changes.
* Integrate automated tests and actionable reporting into CI/CD pipelines, improving execution speed and reliability to maintain dependable regression feedback at every stage of delivery.
* Provide regular, evidence-based updates on testing progress, blockers, residual risks, and release readiness to support delivery decisions and continuous improvement.

AI & DIGITAL CAPABILITY
  
  
We are building a future-ready organization. This role is expected to:
  
  

* Apply AI and technology to improve efficiency, quality, and outcomes
* Use data and digital tools to inform decisions and enhance performance
* Demonstrate curiosity and adaptability in adopting new technologies and ways of working
* Contribute to a culture of innovation and continuous improvement

**Required Qualifications**
CAPABILITIES & EXPERIENCE YOU BRING
  
  

* 8+ years of experience in software quality engineering, with demonstrated senior-level technical depth and independent ownership of testing in an Agile engineering team.
* Hands-on experience designing and maintaining automation frameworks and reliable test suites, with strong programming skills in Python and/or TypeScript (Java or Go also valued) and comfort working across languages.
* Practical experience using AI in test automation workflows — including LLM-assisted test and test-data generation, agentic/MCP-based automation, testing AI/LLM-powered features, or AI self-healing and visual testing tools — with concrete examples of improved coverage, faster delivery, or reduced maintenance effort and the ability to explain how generated tests were reviewed and validated.
* Strong understanding of shift-left testing, continuous testing, risk-based test planning, and the appropriate balance of unit, component, integration, and end-to-end coverage, combined with experience with API automation for REST and/or gRPC services and web automation frameworks such as Playwright (preferred), Selenium, or WebdriverIO.
* Proficiency in SQL and relational databases for test data preparation and validation, with the ability to investigate data consistency issues across integrated systems and diagnose failures using logs and API responses.
* Experience integrating automated tests into CI/CD pipelines, working with Git-based code review (GitHub/GitLab), and testing in cloud environments such as AWS or GCP, alongside familiarity with test case management and API testing tools such as TestRail and Postman.
* Strong analytical and communication skills with the ability to collaborate closely with developers and product managers, prioritize independently, and communicate quality risks with supporting evidence; prior experience in Supply Chain Management (SCM) and/or FinTech/Payments domains, or with ERP systems and their integrations, is strongly preferred.

WORK LOCATION
  
  
Hybrid: The primary place of performance of this role is the Company's office located Hyderabad, India, subject to the Company's current hybrid work policy. This role currently requires in-office presence

This role requires deep technical expertise across the stack, hands-on experience with AWS infrastructure, and the ability to evaluate and integrate emerging AI/ML technologies into production-grade engineering workflows. The Software Development Engineer III delivers business and fan impact through BOLD leadership and execution excellence, leveraging data, automation, and AI-enabled insights.

Success is measured by the ability to deliver results through BOLD capabilities and measurable outcomes.
  
  
Team & Leadership Impact (Build Championship Teams)

Fan & Customer Impact (Obsessed with Fans)

Innovation & Problem Solving (Limitless Entrepreneurial Spirit)

Ownership & Execution (Determined & Relentless Mindset)
  
  

* Own the full software development lifecycle — design, coding, testing, deployment, monitoring, and iteration — with an uncompromising focus on code quality, security, and reliability.
* Proactively identify technical debt, performance bottlenecks, and scalability risks, and drive initiatives to resolve them before they impact the business.
* Operate with a strong sense of ownership and the ability to work independently in ambiguous, fast-paced environments, making sound technical decisions without waiting for direction.
* Consistently deliver complex, full-stack systems end-to-end with a track record of high-quality outcomes on time and at scale.

AI & DIGITAL CAPABILITY
  
  
We are building a future-ready organization. This role is expected to:
  
  

* Apply AI and technology to improve efficiency, quality, and outcomes
* Use data and digital tools to inform decisions and enhance performance
* Demonstrate curiosity and adaptability in adopting new technologies and ways of working
* Contribute to a culture of innovation and continuous improvement

**Required Qualifications**
CAPABILITIES & EXPERIENCE YOU BRING
  
  

* 4–5 years of professional software development experience with a strong track record of owning complex, full-stack systems end-to-end.
* Strong proficiency in backend development using languages such as Java, Python, Node.js, or Go, paired with hands-on experience in modern front-end frameworks such as React, Angular, or Vue.
* Hands-on experience with AWS cloud services spanning compute, storage, networking, serverless, and container orchestration (Lambda, ECS/EKS, S3, DynamoDB, RDS, API Gateway, CloudWatch, IAM).
* Practical experience working with or integrating AI/LLM technologies, including OpenAI/Anthropic APIs, LangChain, vector databases (Pinecone, Weaviate, or similar), or building AI-powered features and agents in production environments.
* Solid understanding of distributed systems, SQL and NoSQL databases, caching strategies, and API design patterns (REST/GraphQL).
* Strong command of CI/CD pipelines, containerization (Docker/Kubernetes), and infrastructure-as-code tooling (Terraform/CloudFormation).
* Excellent communication and collaboration skills, with demonstrated ability to work cross-functionally and mentor other engineers in a fast-paced, ambiguous environment.

WORK LOCATION

**Hyderabad, Telangana.**
Remote: As a fully remote role, the primary place of performance will be your residence or other approved remote location.
  
  
Hybrid: The primary place of performance of this role is the Company's office located in

title: Scrum Master
description:
**About Consilio**
**Consilio**
is a global leader in legal consulting and technology services, empowering multinational law firms and corporations with innovative legal solutions. We help clients manage complex legal, regulatory, and data challenges through expertise, technology, and scale.
  
  
**Job Summary**
We are seeking an experienced Scrum Master to support our Enterprise Data Warehouse (EDW), Domo, and Business Intelligence delivery teams. This role is responsible for ensuring Agile teams operate efficiently, predictably, and in alignment with organizational delivery standards while facilitating the successful execution of initiatives across multiple technology teams and stakeholder groups.
  
  
The Scrum Master will facilitate Agile ceremonies, remove impediments, promote Agile best practices, enforce workflow discipline, and drive continuous improvement across one or more technical delivery teams. In addition, this role will play a critical part in managing cross-team dependencies, coordinating work across interconnected teams, and proactively addressing risks and blockers that may impact delivery commitments.
  
  
The ideal candidate is a servant leader who excels at dependency management, cross-functional collaboration, and stakeholder engagement. Success in this role requires the ability to facilitate alignment among Product Owners, Developers, QA resources, Project Managers, business stakeholders, and leadership while ensuring the timely delivery of high-quality solutions in a complex data and analytics environment.
  
  
This position requires a Scrum Master who combines strong Agile expertise with sufficient technical knowledge of Data Warehouse, reporting, integration, and data platform concepts to effectively support delivery teams and facilitate technical discussions. The Scrum Master serves as a trusted partner to engineering teams and stakeholders, driving transparency, accountability, and continuous improvement while ensuring delivery objectives are achieved.
  
  
**Responsibilities**
**Agile Leadership & Team Facilitation**

* Serve as Scrum Master for Enterprise Data Warehouse (EDW), Domo, and Business Intelligence delivery teams, promoting Agile best practices and team effectiveness.
* Facilitate Scrum ceremonies including Sprint Planning, Daily Stand-Ups, Backlog Refinement, Sprint Reviews, Retrospectives, and Release Planning.
* Partner with Product Owners to maintain prioritized backlogs, ensure work is appropriately defined and estimated, and support predictable delivery.
* Administer and maintain Jira boards, workflows, dashboards, and reporting to support effective planning, execution, and transparency.
* Monitor Agile metrics, sprint commitments, release objectives, capacity, delivery forecasts, and overall delivery health; communicate progress, risks, and key insights to stakeholders and leadership.
* Drive continuous improvement through team coaching, impediment removal, retrospective action planning, process optimization, and release readiness activities.

**Cross-Team Dependency Management**

* Identify, track, and manage dependencies across Data Warehouse, Domo, Business Intelligence, integration, and application development teams.
* Coordinate dependent workstreams to ensure alignment of priorities, schedules, and deliverables.
* Facilitate resolution of cross-team blockers, resource constraints, and competing priorities impacting delivery.
* Partner with technical leads and stakeholders to develop mitigation plans for dependency-related risks.
* Escalate unresolved issues and critical dependencies to leadership when necessary to maintain delivery commitments.

**Stakeholder Engagement & Communication**

* Build strong working relationships with Product Owners, Technology Leaders, and Business Stakeholders.
* Facilitate alignment between business objectives and technical execution.
* Provide clear and concise communication on delivery status, roadmap progress, key decisions, and organizational impacts.
* Lead discussions that drive accountability, decision-making, and consensus among diverse stakeholder groups.

**Data Warehouse & Domo Team Support**

* Support teams delivering Data Warehouse, Domo, reporting, analytics, and data integration solutions.
* Apply working knowledge of data warehousing, ETL/ELT processes, reporting platforms, APIs, and integrations to facilitate delivery discussions and identify potential challenges.
* Help stakeholders understand the business and technical impacts of data-related constraints, dependencies, and architectural decisions.
* Promote effective collaboration between data engineering, analytics, reporting, and business teams to ensure successful solution delivery.

**Qualifications**
**Education**

* Bachelor’s degree in Computer Science, Information Technology, Business, or related field preferred.
* Certified Scrum Master (CSM), Professional Scrum Master (PSM), or equivalent Agile certification.

**Experience**

* 8+ years of experience as a Scrum Master, Agile Delivery Lead, or related role.
* Experience supporting multiple Agile teams within a complex technology environment.
* Experience working with data engineering teams focused on ETL pipelines, Data Warehouse modeling, and data mart development.
* Experience supporting Domo development teams and business intelligence delivery initiatives strongly preferred.
* Strong experience facilitating Agile ceremonies and coaching teams on Scrum practices.
* Demonstrated success managing dependencies, risks, and delivery coordination across multiple teams and stakeholder groups.
* Expertise using Agile management tools such as Jira, Azure DevOps, or similar platforms.
* Working knowledge of SDLC processes, including Agile and Waterfall delivery methodologies.

**Skills & Competencies**

* Excellent communication, facilitation, leadership, conflict-resolution, and problem-solving skills, with the ability to influence outcomes without direct authority.
* Working knowledge of Data Warehouse concepts, data modeling, ETL/ELT processes, data pipelines, SQL, data governance, and enterprise data architectures.
* Experience supporting Business Intelligence and analytics teams, including familiarity with Domo, Power BI, Tableau, or similar reporting and visualization platforms.
* Understanding of APIs, system integrations, and data movement processes, with the ability to facilitate technical discussions and identify delivery risks.
* Willingness and ability to learn quickly, adapt to changing priorities, and continuously improve processes and team effectiveness.
* Prior Project Manager or Technical Project Manager experience is a plus.
* Understanding of the eDiscovery industry is a plus.

**Work Model**
**Hybrid(3 days WFO/2 days WFH)**

**Benefits**

Consilio is an Equal Opportunity Employer and is committed to creating a diverse and inclusive workplace. All qualified applicants will receive consideration for employment without regard to race, color, religion, sex, gender identity, sexual orientation, national origin, disability, veteran status, or any other protected characteristic under applicable law.

**The opportunity**
The Technical Scrum Lead, Specialist is responsible for driving Agile adoption and execution within technology teams, ensuring efficient sprint execution and fostering a culture of continuous improvement. * Lead cross-functional agile teams in iterative technology development, ensuring smooth collaboration and adherence to Agile/Scrum principles.

* Apply agile methodologies to integrate changing customer inputs and business conditions into technology-related product development.

**Skills And Attributes For Success**

* A team player with strong analytical, communication and interpersonal skills
* Constantly updating yourself about new technologies in the market
* A winning personality and the ability to become a trusted advisor to the stakeholders

**To qualify for the role, you must have**

* Minimum 5 years of relevant work experience, with at least 5 years in Agile project management, Scrum Master roles, or technical leadership in software development.
* Bachelor's degree (B.E./B.Tech) in Computer Science, Information Technology, or a related field.
* Strong expertise in Scrum, Kanban and SAFe frameworks, with a deep understanding of Agile principles and best practices.
* Hands-on experience with JIRA, Confluence, Azure DevOps and other Agile project management tools.
* Proficiency in coding and technical concepts, including Java, Angular, Node.js, POSTMAN, CUCUMBER, AWS and SQL queries.
* Familiarity with version control and CI/CD tools such as GitHub, Bitbucket, Bamboo, TDD/BDD and monitoring tools like Splunk and Honeycomb.
* Experience in monitoring and refining dashboards, optimizing workflows, and driving continuous process improvements in Agile environments.
* AWS Cloud Practitioner certification and Professional Scrum Master (CSM, PSM, SAFe) certification is preferred.
* Experience with Genesis
* Programming experience in Python, TypeScript.

**Ideally, you’ll also have**

* Strong verbal and written communication, facilitation, relationship-building, presentation and negotiation skills.
* Be highly flexible, adaptable, and creative.
* Comfortable interacting with senior executives (within the firm and at the client)

**What We Look For**

* Strong teamwork, work ethic, product mindset, client centricity and a relentless commitment to EY values.

**What Working At EY Offers**
We offer a competitive remuneration package where you’ll be rewarded for your individual and team performance. Our comprehensive Total Rewards package includes support for flexible working and career development, and with FlexEY you can select benefits that suit your needs, covering holidays, health and well-being, insurance, savings and a wide range of discounts, offers and promotions. Plus, we offer:
  
  

* Support, coaching and feedback from some of the most engaging colleagues around
* Opportunities to develop new skills and progress your career
* The freedom and flexibility to handle your role in a way that’s right for you

**EY | Building a better working world**
EY exists to build a better working world, helping to create long-term value for clients, people and society and build trust in the capital markets.
  
  
Enabled by data and technology, diverse EY teams in over 150 countries provide trust through assurance and help clients grow, transform and operate.

title: QAE II, Amazon Business Operations, Amazon Business Operations
description:
**Description**
Amazon Business customers place orders that arrive by the pallet: a school district ordering 2,000 chairs, a contractor ordering 900 boxes of fasteners, a hospital restocking a floor. Amazon Business Operations builds the systems that get those orders sourced, consolidated and delivered on the date the customer asked for. When one of these orders goes wrong it does not just degrade a page: a dock appointment is missed, an operator recovers the order by hand, and an enterprise reconsiders how much of its spend comes to Amazon.
  
  
We are building a new engineering team in Hyderabad dedicated to bulk fulfilment, and this is its first quality engineering hire. There is no existing test practice to inherit. You will decide what good looks like for every service the team launches.
  
  
Key job responsibilities
  
  
As a Quality Assurance Engineer on this team, you will:
  
  
Own feature quality end to end: design test plans, execute test cases, run bug triage, coordinate with product and engineering stakeholders, and give release sign-off.
  
  
Build and maintain automated test coverage inside the team's framework so that regression testing does not grow with the codebase.
  
  
Test operator-facing tooling and machine learning assisted decision flows, where correctness means the recommendation a human acts on is right, not only that the service returned a response.
  
  
Validate integrations with Amazon supply chain and fulfilment systems, including the data correctness that inventory, transportation and delivery promises depend on.
  
  
Set the quality bar for a new team: definition of done, quality metrics, and production monitoring that catches problems before an operator does.
  
  
You will work directly with the engineers building the service, the product manager writing the requirements, and the Amazon Business Operations teams who use what you ship. If you want ownership of quality for a product line from its first commit, this is that role.
  
  
A day in the life
  
  
You will sit with the engineers building the service, not apart from them. A typical day mixes writing and running test cases for the feature in the current sprint, extending automated regression coverage in the team's framework, and triaging yesterday's defects with the SDE who owns the code. You will review requirements with the product manager before a story enters the sprint, so acceptance criteria are testable rather than aspirational. You will spend time with the Amazon Business Operations teams who use the tooling, because they will tell you which failures actually hurt. Before a release ships, your sign-off is the gate.
  
  
**About The Team**
Amazon Business Operations builds the systems and processes behind business buying at Amazon, from quoting a large order to landing it on a customer's dock. This is a new engineering team inside it, dedicated to bulk fulfilment, and you are joining at the start. We work in small teams with direct ownership, we measure ourselves on what changed for the customer, and we expect engineers to argue about design in writing. Expect high autonomy, close contact with the operators and customers you build for, and problems that have not been solved anywhere in Amazon yet.
  
  
**Basic Qualifications**

* 4+ years of quality assurance engineering experience
* Experience in automation testing
* Experience in manual testing
* Experience as QA lead on medium to large sized projects
* Experience developing high quality test plans, test designs, test strategies, and test execution
* Bachelor's degree in computer science or equivalent
* Experience scripting or coding
* Experience troubleshooting and debugging technical systems

**Preferred Qualifications**

* Experience in gathering test requirements to create detailed test plans and defining quality metrics to measure product quality
* Experience programming with at least one modern language such as Java, C++, or C# including object-oriented design
* Experience in penetration testing and exploitability-focused vulnerability assessment
* Knowledge of overall system architecture, scalability, reliability, and performance in a database environment
* Experience debugging, diagnosing, and troubleshooting complex, production software issues

title: Senior Architect- AI
description:
**Skill:** Senior Architect- AI

**Exp:** 13 to 18 years

**Location**: Hyderabad

**Shift:** Flexible to work in Shifts

The Senior Architect in Delivery leads architecture and technical direction for multi-team Azure programs across applications, platforms, and data. You connect client goals to scalable designs, guide delivery across teams, and shape modernization work so it delivers measurable results.

At this level, you influence architecture beyond a single project. You set direction across engagements, work with business and technology leaders, raise the bar on delivery quality, and promote reusable patterns. You mentor architects and senior engineers, support strategic pursuits, and turn working solutions into repeatable delivery models.

***Responsibilities***

**Solution Architecture and Technical Leadership**

* Lead architecture and technical strategy for Azure modernization and transformation programs that span multiple teams and workstreams.
* Translate client goals into scalable designs that align with business priorities, non-functional requirements, delivery constraints, and program-level outcomes.
* Drive architecture across teams so designs follow shared models, standards, and patterns.
* Collaborate with architects and engineers in other domains to integrate solutions and maintain a cohesive end-to-end architecture.
* Provide ongoing architectural guidance during implementation, including reviews of key designs and code, and define patterns and guardrails that teams can reuse.
* Apply solid engineering practices in your primary domain—modular design, clear interfaces, testability, and observability—so solutions remain robust and maintainable.
* Use AI-assisted tooling to accelerate design, code, tests, documentation, and analysis, and help teams adopt effective practices at program scale.

***Delivery and Consulting Excellence***

* Lead or co-lead discovery and roadmap work for programs or large workstreams, turning inputs into integrated, testable backlogs with clear non-functional requirements and dependencies.
* Use structured problem solving to clarify scope, dependencies, and risks at program scale, and explain options in terms of value, cost, risk, and time-to-impact.
* Communicate architecture strategy and decisions clearly to technical and non-technical audiences, including executives.
* Build trusted relationships with product, engineering, and technology leaders, and help shape modernization roadmaps in the client’s best interest.
* Provide architecture oversight so designs, interfaces, and integration points support predictable delivery and stable team velocity.
* Align multiple teams on shared outcomes, contracts, and integration points, ensuring dependencies are identified, owned, and tracked through to delivery.
* Help define delivery approaches, working agreements, and documentation practices that keep 3Cloud and client teams aligned across locations and time zones.
* Support effective use of Agile at scale by ensuring architecture and backlog structure enable incremental delivery, clear definitions of done, and data-informed adjustments based on telemetry and feedback.
* Apply a consulting mindset by anticipating client needs, proposing options, and tying solutions to clear results and adoption, and handle challenge and pushback by explaining trade-offs in simple, direct language.
* Demonstrated ability to leverage AI and emerging technologies to improve productivity, enhance decision-making, streamline delivery processes, and drive measurable business value. Commitment to continuous learning and adoption of new digital capabilities is required.
* Proven success operating within large, matrixed consulting organizations and navigating the scale, complexity, governance, and pace of a Global System Integrator (GSI) environment. Ability to manage competing priorities, collaborate across cross-functional teams, and consistently deliver results in a fast-paced, performance-driven setting.

***Mentorship and Team Development***

* Mentor architects, senior engineers, and technical leads, building their design skills, architectural judgment, and ability to work effectively across systems and teams.
* Provide architectural oversight across teams or workstreams, modeling pragmatic decision-making and showing when to keep solutions simple and when new patterns or technologies are justified.
* Support hiring and growth by participating in technical interviews, calibration discussions, and mentorship, and by helping shape development plans for future architects.
* Growth and Innovation
* Contribute to business development by identifying opportunities beyond the current assignment across all our capabilities and assisting the sales director in pursuing them.
* Intentionally builds relationship networks within client accounts to deepen partnership and identify opportunities to provide additional business value.
* Partner with sales and account leaders on strategic pursuits by setting the technical vision, contributing to solution strategy, and participating in client workshops, demos, and roadmap sessions.
* Create solution options, high-level designs, and estimates for programs, clearly documenting assumptions, dependencies, and risks and tying them back to business value and risk reduction.
* Build and evolve reusable assets—such as reference architectures, runbooks, workshops, starter repositories, and templates—that become standard paths for delivery teams.
* Champion adoption of modern frameworks, patterns, platform capabilities, automation, and AI-assisted tools that improve quality, speed, or reliability in a safe and secure way.
* Actively participate in enablement initiatives, share lessons from complex engagements, and help build a culture of collaboration, continuous improvement, and knowledge sharing.

***Requirements***

* 10+ years of experience delivering solutions in a primary technical domain.
* 5+ years of experience in solution architecture and leading development or engineering teams, including multi-team or multi-workstream efforts.
* Deep expertise across most of the following:
* Agents & Orchestration – leveraging Semantic Kernel, LangChain, or similar frameworks to design intelligent workflows; applying tool/function calling, planner and agent-based patterns, and workflow automation engines.
* Search & Retrieval – implementing solutions with vector databases such as Azure AI Search, Pinecone, FAISS, or Milvus; applying hybrid search methods, re-ranking strategies, and selecting embedding models for accuracy and performance.
* Evaluation, Quality & LLM Operations – establishing offline and online evaluation approaches; using golden datasets, hallucination and groundedness validation, toxicity and safety testing; building telemetry and feedback loops; managing monitoring, deployment pipelines, and ongoing optimization of large language models.
* Responsible AI, Security & Privacy – incorporating practices such as threat modeling, privacy reviews, data minimization, safety guardrails, policy enforcement, auditability, and model risk management in line with GDPR and organizational standards.
* AI Platforms & Data Foundations – applying hands-on experience with Azure AI services, Databricks, Azure OpenAI, and related modern data platforms.
* Cloud Engineering – designing with APIs, containers, microservices, and DevOps pipelines to deliver scalable, cloud-native solutions.
* Data Integration & Governance – developing and managing data pipelines; applying quality controls, metadata practices, and master data management approaches.
* Analytics & Visualization – delivering insights with Power BI and other visualization tools.
* Proficiency with modern development tools (e.g., GitHub, Copilot, Cursor).
* Knowledge of analytics and data science tools, frameworks, and advanced techniques.
* Relevant Azure or Databricks certifications in AI, Data, or Architecture.
* Proven experience leading architecture and delivery for Azure-based solutions such as modernizations, transformations, or platform build-outs.
* Ability to define solution architectures that connect business goals to scalable technical designs and solid delivery practices.
* Experience leading hybrid and remote teams and maintaining alignment, quality, and predictable delivery across time zones.
* Deep knowledge of core concepts, languages, frameworks, and design patterns in your primary domain, with the ability to apply them at program scale.
* Experience using AI-augmented development and integrating AI or machine learning capabilities into solutions using APIs, frameworks, or cloud-based AI services.
* Experience with Agile or Scrum at scale, including backlog management, work slicing, and dependency handling.
* Experience in consulting or professional services.
* Familiarity with key Azure services relevant to your domain, such as messaging, compute, data, security, networking, and integration.
* Strong analytical and problem-solving skills, with clear written and verbal communication.
* Demonstrated interest in learning new cloud technologies and turning that learning into practical improvements for teams.
* Ability to stay hands-on with architecture and, when needed, implementation while guiding complex cloud solutions across teams.

title: Scrum Master
description:
Overview:

### **About Consilio**

**Consilio** is a global leader in legal consulting and technology services, empowering multinational law firms and corporations with innovative legal solutions. We help clients manage complex legal, regulatory, and data challenges through expertise, technology, and scale.

**Job Summary**

We are seeking an experienced Scrum Master to support our Enterprise Data Warehouse (EDW), Domo, and Business Intelligence delivery teams. This role is responsible for ensuring Agile teams operate efficiently, predictably, and in alignment with organizational delivery standards while facilitating the successful execution of initiatives across multiple technology teams and stakeholder groups.

The Scrum Master will facilitate Agile ceremonies, remove impediments, promote Agile best practices, enforce workflow discipline, and drive continuous improvement across one or more technical delivery teams. In addition, this role will play a critical part in managing cross-team dependencies, coordinating work across interconnected teams, and proactively addressing risks and blockers that may impact delivery commitments.

The ideal candidate is a servant leader who excels at dependency management, cross-functional collaboration, and stakeholder engagement. Success in this role requires the ability to facilitate alignment among Product Owners, Developers, QA resources, Project Managers, business stakeholders, and leadership while ensuring the timely delivery of high-quality solutions in a complex data and analytics environment.

This position requires a Scrum Master who combines strong Agile expertise with sufficient technical knowledge of Data Warehouse, reporting, integration, and data platform concepts to effectively support delivery teams and facilitate technical discussions. The Scrum Master serves as a trusted partner to engineering teams and stakeholders, driving transparency, accountability, and continuous improvement while ensuring delivery objectives are achieved.

  
Responsibilities:

**Agile Leadership & Team Facilitation**

* Serve as Scrum Master for Enterprise Data Warehouse (EDW), Domo, and Business Intelligence delivery teams, promoting Agile best practices and team effectiveness.
* Facilitate Scrum ceremonies including Sprint Planning, Daily Stand-Ups, Backlog Refinement, Sprint Reviews, Retrospectives, and Release Planning.
* Partner with Product Owners to maintain prioritized backlogs, ensure work is appropriately defined and estimated, and support predictable delivery.
* Administer and maintain Jira boards, workflows, dashboards, and reporting to support effective planning, execution, and transparency.
* Monitor Agile metrics, sprint commitments, release objectives, capacity, delivery forecasts, and overall delivery health; communicate progress, risks, and key insights to stakeholders and leadership.
* Drive continuous improvement through team coaching, impediment removal, retrospective action planning, process optimization, and release readiness activities.

**Cross-Team Dependency Management**

* Identify, track, and manage dependencies across Data Warehouse, Domo, Business Intelligence, integration, and application development teams.
* Coordinate dependent workstreams to ensure alignment of priorities, schedules, and deliverables.
* Facilitate resolution of cross-team blockers, resource constraints, and competing priorities impacting delivery.
* Partner with technical leads and stakeholders to develop mitigation plans for dependency-related risks.
* Escalate unresolved issues and critical dependencies to leadership when necessary to maintain delivery commitments.

**Stakeholder Engagement & Communication**

* Build strong working relationships with Product Owners, Technology Leaders, and Business Stakeholders.
* Facilitate alignment between business objectives and technical execution.
* Provide clear and concise communication on delivery status, roadmap progress, key decisions, and organizational impacts.
* Lead discussions that drive accountability, decision-making, and consensus among diverse stakeholder groups.

**Data Warehouse & Domo Team Support**

* Support teams delivering Data Warehouse, Domo, reporting, analytics, and data integration solutions.
* Apply working knowledge of data warehousing, ETL/ELT processes, reporting platforms, APIs, and integrations to facilitate delivery discussions and identify potential challenges.
* Help stakeholders understand the business and technical impacts of data-related constraints, dependencies, and architectural decisions.
* Promote effective collaboration between data engineering, analytics, reporting, and business teams to ensure successful solution delivery.

Qualifications:

**Education**

* Bachelor’s degree in Computer Science, Information Technology, Business, or related field preferred.
* Certified Scrum Master (CSM), Professional Scrum Master (PSM), or equivalent Agile certification.

**Experience**

* 8+ years of experience as a Scrum Master, Agile Delivery Lead, or related role.
* Experience supporting multiple Agile teams within a complex technology environment.
* Experience working with data engineering teams focused on ETL pipelines, Data Warehouse modeling, and data mart development.
* Experience supporting Domo development teams and business intelligence delivery initiatives strongly preferred.
* Strong experience facilitating Agile ceremonies and coaching teams on Scrum practices.
* Demonstrated success managing dependencies, risks, and delivery coordination across multiple teams and stakeholder groups.
* Expertise using Agile management tools such as Jira, Azure DevOps, or similar platforms.
* Working knowledge of SDLC processes, including Agile and Waterfall delivery methodologies.

**Skills & Competencies**

* Excellent communication, facilitation, leadership, conflict-resolution, and problem-solving skills, with the ability to influence outcomes without direct authority.
* Working knowledge of Data Warehouse concepts, data modeling, ETL/ELT processes, data pipelines, SQL, data governance, and enterprise data architectures.
* Experience supporting Business Intelligence and analytics teams, including familiarity with Domo, Power BI, Tableau, or similar reporting and visualization platforms.
* Understanding of APIs, system integrations, and data movement processes, with the ability to facilitate technical discussions and identify delivery risks.
* Willingness and ability to learn quickly, adapt to changing priorities, and continuously improve processes and team effectiveness.
* Prior Project Manager or Technical Project Manager experience is a plus.
* Understanding of the eDiscovery industry is a plus.

### **Work Model**

**Hybrid(3 days WFO/2 days WFH)**

### **Shift Timing**

* **Shift:** 2 PM-11 PM IST

### **Benefits**

* Free company-sponsored **cab pick-up and drop**
* **Free meals** during working hours
* Comprehensive employee benefits package

* **Client Experience** – Deliver exceptional service and value.
* **Collaboration** – Work together to achieve shared success.
* **Innovation** – Continuously improve and embrace new ideas.
* **Grit** – Demonstrate resilience, determination, and accountability.

title: Salesforce DevOps / Process Analyst, Assistant Manager
description:
**Job Summary**
We are seeking a Salesforce DevOps / Process Analyst with a minimum of 3+ years of experience in Salesforce release operations, deployment coordination, process governance, and platform support. The candidate must have practical exposure to both Salesforce development and administration to assess change impacts, support troubleshooting, coordinate releases, and improve delivery processes across development, QA, UAT, and production environments.
  
  
Key Responsibilities
  
  
Salesforce DevOps & Release Management
  
  

* Coordinate Salesforce release activities across development, QA, UAT, staging, and production environments.
* Plan release scope, deployment schedules, prerequisites, validation activities, and post-deployment checks.
* Manage metadata deployments using approved Salesforce deployment and DevOps tools.
* Maintain version control practices, branching standards, pull requests, merge coordination, and release tagging.
* Identify deployment dependencies, metadata conflicts, test failures, and environment-specific issues.
* Coordinate rollback planning and support recovery activities when required.

Process Analysis & Governance
  
  

* Assess the existing software delivery lifecycle and recommend improvements to release, testing, approval, and support processes.
* Define and maintain release checklists, operating procedures, governance controls, and delivery documentation.
* Track change requests, approvals, risks, dependencies, defects, and release readiness.
* Support compliance, audit evidence, segregation-of-duties, and controlled change-management requirements.
* Monitor delivery metrics and identify recurring bottlenecks, manual activities, and automation opportunities.

Developer & Administrator Support
  
  

* Collaborate with Salesforce developers to review metadata dependencies involving Apex, Lightning Web Components, Aura components, triggers, test classes, integrations, and configuration.
* Collaborate with Salesforce administrators on objects, fields, page layouts, record types, validation rules, Flow, profiles, permission sets, reports, dashboards, and sharing settings.
* Perform initial analysis of deployment errors, test failures, user-access issues, data issues, and configuration defects.
* Support minor configuration changes and technical validations within approved access and change controls.
* Ensure required test coverage, deployment validation, peer review, and documentation are completed before release.

Environment & Configuration Management
  
  

* Coordinate sandbox refreshes, environment alignment, access readiness, and post-refresh configuration activities.
* Maintain environment inventories, deployment records, release calendars, and configuration baselines.
* Coordinate updates to endpoints, credentials, connected applications, integration settings, and scheduled jobs following environment changes.
* Help prevent configuration drift by comparing environments and promoting changes through controlled pipelines.

Testing, Support & Stakeholder Coordination
  
  

* Partner with business analysts, developers, administrators, QA, support, and product teams throughout the release lifecycle.
* Support test planning, defect triage, regression testing, UAT coordination, and production validation.
* Communicate release status, risks, dependencies, implementation outcomes, and issues to stakeholders.
* Provide production support for release-related incidents and facilitate root-cause analysis and corrective actions.
* Maintain knowledge articles and reusable troubleshooting guidance for common deployment and process issues.

**Required Qualifications**

* Bachelor's degree in Computer Science, Information Technology, Engineering, Business Systems, or a related field, or equivalent practical experience.
* Minimum 3+ years of experience in Salesforce DevOps, release management, Salesforce administration, development support, or process analysis.
* Hands-on exposure to Salesforce development concepts, including Apex, test classes, SOQL, Lightning Web Components, Aura, integrations, and deployment dependencies.
* Hands-on exposure to Salesforce administration, including objects, fields, security, Flow, validation rules, reports, dashboards, and data management.
* Experience with Git-based version control, branching, pull requests, merge conflict resolution, and code-review workflows.
* Experience supporting Salesforce deployments through change sets, Salesforce CLI, DevOps Center, Copado, Gearset, AutoRABIT, Azure DevOps, Jenkins, or comparable tools.
* Understanding of Salesforce metadata, sandbox strategy, release pipelines, deployment validation, and Apex test execution.
* Experience with Agile delivery, Jira or Azure DevOps work items, change requests, defect tracking, and release documentation.
* Strong analytical, troubleshooting, communication, documentation, and stakeholder-management skills.

**Preferred Qualifications**

* Salesforce Certified Administrator, Platform App Builder, Platform Developer I, or Salesforce DevOps-related certification.
* Experience supporting enterprise or financial-services Salesforce environments.
* Knowledge of CI/CD automation, static code analysis, quality gates, and automated testing practices.
* Familiarity with Salesforce APIs, integration middleware, connected apps, OAuth, and credential-management processes.
* Knowledge of ITIL practices, incident management, problem management, change management, and release governance.
* Experience supporting audit, risk, compliance, access review, and production-control requirements.

Key Competencies
  
  

* Salesforce release coordination
* CI/CD and version control
* Process analysis and governance
* Developer and admin collaboration
* Deployment troubleshooting
* Environment management

**Lead Front-End Engineer**

**technical leadership with team responsibility**
and is intended for someone who wants to remain an active engineer.

* Act as the technical owner for Online Banking, Mobile Banking, Digital Onboarding and the corporate website.
* Own and evolve the front-end architecture, technology roadmap and engineering standards across web and mobile applications.

* Strong communication and technical decision-making skills, with the ability to work effectively with Product, UX and engineering stakeholders.

We owe our exponential growth to our innovative and collaborate team spirit and talented workforce. Every voice counts as we are always committed to learning from diverse perspectives and backgrounds because our people make the difference at AMINA Bank. Join our skilled team and together redefine finance.

title: Manager, Engineering
description:
**Business Title: Engineering Manager**
This role is based in Pune. This location works on a hybrid model,
**2-3 days in the office**
. You will be required to interview in person.

**About SailPoint**
SailPoint is defining the next era of identity security. Our unified, AI-powered platform seamlessly secures both the Human Fabric of your workforce and the Agentic Fabric of AI and non-human identities, completely eliminating organizational blind spots.
  
Built on core principles like zero-standing privilege and contextualized risk, our platform transforms identity from a vulnerability into a strategic business advantage. Today, we are trusted by some of the largest, most complex organizations in the world to deliver intelligent, autonomous identity security at scale.
  
  
**About the Role**
As an Engineering Manager, you will lead and empower a high-performing team of software engineers responsible for owning the technical development of SailPoint’s core product capabilities. In this role, you will champion technical excellence, write and review quality code, debug complex distributed systems issues, and foster a culture of innovation and continuous delivery. You will work in an Agile environment, collaborating closely with US-based teams and stakeholders to build and maintain cloud-native, event-driven microservices on AWS.
  
  
**About the Team**
At SailPoint, our Engineering team is where high-quality professional engineering meets individual impact. We are a results-driven crew built on innovation, collaboration, and mutual trust. Our team designs and deploys scalable, enterprise-grade identity security products powered by mature cloud architecture and cutting-edge technologies.
  
  

**Requirements**

* Bachelors degree in related field, or equivalent professional experience
* **15+ years of experience in software engineering**
  , with demonstrated experience building, leading, and managing teams of software engineers
* Strong foundational understanding of
  **software development, particularly in Java,**
  as well as modern front-end architectures.
* Proven track record of success delivering complex software solutions in an Agile development environment
* Solid foundation in software engineering principles, distributed systems, and cloud architecture (AWS preferred)
* Exceptional leadership, coaching, and mentoring skills with a passion for continuous improvement
* Strong project management abilities with experience scoping, prioritizing, tracking, and delivering engineering milestones
* Excellent communication, organizational, and interpersonal skills with the ability to collaborate effectively across global time zones
* Willingness to maintain at least 4 overlapping working hours with US time zones

**AI-assisted engineering:**
Our engineers are expected to use AI development tools as a core part of their daily workflow, not as a novelty. We expect you to use these tools to accelerate delivery, expand your scope, and raise the quality bar, while applying strong engineering judgment to review, validate, and own everything that ships under your name. Comfort with prompting, agentic workflows, and human-in-the-loop review of AI-generated code is a baseline expectation for this role.
  
  
**AI related Technology:**

* Cursor, Claude Code
* Python-based AI/ML frameworks and libraries such as scikit-learn, pandas, and numpy
* Deep Learning Frameworks such as PyTorch
* LLMs and Foundation Models in Bedrock, VertexAI, or similar

**Roadmap for Success**

**30 Days:**

* Complete SailPoint onboarding, understand our identity security product suite, and get familiar with the cloud-native, event-driven microservices architecture hosted on AWS.
* Establish relationships with your engineering team, Product Management partners, and US-based counterparts.
* Understand the current sprint commitments, team workflows, and active technical priorities.

**60 Days:**

* Assume day-to-day leadership of the engineering team and run Agile ceremonies effectively.
* Actively partner with Product Management to review roadmaps, scope incoming projects, and allocate engineering resources.
* Begin coaching and setting clear performance objectives for direct reports through regular 1:1 mentorship sessions.

**90 Days:**

* Own end-to-end project planning, tracking, and risk management for your team's deliverables and key milestones.
* Maintain a seamless communication cadence with global stakeholders, ensuring overlapping collaboration with the US team.
* Identify operational bottlenecks and implement process or architectural improvements to raise code quality and team velocity.

**6 Months:**

* Drive the successful release of high-impact features and architectural enhancements to production on AWS.
* Foster a strong culture of career development, mentoring engineers toward their next career milestones.
* Proactively manage technical risk, system reliability, and resource allocation across multiple simultaneous initiatives.

**1 Year:**

* Establish a proven track record of predictable, high-quality product delivery that advances SailPoint’s identity security platform.
* Scale team capabilities, mentor emerging leaders, and contribute strategic engineering input toward long-term product roadmaps.

**About SailPoint India and our Benefits**
:
  
Nestled in the heart of Pune, a bustling hub of technology and culture, the office exemplifies SailPoint's commitment to excellence. Surrounded by a vibrant atmosphere, the Pune office serves as a strategic center for the company, where cutting-edge solutions are crafted and implemented to address the ever-evolving challenges in identity security. With a team of highly skilled professionals, the office embodies SailPoint's values of Integrity, Innovation, Impact and Individuals. Our Pune team works under a hybrid model enjoying the office 2-3 days a week (unless otherwise specified). We provide excellent office amenities, competitive salaries and strong benefits:

**What We Offer You**

title: Senior QA Test Engineer GCC
description:
****Who is Litmus****
Litmus is building the data foundation that powers industrial AI.
  
  
AI doesn’t work without real-world, contextualized data - Litmus makes that data usable. As AI adoption accelerates, most industrial environments still can’t access or use their operational data. We solve that gap.
  
  
We’re a growth-stage software company helping manufacturers access, structure, and use real-time data from machines, systems, and sensors at the edge. Our platform sits at the intersection of edge computing, AI, and industrial operations, enabling some of the world’s largest companies to run operations in real time, reduce downtime, and optimize production.
  
  
Backed by leading investors and trusted by global manufacturers and partners like Google, Microsoft, Dell, Oracle, and Mitsubishi, Litmus is powering the shift toward software-defined manufacturing.
  
  
****Why join Litmus****
****Build the infrastructure that makes industrial AI possible****
AI is moving beyond the cloud and into the physical world. At Litmus, you’ll build the infrastructure that enables real-time data to power AI and machine learning systems in production environments.
  
  
****Work on problems where software meets the real world****
Most AI systems fail without access to real-world data. You’ll build the layer that makes them viable in production. We solve challenges at the intersection of distributed systems, real-time data, and industrial constraints — where reliability, scale, and performance are non-negotiable.
  
  
****Have real impact, fast****
You’ll work on systems used by real customers in production, with direct impact on product and company trajectory. As a scaling company, we move quickly. You’ll have ownership, visibility, and the ability to shape both product and company as we scale.
  
  
****Join a high-performance team****
We’re building a team that holds a high bar and pushes each other to improve. You’ll work alongside experienced operators, engineers, and leaders who have done this before and are building again at scale. We hire people who take ownership, move quickly, and care about outcomes. No passengers.
  
  
****Our culture****
At Litmus, the team is collaborative, curious, and low ego. People are scrappy, take ownership, and look for ways to make an impact. We value empathy just as much as execution, whether that’s in how we build, how we communicate, or how we support each other.
  
  
We’re a growing company, so things move quickly and not everything is perfectly defined. If you enjoy figuring things out, working closely with others, and making steady progress, you’ll do well here.
  
  
**About The Role**
We are hiring Senior QA Automation Engineers to test our data cataloging and real-time data platform products. You will build reliable automation with Playwright, turn business and technical requirements into test cases, and work with developers and product owners to improve product quality.
  
  
We have openings in two areas: application and API automation for our data cataloging product, and end-to-end data validation for our real-time data platform. Your experience will help us identify the best fit. Both openings are hands-on automation roles.
  
  
**What You Will Do**

* Develop and maintain automated UI tests with Playwright, using TypeScript or JavaScript, and build supporting test scripts and tools in Python where appropriate.
* Translate functional and non-functional requirements into clear test cases and automated coverage.
* Investigate test failures, work with developers to identify root causes, and improve test coverage and automation efficiency.
* Use Linux, Git and AI tools as part of your testing and automation work.

Depending on your product assignment, you will also:
  
  

* Automate API tests, build and troubleshoot Docker test environments, and set up and maintain CI pipelines for application testing.
* Test data flows from source systems to downstream destinations, checking completeness, correctness and consistency, and build scripts to generate test data and validate results at scale.

**What You Will Bring**

* QA experience with a strong focus on hands-on test automation.
* Practical experience building and maintaining automated tests with Playwright.
* Automation coding skills in TypeScript, JavaScript or Python, with strong TypeScript or JavaScript skills for the application automation opening.
* Confidence working in the Linux command line, using Git, and turning requirements into effective test cases.
* Experience using AI tools to support testing and test automation.

**Additional Requirements By Opening**

* Application and API automation: API testing experience; hands-on Docker skills, including building images, running containers and debugging; and experience with CI/CD practices and setting up pipelines in Jenkins, Git-based tooling or similar.
* Real-time data testing: 3–6 years of QA experience, including hands-on validation of data from source to destination; working knowledge of SQL and JSON; and the ability to automate data checks using Python or TypeScript/JavaScript. Docker and Kubernetes can be learned on the job.

**Nice to have**

* Experience with data processing or cataloging products, industrial or IoT data, or MQTT, Kafka and other pub/sub messaging systems.
* Kubernetes, performance or load testing, and CI pipeline setup experience for the real-time data opening.

title: Associate Director - Product Engineering
description:
We are seeking a talented individual to join our IT team at Marsh. This role will be based in Pune. This is a hybrid role that has a requirement of working at least three days a week in the office.
  
  
Our scaled Agile Delivery Methodology is transforming our IT teams in cohorts of Pods and Squads. If a Squad is defined as the smallest number of people required to deliver product functionality to market then a Pod is the smallest number of Squads required to deliver a complex product or collection of integrated products to market. Pods exist to create Products and services that deliver on business focused Missions. We in Product Delivery Engineering are on a mission: to transform the way our Mercer business and IT teams work together to unlock the benefits of rapid delivery of quality, secure software to market by empowered teams. We will do this by rolling out our Agile at Scale Delivery model. You will guide one or more Squads and will be responsible for their delivery of working software through production.
  
  
We are looking for a highly motivated, experienced Squad Leader with an enthusiasm for all aspects of product development who knows how to work with a team of highly skilled engineers. Our goal is to create an environment where continuous improvement of the development process is in focus and where everyone's common goal is to deliver outstanding software as fast as possible. You will be a proven expert in using the Agile / Scrum / Lean software development methodologies, a guardian of the delivery team's development processes and driven by delivering value. The Squad Lead will be an excellent communicator and facilitator, and not afraid to raise issues and drive change to remove impediments from the delivery team. You will have some familiarity with leading squads that incorporate AI solutions into their product(s).
  
  
**We will count on you to:**

* Run the software delivery for your Squad ensuring there are smooth and efficient processes for getting software through from requirements to working in production
* Identify and work to eliminate blockers
* Responsible for ensuring your Squad is motivated, collaborative, efficient and empowered
* e2e Delivery of working software for 1 or more products or solutions into production
* You will generally be responsible for 2 squads of between 5-9 people
* You will have an Enterprise mind-set able to foster collaboration, break down silos, identify and work to remove blockers
* You will be a recognized Agile Expert intimately familiar with the processes and practices required for successful and sustainable delivery. Our main delivery methodologies are Scrum and Kanban
* You will be proficient at creating highly performing teams and take a hands on approach where required
* Hands on experience of a range of squad-based roles is an advantage
* Solid understanding of Software Development, Architecture, Test Engineering and Security best practice in an Agile environment
* Pods support the full lifecycle of a product, and we operate on the philosophy that the work comes to the team. You will need to consider tech debt, obsolescence, security and modernization
* Ensure our Agile governance and ceremonies are in place and effective
* Plan product releases
* You will be familiar with acting as Scrum Master for teams developing or receiving AI solutions
* Our standard metrics are visible and actively being used to drive making choices
* Own the Continuous Improvement backlog for your squad. This is the key mechanism by which we deliver improvements for the following; time to market, efficiency and quality
* You will provide coaching and support to your squad ensuring that they operate well as a team and foster o culture of ownership and respect
* You may be asked to be a line manager to 1 or more other squad leads
* In addition to your day to day activities you will be assigned 1 or more workstreams leadership opportunities that will deliver cross-functional benefits to our organisation

**What you need to have:**

* Bachelors in a technology related discipline, or a combination of work experience, education and training equivalent to a five-year college in a technology related discipline.
* 12+ years of total experience
* Experience and track record of successful delivery in a regulated, complex, multi-product technological landscape. We also have significant security processes and legislative requirements to protect our customers and their data
* You will be expected to have a broad technical understanding to support your Agile credentials from software architecture through test, DevOps practices, security and operational run
* A metrics driven approach to delivery evaluation and drive out systems and processes that help define and report on the metrics we believe to be important
* Excellent stakeholder management skills. As we work to transform the Mercer IT and Business into a truly Agile organisation you will need to influence and coach senior executives, many of whom will be new to Agile
* Ideally familiarity with managing AI model developments into existing and new applications
* Pods and squads are distributed globally and utilise a mix of permanent and partner staff who work largely remotely so experience of working with and motivating distributed teams is vital
* You will be collaborative, Inquisitive and interested in technology and best practices
* Experience of a wide range of Technology roles is desirable, ideally with some form of development engineering background
* Rounded and holistic understanding of Agile Methodologies such as CSP, KMP & ICP-ACC Certifications or their equivalent

**What makes you stand out:**

* Excellent verbal and written communication skills, comfortable interfacing with business users
* Good troubleshooting and technical skills
* Able to work independently

**Why join our team:**

* We help you be your best through professional development opportunities, interesting work and supportive leaders.
* We foster a vibrant and inclusive culture where you can work with talented colleagues to create new solutions and have impact for colleagues, clients and communities
* Our scale enables us to provide a range of career opportunities, as well as benefits and rewards to enhance your well-being.

Marsh (NYSE: MRSH) is a global leader in risk, reinsurance and capital, people and investments, and management consulting, advising clients in 130 countries. With annual revenue of over $27 billion and more than 95,000 colleagues, Marsh helps build the confidence to thrive through the power of perspective. For more information, visit marsh.com, or follow us on LinkedIn and X.
  
  
Marsh is committed to embracing a diverse, inclusive and flexible work environment. We aim to attract and retain the best people and embrace diversity of age, background, caste, disability, ethnic origin, family duties, gender orientation or expression, gender reassignment, marital status, nationality, parental status, personal or social status, political affiliation, race, religion and beliefs, sex/gender, sexual orientation or expression, skin color, or any other characteristic protected by applicable law.
  
  
Marsh is committed to hybrid work, which includes the flexibility of working remotely and the collaboration, connections and professional development benefits of working together in the office. All Marsh colleagues are expected to be in their local office or working onsite with clients at least three days per week. Office-based teams will identify at least one “anchor day” per week on which their full team will be together in person.
