description:
For more than 30 years, SonicWall has delivered a partner-first unified cybersecurity portfolio that helps SMBs, MSPs, and IT teams consolidate network security, endpoint security, security service edge (SSE), and threat response across hybrid environments. By bringing connected technology, real-time threat intelligence, automation, and expert services together, SonicWall helps organizations simplify security operations, achieve better security outcomes, and lower total cost of ownership. Backed by a global ecosystem of more than 17,000 partners, SonicWall delivers enterprise-grade protection built for SMB and mid-market realities.

or follow us on


X,


LinkedIn

Instagram

.

 

CSE SRE – DBA Focus

**Job Description**

As a Software Dev Senior Engineer, you will own the reliability, scalability, and operational excellence of our Cloud-based services. You will define and enforce reliability standards, drive the adoption of SRE practices across engineering teams, and build the systems and tooling that keep our production infrastructure healthy. We follow a DevOps model: Development and Operations teams are integrated, and the SRE function acts as the reliability layer — setting Service Level Objectives, managing error alerts, and continuously reducing toil through engineering.

**Key Responsibilities:**

* Lead on call response and triage – help design and lead the 24x7 response team for triage and rally engineering to address service degradation, facilitating process and communications along the way
* Define, publish, and continuously refine Service Level Indicators (SLIs), Service Level Objectives (SLOs), and Service Level Agreements (SLAs) for all critical services, partnering with product and engineering leadership.
* Own the error management practices, including monitoring and alerting, and surfacing notable errors to the development team
* Lead the design and implementation of comprehensive observability platforms — metrics, structured logging, and distributed tracing — to ensure full visibility into production systems.
* Drive toil reduction initiatives by identifying and automating repetitive, manual operational work, targeting measurable reduction in operational burden across teams.
* Design and execute chaos engineering programs to proactively uncover reliability weaknesses in our infrastructure and services before they impact customers.

* Lead blameless postmortem culture: facilitate incident retrospectives, extract systemic learnings, and track corrective action items to completion.
* Build and improve on-call incident response processes, runbooks, and escalation paths; manage and optimize on-call rotation health to prevent burnout.
* Collaborate with platform and application developers to bring new features and services into production using production-readiness reviews and launch checklists.
* Champion reliability engineering best practices across the organization, embedding SRE principles into the software development lifecycle.
* Mentor team members on SRE philosophy, technical decision-making, code reviews, and cloud engineering best practices.
* Participate in roadmap planning, identify areas of improvement, and perform technology evaluation and selection.

**Required:**

* 5+ years of experience in database scaling performance and reliability, connection pool optimization
* 5+ years of experience in database HA design and failover strategies
* 3+ years of hands-on Site Reliability Engineering experience, including ownership of SLOs and error budget management.
* 4+ years of experience with Cloud Platforms, GCP CloudSQL required.
* Experience with database capacity planning, load testing, and performance benchmarking at scale.
* Experience managing other database systems — PostgreSQL, Redis, Etc .
* CS Degree or equivalent experience.

**Preferred:**

* Familiarity with Google SRE principles and the concepts outlined in the Google SRE Book
* Understanding of the HTTP protocol and experience diagnosing distributed system latency issues.
* Experience with instrumentation and management of automated deployments.
* Experience resolving customer-facing production issues under time pressure.
* Experience working with distributed, cross-functional teams
* Experience in infrastructure as code (Terraform, AWS CDK)
* Experience in scripting using Python, Shell, or a similar language.
* Experience with orchestration technologies, including Kubernetes.
* Understanding of networking, including routing, naming, security, network performance, and network failure modes.
* Experience designing and operating observability stacks (e.g., Prometheus, Grafana, Datadog, OpenTelemetry, Jaeger, or equivalent).
* Experience with incident management platforms and on-call tooling (e.g., PagerDuty, OpsGenie).

title: AI Product Engineer
description:
**Role Summary**

This role provides technical and delivery oversight across the IAIS (Industry AI Solutions) portfolio of AI / GenAI / Agentic AI solutions. The Product Engineering Lead assesses, solution by solution, whether each is being built as per the roadmap, at the expected quality, architecture and readiness, and then carries the best practices, reusable patterns and lessons from one solution to the others.

The role sits at the intersection of product, engineering and delivery. It works with IAIS Product Managers on what the roadmap commits to, with solution delivery teams and architects on how it is being built, and with program governance on how progress is reported. When a delivery team hits an operational or technical problem, this role brings the right expertise and the proven fix, so the team keeps moving.

**Key Responsibilities**

***Portfolio Review & Roadmap Conformance***

* **Review multiple IAIS solutions concurrently**
  through a structured review cadence (design, build-progress, release-readiness and post-release reviews), judging each against its roadmap commitments, scope, timelines and quality bar.
* **Detect drift early:**
  identify slippage, scope creep, architectural deviation, dependency gaps and technical debt, and agree corrective actions with the Product Manager and delivery lead.
* **Track portfolio health**
  through a consistent set of delivery and engineering KPIs (roadmap adherence, release predictability, quality and defect trends, incident and cost trends) and publish a portfolio view for program governance and senior stakeholders.

***Technical Assurance***

* **Assess solution architecture and engineering practice**
  for scalability, security, integration (including hyperscaler services), observability and maintainability.
* **Apply AI / Agentic AI readiness checkpoints**
  (evaluation metrics, guardrails and responsible-AI checks, quality gates, deployment and ops readiness) so that releases are repeatable and ship with confidence.
* **Review operational risk:**
  hallucination and quality issues, latency and token cost, data and integration failures, and production stability for solutions already live.

***Best-Practice Translation & Enablement***

* **Identify what works**
  in one solution (architecture patterns, evaluation approaches, prompt/agent design, LLMOps and CI/CD practices, accelerators) and translate it into reusable playbooks, reference architectures and standards for the other solutions.
* **Spread learning across teams**
  by running communities of practice, review forums and targeted coaching for delivery leads and engineers on GenAI / Agentic AI engineering and delivery.
* **Help teams solve operational problems**
  as and when they arise by pointing them to proven solutions, bringing in subject-matter experts, and capturing the resolution for the wider portfolio.

***Stakeholder & Team Leadership***

* **Work with IAIS Product Managers and delivery leads**
  to align roadmap, technical feasibility and delivery priorities, and to surface cross-solution dependencies and shared-platform needs.
* **Guide and mentor the solution delivery leads and architects**
  across the portfolio; set expectations on delivery discipline and engineering quality, and give feedback on their performance.
* **Escalate clearly:**
  raise risks and decisions with options and recommendations to program governance and senior leadership.

**Qualifications**

***Must have***

* BE/B.Tech (or equivalent) in Computer Science, Engineering or a related field; MBA / PG is a plus.
* 12+ years in IT services, product engineering or platform delivery, with a progression through developer, architect and delivery roles; has led or overseen more than one solution or team at a time.
* Strong technical grounding, enough to challenge architecture, code quality and engineering practice credibly: APIs and microservices, data pipelines, CI/CD, containers, observability and security.
* Working knowledge of at least one major hyperscaler's cloud and AI services and how they integrate with enterprise systems.
* Working knowledge of GenAI / Agentic AI solutions in production: LLM integration, RAG, agent orchestration, evaluation and guardrails, LLMOps.
* Experience running review and governance mechanisms (design reviews, stage gates, release-readiness checks) across several concurrent programs.
* Proven ability to codify and transfer best practices across teams, such as playbooks, standards and reference architectures.

***Good to have***

* Experience in a product-company or product-engineering environment, working with product managers on roadmaps and releases.
* Experience with LLMOps/MLOps, model-evaluation tooling and agent interoperability standards (e.g. MCP).
* Hyperscaler AI certification(s) and/or PMP / Scrum / SAFe certification.
* Exposure to responsible-AI, data privacy and compliance requirements for enterprise AI.

**Expected Impact**

* Solutions across the IAIS portfolio are built as per roadmap, with early detection of drift and fewer late surprises.
* Consistent engineering quality and release readiness across solutions, rather than strong in some and weak in others.
* Best practices and lessons learned travel quickly between solutions, reducing rework and raising team capability.
* Delivery teams resolve operational and technical problems faster because proven fixes and experts are readily available.
* Stakeholders have a single, credible, KPI-driven view of portfolio delivery health.

**Skills**

Solution Portfolio Review, Roadmap Conformance Tracking, Technical Assurance, GenAI / Agentic AI Architecture Understanding, Hyperscaler / Cloud Integration, Best-Practice Codification, Delivery Governance, Technical Problem Solving, Coaching & Mentoring, Product-Engineering Partnership, Risk/Issue Management, KPI & Metrics Reporting, Stakeholder Management

We are seeking a talented individual to join our IT team at Marsh. This role will be based in Pune. This is a hybrid role that has a requirement of working at least three days a week in the office.

  
  

Our scaled Agile Delivery Methodology is transforming our IT teams in cohorts of Pods and Squads. If a Squad is defined as the smallest number of people required to deliver product functionality to market then a Pod is the smallest number of Squads required to deliver a complex product or collection of integrated products to market. Pods exist to create Products and services that deliver on business focused Missions. We in Product Delivery Engineering are on a mission: to transform the way our Mercer business and IT teams work together to unlock the benefits of rapid delivery of quality, secure software to market by empowered teams. We will do this by rolling out our Agile at Scale Delivery model. You will guide one or more Squads and will be responsible for their delivery of working software through production.

  
  

We are looking for a highly motivated, experienced Squad Leader with an enthusiasm for all aspects of product development who knows how to work with a team of highly skilled engineers. Our goal is to create an environment where continuous improvement of the development process is in focus and where everyone's common goal is to deliver outstanding software as fast as possible. You will be a proven expert in using the Agile / Scrum / Lean software development methodologies, a guardian of the delivery team's development processes and driven by delivering value. The Squad Lead will be an excellent communicator and facilitator, and not afraid to raise issues and drive change to remove impediments from the delivery team. You will have some familiarity with leading squads that incorporate AI solutions into their product(s).

  

**We will count on you to:**

  

* Run the software delivery for your Squad ensuring there are smooth and efficient processes for getting software through from requirements to working in production
* Identify and work to eliminate blockers
* Responsible for ensuring your Squad is motivated, collaborative, efficient and empowered
* e2e Delivery of working software for 1 or more products or solutions into production

* You will be a recognized Agile Expert intimately familiar with the processes and practices required for successful and sustainable delivery. Our main delivery methodologies are Scrum and Kanban
* You will be proficient at creating highly performing teams and take a hands on approach where required
* Hands on experience of a range of squad-based roles is an advantage
* Solid understanding of Software Development, Architecture, Test Engineering and Security best practice in an Agile environment

* Ensure our Agile governance and ceremonies are in place and effective
* Plan product releases
* You will be familiar with acting as Scrum Master for teams developing or receiving AI solutions
* Our standard metrics are visible and actively being used to drive making choices

* You will provide coaching and support to your squad ensuring that they operate well as a team and foster o culture of ownership and respect
* You may be asked to be a line manager to 1 or more other squad leads
* In addition to your day to day activities you will be assigned 1 or more workstreams leadership opportunities that will deliver cross-functional benefits to our organisation
  

**What you need to have:**

  

* Bachelors in a technology related discipline, or a combination of work experience, education and training equivalent to a five-year college in a technology related discipline.

* Excellent stakeholder management skills. As we work to transform the Mercer IT and Business into a truly Agile organisation you will need to influence and coach senior executives, many of whom will be new to Agile

* You will be collaborative, Inquisitive and interested in technology and best practices
* Experience of a wide range of Technology roles is desirable, ideally with some form of development engineering background
* Rounded and holistic understanding of Agile Methodologies such as CSP, KMP & ICP-ACC Certifications or their equivalent
  

**What makes you stand out:**

  

* Excellent verbal and written communication skills, comfortable interfacing with business users
* Good troubleshooting and technical skills
* Able to work independently
  

**Why join our team:**

  

* We help you be your best through professional development opportunities, interesting work and supportive leaders.

* Our scale enables us to provide a range of career opportunities, as well as benefits and rewards to enhance your well-being.

description:

At EY, we’re all in to shape your future with confidence.
  
  
We’ll help you succeed in a globally connected powerhouse of diverse teams and take your career wherever you want it to go.
  
  
Join EY and help to build a better working world.
  
  
**About Global Delivery Services**
Global Delivery Services refers to EY's worldwide network of service delivery centers. The GDS team plays an important role in EY’s strategy by ensuring effective support to EY’s growth agenda.
  
  
Our journey started in 2002 with approximately 200 people. Today we stand at 80,000+ professionals in ten locations around the world. We operate in Argentina, China, Hungary, India, Philippines, Poland, Sri Lanka, Mexico, Spain and the United Kingdom.
  
  
Client service is focused on providing Consulting, Assurance, Tax, Strategy & Transactions, and Knowledge support to our clients around the world. The teams enable account teams worldwide to provide seamless, high-quality, value-added support, helping deliver exceptional client service.
  
  
Enablement Services provides cost-effective, high-skilled, and innovative services to support EY’s global and local enablement teams. Markets, BMC, AWS, Finance and Accounting, Risk Management, Procurement, People Shared Services, IT Service Delivery and IT Global Infrastructure services, are among the services offered by Enablement Services.
  
  
Our innovation specialists serve the GDS Client Service and Enablement Services teams, along with Service Lines, Core Business Services and Sectors. The team brings the desired environment, technologies and skilled teams together for facilitation, rapid prototyping and innovative thinking. The competencies offered include analytics, digital, user experience, mobile technology, infrastructure, Microsoft technologies and open innovation.
  
  
**The Opportunity**
**Your Key Responsibilities**

* Worked on multiple Business transformation, upgrade and modernization programs.
* Requirements Gathering, Elicitation –writing BRDs, FSDs. Conducting JAD sessions and Workshops to capture requirements and working close with Product Owner.
* Work with the client to define the most optimal future state operational process and related product configuration.
* Define scope by providing innovative solutions and challenging all new client requirements and change requests but simultaneously ensuring that client gets the required business value.
* Elaborate and deliver clearly defined requirement documents with relevant dataflow and process flow diagrams.
* Work closely with product design development team to analyse and extract functional enhancements.
* Provide product consultancy and assist the client with acceptance criteria gathering and support throughout the project life cycle.
* Responsible for decision-making, optimizing processes, resource management, and overseeing team management as needed for task execution.
* Accountable for allocating personnel, supervising team members, assigning tasks, ensuring that the team has the necessary tools and support to succeed in their roles and optimizing and evaluating their performance to meet organizational goals.

**Skills And Attributes For Success**

* Product Knowledge – Guidewire, Duckcreek, Exigent, Majesco. (Preferred Guidewire/Duckcreek)
* Strong skills in stakeholder management and communication.
* Should have end to end processes in P&C insurance domain.
* Data transformation, Business data modelling, Data mapping, transformation rules, data migration, data profiling, data visualisation, Tableau, Power-BI, Reporting, Basic understanding of SQL query
* AI and Gen AI use cases implementation, Understanding of AI architecture for AI Use cases
* Should be ready to work in flexible shifts (a good amount of overlap with US/UK hours).
* Good organizational and time management skills required.
* Should have good written and verbal communication skills in English.
* Industry certifications AINS 21 - Property and Liability Insurance Principles, AINS 22 - Personal Insurance, AINS 23 - Commercial Insurance and AINS 24 - General Insurance for IT and Support Professionals will be added advantage.
* Additional experience in Life or other insurance domain is added advantage.

We expect you to work effectively as a team member and build good relationships with the client. You will have the opportunity to expand your domain knowledge and skills and will be able to collaborate frequently with other EY professionals with a wide variety of expertise.
  
  
**What We Offer You**
At EY, we’ll develop you with future-focused skills and equip you with world-class experiences. We’ll empower you in a flexible environment, and fuel you and your extraordinary talents in a diverse and inclusive culture of globally connected teams.
  
  
To help create an equitable and inclusive experience during the recruitment process, please inform us as soon as possible about any disability-related adjustments or accommodations you may need.
  
  
**Our Commitment**
: As a commitment, we persistently endeavour to embody our values, fulfil our purpose, and champion inclusiveness. Our dedication is to cultivate EY into an environment where diverse perspectives are celebrated, creating a supportive atmosphere for individuals to authentically be themselves and contribute their utmost.
  
  
**Professional Development**
: From entry-level employees to senior leaders, we believe in continuous learning. We offer opportunities to build new skills, take on leadership roles, and connect and grow through mentorship.
  
  
**People and Culture**
: In our dynamic workplace, diversity, equity, and inclusiveness are ingrained in our culture. We're united by a commitment to create an environment where every individual's differences are valued, practices are equitable, fostering a sense of belonging. Our shared values include integrity, respect, teaming, inclusiveness, energy, enthusiasm, courage to lead, and building relationships based on doing the right thing.
  
  
**Benefits**
: Embark on a transformative career journey with us and indulge in a suite of premium benefits, encompassing exclusive health and wellness packages, enticing rewards, and cutting-edge learning opportunities that empower you to continually grow and excel in your professional and personal development.
  
  
**How to Apply**
: If you are passionate to join us and are aligned with our commitment to building a better working world, we invite you to apply by completing our user-friendly form with personal and professional information and by providing your consent to data privacy.
  
  
Successful candidates advance to a competency-based interview. If mutual interest persists, a job offer awaits.
  
  
“We are an equal opportunity employer and are committed to Diversity, Equity & Inclusion”.

EY exists to build a better working world, helping to create long-term value for clients, people and society and build trust in the capital markets.

title: Senior Member, Tech (All positions)
company: D. E. Shaw India Private Limited
description:
The D. E. Shaw group is a global investment and technology development firm with more than $100 billion in investment capital as of June 1, 2026, and offices in North America, Europe, and Asia. Since our founding in 1988, our firm has earned an international reputation for successful investing based on innovation, careful risk management, and the quality and depth of our staff. We have a significant presence in the world’s capital markets, investing in a wide range of companies and financial instruments in both developed and developing economies.
  
  
We are looking for bright and exceptional programmers to join our Software Developer teams based in the firm's offices in Hyderabad/Bengaluru/Gurugram. We have requirements across various teams whose work spans the entire life cycle of a trade, scalable, high-performing data APIs in support of our Quant research, the systems supporting post-trade, accounting, valuation, and reporting operations, infrastructure solutions for analytic computations, and critical applications that support legal workflows. Because the software we build is closely tied to the performance of the firm's investments and to its day-to-day operations, the work done by these teams is highly critical and impactful.
  
  
**WHAT YOU'LL DO DAY-TO-DAY:**
You will execute individual projects and deliverables while collaborating with business groups, driving complete project lifecycles from collecting and analyzing requirements through design, implementation, deployment, and production support. You will work closely with a broad set of stakeholders, translating their needs into well-reasoned technical proposals and carrying those proposals through to delivery while holding a high bar for both quality and timelines. You will also perform R&D to evaluate the appropriate technologies to use and resolve application and data issues in production within timelines. You will explore and apply generative AI both to solve business problems and to accelerate your own work across prototyping, coding, testing, and troubleshooting. You will build robust domain knowledge in the business you support, continually look for ways to improve the existing setup, and strike the right balance between pragmatic near-term solutions and long-term maintainability. You will provide direction and guidance to junior members of the team, participate actively in code and design reviews, and contribute to an excellent engineering culture through documentation, knowledge sharing, and mentorship.
  
  
**WHO WE’RE LOOKING FOR:**
The ideal candidate should hold-
  
  
Basic Qualifications:
  
  

* A bachelor's or master's degree in computer science or a related technical field, with a solid foundation in algorithms, data structures, and object-oriented design
* 2 to 4 years of robust programming experience in one or more of C++, Java, or Python, along with the willingness to work in a language-agnostic environment
* Robust low-level design (LLD) skills and the ability to translate requirements into clean, maintainable, well-structured code
* Demonstrated technical problem-solving ability, high quantitative aptitude, and a solid grasp of core computer science fundamentals
* The ability to work independently, with focus, discipline, and attention to detail, in an agile and interdisciplinary environment
* Excellent written and oral communication skills, along with good interpersonal and reasoning ability

Preferred Qualifications:
  
  

* Experience with front-end technologies such as React, along with RESTful web services, messaging middleware, and relational databases
* Experience working with large datasets and building scalable, high-performing data pipelines, libraries, or APIs
* Exposure to the finance domain or familiarity with financial markets

Interested candidates can apply through our website: https://www.deshawindia.com/recruit/jobs/Ads/Link/SrMemTechAug26

title: Founder's Office- Program Management
description:
**About OneMetric**
OneMetric (formerly Growtomation) is a revenue enablement partner for B2B teams. We build revenue engines end to end: the systems and data teams run on, the GTM execution that drives demand, closed deals and retention, and the AI that makes the entire engine faster and smarter.
  
  
As an Elite HubSpot Partner, we work with high-growth companies across the US and globally. We start with the real revenue problem, not the tool. While most companies buy technology, GTM execution and AI solutions from separate vendors, we bring them together into one connected revenue engine.
  
  
**Who We're Hiring For**
We're looking for a Founder’s Office – Program Management professional to work closely with our founders on strategic initiatives that drive business growth and operational excellence.
  
  
This role is suited for someone who can move between strategy and execution, take ownership of ambiguous problems, and drive cross-functional initiatives from idea to implementation. You could be working on customer expansion, service and offer packaging, new growth opportunities, or improving how the business operates.
  
  
We're particularly interested in candidates with prior experience across sales, marketing, business analysis, or program management, who have recently graduated from a top B-school or Tier 1 engineering colleges who have worked in program management or similar cross-functional roles.
  
  
**What You'll Do**

* Strategic Initiatives: Work directly with founders to identify, structure, and drive strategic business initiatives from concept to execution.
* Customer Expansion: Identify opportunities to grow existing accounts, improve customer value, and support expansion initiatives.
* Offer & Service Packaging: Work on structuring and packaging service offerings to improve positioning, differentiation, and commercial outcomes.
* Program Management: Own cross-functional projects, define milestones, coordinate stakeholders, track progress, and ensure timely execution.
* Business Analysis: Analyse business performance, customer data, and operational metrics to identify opportunities, uncover bottlenecks, and recommend improvements.
* Growth Initiatives: Support new business opportunities, GTM initiatives, and experiments that can unlock growth.
* Cross-functional Collaboration: Work with Sales, Marketing, Delivery, Customer Success, and other teams to turn strategic priorities into actionable plans.
* Founder’s Office Support: Prepare business reviews, build presentations and reports, conduct research, and provide structured recommendations to support decision-making.
* Process Improvement: Identify operational inefficiencies and build scalable processes, frameworks, and systems as the business grows.

****What we're looking for****

* Experience: 3–5 years of relevant professional experience in program management, business analysis, consulting, sales, marketing, or strategy and operations.
* Education: Preference for recent graduates from leading B-schools, particularly IIMs and ISB. Candidates from other reputed Tier 1 institutions will also be considered.
* Program Management: Experience driving cross-functional initiatives, managing multiple workstreams, and delivering outcomes with limited supervision.
* Business Acumen: Ability to understand business models, identify growth opportunities, and connect strategic decisions to commercial outcomes.
* Analytical Thinking: Comfort with data, business metrics, structured problem-solving, and translating insights into actionable recommendations.
* Communication: Strong written and verbal communication skills, with the ability to work effectively with founders and senior stakeholders.
* Ownership & Execution: Someone who takes initiative, thrives in ambiguity, and can move from problem definition to execution without waiting for detailed instructions.
* Versatility: Comfortable switching between strategic thinking, detailed analysis, stakeholder coordination, and hands-on execution.

****Why join OneMetric?****

* Work directly with founders: Get exposure to high-impact business decisions and strategic priorities.
* Own meaningful initiatives: Take responsibility for projects that influence growth, customer expansion, and business performance.
* Build across functions: Develop a broad understanding of strategy, GTM, operations, and commercial decision-making.
* Make an impact: Work in a growing business where initiative, problem-solving, and execution directly contribute to outcomes.

****Ideal Candidate Profile****
The ideal candidate
**has 3–5 years of relevant experience across strategy, sales, marketing, business analysis, consulting, or program management,**
along with an academic background from a Tier 1 institution.
**We particularly prefer recent graduates from IIMs or ISB**
who bring prior work experience and a strong understanding of business fundamentals.
**We’re also open to engineers from top-tier colleges with experience driving cross-functional programs or strategic initiatives**
. Above all, we’re looking for someone who is analytical, commercially minded, comfortable working directly with founders, and capable of turning ambiguous business problems into structured plans and actionable outcomes.

title: Manager - IT Business Analysis
description:
Internal Job Posting
  
  
Last date to apply : 28th Oct
  
  
We are seeking a talented individual to join Marsh People & Investment at Marsh Tech. This role will be based in Noida/Gurgaon. This is a hybrid role that has a requirement of working at least three days a week in the office.
  
  
Manager - IT Business Analysis - AI
  
  
**Role Overview**
The Senior Systems Analyst is a role in our scaled agile framework POD and Squad model. As part of a POD team the Senior System Analyst will support one or more cross-functional squads comprised of a Squad Lead, Developers, a System Analyst, and Quality Assurance Engineers committed to ensuring the successful design and delivery of complex application solutions centered on the strategic roadmap for one or more key technology capabilities within MMC. The Senior System Analyst will be primarily responsible for directing the cross-functional elicitation and elaboration of requirements across squads in an Agile Team setting.
  
  
As part of your daily activities, you will collaborate with the Product Owner and teams to manage tactical aspects of iteration planning such as the squads’ backlog, backlog grooming, user story refinement, user story estimation, facilitating Sprint Reviews, and participating in Agile Ceremonies. As a trusted part of a team, you will coordinate activities with up to four System Analysts across squads to ensure just-in-time development of the story.
  
  
You will also assist the Product Owner in the development of personas, customer journey maps, story maps and release planning to foster insights and understanding of vision for the team.
  
  
**We will count on you to:**

* Be a highly motivated team player working within MMC Agile culture, within a specified agile framework of Scrum or KANBAN and maintain a willingness for continuously improving your agile mindset.
* Direct analysis on critical initiatives requiring significant strategic change across multiple platforms and products.
* Ensure that teams are consistently converting the business requirements to solutions, consisting of epics and features, considering technical constraints and existing technical architecture/functionality.
* Work with the Product Owner to communicate the product vision, roadmap, value, and MVP to the agile teams to enable empathy and a shared understanding thereby helping the team to formulate an appropriate solution.
* Collaborate with the Pod Leadership, Product Owner, and stakeholders to create Persona’s, Story Maps, and a Release Plan for the project.
* Work in partnership with the Product Owner and agile teams in the creation and maintenance of Product Backlog Items ensuring that Epics and User Stories are continuously prioritized and aligned to the Product Roadmap and MVP.
* Facilitate refinement sessions with the Agile Teams and Business to sufficiently detail out User Stories, to include dependencies.
* Facilitate the Sprint Review ceremony by working with the agile teams, Product Owner, Business and Customer to review, assess and adapt the latest product increment by incorporating customer insights and feedback into the Product Backlog.
* Actively work with Pod Leadership by running assessments processes for the POD and provide constructive feedback towards continuously improving the Systems Analyst function, standards and processes in Global Technology.
* Lead workshops and work collaboratively with data engineers, data architects, technical experts, and AI engineers to integrate AI solutions into a POD.
* Demonstrate an awareness of MMC and Mercer Technical, Security and Process Standards and work with the team to incorporate them in product delivery through the software development life cycle.

**What you need to have:**

* Highly motivated candidate who is an inquisitive rapid learner that is comfortable working as part of a remote team.
* Possess strong communication skills with the capability of working collaboratively within the organization, regardless of boundaries.
* An effective communicator for both technical and business-oriented audience.
* Demonstrated requirements gathering skills showcasing the capture of customer needs and business drivers using a variety of techniques into product backlog items such as Epics and User Stories.
* Proven quantitative, analytical, and problem-solving skills.
* Skilled in providing process improvement and integration opportunities with other process automation tools.
* Self-motivated and ability to learn through research and self-training.
* Ability to remove impediments for squads by providing timely responses and solutions as required.
* Ability to find resolutions regarding own work methods requiring minimal direction.
* Be willing to respond to emergent changes rather than focused on existing plans.
* Familiarity with AI concepts and technologies, including machine learning, natural language processing, and data analytics, while ensuring compliance with AI governance frameworks. Leverage these technologies to enhance user experiences and improve decision-making processes within applications.
* Minimum 12 months experience as D1/D2
* Should have at least “On-Track” or equivalent rating in last appraisal.
* Should not be under any Performance Counselling Plan or had any official disciplinary action within the last 3 months.

**What makes you stand out?**

* Ability to craft effective prompts that optimize AI responses, enhancing the functionality of AI-driven applications for problem-solving, analysis, and content generation.
* Capability to work within a POD/ cross-functional squads to develop and implement an AI strategy that aligns with business needs.
* Commitment to staying updated on the latest AI trends, technologies, and best practices to continuously improve AI capabilities within the organization.
* An Agile Mindset with an in-depth understanding of Agile Principles.
* Must have prior experience as an IT Systems Analyst or IT Business Analyst working as part of an agile team using an Agile Workflow tool such as JIRA or TFS.
* Agile Certification, such as CSM, PSM, CSPO, PSPO, PMI-ACP, Certified SAFe Practitioner, Azure AI Fundamentals is desirable.

**Why join our team:**

* We help you be your best through professional development opportunities, interesting work and supportive leaders.
* We foster a vibrant and inclusive culture where you can work with talented colleagues to create new solutions and have impact for colleagues, clients and communities.
* Our scale enables us to provide a range of career opportunities, as well as benefits and rewards to enhance your well-being.

**About Finova**
Finova is the UK's leading lending and savings technology provider, supporting one in every five mortgages nationwide. Our agile, cloud-native solutions enable over 60 banks, building societies, specialist lenders, equity release providers and a network of 2,400+ brokers to stay ahead in a competitive market.
  
  
Built on open architecture and backed by deep industry expertise, our platform is designed to scale. Each year, we process over £50 billion in loans, manage nearly £50 billion in savings, and support the digital servicing of more than 650,000 UK borrower accounts.
  
  
Be part of a team that’s driving innovation, enabling growth and shaping the future of UK lending.
  
  
**For Lenders**
Finova offers a flexible, modular technology suite designed to help lenders move faster, scale efficiently and deliver standout digital experiences.
  
  
Financial Institutions use Finova to launch products faster, process applications up to 50% more efficiently and reduce operational costs — all while staying fully compliant in a fast-moving market.
  
  
**About the Role:**
As a Senior Engineer at Finova, you will play a key role in developing, enhancing, and maintaining our core UK lending and digital banking platforms. You will design and write clean, scalable code using C#, .NET MVC, JavaScript, SQL, and RESTful APIs, ensuring high performance, security, and reliability across our software solutions. Working in an Agile environment, you will participate in code reviews, resolve complex technical issues, and collaborate closely with cross-functional teams to deliver impactful software features.

* Liaising with clients or third-party engineers on complex technical issues (interfaces, integrations).

* Providing release support and contributing to production-issue diagnosis and resolution.

**What will you be doing?**
In terms of your experience, your attitude is everything, but we'd particularly love to see your:
  
  

* Experienced or proficiency in C#, .NET MVC, JavaScript, SQL and RESTful APIs. Confidence in code reviews, ensuring quality and adherence to best practice.
* Ability to articulate technical concepts clearly to stakeholders and escalate issues appropriately.
* Experience of Agile delivery at scale, from planning through to warranty support.
* Demonstrable track record of guiding junior team members through coaching or formal training.
* Commitment to continuous learning, sharing insights via presentations or internal communities.

**What we Offer:**

* Hybrid working: We operate on a flexible hybrid model that gives you the choice and freedom to balance working from the office and working remotely.

title: Senior Software Engineer (Full Stack) - Integrations & Partner Enablement
description:
TeamViewer provides a leading Digital Workplace platform that connects people with technology—enabling, improving and automating digital processes to make work work better. Our software solutions harness the power of AI and shape the future of digitalization.
  
  
We believe that our diverse teams and strong company culture are key to the success of our products and technologies, that hundreds of millions of users around the world and around 645,000 customers across all industries rely on. With more than 1,900 employees worldwide, we celebrate the unique perspectives and talents that each individual brings to the table and foster a dynamic work environment where new ideas thrive. Are you ready to join our team and make an impact?
  
  
**Responsibilities**
We are looking for a Senior Fullstack Software Engineer (all genders) to join our new Integrations & Partner Enablement team in Noida. The team connects TeamViewer products to the enterprise systems our customers run on, such as ERP, warehouse management (WMS) and manufacturing execution (MES) systems, and gives partners the tools to build integrations on their own.
  
  
You will own integration features end to end, shape technical direction for our SDKs and integration templates, and act as a technical reference and mentor in the team. The work is mostly backend, with web frontend work on our extension tools. You will work closely with engineering and product teams in Europe.
  
  

* Design, build and maintain our Connector SDK, integration templates and backend services using Java/Kotlin with Spring Boot or Node.js/TypeScript.
* Build web extensions and tooling with React and TypeScript.
* Drive design decisions for scalable, secure and reusable integrations, applying event-driven and API-first principles.
* Design data mapping and transformation between our products and enterprise systems such as SAP, WMS and MES.
* Turn customer-specific integrations into standard, configurable templates.
* Write developer documentation, samples and guides for partners and system integrators, and support them technically.
* Drive testing strategy across the stack (unit, integration, contract, end-to-end) and contribute to CI/CD pipelines.
* Drive adoption of AI-assisted development in the team: set good practices, share workflows and keep quality high.
* Mentor other engineers, lead code reviews and promote engineering best practices.

**Requirements**

* A degree in Computer Science, Software Engineering or a related field, or equivalent experience.
* 6+ years of professional experience in software development across backend and frontend, with a track record of leading technical topics.
* Strong backend experience with Java and/or Kotlin and Spring Boot, or with Node.js and TypeScript.
* Solid experience with React and TypeScript.
* Strong experience with enterprise integration: REST APIs, data mapping and transformation, event-driven integration and messaging.
* Good understanding of authentication and authorization standards such as OAuth 2.0 / OpenID Connect.
* Experience with relational and NoSQL databases.
* Experience with Git, CI/CD, automated testing, Docker and cloud platforms (Azure or AWS).
* Hands-on experience with AI coding tools (e.g. Claude Code, GitHub Copilot, Cursor) and a clear view on how to use them responsibly in a team.
* A consulting mindset: able to understand a customer process and turn it into a reusable, standard solution.
* Experience mentoring engineers and working in agile teams.
* Good working-hours overlap with Central European Time.
* Fluent in English (spoken and written).

**Nice to have**

* Background in SAP consulting or a systems integrator, or at a product company with an integration platform or SDK (e.g. iPaaS, WMS or MES vendors).
* Experience with SAP integrations (e.g. SAP EWM, SAP S/4HANA, OData, BAPI/RFC, IDoc, SAP BTP / Integration Suite); SAP certification is a plus.
* Experience with WMS or MES products (e.g. Manhattan, Blue Yonder, Körber, Siemens Opcenter) and understanding of logistics, warehouse or manufacturing processes.
* Experience building SDKs, developer tools or developer documentation.
* Willingness to travel occasionally to Europe.

TeamViewer is an equal opportunities employer and is committed to building an inclusive culture where everyone feels welcome and supported. We C-A-R-E and understand that our diverse, values-driven culture makes us stronger. As we continue to grow as a company, we also focus on enabling our employees to grow both personally and professionally. title: Manager - IT Business Analysis
description:
Internal Job Posting
  
  
Last date to apply : 28th Oct
  
  
We are seeking a talented individual to join Marsh People & Investment at Marsh Tech. This role will be based in Noida/Gurgaon. This is a hybrid role that has a requirement of working at least three days a week in the office.
  
  
Manager - IT Business Analysis - AI
  
  
**Role Overview**
The Senior Systems Analyst is a role in our scaled agile framework POD and Squad model. As part of a POD team the Senior System Analyst will support one or more cross-functional squads comprised of a Squad Lead, Developers, a System Analyst, and Quality Assurance Engineers committed to ensuring the successful design and delivery of complex application solutions centered on the strategic roadmap for one or more key technology capabilities within MMC. The Senior System Analyst will be primarily responsible for directing the cross-functional elicitation and elaboration of requirements across squads in an Agile Team setting.
  
  
As part of your daily activities, you will collaborate with the Product Owner and teams to manage tactical aspects of iteration planning such as the squads’ backlog, backlog grooming, user story refinement, user story estimation, facilitating Sprint Reviews, and participating in Agile Ceremonies. As a trusted part of a team, you will coordinate activities with up to four System Analysts across squads to ensure just-in-time development of the story.
  
  
You will also assist the Product Owner in the development of personas, customer journey maps, story maps and release planning to foster insights and understanding of vision for the team.
  
  
**We will count on you to:**

* Be a highly motivated team player working within MMC Agile culture, within a specified agile framework of Scrum or KANBAN and maintain a willingness for continuously improving your agile mindset.
* Direct analysis on critical initiatives requiring significant strategic change across multiple platforms and products.
* Ensure that teams are consistently converting the business requirements to solutions, consisting of epics and features, considering technical constraints and existing technical architecture/functionality.
* Work with the Product Owner to communicate the product vision, roadmap, value, and MVP to the agile teams to enable empathy and a shared understanding thereby helping the team to formulate an appropriate solution.
* Collaborate with the Pod Leadership, Product Owner, and stakeholders to create Persona’s, Story Maps, and a Release Plan for the project.
* Work in partnership with the Product Owner and agile teams in the creation and maintenance of Product Backlog Items ensuring that Epics and User Stories are continuously prioritized and aligned to the Product Roadmap and MVP.
* Facilitate refinement sessions with the Agile Teams and Business to sufficiently detail out User Stories, to include dependencies.
* Facilitate the Sprint Review ceremony by working with the agile teams, Product Owner, Business and Customer to review, assess and adapt the latest product increment by incorporating customer insights and feedback into the Product Backlog.
* Actively work with Pod Leadership by running assessments processes for the POD and provide constructive feedback towards continuously improving the Systems Analyst function, standards and processes in Global Technology.
* Lead workshops and work collaboratively with data engineers, data architects, technical experts, and AI engineers to integrate AI solutions into a POD.
* Demonstrate an awareness of MMC and Mercer Technical, Security and Process Standards and work with the team to incorporate them in product delivery through the software development life cycle.

**What you need to have:**

* Highly motivated candidate who is an inquisitive rapid learner that is comfortable working as part of a remote team.
* Possess strong communication skills with the capability of working collaboratively within the organization, regardless of boundaries.
* An effective communicator for both technical and business-oriented audience.
* Demonstrated requirements gathering skills showcasing the capture of customer needs and business drivers using a variety of techniques into product backlog items such as Epics and User Stories.
* Proven quantitative, analytical, and problem-solving skills.
* Skilled in providing process improvement and integration opportunities with other process automation tools.
* Self-motivated and ability to learn through research and self-training.
* Ability to remove impediments for squads by providing timely responses and solutions as required.
* Ability to find resolutions regarding own work methods requiring minimal direction.
* Be willing to respond to emergent changes rather than focused on existing plans.
* Familiarity with AI concepts and technologies, including machine learning, natural language processing, and data analytics, while ensuring compliance with AI governance frameworks. Leverage these technologies to enhance user experiences and improve decision-making processes within applications.
* Minimum 12 months experience as D1/D2
* Should have at least “On-Track” or equivalent rating in last appraisal.
* Should not be under any Performance Counselling Plan or had any official disciplinary action within the last 3 months.

**What makes you stand out?**

* Ability to craft effective prompts that optimize AI responses, enhancing the functionality of AI-driven applications for problem-solving, analysis, and content generation.
* Capability to work within a POD/ cross-functional squads to develop and implement an AI strategy that aligns with business needs.
* Commitment to staying updated on the latest AI trends, technologies, and best practices to continuously improve AI capabilities within the organization.
* An Agile Mindset with an in-depth understanding of Agile Principles.
* Must have prior experience as an IT Systems Analyst or IT Business Analyst working as part of an agile team using an Agile Workflow tool such as JIRA or TFS.
* Agile Certification, such as CSM, PSM, CSPO, PSPO, PMI-ACP, Certified SAFe Practitioner, Azure AI Fundamentals is desirable.

**Why join our team:**

* We help you be your best through professional development opportunities, interesting work and supportive leaders.
* We foster a vibrant and inclusive culture where you can work with talented colleagues to create new solutions and have impact for colleagues, clients and communities.
* Our scale enables us to provide a range of career opportunities, as well as benefits and rewards to enhance your well-being.

title: Technical Implementation Manager
description:
At Landis+Gyr, we're helping shape the future of energy—making it more intelligent, resilient, and sustainable.
  
  
As a global energy technology leader, we're accelerating the energy evolution through purposeful innovation and trusted partnerships. Trusted by more than 2,000 utilities worldwide, our intelligent solutions connect devices, data, and decisions across the grid, helping customers modernize infrastructure, optimize operations, and deliver energy that is more reliable, resilient, accessible, safe, and sustainable.
  
  
Behind every solution is a team of approximately 3,300 employees across more than 40 countries who are passionate about solving complex challenges, driving innovation, and making a meaningful impact for our utility customers and the communities they serve.
  
  
Join Team Green and help shape the future of intelligent energy.
  
  
**Technical Implementation Manager**
The Technical Implementation Manager (TIM) owns the technical delivery of Landis+Gyr's AMI products and solutions for new customer deployments and upgrades. The role covers both containerized deployments on Kubernetes (GKE and RKE), delivered using CI/CD pipelines and automation, and multi-tier deployments of the Head-End System (HES) across Windows and Linux servers. Across both, the TIM takes the Landis+Gyr solution from environment readiness through to production, covering the full stack from head-end software to field network endpoints.
  
  
Working closely with Program Managers, infrastructure teams, customer IT and operations teams, and Landis+Gyr engineering and product groups, the TIM is accountable for a successful go-live. This includes resolving technical issues that arise during deployment and the hypercare period, and transitioning the solution smoothly to the support organization. The role calls for deep hands-on DevOps expertise and a strong working knowledge of GCP, combined with the planning and customer-facing skills needed to deliver complex deployments on schedule.
  
  
**Key Responsibilities**

* Own the end-to-end technical deployment of Landis+Gyr AMI solutions for new customers and upgrades, from environment readiness through go-live, planning activities with Program Managers and managing dependencies and risks.
* Validate that provisioned GCP and RKE environments meet deployment prerequisites, working with the infrastructure teams responsible for provisioning them.
* Deploy, configure and upgrade containerized applications on Kubernetes (GKE and RKE) using Docker and Helm charts.
* Install, configure and upgrade the Head-End System (HES) across its multi-tier architecture (network, metrology, web, application and adapter tiers) on Windows and Linux servers, including IIS and .NET-based components.
* Use and maintain CI/CD pipelines (Jenkins or similar) and scripting (PowerShell, Bash) to automate deployment, upgrade and rollback, and build reusable deployment templates across customers.
* Set up monitoring, logging and alerting so deployed applications are production-ready at go-live.
* Deliver integrations between the Landis+Gyr head-end and customer enterprise systems (e.g., MDM, CIS).
* Lead System Acceptance Testing (SAT) for new deployments and upgrades, driving defects to resolution.
* Troubleshoot and resolve technical issues during deployment and hypercare through root cause analysis, engaging engineering, product, infrastructure and support teams as needed.
* Manage the formal handover to support teams, including operational documentation, runbooks and knowledge transfer.
* Follow formal change control processes and keep ServiceNow records complete for deployment-phase changes and issues.
* Act as the customer's technical point of contact, leading technical workshops and liaising across Landis+Gyr business units throughout the deployment.

**Key Competencies**

* Automation-first mindset, making every deployment repeatable, version-controlled and scripted
* Proven ownership of complex deployments end to end, from planning through go-live
* Strong planning and prioritization skills across parallel workstreams
* Methodical analytical and troubleshooting skills, with sound technical judgment
* Clear, confident communicator with customer technical teams, both written and verbal
* Self-starter who works independently, collaborates across teams and performs under time pressure
* Willingness to travel to customer sites (~50%)

**Technical Skills**
**Required:**

* Kubernetes: deploying and managing production workloads on GKE and RKE (Rancher Kubernetes Engine)
* Containers and packaging: Docker, Helm charts
* CI/CD: working with and maintaining pipelines in Jenkins or similar tools
* Google Cloud Platform (GCP): strong working knowledge of core services, as a user of GCP-hosted environments
* Infrastructure as code: working knowledge of Terraform
* Scripting and automation: PowerShell, Bash
* Version control: Git
* Operating systems: Linux/Unix and Microsoft Windows Server, for application deployment
* Databases: Oracle, MS SQL, PostgreSQL
* Networking: IP suite and wireless/RF/broadband communication technologies
* IIS and .NET Framework

**Preferred:**

* Monitoring and observability tools (e.g., Prometheus, Grafana, ELK)
* Hardware Security Modules (HSM) and load balancers
* Two-way AMI technology, from head-end software to field endpoints

**Qualifications – Education And Experience**

* B.E./B.Tech in Electronics & Communication, Computer Science or IT
* 10+ years of industry experience, including at least 6 years in DevOps, cloud-based or technical deployment roles
* Experience deploying multi-tier enterprise applications on Windows and Linux server environments
* Experience delivering solutions that combine software and hardware
* Customer-facing experience, including independent travel to customer sites
* Energy utility or AMI operations experience is a plus

We value and encourage diversity in our team. This position is open to all qualified candidates regardless of gender, race, age, disability, sexual orientation, or background. We're committed to shaping a better future for everyone. Join Team Green and be part of what's next in energy.

title: Senior Director AI/ML Engineering
description:
Optum is a global organization that delivers care, aided by technology to help millions of people live healthier lives. The work you do with our team will directly improve health outcomes by connecting people with the care, pharmacy benefits, data and resources they need to feel their best. Here, you will find a culture guided by inclusion, talented peers, comprehensive benefits and career development opportunities. Come make an impact on the communities we serve as you help us advance health optimization on a global scale. Join us to start **Caring. Connecting. Growing together.**

An SG31 Senior Director, AI/ML Engineering is a senior technology executive responsible for leading enterprise AI initiatives from strategy through execution and value realization. The role provides leadership for AI engineering organizations and serves as the accountable owner for AI platforms, intelligent automation capabilities, machine learning solutions, and emerging AI technologies that support business transformation. The position focuses on delivering measurable business outcomes through AI while ensuring scalability, reliability, security, and governance.

The Senior Director is responsible for setting the technical and business direction for AI programs, establishing multi-year roadmaps, prioritizing investments, and aligning technology execution with organizational goals. They work closely with business leaders, product teams, operations partners, architecture groups, and executive leadership to identify opportunities where AI can improve efficiency, reduce cost, enhance customer experiences, and create new capabilities. Success is measured not only by technology delivery but also by adoption, operational impact, productivity gains, and financial value creation.

As a people leader, the role oversees a team of engineering leaders, AI engineers, machine learning engineers, data scientists, and platform specialists distributed across onshore and offshore locations. Responsibilities include organizational design, talent strategy, workforce planning, hiring, performance management, leadership development, and succession planning. The Senior Director creates an environment of innovation, accountability, continuous learning, and engineering excellence while building a solid leadership bench capable of scaling enterprise AI capabilities.

From a technology perspective, this leader owns the end-to-end lifecycle of AI solutions, including platform architecture, model deployment, intelligent agents, automation frameworks, cloud infrastructure, production operations, observability, and reliability engineering. The role ensures that AI capabilities are developed as reusable enterprise assets rather than isolated solutions, enabling faster adoption and greater return on investment across multiple business domains.

The position carries significant accountability for Responsible AI, compliance, security, and risk management. The Senior Director ensures that all AI solutions comply with governance requirements, regulatory obligations, ethical AI principles, privacy standards, and operational controls. They establish processes for model monitoring, performance measurement, incident management, human oversight, and continuous improvement to maintain trust and reliability at enterprise scale.

The role requires solid executive presence and the ability to influence senior leaders across the organization. The Senior Director regularly communicates strategy, progress, risks, investment needs, and business outcomes to executives while building alignment across diverse stakeholder groups. They act as the bridge between technology and business organizations, ensuring that AI investments are translated into meaningful operational and financial results.

Ultimately, an SG31 Senior Director, AI/ML Engineering is expected to provide broad organizational leadership, own enterprise-scale AI platforms and programs, drive adoption and value realization, build high-performing teams, ensure governance and operational excellence, and serve as the accountable leader for delivering transformative AI capabilities that advance the organization's strategic objectives.

**Primary Responsibility:**

* Comply with all applicable Company policies, procedures, and business directives, changes including those relating to work location, team assignments, work schedules, and flexible work arrangements

**Required Qualifications:**

* Bachelor's degree in Computer Science, Engineering, Data Science, Information Systems, Mathematics, or a related technical field
* 15+ years of technology and software engineering experience, including at least 8-10 years of leadership experience managing engineering organizations
* Experience leading enterprise-scale AI platforms, MLOps, AI governance frameworks, model deployment, observability, and production operations
* Experience developing senior leaders, driving organizational transformation, managing talent strategies, workforce planning, succession planning, and building high-performing engineering cultures
* Experience translating business strategy into technology roadmaps and investment priorities
* Experience establishing and operating AI governance frameworks, Responsible AI practices, model risk management processes, security controls, compliance requirements, and audit readiness
* Experience partnering with CIOs, business executives, product leaders, operations leaders, and external partners
* Solid understanding of financial management, budgeting, business case development, operational metrics, and technology investment governance.
* Deep understanding of Artificial Intelligence, Machine Learning, Large Language Models (LLMs), Agentic AI, Natural Language Processing, Generative AI, intelligent automation, cloud platforms, and modern software engineering practices
* Proven track record of building and scaling enterprise AI/ML solutions, leading large engineering teams, and delivering measurable business outcomes through AI, automation, and digital transformation initiatives
* Demonstrated success leading multi-functional teams across onshore and offshore locations
* Exceptional communication, influencing, and stakeholder management skills
* Proven ability to manage complex portfolios, prioritize competing demands, drive value realization, and communicate effectively with executive leadership
* Demonstrated ability to present strategy, roadmap, business value, risks, and recommendations to senior leadership and executive committees
* Demonstrated ability to inspire teams while maintaining solid accountability for execution and results
* Demonstrated ability to balance innovation with enterprise governance, regulatory obligations, privacy requirements, and operational risk management

**Preferred Qualifications:**

* Master's degree in Computer Science, Artificial Intelligence, Machine Learning, Data Science, Engineering Management, or Business Administration
* Ph.D. in AI, Machine Learning, Computer Science, or a related discipline is advantageous for highly specialized AI leadership roles
* Industry certifications such as Microsoft Azure AI Engineer, Azure Solutions Architect, AWS Machine Learning Specialty, Google Professional Machine Learning Engineer, SAFe Agilist, PMP, TOGAF, Certified Scrum Professional, or other AI, cloud, architecture, and leadership certifications
* Solid knowledge of Azure AI services, APIs, distributed systems, and platform engineering

**Key Competencies**

Strategic thinking, enterprise leadership, AI innovation, platform ownership, product mindset, organizational design, talent development, executive communication, stakeholder influence, financial stewardship, operational excellence, governance leadership, and business outcome accountability.

**Ideal SG31 Profile**

An executive-level AI leader who can build and scale enterprise AI platforms, lead large engineering organizations, influence senior leadership, govern AI responsibly, and deliver measurable business value through adoption, automation, productivity improvements, cost savings, and transformational AI capabilities.

Partners, manage a demanding senior stakeholder pipeline, and make trade-offs between

stakeholders

quarterly and annual business reviews — translating Tribe objectives into concrete
  
sprint goals and KPIs, and unblocking the team as an escalation point

title: Deployment Strategist
description:
**Job Description**
About the Team
  
  
The FDE (Forward Deployed Engineering) team is a new, strategic initiative sponsored from the CEO and Founders down. Our mission is to win C-suite-sponsored, high-value AI opportunities by selling and delivering outcomes, not just a platform.
  
  
You will be part of the founding team, embedded with our most strategic customers from the very first sales call, all the way through to a production-ready solution. You will be the "product manager" for the customer's problem, responsible for the "why" and "what," while our FDEs (Engineers) will be your partners responsible for the "how."
  
  
Role Description
  
  
As a Deployment Strategist (DS), you are the critical bridge between a customer's multi-million-dollar business problem and Databricks' technical solution. You are a product manager for the field, owning the technical and product direction of the engagement from initial discovery through production launch and adoption.
  
  
You will build C-suite trust, perform deep discovery to map the customer's political and technical landscape, and scope the value. You will define the Minimum Viable Product for a pilot, write the PRD that guides the engineering team, and manage the project to a successful landing. You will also lead technical discovery, shape solution architecture with FDEs, and ensure that each proposed solution can move from prototype to production.
  
  
This role requires a rare combination of executive presence, deep product thinking, technical depth, and a hands-on delivery mindset.
  
  
The impact you will have
  
  

* C-Suite Scoping & Value Definition: Partner with Sales to perform deep discovery, map the customer's organization, quantify the business value of $10M+ problems, and define the pilot, including its MVP, success criteria, and timeline.
* End-to-End Product Ownership: Author the PRD, prioritize the engineering backlog, manage scope, and act as the primary hands-on QA tester. Translate business requirements into clear data, integration, security, and operational requirements that engineers can build against.
* Technical Solution Leadership & Delivery: Drive the FDE build team through an agile delivery process, manage stakeholders from the C-suite to individual engineers, and unblock technical or organizational issues. Lead technical discovery and design reviews. Understand the customer's data flows, integrations, platform constraints, and operational environment; pressure-test architecture choices; and identify technical risks early.
* Solution Launch & Landing: Own the "Day 0" launch, manage the war room, and drive the solution from launch to full adoption by capturing user feedback, iterating, and proving the defined business value. Own production readiness across data quality, testing, security, performance, and operations. Work with the team to diagnose issues and drive them to resolution.
* Strategic Handoff & Growth: Scope the ongoing maintenance plan, create customer documentation/training, and leverage your trusted advisor status to identify the next high-value FDE engagement. Codify reusable solution patterns and bring field insights back to Product and Engineering.

What we look for
  
  

* Executive Presence & Communication: You are a trusted advisor with strong executive presence and excellent communication skills. You are confident and humble, can build rapport quickly, and can help senior stakeholders make difficult decisions.
* Product Judgment & Delivery: You can define what to build and why, write strong product requirements, prioritize engineering work, manage scope, and lead complex agile software projects from an ambiguous problem to a measurable outcome.
* Technical Fluency & Architecture Judgment: You understand modern data and AI architectures, including cloud platforms, data pipelines, data models, distributed systems, APIs, security and governance, machine learning, and generative AI application patterns. You can lead architecture discussions, evaluate trade-offs, and pressure-test technical decisions.
* Hands-on Technical Ability: You are proficient in at least one language such as Python, Java, or SQL. You can explore data, work in notebooks, read and review code and pipelines, build or adapt prototypes, and contribute meaningfully to troubleshooting.
* Relevant Experience: Typically 7+ years of experience delivering complex, customer-facing data, analytics, AI, or software engagements, or equivalent experience as a founder or technical builder. You have helped deliver data, machine learning, or generative AI systems into production and understand the integration, operational, and adoption challenges that appear in real environments. Experience in a high-growth technology company, forward-deployed organization, or leading consultancy is valuable. You enjoy working onsite with customers (often 25-50%, sometimes higher) to drive delivery.

**About Databricks**
Databricks is the Data and AI company. More than 20,000 organizations worldwide — including adidas, AT&T, Bayer, Block, Mastercard, Rivian, Unilever, and 70% of the Fortune 500 — rely on the Databricks Data + AI Platform to build and scale data and AI apps, analytics and agents. Headquartered in San Francisco with 30+ offices around the globe, Databricks offers a unified platform that includes Genie, Lakebase, Agent Bricks, Lakeflow, Lakehouse, and Unity Catalog. To learn more, follow Databricks on LinkedIn, X, YouTube, and Instagram.
  
  
**Benefits**
At Databricks, we strive to provide comprehensive benefits and perks that meet the needs of all of our employees. For specific details on the benefits offered in your region click here.
  
  
Our Commitment to Diversity and Inclusion
  
  
At Databricks, we are committed to fostering a diverse and inclusive culture where everyone can excel. We take great care to ensure that our hiring practices are inclusive and meet equal employment opportunity standards. Individuals looking for employment at Databricks are considered without regard to age, color, disability, ethnicity, family or marital status, gender identity or expression, language, national origin, physical and mental ability, political affiliation, race, religion, sexual orientation, socio-economic status, veteran status, and other protected characteristics.
