title: Strategic Initiatives Associate
description:
Strategic Initiatives Associate

SVECTOR | Ahmedabad, Gujarat (On-site) | Full-time | Monday to Saturday

Experience: 0–4 years. Exceptional fresh graduates are encouraged to apply.

Reports to: Founder-CEO

About SVECTOR

SVECTOR is a technology company building intelligence infrastructure for enterprises and institutions. We develop software systems that help organizations understand complex information, improve decision-making and execute critical business processes. Our initiatives span enterprise intelligence, talent and leadership decision systems, healthcare, industrial technology, financial intelligence and defensive intelligence.

We work on problems where technology must do more than generate information. It must help people understand what is happening, decide what to do and turn decisions into measurable outcomes.

About the Role

We are hiring a Strategic Initiatives Associate to work closely with company leadership on selected product, technology and business initiatives. This is an early-career role for someone curious, capable and dependable who wants to understand how a technology business runs while taking direct responsibility for meaningful work.

You will take assigned objectives, work out a practical approach, bring the right people together and carry the work through to a verified result. You will work across engineering, product and business teams on things like investigating a product issue, understanding a customer requirement, preparing a business analysis, coordinating a pilot or moving an initiative from planning into execution.

This is not a role defined by attending meetings, preparing presentations or passing instructions between departments. The goal is to contribute directly to work that produces results. Experience in an identical role is not required.

What You Will Do

Project execution

• Understand the objective, constraints and importance of each assigned initiative.

• Break objectives into activities, deliverables, owners and milestones.

• Coordinate with engineering, product and business stakeholders.

• Spot delays, dependencies and gaps early, and resolve blockers within your authority.

• Follow up on commitments and keep progress, pending actions and open issues visible.

• Check completed work against its original requirements.

• Prepare short progress summaries and flag decisions that need leadership attention.

You are expected to understand the work you coordinate. Collecting updates or maintaining a tracker without understanding the problem is not enough.

Product and technical-business work

• Use SVECTOR's software products to understand their real capabilities and limits.

• Understand customer workflows and the problems customers expect the product to solve.

• Investigate reported issues and tell defects apart from unclear requirements and new feature requests.

• Turn business and customer needs into clear problem statements, requirements, user stories and acceptance criteria.

• Work with engineers to understand constraints, dependencies and possible approaches.

• Support demos, testing, customer pilots and implementation, and confirm delivered work meets the requirement.

You are not being hired as a full-time software developer, but strong technical literacy matters. You should be comfortable with concepts such as APIs, databases, integrations and data flows, and willing to learn what you do not yet know.

Research and analysis

• Research companies, industries, technologies and business opportunities.

• Compare competitors, products, technical approaches and tools.

• Study enterprise customers and the environments they operate in.

• Review reports, specifications and original source material.

• Prepare decision briefs and recommendations that state what is known, what the evidence is, what remains uncertain and what to do next.

We expect you to go beyond the first search result, verify important claims, check numbers and explain your reasoning. We value independent thinking over long documents full of generic observations.

Business and customer initiatives

• Research prospective customers and decision-makers, and prepare background for key discussions.

• Support demos, discovery calls and technical-business presentations.

• Turn customer feedback into specific product or business actions.

• Help with proposals and solution briefs, and coordinate pilot follow-ups.

• Join customer meetings and speak with external stakeholders when authorized.

There is no individual sales quota. Pricing, contracts and financial commitments stay subject to leadership approval.

Leadership support and AI tools

• Prepare briefing notes and short memos for important discussions.

• Record decisions, commitments and open questions, and keep actions tied to owners.

• Use AI tools and modern software for research, document analysis and repetitive workflows, and check their output against reliable sources.

Using AI does not remove your responsibility to understand your own work. An unverified AI-generated document that you cannot explain is not an acceptable deliverable. You will also follow company rules on confidential information and data handling.

Who You Are

• Curious: you want to understand a hard problem, not avoid it.

• Accountable: a task is done when there is an outcome, not when you have sent a message. You are honest about obstacles and mistakes.

• Structured: you break problems down, test assumptions and reach reasoned conclusions, even under uncertainty.

• Clear communicator: excellent written and spoken English, with precise emails, briefs and summaries.

• Technically curious: you enjoy learning how software is built and used. Coding experience helps but is not required.

• Reliable: you respect deadlines and confidentiality, know when you need approval, and accept feedback well.

Qualifications

• 0–4 years of relevant experience. Internships, independent projects, research, entrepreneurship or full-time work all count.

• A bachelor's degree in Computer Science, Engineering, IT, AI, Data Science, Business Analytics, Economics, Management or a related field is preferred. Other backgrounds are considered where projects show the capability. No MBA required.

• Experience in product operations, business analysis, technical consulting, software development, strategic research or project execution is relevant.

We care about work you have actually completed: a product or technical project, an internship where you solved a real problem, a research assignment with a defensible conclusion, or an initiative where you took responsibility beyond your assigned work. Tell us your own contribution, the decisions you made and the results.

This role is not an administrative or personal-assistant job, a software engineering job focused on production code, a pure consulting role or a senior management position. It is an execution-oriented role centered on product understanding, research, problem-solving and completing assigned initiatives.

What Success Looks Like

• First 30 days: learn the products, workflows and priorities, and complete initial research and product assignments accurately.

• Days 31–60: own a defined initiative, prepare an execution approach and keep progress visible.

• Days 61–90: carry an initiative to an agreed result or a documented handover.

Hiring Process

1. Application review

2. Initial discussion

3. Practical assessment: a realistic research, product or business task. AI tools may be used where permitted, but you must be able to explain and verify your work.

4. Leadership interview

5. Offer discussion: responsibilities, compensation, schedule and joining date are confirmed before a written offer.

Working Arrangements

Full-time, on-site in Ahmedabad, Monday to Saturday. Schedule, compensation and joining terms are confirmed before a formal offer. If anything about the role or location does not match your expectations, please raise it in the first discussion.

How to Apply

Send your resume with a short note covering:

1. Your strongest example of ownership: what you did, which decisions you made and what happened.

2. Why you are interested in technology, research, product understanding and business execution.

3. Your current location, availability to work full-time on-site in Ahmedabad and earliest joining date.

Links to projects, GitHub, portfolios or research are welcome. Please skip the generic statements.

title: Delivery Manager
description:
**Delivery Manager**

Client Delivery & Operations • Digital Marketing

**Purpose of the Role**

Ensemble delivers digital marketing and AI services to a growing base of clinical and healthcare clients. The Delivery Manager owns the system that keeps that growth running smoothly — making on-time, on-scope delivery the standard across every account by owning intake, planning, capacity, cadence, and quality end to end.

This is a dedicated operations role focused on one outcome: consistent, reliable delivery. It is the foundation that lets clients trust us with more work and lets the team do its best work without friction.

**Reporting**

**Reports to:**
COO / Managing Director

**Works with:**
Account leads, the offshore (India) delivery team, and specialists across SEO, Paid Ads, Creative, Video, Web Development, Content, and AI.

**Core Responsibilities**
**1. Own on-time delivery across all accounts**

•  Hold end-to-end accountability for every client deliverable shipping on time and to standard.

•  Maintain one live view of all work in flight — status, owner, due date, and risk — so nothing stays invisible until it is already late.

**2. Plan capacity and resources**

•  Forecast team capacity against committed work and flag over-allocation
**before**
it causes slippage.

•  Balance workload across the offshore team and specialists; reassign to clear bottlenecks.

•  Translate client commitments into realistic timelines the team can actually hit — push back when they can’t.

**3. Control intake, priorities, and scope**

•  Run a disciplined intake process — no work starts without a clear scope, owner, and deadline.

•  Set and communicate priorities across accounts; resolve conflicts between competing client demands.

•  Catch scope creep early and escalate the trade-off rather than silently absorbing it into the timeline.

**4. Run the delivery cadence**

•  Lead a recurring delivery rhythm (daily standup + weekly account review) that surfaces risk early.

•  Coordinate across time zones so the offshore team stays unblocked and handoffs don’t stall overnight.

•  Track dependencies and escalations and drive them to resolution.

**5. Enforce quality**

•  Review deliverables before they reach the client — nothing ships below standard.

•  For healthcare and clinical clients, ensure work meets compliance expectations (HIPAA-aware handling, compliant tracking and reporting).

•  Reduce rework by catching issues internally, not at the client.

**6. Report to clients and leadership**

•  Give clients clear, consistent status updates — progress, what’s next, and any risks to the timeline.

•  Give leadership an honest, data-backed view of delivery health and where it is at risk.

**7. Build the delivery system**

•  Develop and maintain SOPs, checklists, and workflows so delivery is predictable, not heroic.

•  Continuously remove recurring blockers and improve throughput without simply adding headcount.

•  Mentor coordinators and the offshore team toward accountability and ownership.

**What Success Looks Like (KPIs)**

Delivery health is measured, reviewed monthly, and owned by this role:

**Metric Target**

1. On-time delivery rate ≥ 95% of deliverables shipped by the committed date
2. Rework rate < 10% of deliverables needing rework after internal review
3. Client-reported quality issues Trending down quarter over quarter
4. Team utilization 75–85% (productive, not overloaded or idle)
5. SLA / turnaround compliance ≥ 95% of requests handled within agreed timeframes
6. Delivery visibility 100% of active work tracked in one live source of truth
7. Escalation handling Risks flagged and resolved before the deadline, not after

**Qualifications**

•  Minimum 5+ years in project or delivery management, ideally in a digital or creative agency.

•  Proven track record improving or scaling on-time delivery across multiple concurrent accounts.

•  Working knowledge of SEO, Google Ads, Meta Ads, social, creative and video production, web development, content, and analytics — enough to judge quality and timelines, and to execute hands-on, if essential.

•  Experience coordinating distributed or offshore teams across time zones.

•  Familiarity with healthcare or clinical client requirements (HIPAA awareness) is a strong plus.

•  Strong on process design, prioritization, communication, and stakeholder management.

**Ideal Candidate**

An operations leader who makes delivery boringly predictable. Organized, calm under competing deadlines, hands-on and relentless about removing blockers and building the systems that let good quality work ship on time — every account, every time.

**CTC:**
As per market for the right fit candidate

title: Web Designer
description:
As a Web Designer at Skydo, you’ll bring our visual identity to life through engaging web experiences and high-quality landing pages. Working closely with Growth and Product, you’ll create reusable design components and take ideas from concept to launch.

**What you will do:**

* Make the new look feel at home on the web. Carry our visual language across every page, so it all feels like one Skydo.
* Launch pages that do their job. Work with Growth on what each page needs to achieve, design it, ship it, and learn from the numbers.
* Add care to key product moments. Some moments in the product deserve more than a default. You'll make them feel special.
* Build the kit. Components and templates, so the next page takes a day, not a week.
* Take it live. With code or AI tools, you won't wait in a queue to see your work out in the world.

**You’re a good fit if you have:**

* 2-4 years of experience as a Web Designer
* You have a great eye for type, spacing, colour and composition, and can explain why something works.
* You ship. You've put work live, not just mocked it up.
* You're quick, but careful. Moving fast doesn't mean letting details slip.
* You own it. Rough brief in, polished launch out, and you check how it's doing after.
* You're curious. You notice great websites, try new tools early, and love taking things apart to see how they work.
* You care about words. A good headline is part of good design.

**How we Design:**

* Trust lives in the details. People trust us with their money. A misaligned number or a vague label chips away at that, so we sweat the small stuff.
* Simple, for busy people. Our customers have businesses to run. We keep things clear and calm so they can get on with it.
* Do it right once, then move fast. We're a startup, so speed matters. We take the time to get it right, turn it into a system, then build quickly on top.
* Use whatever helps. Figma, Framer, code, AI. We care about great work, not the tool.

**The mindset we’re seeking:**

* Real ownership from day one, with work that reaches 40,000+ businesses.
* A fresh canvas. A brand-new visual language and plenty of room to shape it.
* A team that cares about craft, with honest feedback and regular critiques.
* Room to play with motion, code and AI.

title: Graphic Designer
description:
**Who We Are**

UONEX is an AI-first platform that helps people find products in real stores near them, instantly. Whether it's a linen shirt or a full wedding look, UONEX connects shoppers with the shops around them that actually have what they want. On the other side, we work with brands, retail stores, and malls to help them get discovered by the customers walking past their doors, understand the demand signals & shopping behavior of shoppers. We're building the bridge between online search and offline shopping, and we're doing it physical-first.

**The Role**

We're looking for a creative, detail-oriented Graphic Designer to join our marketing team. You'll design for both sides of UONEX: shoppers discovering what's good in their city (B2C), and the brands, stores, and malls we partner with (B2B).

Your day-to-day will be social media visuals, but the role goes beyond that. You'll also design landing pages and support the team with website and app screens as needed. You don't need to be a product designer, but you should be comfortable working in Figma and eager to grow across formats. What we need from you is a strong visual sense, attention to detail, and the ability to turn ideas into designs that look good and communicate clearly.

**Responsibilities**

* Design social media creatives for Instagram, LinkedIn, and X, including static posts, carousels, and stories.
* Create ad creatives for paid campaigns across Meta, Google, and LinkedIn, for both shopper-facing (B2C) and partner-facing (B2B) audiences.
* Design landing pages for campaigns, launches, and partner acquisition.
* Support the product and marketing teams with website and app screens when required.
* Work closely with the content team to bring copy to life visually.
* Adapt visual style between a vibrant, scroll-stopping consumer look and a clean, credible B2B look.
* Maintain consistency with UONEX's brand identity across every touchpoint, and help build and evolve our design system.
* Turn around quick iterations based on feedback and campaign performance.

**What You Are Expected To Bring**

* Proficiency in at least one of Adobe Photoshop or Illustrator
* Working knowledge of Figma (mandatory), including frames, components, and auto layout.
* Ability to design for different audiences, from everyday shoppers to business decision-makers.
* Basic understanding of how designs translate to web and mobile screens.
* Openness to feedback and eagerness to learn new formats quickly.
* Reliability with deadlines and proactive communication.

**Why Work With Us?**

* Be one of the first members of a marketing team being built from scratch.
* Work across social, ads, landing pages, and product screens, so you grow into a well-rounded designer.
* Design for both B2B and B2C audiences at a fast-moving, AI-first startup.
* Help shape the visual identity of a new product category from the ground up.
* A collaborative team that values ownership, fresh ideas, and great design.

title: Technical Implementation Consultant
description:
**Strength in Trust**
OneTrust’s mission is to enable innovation through the responsible use of data and AI. We believe that ensuring data is trusted shouldn’t slow teams down—it should accelerate what’s possible. This led us to develop the first technology platform for responsible data use in 2016. Today, with AI representing the latest and most impactful expansion of data yet, OneTrust is once again redefining what responsible innovation looks like. OneTrust, the AI‑Ready Governance Platform™, unifies regulatory intelligence, automation, and connected governance workflows so businesses can continue to move at the speed of AI while ensuring good governance to prevent data misuse at scale. Trusted by thousands of organizations worldwide, OneTrust is shaping the future where trusted data becomes a transformative force for business and society.
  
  
**The Challenge**
Due to rapid growth and an increased demand for our platform, OneTrust is seeking a Technical Implementation Consultant. The Technical Implementation Consultant role is one of the key pieces of the OneTrust architecture. After the sales process, consultants are the key contact in driving and building the relationship, implementing the solution, and managing the expectations of the customer. Technical Implementation consultants work across the technical modules. As a Technical Implementation Consultant, you will be responsible for the customer relationship and will work directly with our customers to . The role is one of the most important as it is the bridge between OneTrust and the customer, helping the business grow by identifying product enhancements and relaying them between the customer and OneTrust Product teams.
  
  
**Our Team**
The Content Customization team is unique team with incredible talent. This team combines a fine-tuned project management discipline alongside superb technical acumen sprinkled with stunning design chops. Not only that, but we build on top of 2 world-class, customer-friendly CMS and LMS platforms. Furthermore, we operate like a boutique agency inside the OneTrust Ethics Professional Services Team.
  
  
**Your Mission**
**As a Technical Implementation Consultant, You Will**
Oversee the technical implementation and platform adoption for customer projects from start to finish.
  
  
Provide creative insight and execution for customers while implementing web-based portals and pages based on customer assets and brand guidelines on our CMS tool.
  
  
Provide creative insight and execution for customers while implementing branding and creating custom courses with customer assets and brand guidelines on our learning authoring tool.
  
  
Use your experience across a broad range of front-end technologies including HTML and CSS.
  
  
Use your design experience using wireframing tools like Figma and storyboarding in tools like Fig-jam.
  
  
Use or deepen your experience with the Adobe suite of products to create assets to use in creative projects.
  
  
Use or deepen your knowledge of Instructional Design.
  
  
Use or deepen your experience with web accessibility standards (ADA &WCAG).
  
  
Work closely with UI/UX design, marketing, product management and engineering on project goals and requirements.
  
  
Prioritize and drive resolution on escalated customer issues.
  
  
Complete internal and project documentation.
  
  
Seek opportunities in day-to-day workflow to improve quality and efficiency from ideation to deployment.
  
  
Document processes and workflows in shareable documents for future use and adoption.
  
  
Document project progress in our CRM tool (Salesforce)
  
  
Be an advocate for our customers by representing their issues to Product Management and Software Engineering with a focus on steering the OneTrust roadmap.
  
  
Monitor and analyse the customer’s adoption of our solution features and functionality to provide leadership with an understanding of their overall business needs as they relate to our products.
  
  
Provide strategic and tactical support for Sales, Professional Services, and Business Development
  
  
You will also act as system and regulatory best practice expert, drawing from a plethora of consulting experience to advise customers on optimization of privacy & ethics program(s). Act as the customer advocate. Seamlessly transition ownership and action plan back to involved teams. Show ownership of issues, engage customers, establish urgent priorities, and implement resolution plan. Able to resolve simple to moderate issues with minimal management intervention. Ability to interpret and deliver on custom SOW customer projects.
  
  
**Your Experience Includes**
BA/BS OR MS in Computer Science, Web Design/Development [Bootcamp friendly], Engineering Management or Information Technology/Systems
  
  
2 – 5 years of relevant experience in software development, professional services, solution engineering, design, technical consulting; with expertise in architecting, supporting and/or rolling out new technology and solution initiatives.
  
  
Experience working with front-end technologies and design frameworks.
  
  
Effective customer-facing relationship building skills. Proven success in and genuine enthusiasm for working directly with customer(s).
  
  
Proven ability to engage across corporate functions (Professional Services, Support and Product Management).
  
  
Previous end-to-end implementation experience, ideally on a SAAS platform/product or creative agency.
  
  
Excellent verbal and written communication skills, including the ability to chair meetings or host trainings.
  
  
An understanding of the following tech/tools: HTML, CSS, Figma (or any wireframing tool), Acquia (or any CMS), Gomo (or any learning authoring tool), Salesforce, Jira – a plus, SSO, Domain Management.
  
  
Ability to build relationships across stakeholders in marketing, product, sales, and engineering.
  
  
Proficiency in Microsoft suite of products.
  
  
**Extra Awesome**
Knowledge of HTTP, SSO, SCORM packages, domain management.
  
  
Knowledge of Learning Management Systems.
  
  
Functional experience in the field (Privacy, Ethics or GRC)
  
  
Industry Certifications (CIPP/E, CIPM, GRCP, CPA, CISA, LPEC, etc.)
  
  
Experience dealing with senior management (C-Level) across multiple customers.
  
  
Language skills (German, French, Spanish, or Italian)
  
  
Where we Work
  
  
We are embracing an office-first culture, encouraging three days a week in office for most roles, with meaningful opportunities to collaborate and celebrate in person.
  
  
Each role may have specific requirements or flexibility depending on the scope of the position, so we encourage you to verify this with your recruiter during your first interview.
  
  
**Benefits**
As an employee at OneTrust, you will be part of the OneTeam. That means you’ll receive support physically, mentally, and emotionally so that you can do your best work both in and out of the office. This includes comprehensive healthcare coverage, flexible PTO, equity RSUs, annual performance bonus opportunities, retirement account support, 14+ weeks of paid parental leave, career development opportunities, company-paid privacy certification exam fees, and much more. Specific benefits differ by country. For more information, talk to your recruiter or visit onetrust.com/careers.
  
  
Resources
  
  
Check out the following to learn more about OneTrust and its people:
  
  

* OneTrust Careers on YouTube
* @LifeatOneTrust on Instagram

Your Data
  
  
You have the right to have your personal data updated or removed. You also have the right to have a copy of the information OneTrust holds about you. Further details about these rights are available on the website in our Privacy Overview
**.**
You can change your mind at any time and have your personal data removed from our database. In order to do this you must contact us and let us know you wish to be removed. The request should be made on the Data Subject Request Form.
  
  
Recruitment fraud warning: OneTrust is aware of scams involving false offers of employment with our company. The fraudulent jobs, interviews and job offers use fake websites, email addresses, group chat and text messages. Be aware that we never ask candidates for personal information, IDs or bank information during the interview process. We do not interview prospective candidates via instant message or group chat, and do not require candidates to purchase products or services, or process payments on our behalf as a condition of any employment offer. Please note that any legitimate interview availability requests will come directly from a OneTrust recruiter with an "@onetrust.com" email address. You may also receive legitimate emails from "@us.greenhouse-mail.io". Recruiters will only reach out to candidates who have applied for a role through our ATS (Greenhouse) or prospects via LinkedIn InMail. Job offers will come from a recruiter and may have a "@docusign.net" email address. For more information or if you have been targeted please reach out to askrecruiting@onetrust.com.
  
  
**Our Commitment to You**
When you join OneTrust you are stepping onto a launching pad — the countdown has begun. The destination? A career without boundaries working alongside a diverse and inclusive crew who is passionate about doing meaningful work. As a pioneer, your voice and expertise will help chart the direction of an entirely new category. Our commitment to putting people first starts with you. Your growth is part of the mission. Our goal is to give you the power to embark on the next phase of your uniquely, unique career.
  
  
OneTrust provides equal employment opportunities to all employees and applicants for employment and prohibits discrimination and harassment of any type without regard to race, color, religion, age, sex, national origin, disability status, genetics, protected veteran status, sexual orientation, gender identity or expression, or any other characteristic protected by local laws.

title: Product Analyst
description:
**Product Analyst**

**Experience:**
1-2yrs

**Location:**
Bengaluru
**(Onsite only)**

**About the Role**

We are looking for a curious, analytical, and highly communicative Product Analyst to join our Product team. This role goes well beyond dashboards and reporting—you will partner closely with Product Managers, Design, Engineering, Customer Success, and customers themselves to help shape what we build and why.

You will combine data-driven thinking with deep product understanding, transforming customer problems, market insights, and competitive intelligence into well-defined product requirements. From discovery through release and adoption, you will play a key role in ensuring we deliver solutions that create measurable value.

**Key Responsibilities**

**Product Discovery & Research**

* Conduct deep research into customer workflows, industry trends, emerging technologies, and market opportunities.
* Perform competitor analysis to understand positioning, identify feature gaps, and recommend strategic improvements.
* Gather and synthesize feedback from customers, internal stakeholders, and support teams into actionable product insights.
* Translate ambiguous business problems into structured hypotheses and product recommendations.

**Product Requirements & Documentation**

* Draft high-quality Product Requirement Documents (PRDs), user stories, acceptance criteria, and supporting documentation.
* Use AI-assisted research and documentation tools (including Claude Skills or similar workflows) to accelerate research, requirement gathering, and documentation while maintaining high quality and accuracy.
* Ensure product specifications are complete, testable, and clearly understood by engineering and design teams.
* Maintain documentation throughout the product lifecycle as requirements evolve.

**Product Validation & Quality**

* Participate in feature reviews, QA demonstrations, and pre-release validations to verify that delivered functionality aligns with product intent and customer expectations.
* Provide product sign-off or recommend changes before features are released.
* Collaborate with QA and Engineering to identify functional gaps, usability issues, and edge cases early in the development process.

**Customer & Stakeholder Engagement**

* Participate in customer meetings, discovery sessions, implementation discussions, and feedback calls.
* Clearly communicate product capabilities, limitations, and roadmap decisions to both technical and non-technical audiences.
* Support customer-facing teams by helping explain new functionality and gather structured feedback for future improvements.
* Deliver product demonstrations and contribute to customer training sessions when required.

**Product Analytics**

* Define and monitor product KPIs, adoption metrics, engagement trends, and feature success measures.
* Analyze user behavior, funnels, retention, and usage patterns to inform product decisions.
* Build evidence-based recommendations using quantitative and qualitative data rather than intuition alone.
* Evaluate product experiments and recommend next steps based on measurable outcomes.

**What We're Looking For**

* Strong analytical and structured problem-solving skills.
* Excellent written and verbal communication skills, with the ability to explain complex concepts clearly.
* Experience writing PRDs, user stories, functional specifications, or similar product documentation.
* Ability to conduct independent research and convert findings into practical product recommendations.
* Comfort working directly with customers and presenting ideas to cross-functional teams.
* Experience participating in feature validation or QA reviews with a product mindset.
* Ability to balance customer needs, business priorities, and technical constraints when making recommendations.
* High attention to detail and a strong sense of ownership.

**Nice to Have**

While not required, we would especially value candidates who have worked on digital transformation initiatives within construction, engineering, infrastructure, or field operations organizations. Experience in these environments can provide useful context for understanding operational workflows and user needs, but we welcome applicants from all industries with strong product and analytical capabilities.

**Success in This Role**

**A successful Product Analyst will:**

* Produce clear, thoughtful, and implementation-ready PRDs.
* Surface meaningful insights through research and competitive analysis.
* Help ensure features meet both business goals and customer expectations before release.
* Confidently represent the Product team in customer conversations and training sessions.
* Act as a trusted partner to Product Management by combining analytical rigor with strong communication and sound product judgment.

title: Senior Design Engineer
description:
**Purpose of this position / Position summary**

We are seeking a highly skilled and experienced Senior Full Stack Developer to join our dynamic team. The ideal candidate will have:

* Strong experience in end-to-end application development (front-end and back-end).
* Solid exposure to system design, data model design, API design, and
  **cloud-native**
  development practices.
* Deep hands-on expertise with modern front-end frameworks (preferably Angular and/or React) and back-end development using ".NET Core", ".NET Framework", "C#", and/or "Python".
* A strong understanding of secure-first design and OWASP guidelines, cloud security, software engineering best practices, Agile methodologies, and cloud architecture (preferably Azure).

This role requires excellent coding and debugging skills, strong documentation habits, the ability to collaborate closely with architects and technical leads, and the capability to guide junior developers. Experience with Azure, micro-frontends, microservices, cloud-native services, and the use of Generative AI tools for code and test generation is highly desirable.

**Primary duties and responsibilities**

**Key Responsibilities**

* **Full Stack Application Development**
* Implement high-quality, maintainable, and efficient back-end and front-end code using ".NET Core", ".NET Framework", "C#", "Python", "Angular", and/or "React".
* Build responsive, accessible, and cross-browser compatible UIs integrated with robust back-end services.
* **System, Component & UI Architecture**
* Contribute to system and component-level design, working closely with software architects to refine and implement design patterns and technical solutions.
* Develop reusable UI components, libraries, and patterns to ensure consistency across applications.
* Contribute to and refine front-end architecture, including
  **micro-frontends**
  (e.g., module-based composition, Module Federation or similar patterns).
* **Data Model Implementation**
* Implement and optimize data models in collaboration with architects and database engineers to support application performance, integrity, and scalability.
* **API Development & Integration**
* Develop, document, and maintain secure, robust, and scalable APIs, ensuring adherence to established API design standards.
* Integrate front-end applications with RESTful APIs and backend services, handling client-side state management, error handling, and performance optimization for API-heavy applications.
* **Cloud-Native Development & Integration (Azure Preferred)**
* Design and build cloud-native applications, leveraging containerization, microservices, and managed cloud services.
* Build and deploy services on Azure using Docker and Kubernetes, following cloud-native best practices (scalability, resilience, observability, and cost-efficiency).
* Implement and integrate with Azure services (e.g., App Service, API Management, Storage, Identity, Monitoring, CDN) in line with architectural guidelines.
* **Secure-First Development (OWASP & Cloud Security)**
* Apply OWASP and secure coding practices throughout the development lifecycle (e.g., XSS, CSRF, injection, authentication/authorization, secure session management) on both client and server.
* Collaborate with security and platform teams to ensure cloud-native security (IAM, network security, secrets management, TLS, configuration hardening).
* **Performance, Optimization & Quality**
* Optimize applications for speed and scalability (bundling, lazy loading, code splitting, caching, query optimization, API and database performance tuning).
* Use profiling tools and metrics to identify and resolve performance bottlenecks on both client and server.
* Apply solid software engineering principles, including clean code, design patterns, unit/integration/end-to-end testing, and code reviews to ensure high code quality.
* **Agile Delivery & Collaboration**
* Participate actively in Agile ceremonies (daily stand-ups, sprint planning, reviews, and retrospectives).
* Estimate work items, manage technical debt, and deliver features on time.
* Work closely with architects, product owners, QA engineers, UX/UI designers, and other developers to clarify requirements, resolve technical issues, and deliver robust solutions.
* **Documentation**
* Produce clear, concise technical documentation for modules, APIs, front-end components, patterns, and development processes to support maintainability and knowledge sharing.
* Contribute to design systems, style guides, and coding standards for full stack development.
* **Mentoring, Guidance & Knowledge Sharing**
* Provide technical guidance to junior developers, perform code reviews, and share best practices within the team.
* Conduct technical sessions and help elevate overall full stack and
  **cloud-native**
  competency of the team.
* **Generative & Agentic AI, Prompt Engineering (Desirable)**
* Use Generative AI tools for code scaffolding, refactoring, test generation, and documentation to improve productivity and quality.
* Apply basic prompt engineering techniques to obtain reliable and secure outputs from AI tools.
* Experiment with Agentic AI concepts where applicable (e.g., automating repetitive coding/testing tasks) under guidance from architects or technical leads where needed.

**Education**

* Bachelor’s degree in computer science or a related field.

**Experience**

* 6–10 years of professional software development experience, with significant exposure to full stack and cloud-native development.
* Experience contributing to at least 5–6 distinct projects or major product releases.

**Technical Skills**

**Core Back-end Skills**

* Strong proficiency in:
* Application development using ".NET Core", ".NET Framework", and "C#".
* "Python" (added advantage).
* Experience with:
* Microservices architecture and cloud-native service design.
* ORMs such as Dapper or similar.
* DAPR or similar distributed application runtimes (exposure/experience is a plus).

**Core Front-end Skills**

* Strong proficiency in "JavaScript" and "TypeScript".
* Expert-level experience in at least one modern front-end framework: "Angular" and/or "React".
* Solid understanding of "HTML5", "CSS3", responsive design, and modern layout techniques (Flexbox, Grid).
* Experience with:
* Component-based design and reusable UI patterns.
* State management (e.g., "NgRx", "Redux", or equivalent).
* Micro-frontends and modular front-end architecture (e.g., Module Federation).

**Integration, Tooling & Testing**

* Experience integrating with RESTful APIs and handling authentication/authorization on client and server.
* Familiarity with build tools and bundlers (e.g., Webpack, Vite, Angular CLI, Create React App).
* Experience with testing frameworks and tools, such as:
* Back-end: xUnit, NUnit, MSTest, pytest (or equivalents).
* Front-end: Jest, Karma, Jasmine, Cypress, Playwright (or equivalents).

**Cloud & DevOps (Cloud-Native, Azure Preferred)**

* Hands-on cloud-native development experience on Azure or similar cloud platforms.
* Experience with:
* Containerization and orchestration: Docker, Kubernetes.
* CI/CD pipelines for full stack build, test, and deployment.
* Azure services: App Service, API Management, Storage, identity and access management, monitoring, logging, and alerting.

**Security & OWASP**

* Good understanding of:
* System design, data model design, and API design concepts.
* Cloud-native design and secure-first design principles.
* Strong understanding and practical application of:
* OWASP Top 10 and secure coding practices for both front-end and back-end.
* Performance, accessibility, and usability on the client; reliability and robustness on the server.

**Additional / Complementary Skills (Added Advantage)**

* Experience with DICOM or healthcare-related applications.
* Familiarity with design systems, Storybook, or similar component documentation tools.
* Experience with microservices backends integrated with micro-frontends.
* Generative & Agentic AI:
* Familiarity with Generative AI tools for code generation and test suite creation.
* Exposure or experience in using Agentic AI framework concepts for development workflows.
* Experience working in both Linux and Windows development environments.

**Soft Skills**

* Strong problem-solving and analytical skills.
* Clear and effective communication and interpersonal skills to work within cross-functional teams.
* Ability to collaborate closely with architects and leads, and to provide guidance to junior developers.
* Detail-oriented with a strong focus on UI quality, user experience, performance, security, and maintainability across the stack.

**Preferred Qualifications**

**Certifications**

* Azure-related certifications (e.g., Azure Developer Associate, Azure Administrator Associate, or equivalent).
* Recognized certifications in "JavaScript"/"TypeScript", "Angular", or "React" ecosystems.

**Experience**

* Prior experience building complex, large-scale single-page applications and distributed, cloud-native back-end systems.
* Experience working in fast-paced, Agile environments on cloud-native and distributed systems.
* Demonstrated use of AI-assisted development tools in day-to-day full stack work.

Kulfi is where couples in India spend time together, even when they can't be in the same place.
  
  
About 100 million unmarried Indian couples don't get to be together most nights. Different cities, different homes, parents around. A phone is all they have. So they join a class just to be near each other, or stay on a one-way call, or watch a movie over video. They do all this for love, and nothing was built for them.
  
  
We are building that. Kulfi is a digital experiences app for couples, and close to a million people already use it. We did not get here by spending. Daily users grew 4x in 30 days this summer. We added 100,000 users in the first 20 days of August without paying for a single ad. 80% of all play happens between 9pm and midnight. That is bedtime, and we own it. We are backed by South Park Commons and by founders and CEOs from Swiggy, Mosaic Wellness, Snitch and Moonshot.
  
  
Next is an AI personalization engine for games. Every couple gets a new game every day, made for them on the spot from what they like. Our team already ships a new game in about two days. No couple should run out of things to do together.
  
  
India has more couples than any other country. We want every one of them on Kulfi.
  
  
We are a small, high-intensity team. Your work will reach real users quickly, and you will be expected to notice what is broken—not wait for someone else to notice it for you.
  
  
What you will do
  
  
**Dual Craft: App UI & Game UI/Art**

* App Surface Design: Design the core mobile experience in Figma—onboarding, couple-pairing flows, home navigation, profile identities, and ambient night-time chat interfaces.
* Game UI & In-Game HUDs: Design specialized, tactile interfaces for 2-player micro-games—turn indicators, interactive boards, card layouts, answer reveals, countdown timers, and victory/loss screens.
* Visual Art & Thematic Assets: Produce bespoke visual assets, illustrations, avatars, thematic stickers, and expressive game props tailored to intimate couple rituals and 48-hour game drops.
* Micro-Interactions & "Game Feel": Combine visual art with motion, haptics, and particle/celebration effects (Lottie, Rive, or Figma motion) so interactions feel alive, physical, and emotionally rewarding.

**AI-Native Visual Production**

* Generative Art Engine: Produce production-grade game art, character sets, and backgrounds.
* Interactive Prototyping with AI: Use AI tools (Codex, Claude) to build functional, playable games end-to-end using our in-house SDK.

**Systems**

* Zero-Friction Dev Handoff: Provide clean exports, asset slices, tokenized specs, and explicit edge-case states (disconnections, partner inactive, asymmetric screen sizes).

What we are looking for
  
  

* Exceptional Taste & Visual Artistry
* Strong Core Fundamentals: Demonstrated mastery of composition, color theory, stylized 2D art, typography, and visual balance.
* Dual Fluent (App + Game): You understand that an app screen demands clarity and low cognitive load, while a game screen demands immersion, tactile feedback, and delight.
* Emotionally Resonant Style: Intuition for novel, cozy, and playful aesthetics suitable for late-night mobile interactions.
* AI as a Visual Multiplier
* Not Just a Prompt Typist: You actively direct, iterate, and stylize raw AI outputs into finished, cohesive product artwork.
* Obsessive Tool Exploration: You continuously tinker with bleeding-edge visual AI models, plugins, and control nets to push what a 1-person design pod can output.
* Super Curiosity & High Agency
* Unprompted Output: A rich body of personal creative work—indie games, card game mockups, digital illustration series, custom sticker packs, or concept apps.
* Extreme Self-Direction: When an asset is missing or experience is lagging, you fix or report it yourself immediately rather than waiting for an external push or PM spec.

Bonus points (helpful, not required)
  
  

* Background in sketching or art as a hobby, project or profession.
* Basic understanding of mobile rendering constraints (vector optimization, texture atlas sizing, WebGL, or Canvas).

What success looks like
  
  
**Within 30 Days:**

* Audit Kulfi’s existing app surfaces and active games; map visual inconsistencies and fix them.
* Ship your first live game.

Interview process
  
  

* Portfolio Screen: Rigorous filter on visual taste, craft, 2D art skill, and UI structure (no generic templates).
* 15-Minute Intro Screen: Evaluates taste influences, creative appetite, and personal agency.
* 90-Minute Live Visual & Game Jam.
* 45-Minute Founder Chat: Deep dive on creative ambition, speed of iteration, and cultural alignment.
* Reference Checks

Calling anyone at Kulfi directly or contacting them on WhatsApp will result in immediate rejection of your application.

title: Sr. Content Designer
description:
**Our Mission:**
6sense's mission is to multiply what matters: growth, retention, and efficiency. We envision a future where companies, teams and people reach their full potential.
  
  
**Our People:**
People are the heart and soul of 6sense. We serve with passion and purpose. We live by our Being 6sense values of Win as One Team, Stay Curious, Do The Right Thing, Own the Outcome, and Create Belonging. Every 6sensor plays a part in deﬁning the future of our industry-leading technology. 6sense is a place where difference-makers roll up their sleeves, take risks, act with integrity, and measure success by the value we create for our customers. We want 6sense to be the best chapter of your career.
  
  
**About the Role :**
We're looking for a Sr. Content Designer to shape how people experience our product through words — across screens, flows, and increasingly, conversations with AI. You'll partner closely with Product, Design, Research, and our AI/ML teams to craft content that's clear, useful, and on-brand, whether it's a button label, an onboarding flow, or a multi-turn exchange with an AI assistant.
  
  
This role is for someone who thinks in systems, writes with precision, and is genuinely energized by the shift toward conversational and AI-generated interfaces — not just traditional UI copy.
  
  
**What You'll Do :**

* Own content design end-to-end for a product area: from early flow sketches through shipped, measured experiences.
* Design conversational flows for chat-based and voice interfaces, including multi-turn dialogue, disambiguation, error recovery, and graceful fallback when the AI doesn't know the answer.
* Write, test, and iterate on prompts and system instructions that shape AI-generated content surfaced to users — balancing tone, accuracy, brevity, and safety.
* Partner with ML/AI engineers to evaluate model outputs for voice, clarity, bias, and hallucination risk, and build feedback loops to improve them over time.
* Build and maintain content patterns, voice & tone guidelines, and a scalable content design system that covers both static UI and dynamic/AI-generated content.
* Collaborate with PMs, designers, and researchers from discovery through delivery; represent the user's need for clarity in every product decision.
* Use qualitative research and quantitative metrics (task success, drop-off, CSAT, containment rate for AI flows) to inform and defend content decisions.
* Review and elevate the work of other writers and designers; mentor junior content designers.
* Advocate for accessible, inclusive, plain-language content across the product.

**What We're Looking For :**

* 5+ years of experience in content design, UX writing, or a closely related field, with at least 1–2 years working on conversational or AI-driven surfaces.
* Conversational design experience — you've designed chatbot, voice assistant, or AI-agent flows and understand turn-taking, context handling, and failure states.
* Hands-on prompting / prompt engineering experience — you've written and refined prompts or system instructions for LLM-powered features, and you can talk concretely about how prompt structure affects tone, reliability, and safety of output.
* A portfolio that demonstrates strong craft in traditional UX writing and at least one project involving conversational or generative AI content.
* Comfort working directly with AI/ML teams — reading model outputs critically, giving structured feedback, and iterating quickly.
* Strong systems thinking: you can design a single string and a scalable pattern in the same day.
* Excellent editing skills and an ear for voice, tone, and plain language.
* Experience partnering cross-functionally in a fast-moving, ambiguous product environment.
* Familiarity with accessibility standards (WCAG) and inclusive writing practices.
* Experience with tools like Figma, Ditto (or a similar content design/collaboration platform), a content-ops/localization platform, and an LLM playground or console (e.g., Claude, ChatGPT, or similar).

**Nice to Have :**

* Experience building a conversational design system or an AI content style guide from scratch.
* Familiarity with agentic or RAG-based product patterns, multi-modal AI experiences, or evaluation frameworks for generative content.
* Background in linguistics, taxonomy, or information architecture.
* Prior experience shipping AI features at a B2B SaaS or Martech/AI company.

**Our Benefits:**
Full-time employees can take advantage of health coverage, paid parental leave, generous paid time-off and holidays, quarterly self-care days off, and stock options. We’ll make sure you have the equipment and support you need to work and connect with your teams, at home or in one of our oﬃces.
  
  
We have a growth mindset culture that is represented in all that we do, from onboarding through to numerous learning and development initiatives including access to our LinkedIn Learning platform. Employee well-being is also top of mind for us. We host quarterly wellness education sessions to encourage self care and personal growth. From wellness days to ERG-hosted events, we celebrate and energize all 6sense employees and their backgrounds.
  
  
**Equal Opportunity Employer:**
6sense is an Equal Employment Opportunity and Affirmative Action Employers. Qualified applicants will receive consideration for employment without regard to race, color, religion, sex, sexual orientation, gender perception or identity, national origin, age, marital status, protected veteran status, or disability status. If you require reasonable accommodation in completing this application, interviewing, completing any pre-employment testing, or otherwise participating in the employee selection process, please direct your inquiries to jobs@6sense.com.
  
  
*We are aware of recruiting impersonation attempts that are not affiliated with 6sense in any way. All email communications from 6sense will originate from the @6sense.com domain. We will not initially contact you via text message and will never request payments. If you are uncertain whether you have been contacted by an official 6sense employee, reach out to jobs@6sense.com*

description:

* Role focus: Own and continuously improve a modern company website across development, content infrastructure, performance, SEO, analytics, and AI-search discoverability.
* We are looking for a hands-on Web Developer to own the development, maintenance, and ongoing improvement of our company website and digital web experiences.
* This role combines
  **front-end development with content-management infrastructure, website performance, technical SEO, Generative Engine Optimization (GEO), analytics, integrations, and ongoing site optimization.**
* The ideal candidate is comfortable taking a website initiative from design or business requirements through development, testing, deployment, measurement, and maintenance.
* You will work closely with marketing, design, and other internal stakeholders to build new pages and experiences, improve existing functionality, maintain strong site performance, and make it easier for the organization to publish and manage web content efficiently.

**Responsibilities**

·       Develop, maintain, and enhance responsive, production-quality websites and landing pages.

·       Translate designs and prototypes into accurate, responsive web experiences.

·       Build reusable components and scalable page structures that support ongoing website growth.

·       Manage and improve the website's content-management capabilities, including templates, reusable components, and structured content.

·       Implement website updates ranging from routine content changes to new pages, functionality, and integrations.

·       Optimize website performance, including page speed, Core Web Vitals, image performance, JavaScript loading, and overall user experience.

·       Implement technical and on-page SEO requirements, including title tags, meta descriptions, heading structures, canonical URLs, redirects, XML sitemaps, robots directives, image alt text, structured data/schema markup, and internal linking.

·       Support Generative Engine Optimization (GEO) by ensuring website content is accessible, indexable, machine-readable, and structured for both traditional search engines and AI-powered search and answer platforms.

·       Implement and maintain semantic HTML, structured data, metadata, canonical URLs, sitemaps, and other technical elements that help search engines and AI systems understand website content.

·       Work with marketing to structure product information, technical content, research, FAQs, proof points, and other authoritative content so it can be easily discovered, interpreted, and cited by search and AI platforms.

·       Monitor search-engine and AI crawler accessibility and troubleshoot technical issues that may prevent important content from being discovered, rendered, or indexed.

·       Ensure websites follow responsive-design, accessibility, semantic HTML, and cross-browser best practices.

·       Integrate forms, analytics, CRM, marketing automation, and other third-party services.

·       Implement and maintain website analytics, event tracking, tag management, conversion measurement, and AI-referral reporting.

·       Troubleshoot website issues and identify and resolve bugs, broken links, layout problems, integration failures, and performance issues.

·       Maintain website security, dependencies, and development best practices.

·       Test website changes across desktop and mobile devices before deployment.

·       Manage code using Git and follow established development, review, testing, and deployment processes.

·       Collaborate with marketing and design teams to continually improve site usability, content presentation, organic search performance, AI-search visibility, and conversion.

·       Recommend improvements to the website architecture, technology stack, development workflow, and content-management process.

·       Document website architecture, components, integrations, and publishing procedures so the site can be maintained effectively over time.

·       Stay current with evolving SEO, GEO, AI-search, structured-data, and web-discovery best practices and recommend appropriate improvements.

**Required Skills and Qualifications:**

·    
**2–5+ years**
of professional web-development experience, ideally including ownership of a corporate, marketing, or content-driven website.

·       Strong proficiency in
**HTML, CSS, and modern JavaScript/TypeScript.**

·       Experience with a modern front-end framework such as
**React, Next.js, Vue, or a comparable framework.**

·       Experience working with a CMS, including traditional or headless CMS platforms.

·       Ability to translate Figma or similar design files into responsive, production-ready web pages.

·       Strong understanding of responsive design and mobile-first development.

·       Working knowledge of technical SEO and how website architecture and development decisions affect organic search performance.

title: Associate Product Manager
description:
**Associate Product Manager/Product Manager**

**About Eloelo Group**

Eloelo Group is one of India’s fastest-growing consumer technology companies, building category-defining products at the intersection of content, technology, and culture. The Group’s flagship products, Story TV in micro-drama and Master in micro-learning, have together placed two Eloelo apps in India’s Top 10, reaching over 100 million Indians who consume short-form vertical content every day.

**About Master**

Master is India’s #1 micro-learning app. It scaled to
**5M+ users in 50 days**
and offers
**1,000+ bite-sized courses**
across AI, finance, English, and life skills, making learning as easy and addictive as scrolling short videos.

**Role Overview**

As an Associate Product Manager or Product Manager at Master, you will own one or more key product areas end-to-end, such as course discovery and recommendations, the lesson and learning experience, onboarding, gamification and habit loops, AI-powered learning features, or subscriptions and monetisation. You will work at the intersection of user research, data, design, content, and engineering to build a learning product that millions of Indians open every day. This is a high-ownership, high-impact role for someone who is user-obsessed, data-informed, and ready to execute.

**Key Responsibilities**

Product Strategy & Roadmap

* Define and own the product vision, strategy, and roadmap for your product area, in line with Master’s business goals.
* Find opportunities through user research, data analysis, competitor benchmarking, and stakeholder input.
* Prioritise features using structured frameworks (RICE, ICE, MoSCoW) to maximise impact.

Discovery & User Research

* Run qualitative and quantitative research to understand how learners discover, consume, and complete courses.
* Turn insights into clear problem statements and well-defined product requirements.
* Validate assumptions through A/B tests, user interviews, usability testing, and analytics.

Execution & Delivery

* Write crisp PRDs, user stories, and acceptance criteria for the engineering and design teams.
* Work with engineering leads to scope, plan, and ship features on time with high quality.
* Own sprint planning, backlog grooming, and release management for your pod.

Data, Metrics & Growth

* Define and track key metrics, such as DAU/MAU, D1/D7/D30 retention, lessons completed, course completion rate, streaks, and free-to-paid conversion, and own the dashboards for them.
* Use data to drive product decisions, find growth levers, and change course when needed.
* Build a culture of experimentation by designing, launching, and analysing A/B tests.

Learning Experience & AI

* Work with the content team to shape bite-sized course formats that keep learners engaged and help them finish.
* Build personalisation and AI-powered features, such as smart course recommendations, AI tutors, adaptive learning paths, and quizzes.
* Design habit-forming loops through streaks, rewards, reminders, and progress tracking.

Stakeholder & Cross-Functional Collaboration

* Work closely with Design, Engineering, Content, Marketing, and Business teams to deliver a cohesive product.
* Communicate product plans, progress, and results clearly to leadership and partner teams.
* Be the voice of the learner in every decision.

**What We’re Looking For**

**Must-Have Qualifications**

* 2–5 years of experience in product management or a related product role, preferably at a consumer internet, edtech, content, or subscription company.
* Strong analytical skills: comfortable with SQL and product analytics tools (Mixpanel, Amplitude, Firebase, CleverTap, or similar), and able to turn data into action.
* Experience writing PRDs and working in agile teams.
* Ability to manage multiple stakeholders and drive alignment across teams.
* Clear communication and storytelling skills.
* A strong ownership mindset and the ability to deliver in a fast-paced environment.

**Good-to-Have**

* Prior experience with video streaming platforms, OTT products, content recommendation systems, or creator economy tools.
* Exposure to personalisation, ML-driven features, or recommendation algorithms is a strong plus.
* Familiarity with monetisation models AVOD, SVOD, in-app purchases, or creator revenue sharing.
* Bachelor's degree in Engineering, Computer Science, or a related field; an MBA from a premier institution is a plus.
* Experience working in a high-growth startup environment.

**Traits That Will Make You Exceptional**

* You are deeply curious about what users want and even more curious about why.
* You treat data as a compass, not a crutch; you know when to trust the numbers and when to trust your instincts.
* You are a strong communicator who can inspire a team around a vision and also get into the weeds with engineers when needed.
* You move fast without breaking things; you know how to ship iteratively and learn quickly.
* You are passionate about storytelling, content, and the future of entertainment in India.

**What We Offer**

* An opportunity to shape the product experience of a rapidly growing digital entertainment platform.
* A collaborative, creative, and fast-moving work environment with passionate colleagues.
* Competitive compensation, performance-linked bonuses, and ESOPs.
* Direct access to leadership and a culture that values product thinking at every level.
* Significant career growth opportunities as Story TV scales its audience and product portfolio.

title: Sr. Content Designer
description:
**Our Mission:**
6sense's mission is to multiply what matters: growth, retention, and efficiency. We envision a future where companies, teams and people reach their full potential.
  
  
**Our People:**
People are the heart and soul of 6sense. We serve with passion and purpose. We live by our Being 6sense values of Win as One Team, Stay Curious, Do The Right Thing, Own the Outcome, and Create Belonging. Every 6sensor plays a part in deﬁning the future of our industry-leading technology. 6sense is a place where difference-makers roll up their sleeves, take risks, act with integrity, and measure success by the value we create for our customers. We want 6sense to be the best chapter of your career.
  
  
**About the Role :**
We're looking for a Sr. Content Designer to shape how people experience our product through words — across screens, flows, and increasingly, conversations with AI. You'll partner closely with Product, Design, Research, and our AI/ML teams to craft content that's clear, useful, and on-brand, whether it's a button label, an onboarding flow, or a multi-turn exchange with an AI assistant.
  
  
This role is for someone who thinks in systems, writes with precision, and is genuinely energized by the shift toward conversational and AI-generated interfaces — not just traditional UI copy.
  
  
**What You'll Do :**

* Own content design end-to-end for a product area: from early flow sketches through shipped, measured experiences.
* Design conversational flows for chat-based and voice interfaces, including multi-turn dialogue, disambiguation, error recovery, and graceful fallback when the AI doesn't know the answer.
* Write, test, and iterate on prompts and system instructions that shape AI-generated content surfaced to users — balancing tone, accuracy, brevity, and safety.
* Partner with ML/AI engineers to evaluate model outputs for voice, clarity, bias, and hallucination risk, and build feedback loops to improve them over time.
* Build and maintain content patterns, voice & tone guidelines, and a scalable content design system that covers both static UI and dynamic/AI-generated content.
* Collaborate with PMs, designers, and researchers from discovery through delivery; represent the user's need for clarity in every product decision.
* Use qualitative research and quantitative metrics (task success, drop-off, CSAT, containment rate for AI flows) to inform and defend content decisions.
* Review and elevate the work of other writers and designers; mentor junior content designers.
* Advocate for accessible, inclusive, plain-language content across the product.

**What We're Looking For :**

* 5+ years of experience in content design, UX writing, or a closely related field, with at least 1–2 years working on conversational or AI-driven surfaces.
* Conversational design experience — you've designed chatbot, voice assistant, or AI-agent flows and understand turn-taking, context handling, and failure states.
* Hands-on prompting / prompt engineering experience — you've written and refined prompts or system instructions for LLM-powered features, and you can talk concretely about how prompt structure affects tone, reliability, and safety of output.
* A portfolio that demonstrates strong craft in traditional UX writing and at least one project involving conversational or generative AI content.
* Comfort working directly with AI/ML teams — reading model outputs critically, giving structured feedback, and iterating quickly.
* Strong systems thinking: you can design a single string and a scalable pattern in the same day.
* Excellent editing skills and an ear for voice, tone, and plain language.
* Experience partnering cross-functionally in a fast-moving, ambiguous product environment.
* Familiarity with accessibility standards (WCAG) and inclusive writing practices.
* Experience with tools like Figma, Ditto (or a similar content design/collaboration platform), a content-ops/localization platform, and an LLM playground or console (e.g., Claude, ChatGPT, or similar).

**Nice to Have :**

* Experience building a conversational design system or an AI content style guide from scratch.
* Familiarity with agentic or RAG-based product patterns, multi-modal AI experiences, or evaluation frameworks for generative content.
* Background in linguistics, taxonomy, or information architecture.
* Prior experience shipping AI features at a B2B SaaS or Martech/AI company.

**Our Benefits:**
Full-time employees can take advantage of health coverage, paid parental leave, generous paid time-off and holidays, quarterly self-care days off, and stock options. We’ll make sure you have the equipment and support you need to work and connect with your teams, at home or in one of our oﬃces.
  
  
We have a growth mindset culture that is represented in all that we do, from onboarding through to numerous learning and development initiatives including access to our LinkedIn Learning platform. Employee well-being is also top of mind for us. We host quarterly wellness education sessions to encourage self care and personal growth. From wellness days to ERG-hosted events, we celebrate and energize all 6sense employees and their backgrounds.
  
  
**Equal Opportunity Employer:**
6sense is an Equal Employment Opportunity and Affirmative Action Employers. Qualified applicants will receive consideration for employment without regard to race, color, religion, sex, sexual orientation, gender perception or identity, national origin, age, marital status, protected veteran status, or disability status. If you require reasonable accommodation in completing this application, interviewing, completing any pre-employment testing, or otherwise participating in the employee selection process, please direct your inquiries to jobs@6sense.com.
  
  
*We are aware of recruiting impersonation attempts that are not affiliated with 6sense in any way. All email communications from 6sense will originate from the @6sense.com domain. We will not initially contact you via text message and will never request payments. If you are uncertain whether you have been contacted by an official 6sense employee, reach out to jobs@6sense.com*

title: Lead UX Designer
description:
We're hiring a
**(**
**freelancer)**

senior UX designer to own the end-to-end customer experience of a fast-scaling D2C product, working from our Gurgaon office.

**Role -**

Senior UX Designer (title flexible: Lead / Principal for the right person)

**Experience -**

7+ years in UX, including high-growth D2C or consumer internet

**Engagement -**

Contract

**About the role**

Our customers are growing faster than our experience can keep up with, and every friction point now costs us at scale. This role exists to fix that: to make buying, using and coming back to our product feel effortless.

You won't be handed pixel-pushing tickets. You'll decide what problems are worth solving, prove it with customers and data, and ship it with product and engineering in weeks, not quarters.

We're looking for someone who starts from the customer, not from a design trend or a competitor's screen, and who reasons from first principles when the playbook runs out.

**What you'll do**

* **Own the core journeys end to end:**

  discovery, product page, cart and checkout, post-purchase, reorder and support, across app and web.
* **Stay close to customers every week:**

  run interviews, watch session recordings, read reviews and support tickets, and bring what you learn back to the team.
* **Frame problems before solving them:**

  break fuzzy asks into the real customer problem, the underlying assumptions and the smallest test that settles them.
* **Design for business outcomes:**

  tie your work to conversion, AOV, repeat rate, NPS and support volume, and set up A/B tests with product and growth.
* **Ship fast, with craft:**

  move from sketch to high-fidelity prototype to production in tight loops, partnering closely with engineering on what actually goes live.
* **Build the foundations:**

  set up or evolve the design system, UX principles and research cadence so quality scales as the team grows.
* **Raise the bar:**

  mentor designers, run design critiques and help hire as the team grows.

**What we're looking for**

* **7+ years in UX/product design,**

  with a portfolio of shipped consumer products, not only concepts.
* **Hands-on experience in a high-growth D2C or consumer internet company,**

  ideally through a phase of rapid scale (for example, 3x+ growth in users or revenue).
* **Customer-first by instinct:**

  you can name the last five customers you spoke to and what changed because of it. You push back when a decision is made for internal convenience at the customer's expense.
* **First-principles thinking:**

  you question inherited assumptions, reason from what customers actually need and can explain why a design works, not just that it looks right.
* **Comfort with data:**

  you read funnels and cohorts, form hypotheses and design experiments, and know when qualitative insight should overrule a number.
* **End-to-end craft:**

  strong in research, interaction design, visual design and prototyping (Figma or similar).
* **Clear communicator:**

  you can make the case for a design to founders, engineers and marketers in plain language.
* **Bias for action:**

  you're energised by ambiguity and pace, and happy working in person with the team in Gurgaon.

**Nice to have**

* Experience designing for Indian consumers across tier 1, 2 and 3 cities, including vernacular, COD and low-bandwidth contexts.
* Background in subscription, replenishment or loyalty experiences.
* Experience building or leading a small design team.
* Working knowledge of front-end basics, motion or no-code prototyping tools.

* Optimize front-end performance, page load times, and cross-browser/cross-device compatibility.
* Conduct usability reviews and incorporate feedback from user testing into design and development iterations.
* Ensure all interfaces meet accessibility standards (WCAG/ADA compliance).
* Participate in code reviews, sprint planning, and Agile ceremonies.
* Troubleshoot and resolve UI-related defects across the AEM platform.
* Stay current with UI/UX trends, front-end frameworks, and AEM platform updates.

Qualifications:

B.E/B.Tech/M.Tech/MCA in Computers, IT or other related streams with 3-5 years of working experience with following skills:

  

* 3 - 5 years of experience in UI/UX development, front-end engineering, or a related role.

* Strong attention to detail and ability to bridge design intent with technical implementation.

**Soft Skills**

* Strong communication skills and ability to articulate design/technical decisions to both technical and non-technical stakeholders.
* Collaborative mindset with experience working in cross-functional, Agile teams.
* Problem-solving orientation with a keen eye for detail and design consistency.

* AEM certification (Adobe Certified Expert – AEM Developer).
