title: Product Analyst
description:
**Product Analyst**

**Experience:**
1-2yrs

**Location:**
Bengaluru
**(Onsite only)**

**About the Role**

We are looking for a curious, analytical, and highly communicative Product Analyst to join our Product team. This role goes well beyond dashboards and reporting—you will partner closely with Product Managers, Design, Engineering, Customer Success, and customers themselves to help shape what we build and why.

You will combine data-driven thinking with deep product understanding, transforming customer problems, market insights, and competitive intelligence into well-defined product requirements. From discovery through release and adoption, you will play a key role in ensuring we deliver solutions that create measurable value.

**Key Responsibilities**

**Product Discovery & Research**

* Conduct deep research into customer workflows, industry trends, emerging technologies, and market opportunities.
* Perform competitor analysis to understand positioning, identify feature gaps, and recommend strategic improvements.
* Gather and synthesize feedback from customers, internal stakeholders, and support teams into actionable product insights.
* Translate ambiguous business problems into structured hypotheses and product recommendations.

**Product Requirements & Documentation**

* Draft high-quality Product Requirement Documents (PRDs), user stories, acceptance criteria, and supporting documentation.
* Use AI-assisted research and documentation tools (including Claude Skills or similar workflows) to accelerate research, requirement gathering, and documentation while maintaining high quality and accuracy.
* Ensure product specifications are complete, testable, and clearly understood by engineering and design teams.
* Maintain documentation throughout the product lifecycle as requirements evolve.

**Product Validation & Quality**

* Participate in feature reviews, QA demonstrations, and pre-release validations to verify that delivered functionality aligns with product intent and customer expectations.
* Provide product sign-off or recommend changes before features are released.
* Collaborate with QA and Engineering to identify functional gaps, usability issues, and edge cases early in the development process.

**Customer & Stakeholder Engagement**

* Participate in customer meetings, discovery sessions, implementation discussions, and feedback calls.
* Clearly communicate product capabilities, limitations, and roadmap decisions to both technical and non-technical audiences.
* Support customer-facing teams by helping explain new functionality and gather structured feedback for future improvements.
* Deliver product demonstrations and contribute to customer training sessions when required.

**Product Analytics**

* Define and monitor product KPIs, adoption metrics, engagement trends, and feature success measures.
* Analyze user behavior, funnels, retention, and usage patterns to inform product decisions.
* Build evidence-based recommendations using quantitative and qualitative data rather than intuition alone.
* Evaluate product experiments and recommend next steps based on measurable outcomes.

**What We're Looking For**

* Strong analytical and structured problem-solving skills.
* Excellent written and verbal communication skills, with the ability to explain complex concepts clearly.
* Experience writing PRDs, user stories, functional specifications, or similar product documentation.
* Ability to conduct independent research and convert findings into practical product recommendations.
* Comfort working directly with customers and presenting ideas to cross-functional teams.
* Experience participating in feature validation or QA reviews with a product mindset.
* Ability to balance customer needs, business priorities, and technical constraints when making recommendations.
* High attention to detail and a strong sense of ownership.

**Nice to Have**

While not required, we would especially value candidates who have worked on digital transformation initiatives within construction, engineering, infrastructure, or field operations organizations. Experience in these environments can provide useful context for understanding operational workflows and user needs, but we welcome applicants from all industries with strong product and analytical capabilities.

**Success in This Role**

**A successful Product Analyst will:**

* Produce clear, thoughtful, and implementation-ready PRDs.
* Surface meaningful insights through research and competitive analysis.
* Help ensure features meet both business goals and customer expectations before release.
* Confidently represent the Product team in customer conversations and training sessions.
* Act as a trusted partner to Product Management by combining analytical rigor with strong communication and sound product judgment.

title: IND-Senior Analyst_Digital Business Enablement
description:
**Innovate in Bengaluru**
This position is based at our on-site office in Bengaluru. Lowe's offers an ultramodern work environment, complete with cutting-edge technology, collaborative workspaces, an on-site gym and clinic, and other perks to enhance your work experience.
  
  
**About Lowe's**
Lowe’s is a FORTUNE® 100 home improvement company serving approximately 16 million customer transactions a week in the United States. With total fiscal year 2024 sales of more than $83 billion, Lowe’s operates over 1,700 home improvement stores and employs approximately 300,000 associates. Based in Mooresville, N.C., Lowe’s supports the communities it serves through programs focused on creating safe, affordable housing, improving community spaces, helping to develop the next generation of skilled trade experts and providing disaster relief to communities in need. For more information, visit Lowes.com.
  
  
Lowe’s India, the Global Capability Center of Lowe’s Companies Inc., is a hub for driving our technology, business, analytics, and shared services strategy. Based in Bengaluru with over 4,500 associates, it powers innovations across omnichannel retail, AI/ML, enterprise architecture, supply chain, and customer experience. From supporting and launching homegrown solutions to fostering innovation through its Catalyze platform, Lowe’s India plays a pivotal role in transforming home improvement retail while upholding strong commitment to social impact and sustainability. For more information, visit Lowes India
  
  
**About Team**
The Senior Analyst will manage category performance and key site-experience metrics, ensuring alignment with Lowe’s Pro Supply strategic priorities and financial objectives. They will actively identify, evaluate and advocate for enhancements that reduce friction and create a more efficient, seamless customer journey. By translating data-driven insights into clear recommendations, this role will help deliver a stronger digital experience for Lowe’s Pro Supply customers and accelerate digital growth.
  
  
As part of the DBE team, the Senior Analyst will play a key role in identifying and shaping opportunities to improve the digital shopping experience for LPS customers on Lowesprosupply.com. The role will focus on understanding the current digital journey, identifying friction and experience gaps and helping define improvements that enable a smoother path from product discovery through purchase, fulfillment and reorder.
  
  
**Roles &Responsibilities**
As a Senior Analyst, your work will support the development of a stronger LPS digital experience by combining customer, business and digital insights to identify high-impact opportunities and guide prioritization across teams.
  
  

* Analyze the LPS Customer Journey: Develop a strong understanding of how LPS customers navigate LowesProSupply.com across Search, product discovery, product evaluation, Cart, Checkout, fulfillment and reorder. Identify friction points, missing capabilities and opportunities to simplify the journey.
* Identify Digital Experience Opportunities: Assess the current experience at an item, category and journey level to identify gaps that may impact product discovery, purchase confidence, conversion or repeat purchase.
* Data Analysis and Reporting: Analyze digital and business performance data to identify trends, customer behavior patterns, and areas of opportunity. Translate findings into clear insights and recommendations for stakeholders.
* Performance Tracking: Monitor key digital metrics including revenue, conversion, average order value, digital penetration, engagement and journey performance to identify where deeper analysis or intervention may be needed.
* Drive Revenue and Conversion Opportunities: Identify opportunities to improve revenue, conversion, and average order value by addressing customer friction, improving existing journeys and identifying new digital capabilities or experience enhancements.
* Category-Level Digital Analysis: Evaluate priority categories and products to identify recurring experience gaps across Search, PLP, PDP, Cart and Checkout and recommend scalable opportunities that can improve the experience across a broader set of items.
* Competitor Analysis and Benchmarking: Assess relevant B2B, MRO and industry competitor experiences to identify best practices and capabilities that may be relevant for LPS customers.
* Cross-Functional Collaboration: Partner with teams across Merchandising, Product, Technology, Marketing, SEO, Pricing, Inventory, Supply Chain and other LPS business functions to share insights, prioritize opportunities and support execution of digital experience improvements

Years of Experience
  
  
4+ years of relevant experience in E-commerce and Data Analysis
  
  
**Primary Skills (must Have)**

* End to end understanding of Ecommerce purchase funnel
* Web Analytics
* Google Analytics
* Advanced Excel
* SQL
* Power BI, Tableau
* Strong e-commerce knowledge

title: Associate Manager, Product Planning and Adoption, EIP
description:
**Place of Posting -**
Bengaluru
  
  
**Team :**
Economic Inclusion Program
  
  
**About The/Nudge**
**The/Nudge**
is an action institute building resilient livelihoods to alleviate poverty. We work with women, farmers, tribals, and youth across rural development, agriculture, skilling, and economic inclusion, in partnership with 15+ central and state governments.
  
  
Our economic inclusion journey towards serving 25 million Indians spans 10 states and currently reaches over 1.5 million people. Through our incubator, accelerator, and grand challenges, we have supported 200+ social entrepreneurs, including Forbes 30 Under 30 honorees, Earthshot Prize winners, and nationally recognized changemakers.
  
  
Founded with the support of 130+ eminent philanthropists, 40+ corporates, and 15+ foundations, The/Nudge is working towards a poverty-free India, within our lifetime.
  
  
**What are we solving for?**
We are solving for households in poverty who are also financially and socially vulnerable through a targeted, multi-faceted, and sequenced model called the graduation approach, which has demonstrated that we can durably pull households out of poverty.
  
  
At The/Nudge Institute, We Have Been Piloting This Program For The Past 3 Years And Are Now Scaling It Across Multiple States. Our Purpose Is To Enable The Most Excluded Individuals To Become Contributing Members Of The Economy. We Will
  
  

* Enable government to adopt by providing research, design, and implementation support
* Continue to iterate on the program design to create impact at scale through our own implementations
* Support more NGOs in adopting graduation approach by offering technical expertise and capacity building
* Build evidence on graduation approach to nudge governments to adopt at-scale
* Develop technology solutions that enable NGOs and governments to adopt and implement the program at scale & with quality

**Position Overview**
**What are some of the principles/ approaches we use?**

* First principles thinking
* Human centered design (thoughtful, action oriented, experimental & iterative process) with a gender lens (unbiased and reflective approach)
* Systems thinking (analytical, stakeholder oriented and holistic)
* Strategic planning (result oriented, logical & coherent with clearly defined outcomes, grounded in current realities)

**What will you do?**
We are hiring an Associate Manager, Product Planning Feedback and Adoption to independently own planning, adoption and feedback workstreams across multiple state programs. The person will translate program priorities into measurable plans, ensure that product interventions and tools are used effectively, and build feedback loops that turn field experience into product and operating improvements.
  
  
This role combines hands-on program management with analytical and strategic ownership. The Associate Manager will work closely with State Operations, Product, Technology, Insights, Livelihood, Learning and Development, and program leadership. The role requires the ability to facilitate decisions, identify risks early and drive actions to closure with limited supervision.
  
  
**Key Responsibilities**

* Planning and program visibility

+ Strengthen governance. Design weekly, fortnightly and monthly review rhythms that result in clear decisions, owners and next steps.
+ Strengthen collaboration between State Operation teams and Central Product teams through a regular cadence.

* Adoption and data driven action

+ Own adoption across states. Lead the adoption of product interventions and tools from rollout through sustained and meaningful use.
+ Define meaningful metrics. Establish metric definitions, data sources, reporting frequency and data quality checks.
+ Interpret performance. Analyse trackers and dashboards, segment gaps by state, block, cohort or tool, and distinguish process, product and data issues.
+ Convert insights into action. Develop state-specific recommendations, align owners and timelines, and monitor whether interventions improve adoption.

* Feedback systems and product improvement

+ Design end to end feedback cycles. Define the milestone, respondents, sampling approach, questions, scoring logic and success measures.
+ Ensure reliable data collection. Coordinate with state teams, monitor response quality and resolve collection gaps without compromising timelines.
+ Synthesize field evidence. Combine quantitative and qualitative inputs into clear product and process recommendations prioritised by impact, urgency and feasibility.
+ Close the feedback loop. Track accepted actions with owners and timelines, communicate decisions to stakeholders and verify closure.

* Stakeholder leadership and communication

+ Anchor cross-functional forums. Set the agenda, prepare concise pre-reads, facilitate the discussion and keep reviews focused on decisions and actions.
+ Influence without authority. Build alignment across State Operations, Product, Technology, Insights and domain teams, and escalate dependencies with context and options.
+ Create leadership visibility. Prepare scorecards, reviews and written updates that explain progress, risks, underlying causes and specific asks.
+ Raise execution standards. Guide team members and partners on data discipline, meeting preparation, documentation and follow-through.

**What Success Looks Like**
Success in this role means that program plans and adoption metrics are trusted and used in reviews; risks are surfaced early with clear recovery plans; state and product teams receive recommendations that improve adoption; and field feedback leads to prioritised, tracked and communicated product or process improvements.
  
  
**Who are we looking for in this role?**

* Experience and education

+ Relevant experience. 6+ years in program management, product operations, strategy and operations, implementation consulting or large-scale operations.
+ Independent ownership. Demonstrated experience leading cross-functional, multi-location or multi-state workstreams from planning through closure.
+ Education. A postgraduate degree or MBA is preferred. Candidates with a bachelor's degree and strong relevant experience will also be considered.

* Core capabilities:

+ Analytical fluency. Can define and interpret metrics, question data quality, identify patterns and translate analysis into practical recommendations.
+ Structured problem solving. Can break down ambiguous problems, identify root causes, evaluate options and make sound recommendations.
+ Stakeholder management. Can build credibility, navigate differing priorities and influence senior and cross-functional stakeholders without formal authority.
+ Executive communication. Can facilitate effective meetings and communicate complex information clearly in written and verbal formats.
+ Execution discipline. Is organized, detail-oriented and proactive about follow-ups, risks and escalation while managing multiple priorities.
+ Tools. Is proficient in Excel or Google Sheets and comfortable working with dashboards and presentation tools.
+ Language and travel. Has strong written and spoken English and Hindi, and is willing to travel to and stay in rural program locations when required.

* Good to have:

+ Sector experience. Exposure to livelihoods, social impact programs, government systems or large-scale field implementation.
+ Product adoption. Experience driving adoption of digital tools or process interventions across distributed teams.
+ Research and feedback. Experience with survey design, qualitative research, feedback synthesis or user research.

*We aspire to be an inclusive and diverse organization and encourage qualified individuals irrespective of their religion, caste, gender identity or expression, sexual orientation, ethnicity, age, or any other dimension of identity, to apply.*

title: Technical Implementation Consultant
description:
**Strength in Trust**
OneTrust’s mission is to enable innovation through the responsible use of data and AI. We believe that ensuring data is trusted shouldn’t slow teams down—it should accelerate what’s possible. This led us to develop the first technology platform for responsible data use in 2016. Today, with AI representing the latest and most impactful expansion of data yet, OneTrust is once again redefining what responsible innovation looks like. OneTrust, the AI‑Ready Governance Platform™, unifies regulatory intelligence, automation, and connected governance workflows so businesses can continue to move at the speed of AI while ensuring good governance to prevent data misuse at scale. Trusted by thousands of organizations worldwide, OneTrust is shaping the future where trusted data becomes a transformative force for business and society.
  
  
**The Challenge**
Due to rapid growth and an increased demand for our platform, OneTrust is seeking a Technical Implementation Consultant. The Technical Implementation Consultant role is one of the key pieces of the OneTrust architecture. After the sales process, consultants are the key contact in driving and building the relationship, implementing the solution, and managing the expectations of the customer. Technical Implementation consultants work across the technical modules. As a Technical Implementation Consultant, you will be responsible for the customer relationship and will work directly with our customers to . The role is one of the most important as it is the bridge between OneTrust and the customer, helping the business grow by identifying product enhancements and relaying them between the customer and OneTrust Product teams.
  
  
**Our Team**
The Content Customization team is unique team with incredible talent. This team combines a fine-tuned project management discipline alongside superb technical acumen sprinkled with stunning design chops. Not only that, but we build on top of 2 world-class, customer-friendly CMS and LMS platforms. Furthermore, we operate like a boutique agency inside the OneTrust Ethics Professional Services Team.
  
  
**Your Mission**

Oversee the technical implementation and platform adoption for customer projects from start to finish.
  
  
Provide creative insight and execution for customers while implementing web-based portals and pages based on customer assets and brand guidelines on our CMS tool.
  
  
Provide creative insight and execution for customers while implementing branding and creating custom courses with customer assets and brand guidelines on our learning authoring tool.

Complete internal and project documentation.

Document processes and workflows in shareable documents for future use and adoption.
  
  
Document project progress in our CRM tool (Salesforce)
  
  
Be an advocate for our customers by representing their issues to Product Management and Software Engineering with a focus on steering the OneTrust roadmap.
  
  
Monitor and analyse the customer’s adoption of our solution features and functionality to provide leadership with an understanding of their overall business needs as they relate to our products.
  
  
Provide strategic and tactical support for Sales, Professional Services, and Business Development
  
  
You will also act as system and regulatory best practice expert, drawing from a plethora of consulting experience to advise customers on optimization of privacy & ethics program(s). Act as the customer advocate. Seamlessly transition ownership and action plan back to involved teams. Show ownership of issues, engage customers, establish urgent priorities, and implement resolution plan. Able to resolve simple to moderate issues with minimal management intervention. Ability to interpret and deliver on custom SOW customer projects.
  
  
**Your Experience Includes**
BA/BS OR MS in Computer Science, Web Design/Development [Bootcamp friendly], Engineering Management or Information Technology/Systems
  
  
2 – 5 years of relevant experience in software development, professional services, solution engineering, design, technical consulting; with expertise in architecting, supporting and/or rolling out new technology and solution initiatives.
  
  
Experience working with front-end technologies and design frameworks.
  
  
Effective customer-facing relationship building skills. Proven success in and genuine enthusiasm for working directly with customer(s).
  
  
Proven ability to engage across corporate functions (Professional Services, Support and Product Management).
  
  
Previous end-to-end implementation experience, ideally on a SAAS platform/product or creative agency.
  
  
Excellent verbal and written communication skills, including the ability to chair meetings or host trainings.
  
  
An understanding of the following tech/tools: HTML, CSS, Figma (or any wireframing tool), Acquia (or any CMS), Gomo (or any learning authoring tool), Salesforce, Jira – a plus, SSO, Domain Management.
  
  
Ability to build relationships across stakeholders in marketing, product, sales, and engineering.
  
  
Proficiency in Microsoft suite of products.
  
  
**Extra Awesome**
Knowledge of HTTP, SSO, SCORM packages, domain management.
  
  
Knowledge of Learning Management Systems.
  
  
Functional experience in the field (Privacy, Ethics or GRC)
  
  
Industry Certifications (CIPP/E, CIPM, GRCP, CPA, CISA, LPEC, etc.)
  
  
Experience dealing with senior management (C-Level) across multiple customers.
  
  
Language skills (German, French, Spanish, or Italian)
  
  
Where we Work

**Benefits**

This includes comprehensive healthcare coverage, flexible PTO, equity RSUs, annual performance bonus opportunities, retirement account support, 14+ weeks of paid parental leave, career development opportunities, company-paid privacy certification exam fees, and much more. Specific benefits differ by country. For more information, talk to your recruiter or visit onetrust.com/careers.
  
  
Resources
  
  
Check out the following to learn more about OneTrust and its people:

Your Data

title: Senior Human Factors Engineer
description:
**Bring more to life.**
Are you ready to accelerate your potential and make a real difference within life sciences, diagnostics and biotechnology?
  
  
At Beckman Coulter Diagnostics, one of Danaher’s 15+ operating companies, our work saves lives—and we’re all united by a shared commitment to innovate for tangible impact.
  
  
You’ll thrive in a culture of belonging where you and your unique viewpoint matter. And by harnessing Danaher’s system of continuous improvement, you help turn ideas into impact – innovating at the speed of life.
  
  
As a global leader in clinical diagnostics, Beckman Coulter Diagnostics has challenged convention to elevate the diagnostic laboratory’s role in improving patient health for more than 90 years. Our diagnostic solutions are used in routine and complex clinical testing, and are used in hospitals, reference and research laboratories, and physician offices around the world. Every hour around the world, more than one million tests are run on Beckman Coulter Diagnostics systems, impacting 1.2 billion patients and more than three million clinicians per year. From uncovering the next clinical breakthrough, to rapid and reliable sample analysis, to more rigorous decision making—we are enabling clinicians to deliver the best possible care to their patients with improved efficiency, clinical confidence, adaptive collaboration, and accelerated intelligence.
  
  
Learn about the Danaher Business System which makes everything possible.
  
  
This position of Senior Human factors Engineer is for Beckman Coulter team located at Danaher India Development Center (IDC), Bangalore and will be an on-site role.
  
  
IDC is a research and development center with the vision of accelerating product roadmaps across various Danaher business segments. Started in 2014, the center now hosts 500+ associates, for multiple Danaher operating companies focusing on Diagnostics and Life Science. The operating companies includes Beckman Coulter, Radiometer, Leica Bio systems, HemoCue, Cepheid and more.
  
  
The IDC workforce comprises of various product engineering teams, working on development of software and hardware components of cutting-edge products for, Immunoassay, Chemistry, Hematology, Molecular diagnostics, Oncology, Neurosurgery and Water Quality. IDC has evolved as center of excellence for Cloud and data analytics, with significant contributions to the key informatics solutions. The teams consist of highly hardworking software & hardware engineers and development managers. The teams are supported by local Product managers, Quality & Regulatory and Intellectual property specialists.
  
  
As a Human Factors Engineer, you will play a vital role in elevating the user experience and ensuring patient safety for our cutting-edge diagnostic products. By actively planning and conducting human factors research – from critical usability studies to thorough user risk analyses – you'll uncover key insights. Your user-centric design recommendations will directly inform product enhancements, making our solutions more intuitive, safer, and ultimately, more effective for healthcare professionals and the patients they serve.
  
  
**In This Role, You Will Have The Opportunity To**

* Lead Human Factors Engineering (HFE) activities throughout the product development lifecycle, ensuring the safe and effective use of medical devices through application of usability engineering and risk management principles.
* Develop and execute HFE strategies, plans, and deliverables in compliance with FDA Human Factors Guidance, IEC 62366-1, ISO 14971, and internal design control processes.
* Plan, conduct, and report user research, formative evaluations, and summative usability validation studies to identify and mitigate use-related risks and support regulatory submissions.
* Author and maintain key HFE deliverables, including use specifications, task analyses, critical task assessments, use-related risk analyses, and usability engineering files.
* Partner with cross-functional teams to integrate human factors into design inputs, requirements, risk management activities, verification efforts, and product development decisions while providing technical leadership and mentorship.

**The Essential Requirements Of The Job Include**

* Bachelor's degree in Human Factors Engineering, Biomedical Engineering, Industrial Engineering, Ergonomics, Psychology, Cognitive Science, Systems Engineering, or a related technical discipline.
* 5+ years of Human Factors Engineering experience in a regulated industry, including medical device or combination product development.
* Demonstrated experience applying human factors engineering principles within a design controls environment and using risk management methodologies aligned with ISO 14971.
* Experience planning, conducting, and documenting formative and summative usability studies in accordance with FDA Human Factors Guidance and IEC 62366-1.
* Strong technical writing, communication, and collaboration skills, with the ability to work independently and influence cross-functional teams in a matrixed environment.

**It would be a plus if you also possess previous experience in:**

* Authoring human factors documentation supporting FDA, EU MDR, Health Canada, or other global regulatory submissions.
* Supporting the development of complex medical technologies, including infusion systems, diagnostics, patient monitoring systems, or Software as a Medical Device (SaMD).
* Applying systems engineering, FMEA, hazard analysis, fault analysis, or other risk assessment methodologies to identify and mitigate use-related risks.

Join our winning team today. Together, we’ll accelerate the real-life impact of tomorrow’s science and technology. We partner with customers across the globe to help them solve their most complex challenges, architecting solutions that bring the power of science to life. title: Product Analyst Intern
description:
**About Bureau**
Bureau is a unified risk decisioning platform for Compliance, Fraud, and Transaction risks. Our platform is a single decision-making engine, powered by a 1 billion+ identity knowledge graph. Over 150 Banks, fintechs, retailers, and digital platforms use Bureau to verify identities faster and stop fraud earlier globally.
  
  
Bureau has raised $50M+ from renowned Silicon Valley and global investors including Sorenson Capital and PayPal Ventures and is expanding rapidly from APAC to Americas, Europe, and beyond.
  
  
**Why Bureau?**
Bureau is building the infrastructure that makes digital identities and transactions safe and trustworthy for billions of people. The mission is big, the problems are complex, and the impact is real.
  
  
We hire people who want that level of responsibility. People who move fast, build systems from scratch, and care deeply about turning strategy into execution. If you want predictability or narrow scope, this won't be your place. If you want to shape how a scaling global company operates—keep reading.
  
  
**What You’ll Be Doing**

* Foundation & Data Quality: You will own the data sourcing engine for our OCR models. This includes sourcing new document types, ensuring decent volume for each type, and tagging data to create high-quality training sets.
* Performance Benchmarking: Systematically evaluate our 120+ API services against internal standards and external competitors. You will identify latency issues, success rate drops, and coverage gaps to ensure we stay best-in-class.
* Data-Driven Strategy: Analyze transaction data to uncover opportunities for product optimization. You will answer questions like: "Why did this verification fail?" and "How can we improve conversion rates for this specific segment?"
* Impact Reporting: Translate raw data into actionable insights. You will utilize SQL and data visualization to recommend specific upgrades to our tech stack to the Engineering and Product teams.

**What You’ll Bring**

* Education: Final year student or recent graduate in Engineering, Economics, Statistics, or a business-related field with a heavy analytical focus.
* Skills:
* Data Fluency: You are comfortable with SQL and handling large datasets. You can query data and find the story inside the numbers.
* Technical Aptitude: You don't need to be a software engineer, but you must be comfortable understanding how APIs work and how data flows through a system.
* Mindset: You are a go-getter. You don't wait for permission to fix a data error; you identify it, report it, and propose a solution.

**Our Culture**

* We hire self-motivated people and get out of their way
* We value performance, not hours worked
* Speed, ownership, and impact matter most

**Compensation**

* Competitive salary + potential equity
* Health benefits, flexible PTO, learning budget

1-2 years
  
  
**Compensation:**
the posted range is fixed pay; ESOPs come over and above.
  
  
**About Kulfi**
Kulfi is where couples in India spend time together, even when they can't be in the same place.
  
  
About 100 million unmarried Indian couples don't get to be together most nights. Different cities, different homes, parents around. A phone is all they have. So they join a class just to be near each other, or stay on a one-way call, or watch a movie over video. They do all this for love, and nothing was built for them.
  
  
We are building that. Kulfi is a digital experiences app for couples, and close to a million people already use it. We did not get here by spending. Daily users grew 4x in 30 days this summer. We added 100,000 users in the first 20 days of August without paying for a single ad. 80% of all play happens between 9pm and midnight. That is bedtime, and we own it. We are backed by South Park Commons and by founders and CEOs from Swiggy, Mosaic Wellness, Snitch and Moonshot.
  
  
Next is an AI personalization engine for games. Every couple gets a new game every day, made for them on the spot from what they like. Our team already ships a new game in about two days. No couple should run out of things to do together.
  
  
India has more couples than any other country. We want every one of them on Kulfi.
  
  
We are a small, high-intensity team. Your work will reach real users quickly, and you will be expected to notice what is broken—not wait for someone else to notice it for you.
  
  
What you will do
  
  
**Own Data**

* Instrument Event Schemas: Define, document, and audit user information (events, properties, user profiles) across all app updates, ensuring zero tracking issues.
* Own Primary Conversion Funnels: Build and monitor core tracking dashboards in Mixpanel and Metabase like user onboarding, couple-pairing completion, game lobby drop-offs, and push notification open rates.

**Product Thinking & Experimentation**

* Monitor Core Metrics: Track onboarding, activation, retention curves, etc. regularly and form hypotheses to achieve internal goals.
* Translate Data into Hypotheses: Move beyond pull requests for dashboards. Identify the exact step where users drop off and hand PMs actionable, pre-scoped hypotheses.
* Evaluate A/B Experiments: Run statistical significance, sample size, and guardrail metric analyses for live A/B tests across onboarding and retention loops.

**Complex SQL & Cohort Analytics**

* Write Production-Grade SQL: Query raw production databases directly using advanced SQL to answer non-standard product questions.
* Data Hygiene & Anomaly Detection: Run daily validation checks to flag telemetry drops, duplicate events, or logging mismatches between Android and iOS.

What we are looking for
  
  

* Technical Skills
* SQL Fluency: Writing optimized, multi-table queries, complex aggregations, and subqueries without relying on visual query builders.
* Mixpanel Mastery: Practical knowledge of Mixpanel’s core reports (Funnels, Retention Cohorts, Flows, Formulas, and Custom Events).
* Product Thinking
* First-Principles Behavioural Empathy: You understand that data points reflect emotional couple rituals. You ask why, not just what.
* Metric Tree Architecture: Ability to break a top-level goal (e.g., D7 retention) down into clear input and leading indicators.
* Super Curious & High Agency
* Proactive Investigation: When a metric dips, you dig into raw logs, device categories, and app versions before anyone asks.
* Extreme Ownership: You refuse to accept dirty data or untracked features; you confront engineering and product to fix broken telemetry immediately.

Bonus points (helpful, not required)
  
  

* Experience with Python or R for exploratory data analysis and statistical validation.
* Familiarity with logging and experimentation infrastructure (DataDog, PostHog, etc.).
* Prior work on consumer social, mobile gaming, or two-sided marketplace datasets.

What success looks like
  
  
**Within 30 Days:**

* Complete a full audit of Mixpanel event taxonomy; fix missing tracking properties; deliver a complete cohort baseline for nightly active couples.
* Lead statistical analysis for ongoing onboarding A/B tests.

**Within 90 Days:**

* Uncover a non-obvious retention driver that directly shapes the product roadmap.

Interview process
  
  

* Application Screen: Review of SQL competency, analytical projects, and data storytelling.
* 15-Minute Intro Screen: Evaluates product curiosity, structured reasoning, and technical baseline.
* 90-Minute Live SQL & Product Analytics Jam
* 45-Minute Founder Chat: Deep dive into analytical rigor, intellectual honesty, and high agency.
* Reference Checks

Calling anyone at Kulfi directly or contacting them on WhatsApp will result in immediate rejection of your application.

title: MRE Intern
description:
Sprinto is an
**Autonomous Trust Platform**
that centralizes trust requirements across
**security frameworks, vendors, and customers.**
Sprinto autonomously executes tasks needed to maintain trust across compliance, audits, risk management, vendor risk, privacy, and AI governance, enabling organizations to maintain a strong, reliable trust posture without draining operational bandwidth and resources on repetitive tasks.
  
  
Backed by top-tier investors such as Accel, Elevation, and Blume Ventures, we’ve
**raised**
**$31.8M**
in funding to fuel our mission. Trusted by over
**4,000 organizations across 75 countries**
, Sprinto helps organizations stay audit-ready, manage real-time risks, and scale fearlessly. With
**300+ native integrations**
and AI-driven automation, Sprinto supports
**200+ global security standards natively**
, including SOC 2, ISO 27001, GDPR, HIPAA, PCI-DSS, and more. Sprinto's extensible architecture enables organizations to build and support an infinite number of custom integrations and frameworks.
  
  
**Founded in 2020**
by second-time founders Girish Redekar and Raghuveer Kancherla, Sprinto powers compliance for organizations like Whatfix, Encora, Anaconda, Whatnot, Ultrahuman, WeWork, Everstage, AI Foundation, HackerRank, and many more.
  
  
**Life as a Sprinter -**
Nobody succeeds at Sprinto by staying in their lane.
  
  
We are organized around problems, not job titles. Sprinters take ownership beyond their role, solve hard problems, and care deeply about the impact they create. If something can be improved, fixed, or built, we don't wait for permission; we step in.
  
  
Being remote means we rely less on proximity and more on trust. We write things down, communicate openly, and move quickly because great teams aren't built by sitting together, they're built by pulling in the same direction.
  
  
We believe progress beats perfection, feedback is a gift, and doing the right thing matters, even when nobody is watching.
  
  
And while we move with urgency, we never move alone.
  
  
**The mission -**
Every good sales conversation at Sprinto starts long before anyone picks up the phone. It starts with knowing who to talk to, what's happening inside their company, and why compliance is suddenly on their roadmap.
  
  
That's the work you'll be doing. As a Market Research & Enrichment Intern, you'll dig into companies, industries, and markets to figure out which accounts fit Sprinto and which people inside them matter. Your research becomes the foundation our Sales and Marketing teams build campaigns on.
  
  
This isn't a "copy names into a sheet" internship. You'll learn how modern B2B companies decide who to sell to, and you'll get sharp at finding signal in messy, scattered, publicly available information.
  
  
If you like puzzles, get satisfaction from a clean and well organised dataset, and enjoy going down research rabbit holes, you'll enjoy this one.
  
  
**Where you'll leave your mark?**

* Run primary and secondary research to build a picture of companies, industries, markets, and customers
* Find and organise information from public sources into something the team can actually act on
* Identify relevant companies and contacts against clearly defined research criteria
* Collect, validate, and structure research data in spreadsheets and internal systems
* Keep our research databases accurate and current, and flag what's gone stale
* Analyse what you find and turn it into summaries, reports, and presentations
* Pull together market, account, and customer insights that feed Sales and Marketing initiatives
* Learn and apply the research methodologies, tools, and processes the team runs on
* Work closely with your manager and teammates on ongoing research projects

**The kind of builder we're looking for -**

* You're a fresher or currently pursuing a Bachelor's or Master's in Business Administration, Business Analytics, Economics, Marketing, or something adjacent
* You've already done at least 3 months as a Marketing Research Intern, so you know what real research work feels like
* You're good at finding things. Give you a half-formed question and you'll come back with sources, structure, and a point of view
* You're comfortable in Excel or Google Sheets and can keep a large dataset clean without being told twice
* You're detail-obsessed. A mismatched column or a duplicate row bothers you
* You think logically, write clearly, and can explain what your research means, not just what it says
* You pick up new tools quickly and don't wait for a manual
* You're curious enough to research an industry you've never heard of and come out understanding it
* You like working with data to answer questions, and you're interested in market research, sales, and B2B SaaS
* You adapt easily, stay open to feedback, and are comfortable in a fast-moving environment

**Inclusion & Diversity -**
At Sprinto, talent, curiosity, and ownership matter more than where you come from. We hire people for the problems they can solve, the impact they create, and the way they help others succeed—not their background, identity, or personal circumstances. We believe the best teams are built when people with different perspectives come together around a shared ambition to build something meaningful.
  
  
We're proud to be an equal opportunity employer and are committed to creating a fair, inclusive, and accessible hiring process for everyone.
  
  
We may use artificial intelligence (AI) tools to support parts of the hiring process, such as reviewing applications, analyzing resumes, or assessing responses and identifying potential inconsistencies or verification signals in application materials based on available information. These tools assist our recruitment team but do not replace human judgment. Final hiring decisions are ultimately made by humans. If you would like more information about how your data is processed, please contact us.

title: Senior Associate - Enterprise & Functional Strategy – Front Office Strategy – Service Strategy
description:

Join our Acceleration Center India and help shape the future of business for our diverse client portfolio across geographies and jurisdictions. You’ll work at the heart of global teams across Advisory, Assurance, Tax and Business Services—solving real client challenges through connected collaboration. * Analyzing market trends and competitive benchmarks
* Building client relationships and internal stakeholder trust
* Applying AI, automation, and analytics to service design
* Developing training materials, leadership communications, and adoption programs

title: Engineer
description:
Role Summary
  
  

* We are seeking a detail-oriented I18N and l10n QA Tester with extensive experience testing software across diverse physical hardware and mobile devices. In this role, you will be responsible for executing end-to-end functional, usability, and cross-device testing across iOS, Android, web browsers, and specialized hardware. You will collaborate closely with product managers and development teams to ensure seamless performance, UI consistency, and high quality across all supported platforms

Key Responsibility
  
  

* Device & Hardware Testing: Conduct rigorous testing across multiple physical devices (iOS, Android tablets/phones, desktops, and Smart Home and Health Devices) to verify functionality, responsiveness, and UI layouts.
* Test Execution & Coverage: Develop, update, and execute comprehensive test plans, functional test cases, and exploratory test scenarios for new features and bug fixes.
* Compatibility Testing: Test applications across varying system versions, screen resolutions and hardware specs to identify device-specific issues.
* Defect Management: Identify, reproduce, and document detailed bug reports using tracking tools (Jira, Azure DevOps, Buganizer), including logs, steps to reproduce, screenshots, and video recordings.
* Regression & Sanity Testing: Perform thorough regression cycles prior to production releases to ensure core functionality remains stable.
* Internationalization (i18n) Testing: Validate that application architecture supports multi-locale enablement without code modification (e.g., Unicode/UTF-8 support, string externalization, hardcoded string detection, bi- directional text like RTL, variable expansion, and locale-aware sorting/filtering).
* Localization (l10n) Testing: Verify translated UI elements across multiple languages for accuracy, context, and formatting compliance (e.g., date/time formats, currency symbols, address layouts, dynamic pluralization, and text truncation/wrap issues).
* Pseudo-Localization: Conduct pseudo-localization builds during early development cycles to catch hardcoded strings, layout clipping, and character rendering errors early in the SDLC.
* Linguistic & UI Quality Verification: Review UI for visual integrity across different screen sizes when localized strings expand or shrink; coordinate linguistic reviews with native-speaking linguists or translation agencies.
* TMS & Localization Tool

title: Product Manager II
description:
**About The Team**
Product Management in Meesho closely resembles our rocketship growth. Because we obsess over understanding customer behaviour, we’ve been able to carve out an e-commerce niche in Tier 2/3/4 towns in Bharat. Our business growth is testimony to a singular focus on how we think of ‘product’ for our unique customers - ones that have barely shopped online, but are now able to because of Meesho.
  
  
Fun fact: Nearly 7% of India’s households shop with us. 😉
  
  
We are driven by a ‘user-first’ mindset. We have a strong bias for action. Above all, our team is driven by impact, not features. We drive ‘problem discovery’ & delivery - not only obsess over “what to build”, but execute with rigour to create impact.
  
  
But there’s more – we love to have fun as much as we love to work hard. From movie buffs to sportspersons, we have a super cool team. So, if a game of badminton after a day of brainstorming at work sounds like something you would love to do, then join us!
  
  
**About The Role**
We are looking for a Product Manager 2 who is passionate about solving high-impact problems in a fast-paced start-up environment with a high degree of autonomy. This is inherently a cross-functional leadership role where you will work closely with teams such as software engineering, UX design, category management, marketing, operations, finance, etc. to bring a new product to life.
  
  
**What You Will Do**

* Market & Customer Understanding: Understand the e-commerce market and needs of customers/sellers deeply through landscape analysis, customer interviews, user research, competition analysis and other qualitative/quantitative techniques.
* Problem Identification & Prioritization: Adopt a structured approach to identify what problems need to be solved and break them down into smaller chunks. Prioritize what problems need to be solved now vs. later.
* Solution Discovery: Facilitate a process to come up with the best technology-led ideas to solve the prioritised problems. Harness the creativity of not just yourself but of other teams such as design, engineering., business, etc Be willing to experiment with multiple solution ideas and test them using MVPs, prototypes, etc.
* Product Delivery: Define detailed product requirements and work collaboratively with a cross-functional team (design, engg. business, analytics, etc.) to bring a product to life. Ensure high product quality through processes such as user acceptance testing, dogfooding, etc.
* Go-to-Market Planning: Create a go-to-market plan working with business/marketing stakeholders to maximize product adoption and success.
* Adoption & Metrics: Define product metrics for your area, and track them continuously. Identify usage patterns and come up with action plans to move metrics in the right direction.
* Roadmap Creation: Create a product roadmap for your area that has at least a 3-month forward-looking view of key customer/business problems to be solved.

**What You Will Need**

* Overall experience of 4+ yrs with at least 4+ yrs in product management in a tech-led company (consumer internet space is preferred)
* Exceptional problem-solving skills based on first principles of thinking
* Good understanding of technology, and comfort with product management processes such as A/B experimentation, writing product requirement documents, managing product backlogs, and creating roadmaps
* Good communication and stakeholder management skills to get work done across different functions and drive product development

title: Business Analyst (2-4 Years) - Corporate
description:
PhonePe Limited (Formerly PhonePe Private Limited) is a technology company that builds digital platforms for Payments, Digital Distribution Services and Financial Services. Headquartered in India, the PhonePe digital payments app was launched in 2016. As of April 2026, PhonePe has over 70 Crore life-till-date registered users and a digital payments acceptance network spread across over 5 Crore merchants. PhonePe’s products and services include Consumer Payments (including Digital Distribution Services), Merchant Payments, Lending and Insurance Distribution services, and New Platforms, which comprise Share.Market (stock broking and mutual funds distribution platform), and Indus Appstore (Android-based mobile app marketplace). Culture:
  
  
At PhonePe, we go the extra mile to make sure you can bring your best self to work, Everyday!. And that starts with creating the right environment for you. We empower people and trust them to do the right thing. Here, you own your work from start to finish, right from day one. PhonePe-rs solve complex problems and execute quickly; often building frameworks from scratch. If you’re excited by the idea of building platforms that touch millions, ideating with some of the best minds in the country and executing on your dreams with purpose and speed, join us!
  
  
**Job Description**
**What kind of person are we looking for?**
First-principle problem solvers who are passionate about working with data and uncovering the stories that the numbers hide. If you’re a curious mind and constantly questions the status-quo, then you’d fit right in with us.
  
  
**What would you get if you work with us?**
You’ll be closely working on problem statements and influencing decisions that impact 70 crore+ people in the country; if you’re not keeping track. You’ll get to interact with some of the smartest professionals that the country has to offer and get exposure to all facets of building a product at scale. You get complete ownership and responsibility of all analytics support for your area right from identifying the problem to presenting to the CEO, if need be.
  
  
**What would you get to do in this role?**

* Be an integral part of the pod strategy and will have to define the critical metrics. You’ll also monitor performance trends and influence any interventions, based on performance.
* Collaborate closely with the business, and product functions to understand the business problem and translate them into the right analytical problem statement.
* Own the entire insight generation phase and work on deep, thorough analysis to provide unbiased answers on the identified problem statement. These insights and decisions will be influenced based on your presentation of the evidence, backed by a data-driven hypothesis.
* Move past just being the “Data person” and contribute with individual thoughts on how to improve the critical metrics for the pod. We love people who think of themselves as the business owner and then go back to the data to prove or disprove the thought.
* Act as the analytics and visualization SME for the team and ensure that the dashboards are designed and built in a way that makes it easy for the pod to consume the data they need.
* Mentor other analysts in the team; play an active role in hiring process & new team members’ onboarding process.

**Qualifications**
**What do you need to have to apply for this position?**

* Minimum 2 years of overall analytics experience, including 1 year of experience in the lending domain.
* Strong problem solving & analytical skills.
* Penchant for business & curiosity to understand how the product works.
* Ability to write complex queries on SQL to manipulate, consolidate multiple data sources for the purpose of dashboarding and analysis.
* Intuition for data and ability to handle big data sources.
* Strong working knowledge in Excel and visualization tools like PowerBI, Tableau, QlikView.
* Understanding of data-analysis languages such as R, Python and in core statistical concepts is expected; Experience in building ML models is good-to-have, but not mandatory.
* Ability to clearly explain thoughts and ideas either verbally or in the written form.
* Candidates who are able to explain the story behind their analysis will find themselves at an advantage

**Additional Information**
PhonePe Full Time Employee Benefits (Not applicable for Intern or Contract Roles)
  
  
Insurance Benefits - Medical Insurance, Critical Illness Insurance, Accidental Insurance, Life Insurance Wellness Program - Employee Assistance Program, Onsite Medical Center, Emergency Support System Parental Support - Maternity Benefit, Paternity Benefit Program, Adoption Assistance Program, Day-care Support Program Mobility Benefits - Relocation benefits, Transfer Support Policy, Travel Policy Retirement Benefits - Employee PF Contribution, Flexible PF Contribution, Gratuity, NPS, Leave Encashment Other Benefits - Higher Education Assistance, Car Lease, Salary Advance Policy
  
  
Our inclusive culture promotes individual expression, creativity, innovation, and achievement and in turn helps us better understand and serve our customers. We see ourselves as a place for intellectual curiosity, ideas and debates, where diverse perspectives lead to deeper understanding and better quality results. PhonePe is an equal opportunity employer and is committed to treating all its employees and job applicants equally; regardless of gender, sexual preference, religion, race, color or disability. If you have a disability or special need that requires assistance or reasonable accommodation, during the application and hiring process, including support for the interview or onboarding process, please fill out this form.
  
  
Read more about PhonePe on our blog.
  
  
Life at PhonePe
  
  
PhonePe in the news

First-principle problem solvers who are passionate about working with data and uncovering the stories that the numbers hide. If you’re a curious mind and constantly questions the status-quo, then you’d fit right in with us.

* onboarding process

* Strong problem solving & analytical skills.

Our team works backwards from customers by understanding their needs to design and implement solutions that deliver an immersive reading experience across a wide variety of devices, genres, and formats.

title: UX Research Manager, Customer Engagement, Google Ads
description:
**Minimum qualifications:**

* Bachelor’s degree or equivalent practical experience.
* 8 years of experience in an applied research setting, or similar.
* 3 years of experience leading design projects and managing people or teams.

**Preferred qualifications:**

* Master's degree or PhD in Human-Computer Interaction, Cognitive Science, Statistics, Psychology, Anthropology, or a related field.
* 7 years of experience working with executive leadership (e.g., Director level and above).
* 5 years of experience managing projects, and working in a large, matrixed organization.
* Experience establishing research road maps and influencing technical product strategy in a distributed, global organization.
* Experience evaluating Generative AI, conversational interfaces, or machine learning-driven workflows.

**About The Job**
At Google, we "Focus on the user and all else will follow." As a UX Research Manager, you will help define and drive the future of Google design by clarifying strategy and conceptualizing UX ecosystems. You are an expert researcher, a visionary leader, and a fierce advocate for both users and your team.
  
  
You will be responsible for guiding the careers of your team members, helping them realize their full potential, and inspiring forward-thinking design. You are an expert in qualitative research methods—such as field studies, interviews, and diary studies—to shape product development and influence overall strategy. In this role, you will understand both the execution and business aspects of our products, collaborating with leaders across UX, Engineering, and Product Management to create innovative experiences, leveraging your passion for brand, craft, and design quality.
  
  
Cases Platform powers high-touch customer support resolution for Google representatives and agents globally across Google Ads, YouTube, Play, and Cloud. As our ecosystem transitions toward intelligent agent workflows, the Support Platform UX team is redefining how human agents and AI systems collaborate to resolve complex customer issues.
  
  
As the UX Research Manager for Cases Platform in Hyderabad, you will lead a dedicated team of UX researchers driving the insights behind this transformation. You will establish a user-centered direection for pivotal AI initiatives, partner with cross-functional leadership across global sites, and ensure our products demonstrably reduce workflow complexity and cognitive load.
  
  
Google Ads is at the forefront of AI innovation, applying cutting-edge machine learning and Generative AI models like Gemini to power a multi-billion dollar global business.
  
  
Our work directly impacts billions of users by protecting users from harm, improving ad quality, and optimizing campaigns for advertiser return-on-investment. We foster a culture of deep collaboration, partnering closely with teams like Google Research and DeepMind to solve complex challenges. Join us to work on state-of-the-art AI, take on problems at an unparalleled scale, and build the next generation of advertising technology.
  
  
**Responsibilities**

* Manage, mentor, and foster the professional growth of a multi-disciplinary team of UX researchers.
* Define and drive the multi-year user research roadmap for Cases Platform, aligning studies directly with product and engineering planning cycles.
* Partner with Product Management, Engineering, and UX Design leadership to shape the strategic direction of AI-assisted support workflows.
* Oversee end-to-end research programs combining exploratory user interviews, usability testing, survey metrics, and behavioral log analysis.
* Translate user behavioral findings into clear product requirements, usability frameworks, and executive share-outs to inform strategic decisions.

We are committed to equal employment opportunity regardless of race, color, ancestry, religion, sex, national origin, sexual orientation, age, citizenship, marital status, disability, gender identity or Veteran status. title: Product Research Analyst Intern
description:

Business Writing & Structured

ReportingFamiliarity with tools like Google Trends, Statista, Crunchbase, G2, or Notion is a plus

title: Data & Insights Analyst
description:
Data & Insights Analyst

**Role:**
Data & Insights Analyst

**Experience:**
3–4 years

**Function:**
AI & Data Intelligence

**﻿Location:**
Hyderabad

**Work Mode:**
Work From Office

**About Zenwork**

Zenwork is a market-leading, award-winning provider of digital tax compliance software serving ~20% of US SMBs, mid-market companies, and large enterprises, including 30,000+ CPA firms across the United States. As businesses rely more on independent contractors, vendors, and suppliers, Zenwork helps customers manage increasing federal and state tax reporting requirements through modern, automated compliance technology.

Zenwork’s Tax1099 software enables companies of all sizes to compliantly e-file 1099 tax forms and other critical tax documents, with ~90M+ tax forms e-filed to date. Headquartered in Fayetteville, Arkansas, Zenwork announced a
**$163 million minority investment from Spectrum Equity**
to accelerate product innovation and capture the growing opportunity in automated tax compliance and regulatory reporting.

Learn more: Zenwork

**The Role**

We are looking for a highly analytical, logical, and business-minded Data & Insights Analyst to join our AI team. The person must understand business workflows, customer behaviour, product usage, and stakeholder needs, then translate that context into meaningful insights and action.

The ideal candidate can independently structure ambiguous problems, write advanced analytical queries, build trusted dashboards, use Python for analysis and automation, and leverage AI tools to work faster and smarter.

**What You Will Do**

·  Develop a strong understanding of business processes, product workflows, customer journeys, and stakeholder objectives.

·  Translate business questions into analytical frameworks, metrics, and clear recommendations.

·  Write, optimise, and validate complex SQL queries across large and varied datasets.

·  Use Python to automate data preparation, validation, analysis, monitoring, and recurring reporting.

·  Identify trends, anomalies, risks, opportunities, and leading indicators that stakeholders should act on.

·  Define meaningful KPIs and distinguish decision-useful signals from noise.

·  Build intuitive dashboards that explain what happened, why it happened, and what users should do next.

·  Use AI tools to accelerate analysis, query development, research, documentation, and workflow automation.

·  Partner with Product, Engineering, AI, Operations, Growth, and leadership teams to support data-driven decisions.

**What You Bring**

·  3–4 years of experience in data analytics, business intelligence, product analytics, or a related role.

·  Strong SQL skills, including joins, CTEs, window functions, aggregations, query optimisation, and data validation.

·  Strong Python skills, including Pandas, NumPy, APIs, automation, and data transformation.

title: Manager, Product Design
description:
**Company Description**
It all started when engineer Fred Luddy wrote code that automated a tedious task for his coworker, Phyllis. She cried tears of joy. That moment inspired Fred to build a company that could do that for everyone—freeing people from busywork so they could focus on meaningful work. Today, ServiceNow is the AI control tower for business reinvention. Our ServiceNow AI platform brings together any AI, any data, and any workflow— helping 85% of the Fortune 500® work smarter, faster, and better. We're building an AI-native culture where technology and talent are unstoppable together. And we're just getting started.
  
  
Join us to put AI to work for people.
  
  
**Job Description**
**What you get to do in this role:**

* Directly manage, mentor and develop 3–5 designers
* Drive the UX vision and execution of a platform that produces a product line to revolutionize workplace productivity and analytics solutions for some of the largest companies in the world
* Collaborate cross-functionally with product management, user research, engineering and content from strategic definition, planning, architecture, through tactical execution of the product roadmaps

* Develop high level task flow content and then use storyboards and other design documents to communicate concepts and vision to others.
* Lead your team through rapid iterations of theoretical task scenarios, navigation map, flow, and state-transition diagrams to document design decisions.

* Oversee UI layouts including controls, labels and graphical elements for software on both mobile and desktop platforms with an eye towards experience unification.

* Work closely with product management in UX ideation and innovation.
* Travel up to 20% of the year

**Qualifications**

* Experience in leveraging or critically thinking about how to integrate AI into work processes, decision-making, or problem-solving. This may include using AI-powered tools, automating workflows, analyzing AI-driven insights, or exploring AI's potential impact on the function or industry.

* Ability to understand and distill complex problems into clean solutions
* Must have strong written and verbal English communication skills
* Must have excellent teamwork, communication, and technical problem-solving skills to contribute within a multi-functional and multi-disciplined team
* Obsessed with the relentless pursuit of UX perfection working inside an iterative and agile development environment
* Must be able to work with minimal supervision in a fluid, fast-paced and truly agile environment

title: Senior CX Insights Manager, APAC
description:
**About Crunchyroll**
Founded by fans, Crunchyroll delivers the art and culture of anime to a passionate community. We super-serve over 100 million anime and manga fans across 200+ countries and territories, and help them connect with the stories and characters they crave. Whether that experience is online or in-person, streaming video, theatrical, games, merchandise, events and more, it’s powered by the anime content we all love.
  
  
Join our team, and help us shape the future of anime!
  
  
**About The Role**
Crunchyroll is seeking a
**Senior Manager, CX Insights (APAC)**
to lead our Customer Experience (CX) Insights function across APAC. Reporting to the
**Director of CX Insights & Analytics**
, this leader will transform customer feedback, operational data, and market insights into actionable recommendations that improve the fan experience and influence business strategy.
  
  
This is a highly visible role that sits at the intersection of Customer Experience, Analytics, Product, Content, Marketing, Subscription, and Customer Support. You will be responsible for developing a comprehensive understanding of the APAC customer journey, identifying opportunities to improve satisfaction and loyalty, and championing the voice of the customer throughout the organization.
  
  
The ideal candidate combines strong analytical expertise, customer obsession, business acumen, and a deep understanding of the APAC market. They are equally comfortable diving into data, presenting executive-level insights, and leading high-performing teams.
  
  
**What You'll Do**
**Lead Customer Insights Strategy**

* Own the CX Insights strategy for the APAC region, ensuring alignment with Crunchyroll's global customer experience objectives.
* Build a holistic view of the customer journey by integrating feedback, behavioral, operational, and market data.
* Develop frameworks to measure customer sentiment, loyalty, satisfaction, effort, and retention drivers across the region.
* Identify emerging customer trends, pain points, and opportunities that influence strategic priorities.

**Drive Actionable Business Impact**

* Translate complex data into compelling narratives and recommendations that influence decision-making across Product, Marketing, Content, Subscription, Commerce, and Customer Support teams.
* Establish scalable mechanisms for surfacing customer insights to stakeholders and leadership.
* Partner with regional and global teams to prioritize initiatives that improve customer satisfaction and business outcomes.
* Quantify the impact of customer experience improvements and track progress against key performance indicators.

**Lead Voice of the Customer Programs**

* Own and evolve Voice of the Customer (VoC) programs across APAC.
* Design and optimize customer listening strategies, including surveys, feedback programs, support interactions, social insights, and community feedback.
* Ensure customer feedback is systematically captured, analyzed, and integrated into business planning.

**Build World-Class Analytics & Reporting**

* Develop executive-level dashboards, reporting frameworks, and performance reviews.
* Leverage advanced analytical techniques to identify drivers of customer behavior and sentiment.
* Partner closely with Analytics, Data Science, and Research teams to enhance measurement capabilities and predictive insights.
* Champion data quality, governance, and best practices for customer insights.

**Lead and Develop Talent**

* Build, mentor, and inspire a high-performing team of insights professionals.
* Foster a culture of curiosity, accountability, innovation, and customer obsession.
* Establish clear goals, development plans, and career growth opportunities for team members.

**What You'll Bring**
**Required Qualifications**

* 12+ years of experience in Customer Experience, Customer Insights, Consumer Research, Analytics, Business Intelligence, Strategy, or related fields.
* Including 3+ years of people leadership experience managing high-performing teams.
* Proven experience leading customer insights programs within a subscription, digital product, streaming, entertainment, technology, or consumer-focused business.
* AI and technology-forward mindset with experience evaluating and adopting innovative tools and methodologies to improve the speed, scale, and quality of customer insight generation.
* Strong analytical capabilities with experience working across large datasets and customer feedback ecosystems.
* Expertise in Voice of the Customer methodologies, customer satisfaction measurement, and customer journey analysis.
* Demonstrated ability to influence senior leaders and drive cross-functional alignment.
* Exceptional communication, storytelling, and executive presentation skills.
* Professional fluency in English.

**Preferred Qualifications**

* Experience working across multiple APAC markets.
* Familiarity with streaming, media, entertainment, gaming, or fan-driven consumer businesses.
* Experience with customer feedback platforms, survey tools, CRM systems, and modern BI solutions.
* Knowledge of advanced analytics, predictive modeling, experimentation, or customer segmentation methodologies.

**Success in Your First Year**
In your first year, you will:
  
  

* Establish yourself as the leading voice of the APAC customer within Crunchyroll.
* Build trusted partnerships with regional and global stakeholders.
* Elevate the maturity of our Voice of the Customer and CX measurement programs.
* Deliver insights that directly influence customer experience improvements and business performance.
* Develop a scalable framework for understanding and communicating the evolving needs of anime fans across Asia-Pacific.

Why you will love working at Crunchyroll
  
  
In addition to getting to work with fun, passionate and inspired colleagues, you will also enjoy the following benefits and perks:
  
  

* Best-in class medical, dental, and vision private insurance healthcare coverage
* Access to counseling & mental health sessions 24/7 through our Employee Assistance Program (EAP)
* Free premium access to Crunchyroll

title: Digital Insights Consultant
description:
**About i-Genie**

At i-Genie.ai, we believe the best insights don't just inform. They inspire.

We're an AI-powered consumer insights company. We help leading global brands and retailers, including Kenvue, Unilever and Coca-Cola, spot future trends and make better decisions, faster.

We do this by bringing together billions of data points from search, social media, reviews and market data. Clients get the answers through easy-to-use dashboards and Presto, our GenAI copilot, which spots trends, tracks brand health and benchmarks performance in real time.

**The role at a glance**

Role: Digital Insights Consultant (Social, Search & Reviews)

Location: Mumbai, hybrid

Type: Full-time

Experience: 5 to 6 years in social listening, search and reviews insights

Focus: Global FMCG client

Start: November 2026

**Why this role matters.**
Brands are drowning in digital signals but short on clear answers. You'll turn what people post, search for and write in reviews into insights that shape marketing, brand strategy, innovation and content.

You'll also help our client's teams get better at this themselves. You'll coach them on using social, search and reviews data well, so good insight becomes part of how they work every day.

**What you'll do**
