title: Content Lead - AI Engineering
description:
**Company Description**

byteXL is an edtech company focused on transforming engineering education in India by partnering with colleges and industry to modernize curriculum, content, and hands-on learning. The organization equips students with practical skills and clear awareness of employability requirements, enabling them to excel in evolving technology careers. By bridging the gap between academia and industry, byteXL aims to create a generation of highly skilled professionals who contribute meaningfully to national development. The company’s vision is that every engineering student has access to holistic, industry-relevant education that strengthens competencies and improves job prospects. Team members join a mission-driven environment that is deeply invested in student success and educational innovation.

**Role Summary**

As a Content Lead for AI Engineering, you'll own everything related to building applications with AI. That includes designing the curriculum, writing reading materials, building assessments, creating lab exercises, and developing projects around LLM application development, agentic workflows, RAG systems, and multi-modal AI.

This is a hands-on creation role. You'll spend most of your time building, testing, and improving content. You'll also be shipping AI applications and prototypes yourself regularly, because this space moves too fast for someone who's just reading about it. If you haven't built a RAG pipeline or debugged an agent loop yourself, you can't teach someone else to do it well.

If you're someone who's been building with LLMs since before it was cool, understands why agents fail more often than they work, and can turn a complex AI architecture into something a student can build step by step, this is your role.

**What You'll Do**

* Design semester-wise curriculum and decide how topics are structured, sequenced, and paced across the academic calendar.
* Continuously evolve the content strategy based on what's working, what's not, and where the AI engineering landscape is heading. This space changes fast and the content needs to keep up.
* Write clear, in-depth reading materials that students can actually learn from independently. Not hype-driven overviews, but grounded explanations of how things actually work under the hood.
* Design problems that test whether students understand the architecture and trade-offs behind AI applications, not just whether they can chain a few API calls together.
* Build question banks following ByteXL's quality standards for difficulty distribution, answer balance, and auto-gradability.
* Create hands-on lab exercises that take students from their first API call to building production-ready AI applications.
* Design capstone projects that push students to build complete AI applications integrating LLMs, vector stores, retrieval pipelines, and deployment.
* Build AI applications and prototypes yourself regularly to validate that what you're asking students to do is actually doable, meaningful, and teaches the right lessons.
* Stay current with how the AI engineering ecosystem is evolving.
* Try new ways of teaching and building content. If something could work better, prototype it and make the case.

**What We're Looking For**

**Must Have**

- B.Tech, M.Tech, MCA, or equivalent in Computer Science or a related field.

- 3–5 years of experience in AI/ML engineering, software development, or content development with a strong focus on applied AI.

- Expert-level Python proficiency.

- Hands-on experience building LLM-powered applications, not just experimenting in notebooks.

- Deep understanding of prompt engineering, RAG architectures, and vector databases.

- Experience building AI agents and agentic workflows. Understands why they break and how to make them reliable.

- Working knowledge of frameworks like LangChain, LlamaIndex, or similar.

- Experience integrating AI APIs from providers like OpenAI, Anthropic, and others.

- Understanding of multi-modal AI concepts spanning text, image, and audio.

- Awareness of responsible AI principles and AI safety considerations.

- Exposure to MLOps practices for AI application deployment and monitoring.

- Can explain how a retrieval pipeline works or why an agent keeps hallucinating clearly enough that someone building their first AI app actually gets it.

- Works independently without needing constant direction.

**Nice to Have**

- Working knowledge of TypeScript for frontend integration with AI backends.

- Experience with fine-tuning and model adaptation techniques.

- Has built and open-sourced AI tools or applications.

- Background in technical training, academic teaching, or developer education.

- Active presence in the AI engineering community through blogs, talks, or open-source work.

title: Technical Manager
description:
**Position Overview**

The Technical Manager will lead technical and engineering activities for Kaprel India, ensuring accurate and timely project technical submittals, compliance with project specifications, effective coordination with contractors and consultants, and practical technical support through procurement, production and installation. The role will oversee the technical team, support product development and standardization, and act as a central technical resource for projects across all Kaprel locations, including India, the UAE and Saudi Arabia.

**Responsibilities**

**1.Technical Submittals and Project Approvals**

·        Prepare, review and coordinate complete technical submittal packages for projects across all Kaprel locations, including India, the UAE and Saudi Arabia, in line with project-specific requirements and approval procedures.

·        Compile material submittals, compliance statements, technical data sheets, product specifications, test reports, certificates, method statements and supporting engineering documents as required.

·        Manage material and finish sample submissions, approval tracking, consultant comments, resubmissions and closure of technical queries.

·        Coordinate with main contractors, consultants, clients, project teams and Kaprel management to obtain approvals and finalize project-specific materials, system details and designs.

·        Maintain an up-to-date submittal register, document revision history and approvals record; proactively flag submission risks affecting procurement or site schedules.

**2.Technical Leadership and Engineering Management**

·        Lead and coordinate the technical and design team, assign work priorities, review deliverables and monitor workload, quality and submission deadlines.

·        Oversee the development and checking of shop drawings, fabrication drawings, installation details, material take-offs and bills of materials to support accurate procurement and manufacturing.

·        Conduct technical evaluations and design assessments for compliance with applicable standards, approved specifications, contractual scope and customer requirements.

·        Establish consistent engineering checklists, drawing review procedures, revision controls and handover requirements between departments.

·        Identify gaps or discrepancies in tender documents, drawings and specifications; raise technical clarifications and coordinate timely resolution before fabrication.

**3.Procurement, Production and Site Coordination**

·        Prepare and maintain procurement schedules and long-lead material requirements in coordination with project programmes and approved technical submittals.

·        Liaise with Procurement, Stores and Production teams to ensure the correct materials and specifications are available when required, and highlight risks early.

·        Provide technical support to manufacturing and installation teams, resolving design interfaces, fabrication constraints and site-specific technical problems.

·        Investigate installation and product performance issues, establish root causes and implement practical corrective measures to prevent recurrence.

·        Coordinate technical responses and support to customers and project teams on system specifications, installation details and product performance.

**4.Product Engineering, Quality and Improvement**

·        Drive value engineering initiatives to improve manufacturability, installation efficiency, product reliability and cost effectiveness without compromising approved performance.

·        Support new product and system development, component selection, prototyping, testing, certification and performance improvement initiatives.

·        Work with suppliers and internal stakeholders on suitable alternatives for aluminium profiles, glass, hardware, seals, gaskets and related components.

·        Maintain controlled records of technical specifications, approved system details, certificates, testing reports and product documentation for use across Kaprel locations.

·        Analyze recurring technical errors, nonconformities and rework costs; recommend design standardization and preventive improvements.

**5.Reporting and Accountability**

·        Provide regular updates to the General Manager on technical submission status, departmental workload, approval delays, unresolved technical risks and improvement initiatives.

·        Coordinate closely with regional Kaprel teams so requirements and approved technical documentation are consistent, while respecting differences in local project specifications and standards.

·        Escalate deviations involving unapproved system changes, project cost impact, contractual scope or technical performance before implementation.

**Qualifications and Experience**

·        Bachelor's degree in Engineering or a relevant technical discipline.

·        Minimum 6 years of relevant construction or subcontracting experience, preferably in the glazing, architectural aluminium, partition or door systems industry.

·        Prior experience managing technical work and coordinating with main contractors, consultants and clients.

·        Good knowledge of project specifications, technical documentation, material approvals and subcontract scope management.

·        Ability to interpret engineering drawings and coordinate fabrication, procurement and installation requirements; proficiency with AutoCAD and relevant technical tools is advantageous.

·        Strong communication, organization, problem-solving and team management skills; comfortable coordinating technical deliverables across multiple locations.

For those interested, pls send your CV to recruitment@kaprel.com with subject line: Application\_Technical Manager\_India

title: Teaching and Learning Coach
company: Keystone Center for Innovation & Teacher Education
description:
**About KCITE**

KCITE works with teachers and school leaders to improve teaching and learning through professional development, research and classroom practice. Our work includes teacher education, social-emotional learning, project-based learning, digital pedagogy and school leadership.

We create learning experiences that help educators understand new ideas, try them in their classrooms and reflect on what changes.

**About the role**

We are looking for an educator who can design and develop practical courses for teachers and school leaders. You will bring together classroom experience, educational research and clear writing to create content that educators can use in their everyday work.

The role includes course development, teacher support and reviewing how effectively the learning translates into classroom practice.

**Key responsibilities**

**Course design and development**

* Identify learning needs through conversations with teachers, school leaders and the KCITE team.
* Develop course outlines with clear learning outcomes and a logical sequence of modules.
* Write course content, video scripts, facilitator guides and participant resources.
* Create classroom examples, case studies, activities and practical tools relevant to different school contexts.
* Design assessments, reflection tasks and classroom implementation assignments that show what participants have learned.

**Research and content quality**

* Use credible educational research to inform course content.
* Explain concepts in simple language while preserving their meaning and accuracy.
* Review content for relevance, clarity and suitability for the intended audience.
* Update courses based on participant feedback, classroom evidence and developments in education.

**Teacher learning and coaching**

* Facilitate workshops, course discussions and teacher learning sessions as required.
* Support teachers as they apply course ideas in their classrooms.
* Review teachers’ reflections and evidence of implementation, and provide specific, constructive feedback.
* Help teachers identify what worked, what needs improvement and what they can try next.

**Collaboration**

* Work with subject experts and the research team to develop and review content.
* Coordinate with design and technology teams to prepare courses for the KCITE platform.
* Manage agreed timelines and take responsibility for completing assigned courses and resources.

**Qualifications and experience**

* A bachelor’s degree in education or a relevant field. A postgraduate qualification in education is preferred.
* Relevant school teaching experience and a sound understanding of how children learn.
* Experience in developing curriculum, learning resources or professional development content.
* Experience in teacher training, mentoring or coaching is an advantage.

**Skills and qualities**

* Clear writing and communication skills in English.
* Ability to turn educational concepts into useful classroom examples and activities.
* Understanding of pedagogy, assessment and reflective practice.
* Ability to evaluate sources and use research responsibly.
* Comfort with digital tools for content creation and online learning.
* Attention to detail, openness to feedback and the ability to work independently.



**What success looks like**

You create well-structured, accurate courses that teachers can follow and apply. The resources address real classroom needs, and your feedback helps educators improve their practice. You complete work on time and use evidence from participants to improve the courses.

**How to apply**

Please share your CV and a sample of a course, teaching resource, training module or learning material you have developed. Include a brief note explaining your contribution to the sample and your interest in this role. Email to careers@kcite.in

With the first SaaS-based composable automation platform specifically built for ERP, we believe in automation's transformative power. Our unparalleled solutions empower organizations to orchestrate, manage, and monitor their workflows across any application, service, or server — in the cloud or on-premise — with confidence and control.
  
  
CORE VALUES
  
  
One Team. One Redwood Make Your Own Weather Obsess over Customer Success Work the Problem Be Curious Own the Outcome Respect Each Other

As a Technical Writer at Redwood, you'll create and maintain documentation for our Tidal product line, working closely with product, engineering, and UX/design to keep customer-facing documentation and in-product content accurate and consistent.
  
  
You bring solid technical writing skills and sound judgment on ambiguous product or design questions. You're curious about applying AI tools to your own workflow, and comfortable partnering with designers and senior writers on content strategy. You'll follow and contribute to documentation and content design standards set by the team, and make structural or strategic content calls as they arise, looping in your lead on cross-team tradeoffs.
  
  
Documentation Development
  
  

* Write and maintain user guides, implementation documentation, developer content, and release notes for Tidal and Finance Automation, keeping pace with each release cycle.
* Produce API documentation (e.g., using Swagger/OpenAPI) for developer-facing endpoints as needed.
* Translate technical concepts — such as job scheduling and workload orchestration in Tidal, or financial close and reconciliation processes in Finance Automation — into content suited to administrators, developers, and business users.

Content Design Collaboration
  
  

* Partner with UX/design on in-product content, UI text, tooltips, error messages, onboarding copy.
* Apply established content design principles (structure, findability, consistency) to your own documentation work.
* Identify and resolve content inconsistencies or gaps across docs and in-product text, looping in the team when a fix touches shared standards.

AI-Assisted Documentation
  
  

* Use approved AI tools to assist with drafting, editing, and structuring documentation, always reviewing AI-assisted output for accuracy before publishing.
* Identify and pilot opportunities to apply AI to documentation workflows, bringing outcomes back to the team.

Documentation Publishing & Operations
  
  

* Publish and maintain documentation using the team's Git-based, docs-as-code workflow (Markdown, version control).
* Maintain metadata, organization, and versioning of published docs according to team standards.
* Update published content in response to product changes, customer feedback, and post-release review.

Team Collaboration
  
  

* Use Jira and Confluence within established team workflows.
* Participate in Agile ceremonies and deliver content aligned to sprint/release cycles.
* Communicate progress, blockers, and scope changes proactively so your lead can adjust priorities and timelines.
* Collaborate with SMEs and product stakeholders to verify technical accuracy.

**Required**
YOUR EXPERIENCE
  
  

* Bachelor's degree in Technical Communication, English, Computer Science, or equivalent practical experience.
* 3-5 years of technical writing experience for software products, ideally in B2B SaaS.
* Experience producing user guides, API documentation, and release notes in a fast-release (Agile/sprint-based) environment.
* Experience using Jira and Confluence for project tracking and collaboration.
* Experience with Git-based, docs-as-code workflows and lightweight markup (e.g., Markdown).
* Experience applying AI tools to documentation work, whether from prior job experience or self-directed exploration.
* Strong written and verbal communication skills, attention to detail, ability to manage multiple priorities.

**Preferred**

* Familiarity with API documentation tools (e.g., Swagger/OpenAPI).
* Experience partnering with UX/design teams on in-product content or microcopy.

title: Senior Manager - Knowledge Management
description:
**Overview**
Role Overview
  
  
Knowledge Management (KM) is a critical enabler of Financial Planning's strategic priorities, supporting efficient and effective service delivery across PepsiCo's global operations while enhancing employee experience and operational excellence.
  
  
The FPT ESM & KM Senior Analyst plays a key role in driving the implementation, governance, and continuous improvement of Knowledge Management and Enterprise Service Management (ESM) practices within the Financial Planning (FP) function. Working closely with the FP ESM & KM Lead, this role supports the deployment of KM frameworks, knowledge platforms, service management processes, service performance measurement, and service portfolio management.
  
  
As PepsiCo continues to expand its digital capabilities, including the adoption of ServiceNow and other knowledge management technologies, this role will partner with business, IT, and KM Center of Excellence (CoE) teams to ensure effective knowledge capture, governance, accessibility, and service management enablement across the global Financial Planning organization.
  
  
The role allocation is approximately:
  
  

* 80% Knowledge Management (KM)
* 20% Enterprise Service Management (ESM)

**Responsibilities**
Key Responsibilities
  
  
Knowledge Management (80%)
  
  
Knowledge Management Program Support
  
  

* Support the end-to-end Knowledge Management program, including KM framework deployment, system administration, content governance, document management, and business-critical knowledge retention.
* Partner with the FP ESM & KM Lead to drive KM best practices, governance standards, and continuous improvement initiatives across the Financial Planning organization.

Knowledge Repository Management
  
  

* Manage and maintain ServiceNow Knowledge Management content, including 4,000+ Desktop Procedures (DTPs), ensuring information remains accurate, relevant, and accessible.
* Collaborate with capability leads, sector leads, and functional teams to identify, create, update, and retire knowledge assets.
* Ensure knowledge content is structured, categorized, and aligned to capability frameworks to improve discoverability and standardization.
* Partner with the central KM team to create and maintain a centralized knowledge library for S&T teams, ensuring seamless access to trusted and up-to-date information that enhances productivity, promotes knowledge reuse, and accelerates issue resolution across the organization.
* Drive adoption of knowledge-sharing best practices across teams to improve content accessibility and knowledge reuse.

Knowledge Standardization & Adoption
  
  

* Drive content quality standards, governance processes, metadata management, and exception handling practices.
* Support the creation and maintenance of standardized knowledge taxonomies and article structures.
* Promote adoption and effective use of ServiceNow Knowledge Management, Epiplex, ARIS, and other knowledge-sharing platforms.

Knowledge Authoring & Process Documentation
  
  

* Support implementation of modern knowledge authoring methodologies and tools.
* Facilitate process knowledge capture through interactive documentation, process simulations, videos, and process maps.
* Drive adoption of ARIS for process documentation and process mapping activities.

Knowledge Retention & Continuous Improvement
  
  

* Maintain knowledge lifecycle management processes, including regular review, validation, and archival activities.
* Ensure critical process knowledge is retained and updated to support workforce transitions, cross-training, and business continuity requirements.
* Monitor knowledge effectiveness metrics and recommend enhancements to optimize user experience and knowledge reuse.

Knowledge Transfer & Transition Support
  
  

* Partner with Design & Transition teams to establish and implement knowledge transfer methodologies and KM ways of working.
* Support onboarding, transition, and capability-building initiatives through structured knowledge capture and sharing practices.

Controls & Compliance
  
  

* Support KM-related controls testing activities and ensure compliance with internal control requirements, audit standards, and corporate policies.
* Drive timely remediation of observations and continuous process improvements.

Enterprise Service Management (20%)
  
  
Service Management Enablement
  
  

* Gather, analyse, document, and maintain business requirements for service management solutions across the Financial Planning organization.
* Partner with the FP ESM & KM Lead to assess, prioritize, and manage service management enhancements and initiatives.

title: Professional, Integrations
description:
**When you join Accurate Background, you’re an integral part of making every hire the start of a success story. Your contributions will help us fulfill our mission of advancing the background screening experience through visibility and insights, empowering our clients to make smarter, unbiased decisions.**
**Job Description**
As an Integration Support Professional at Accurate, you will drive Accurate's future growth engine by assisting Accurate’s Onboarding Team and clients through the onboarding/integration process and turning them into happy users. Additionally, you will collaborate with multiple internal departments to ensure clients and Accurate are positioned for short and long term success.
  
  
A full degree of creativity and latitude are expected in this role to facilitate delivery of results to our business. Being consultative and solutions-oriented are critical for this position.
  
  
**This Role Is For You If**

* You have an in-depth understanding of integrated solutions using different methods of communication (i.e., API’s, periodic files, etc.).
* You have worked with cross-functional teams to problem solve and provide ideal solutions to achieve client objectives.
* You thrive on the urgency and importance of working with our clients and are capable of independently triaging reported issues/bugs related to their integrated solution and leading the effort to resolve.
* You want to actively increase a client’s overall satisfaction with their integrated solution and help Accurate understand the benefits of client requested changes/improvements.
* You have the passion and drive to change the job applicant/candidate and recruiter experience for the better.
* You can engage in business-level and technical conversations with internal and external clients.

At Accurate, we're transforming the background screening experience through innovative technology, industry expertise, and a commitment to client success. As a fast-growing organization, we partner with leading employers to deliver seamless screening and credentialing solutions that help build safer, more trusted workplaces. We foster a collaborative, results-driven culture where new ideas are welcomed, learning is encouraged, and career growth opportunities are plentiful. If you're looking to make an impact while working alongside a talented team in a dynamic environment, Accurate could be the place for you.
  
  
**Responsibilities**
In this role, you will triage client reported issues in relation to their ATS (Applicant Tracking System) or API integrations. Additionally, you will assist clients and the Accurate Onboarding Team in integration configuration and testing, as well as answer open client questions in relation to integrations, provide clarification on solutions, etc.
  
  

* Act as an initial point of contact for all client reported integration issues or concerns through ticketing system.
* Troubleshoot complex data flow issues between Accurate and third-party ATS, HRIS, and recruiting platforms.
* Analyze API requests, responses, error logs, and webhook deliveries to identify root causes of integration issues and either offer potential solutions OR escalate accordingly.
* Maintain communication with stakeholders regarding resolution of reported issues.
* Understand client integration requirements and system capabilities and be able to translate accordingly.
* Serve as a subject matter expert for platform-specific integration capabilities, limitations, and best practices.
* Work closely with clients and ATS representatives to identify account setup and integration requirements.
* Work closely with Onboarding to properly configure clients for specific integrations, considering any client specific initiatives/requirements.
* Provide support for integration testing.
* Translate technical concepts into business-friendly language for both technical and non-technical stakeholders.

**Qualifications**

* A familiarity with integrated API solutions and ability to explain technical solutions to clients.
* Ability to understand, evaluate, and translate complex client requirements into practical integration solutions.
* Strong critical thinking and communication skills combined with a commitment and proven ability to succeed within a fast-paced organization.
* Strong overall interpersonal skills and a history exceeding client expectations.
* Time-management skills and the ability to establish reasonable and attainable deadlines for resolution.
* Self-motivated professional with the ability to work independently, manage competing priorities, and deliver results in a fast-paced environment.
* Basic knowledge of XML and JSON required.
* Basic knowledge of SQL and databases required.
* Experience with Microsoft Office Suite required.
* Experience with related tools such as Postman, SOAP UI, etc., a plus.
* Background Screening experience a plus.

**The Accurate Way**
We offer a fun, fast-paced environment, with lots of room for growth. We have an unwavering commitment to diversity, ensuring everyone has a complete sense of belonging here. To do this, we follow four guiding principles – Take Ownership, Be Open, Stay Curious, Work as One – core values that dictate what we stand for, and how we behave.
  
  
**Take ownership.**
Be accountable for your actions, your team, and the company. Accept responsibility willingly, especially when it’s what’s best for our customers. Give others every reason to trust you, believe in you, and count on you. Rise to every occasion with your personal best.
  
  
**Be open.**
Be open to new ideas. Be inclusive of people and ways of doing things. Make yourself accessible and approachable, and communicate with genuineness, transparency, honesty, and respect. Embrace differences.
  
  
**Stay curious.**
Stay curious even as you move forward. Tirelessly ask questions and challenge the status quo in your pursuit of new ideas, ways to solve problems, and to continually grow and improve.
  
  
**Work as one.**
Work together to create the best customer and workplace experience. Put our customers and employees first—before individual or departmental agendas. Make sure they get the help they need to succeed.
  
  
**Equal opportunities**
Accurate is an equal-opportunity employer and is committed to hiring talented and qualified individuals with diverse backgrounds. All qualified applicants will receive consideration for employment without regard to sex, gender identity, sexual orientation, race, color, religion, national origin, disability, protected veteran status, age, or any other characteristic protected by law.
  
  
Accurate will consider for employment all qualified applicants, including those with criminal histories, in a manner consistent with the requirements of applicable state and local laws.
  
  
You must have a right to work in Australia indefinitely that does not involve sponsorship by the Company.
  
  
**Special Notice**
Accurate is aware of schemes involving fraudulent job postings/offers and/or individuals or entities claiming to be employees of Accurate. Those involved are offering fabricated employment opportunities to applicants, often asking for sensitive personal and financial information. If you believe you have been contacted by anyone misrepresenting themselves as an employee of Accurate, please contact humanresources@accurate.com.
  
  

* Please be advised that all legitimate correspondence from an Accurate employee will come from "@accurate.com" email accounts.
* Accurate will not interview candidates via text or email. Our interviews are conducted by recruiters and leaders via the phone, Zoom/Teams or in an in-person format.
* Accurate will never ask candidates to make any type of personal financial investment related to gaining employment with the Company.

At Schwab India, you’re empowered to shape your future. title: Specialist, Strategic Market Insights and Thought Leadership (Health Care Sector) - Mumbai/Hyderabad
description:
**Summary**
**Position Summary**
**Specialist – Health Care Sector Research – Center for Health Solutions – Research & Insights**
The Deloitte Center for Health Solutions is one of the industry teams within the Research & Insights (MI&I) group, focusing primarily on the Life Sciences & Health Care industry. The Center's goals are:
  
  

* Deloitte Center for Health Solutions (DCHS) is Deloitte’s trusted source for actionable insights on the most pressing issues in life sciences and health care.
* Our mission is to turn evidence into influence—delivering research that challenges conventional wisdom, sparks dialogue and drives transformation across the health ecosystem.
* The Center brings together researchers, policy experts, and strategists to generate differentiated, data-driven thought leadership.
* As part of Deloitte’s Research & Insights organization within the Clients, Strategy and Growth function, DCHS works at the intersection of commercial, public sector, academic, and business to help our clients, and the world, make smarter, more sustainable decisions about health.

Learn more about the Center and have a peek into our work here – Deloitte Center for Health Solutions .
  
  
This role involves contributing to thought leadership and research projects across the full lifecycle—from design to delivery—examining critical challenges and opportunities in the health care sector across health providers and health insurers subsectors. Our Center focuses on key topics and campaigns including AI and tech-enabled transformation, care model transformation, workforce productivity, consumer engagement, and more.
  
  
The candidate will contribute to advancing the quality of the Center's research and thought-leadership work in the health care sector, with a focus on health providers and health insurers subsectors that include topics like affordability and cost of care, AI and tech-enabled transformation, care delivery transformation, patient experience and engagement, strategic margin growth, M&A and strategic partnerships, and the US regulatory and policy landscape (340B changes, Medicaid reform, Medicare rate updates, price transparency, AI-governance etc.). These include whitepapers, in-depth research reports, case studies, articles, data-based research tools, client presentations, and collaterals for specific client accounts. These deliverables would integrate information from a range of primary and secondary sources, including Deloitte subject-matter experts, primary research (surveys), publicly available data, third-party research, analyst reports, presentations, industry commentaries, and news articles.
  
  
**Responsibilities:**
As a Specialist focused on developing thought leadership, you will be required to –
  
  

* Work across diverse health care sector topics, quickly build subject-matter familiarity, synthesize complex information, and deliver high-quality research insights.
* Identify novel topics, areas and trends to focus on, based on extensive analysis of competition thoughtware/articles and importance of issues based on market studies, industry reports and tracking.
* Design research proposals, build consensus, and formulate a research plan.
* Interact with internal and external subject matter experts on industry topics and synthesize takeaways and findings into concise and well-structured narratives, assisting senior research leads to shape internal/external thought-leadership content and collaterals.
* Liaison with U.S. colleagues and senior researchers to understand, refine, and manage internal client expectations and priorities.
* Apply established research tools and methodologies to support business decision-making.

title: Senior Specialist, Business Analyst – MLR Review Capability (Veeva PromoMats)
description:
**Job Description**
**Senior Specialist, Business Analyst – MLR Review Capability (Veeva PromoMats)**
**The Opportunity**

* Based in Hyderabad, join a global healthcare biopharma company and be part of a 130- year legacy of success backed by ethical integrity, forward momentum, and an inspiring mission to achieve new milestones in global healthcare.
* Be part of an organization driven by digital technology and data-backed approaches that support a diversified portfolio of prescription medicines, vaccines, and animal health products.
* Drive innovation and execution excellence. Be a part of a team with passion for using data, analytics, and insights to drive decision-making, and which creates custom software, allowing us to tackle some of the world's greatest health threats.

Our Technology Centers focus on creating a space where teams can come together to deliver business solutions that save and improve lives. An integral part of our company’s IT operating model, Tech Centers are globally distributed locations where each IT division has employees to enable our digital transformation journey and drive business outcomes. These locations, in addition to the other sites, are essential to supporting our business and strategy.
  
  
A focused group of leaders in each Tech Center helps to ensure we can manage and improve each location, from investing in growth, success, and well-being of our people, to making sure colleagues from each IT division feel a sense of belonging to managing critical emergencies. And together, we must leverage the strength of our team to collaborate globally to optimize connections and share best practices across the Tech Centers.
  
  
**About Digital Human Health (DHH)**
Digital Human Health (DHH) connects technology, data, and people to enable and accelerate Human Health business across global markets. DHH supports commercial and medical teams by delivering customer-centric digital platforms, data capabilities, and technology-enabled operating models that enable flexible go-to-market approaches, actionable insights, and personalized customer experiences in a regulated environment.
  
  
Within DHH, Digital Content & Customer Experience (DCCE) supports the Content Accelerator by modernizing the end-to-end content operating model. The Content & Promotional Lifecycle Automation portfolio owns the Medical, Legal, and Regulatory (MLR) review capability, centered on Veeva Vault PromoMats and its integrations across the content ecosystem, so that promotional content is reviewed and approved compliantly, efficiently, and at scale.
  
  
**Role Purpose**
Serve as the India hub’s senior, hands-on business and technical anchor for the MLR review capability—combining Veeva Vault PromoMats administration and configuration expertise with strong business analysis to translate MLR needs into scalable, standardized, and supportable solutions across markets.
  
  
Scope of Ownership & Adjacent Responsibilities
  
  
Own requirements, impact analysis, and configuration recommendations for PromoMats enhancements from intake through design, build, testing, deployment, and production support.
  
  
Act as the go-to expert on the current Vault setup, driving configuration clean-up, rationalization, reuse, and standardization across markets and business processes.
  
  
Partner with the Product Owner/Product Manager on backlog maturity, prioritization, and release planning across configuration, integration, validation, and business readiness.
  
  
Collaborate with architecture and integration teams on PromoMats touchpoints with enterprise DAM, MedComms, content platforms, and identity/access services.
  
  
Flex into adjacent MLR priorities as the capability evolves, including automation and AI-assisted review opportunities, in partnership with the wider DCCE team.
  
  
**Key Responsibilities**
PromoMats Administration & Technical Analysis
  
  
Analyze and support Veeva Vault PromoMats configuration, including document types, fields, lifecycles, workflows, states, roles, permissions, security profiles, sharing settings, objects, picklists, notifications, renditions, and document relationships.
  
  
Assess enhancement requests and translate business needs into functional and technical requirements, solution options, configuration specifications, user stories, and acceptance criteria.
  
  
Perform impact analysis across configuration, metadata, security, workflows, integrations, reporting, and downstream processes before changes are approved.
  
  
Review the existing Vault setup and identify opportunities for clean-up, rationalization, reuse, and standardization.
  
  
Product & Backlog Management
  
  
Mature, prioritize, and maintain the product backlog with the Product Owner/Product Manager based on business value, compliance needs, technical dependencies, and platform strategy.
  
  
Write high-quality user stories covering business intent, existing configuration, proposed behavior, technical considerations, and expected outcomes.
  
  
Ensure stories meet Definition of Ready with clear acceptance criteria, process flows, data/metadata requirements, security considerations, dependencies, and validation approach.
  
  
Facilitate refinement, solution design, sprint planning, release readiness, and post-deployment reviews with the global cross-functional team.
  
  
MLR Process & Integration Collaboration
  
  
Apply strong understanding of promotional content management and MLR review to ensure system changes support compliant and efficient ways of working.
  
  
Partner with business, architecture, and technical teams on integrations with enterprise DAM, MedComms, content ecosystems, identity/access services, and other connected platforms.
  
  
Document current- and future-state processes, data flows, integration touchpoints, decision rules, and exception scenarios.
  
  
Quality, Validation & Testing
  
  
Develop and review test scenarios, test cases, and traceability to confirm configured solutions meet approved requirements.
  
  
Coordinate system, regression, and User Acceptance Testing (UAT), deployment validation, and hypercare.
  
  
Ensure acceptance criteria address quality, compliance, and MLR risk considerations.
  
  
Documentation, Governance & Continuous Improvement
  
  
Maintain current documentation in JIRA, Confluence, and SharePoint, including requirements, configuration decisions, process maps, test evidence, and release artifacts.
  
  
Support end-to-end traceability across requirements, design decisions, configuration, testing, approvals, and deployment.
  
  
Proactively identify opportunities to improve efficiency, scalability, and user experience in MLR review solutions and processes.
  
  
**What Success Looks Like**
PromoMats changes are delivered with clear impact analysis, fewer defects, and minimal rework or production issues.
  
  
A cleaner, more standardized Vault configuration that is easier to support and scale across markets.
  
  
A well-prioritized, ready backlog that enables predictable sprint and release delivery.
  
  
Full traceability and audit-ready documentation across requirements, configuration, testing, and approvals.
  
  
The India hub is a trusted, go-to partner for PromoMats enhancements and support, delivering consistently and on time for stakeholders across markets.
  
  
**Qualifications & Experience**
**Education**
Bachelor’s degree in computer science, Information Technology, Engineering, or a related discipline required.
  
  
**Experience**
Current Veeva Vault Administrator certification required.
  
  
7–8+ years of experience as a Business Analyst, Systems Analyst, Product Analyst, or similar role.
  
  
3+ years of hands-on experience with Veeva Vault, with strong practical knowledge of PromoMats configuration and administration.
  
  
Strong understanding of pharma promotional content and MLR review processes.
  
  
Experience in Agile/Scrum environments with cross-functional global teams; proficiency with JIRA, Confluence, and SharePoint.
  
  
Proven ability to translate stakeholder needs into clear functional requirements and user stories, and to constructively challenge requirements with pragmatic alternatives.
  
  
Experience facilitating workshops and review sessions, and supporting UAT and solution validation.
  
  
Ability to work effectively across a geographically distributed team (India–Europe–US).
  
  
**Preferred / Nice To Have**
Experience with PromoMats integrations (e.g., DAM, MedComms, identity/access services).
  
  
Exposure to automation or AI-enabled capabilities in content review.
  
  
Familiarity with pharma regulations, computer system validation (CSV), and audit expectations.
  
  
**Key Competencies**
Analytical rigor and systems thinking across configuration, process, and integrations
  
  
Ownership and attention to compliance and quality
  
  
Clear, structured communication and documentation
  
  
Collaboration and stakeholder influence across global teams
  
  
**Additional location(s) Compensation Information**

Data Engineering, Data Visualization, Design Applications, Software Configurations, Software Development, Software Development Life Cycle (SDLC), Solution Architecture, System Designs, System Integration, Testing

3+ years of experience working within an LMS — creating, maintaining, and troubleshooting learning objects, assignments, and related program assets
  
  
Strong organizational skills with the ability to manage multiple tasks, priorities, and deadlines independently
  
  
Exceptional written and verbal communication skills — the ability to write with precision, professionalism, and clarity is essential, as a significant portion of collaboration occurs asynchronously across time zones
  
  
Strong process orientation — following established SOPs, identifying gaps, building new documentation, and driving continuous improvement
  
  
Critical thinking and problem-solving skills, with the ability to navigate ambiguity, surface issues proactively, and recommend practical solutions
  
  
Comfort operating in a global environment, including awareness of privacy, data security, and responsible data handling obligations
  
  
Aptitude to quickly learn new system functionality without requiring step-by-step instruction
  
  
Bachelor's degree
  
  
Background in HR technology, learning technology, enterprise SaaS, workforce transformation, or talent management

title: Knowledge Editorial Lead, People Operations
description:
### **Minimum qualifications:**

* Bachelor’s degree or equivalent practical experience.
* 8 years of experience in editorial strategy, technical writing, knowledge management, or content operations.

  

### **Preferred qualifications:**

* Experience directing external vendor partners, agencies, or distributed writing pools - including defining quality scorecards, leading calibration sessions, and managing throughput Service Level Agreements.
* Experience working in a Content Management System.
* Demonstrated program experience managing large-scale knowledge bases (2,000+ articles) or leading complex content audits, mass restructuring, and migration initiatives.
* Proven track record of creating and enforcing style guides, content taxonomies, and operational documentation standards (e.g., standard operating procedures, job aids, quick-reference guides, decision trees, canned responses).
* Ability to partner with process owners, operations leaders, and legal/compliance teams to establish clear RACI models and streamline review workflows.

**About the job**
-----------------

We are the Editorial and Production hub within People Operations (POps) Content and Knowledge (C+K). We own the ultimate source of truth for Google's global workforce. Our team acts as the master translation and quality lens between complex, localized HR policies and the two frontlines that keep Google moving: our global employees and the human and AI support agents who assist them.Great just isn't good enough for our People Operations team (known elsewhere as "Human Resources"). We bring the world's most innovative people to Google and provide the programs that help them thrive. Whether recruiting the next Googler, refining our core programs, developing talent, or simply looking for ways to inject some more fun into the lives of our Googlers, we bring a data-driven approach that is reinventing the human resources field.

**Responsibilities**
--------------------

* Author operational style guides, structured standard operating procedure templates, canned response guidelines, and scan-and-act content standards.
* Own the editorial quality rubrics, Quality Audit (QA) sampling gauntlets, and calibration workflows for vendor writers executing updates across the People Operations (POps) knowledge content corpus.
* Partner with process owners to identify redundant, outdated, and trivial (ROT) documentation, establishing data-driven criteria for content retirement and consolidation.
* Lead arbitration and editorial reviews with Global Process Owners (GPOs), Compliance, and Service Delivery leads to resolve conflicting procedural guidance.

description:
**About Kerry**

Reporting to the GTS Manager - Pharma, the specialist is responsible for resolving internal and external customer technical queries promptly and effectively. The role requires prioritizing activities in a dynamic environment, allocating resources to critical projects, and assisting the global business team in driving sales and capturing new opportunities. The Specialist will play a crucial role in maintaining high levels of customer satisfaction and loyalty by delivering exceptional support and service.
  
  
**Key responsibilities**
Key Responsibilities
  
  

* Customer Inquiries Promptly address technical customer inquiries regarding the BioPharma and Life Sciences Product Portfolio, gathering appropriate responses from internal technical collateral, literature searches, and consultations with internal subject matter experts (SMEs). Recommendations provided will include product application details, product-specific technical information, and general end-use application knowledge.
* Communication Effectively communicate with Account Managers, Product Managers and other stake holders to clearly understand and meet customers’ needs.
* Collaboration Collaborate cross-functionally (with sales, RD&A, product management, marketing, process technology, regulatory, quality, etc.) to develop appropriate, customized technical responses. The candidate will communicate and work closely with product development teams to provide feedback and insights from customer interactions. Interact with a wide array of SMEs and stakeholders to aid the sales team.
* Resource Utilization Utilize available resources strategically to support account directors with technical information specific to BioPharma and Life Sciences portfolio end-uses.

Activities may include, but are not limited to supporting customer calls, scheduling internal debriefs and brainstorming meetings, capturing meeting notes, requesting and submitting samples for testing, gathering data from other departments, analyzing data and preparing reports, presenting summaries to internal stakeholders and on customer calls. Conduct root cause analysis in collaboration with relevant departments to resolve technical issues, ensuring minimal disruption to customer operations.

* Industry Knowledge Stay up-to-date with the latest industry trends and technologies to provide informed support. Continuously enhance technical knowledge through training and professional development.
* Multitask Ability to manage multiple tasks simultaneously while maintaining high levels of accuracy and efficiency.
* Technical Writing Create, review, and update technical documents, including user manuals, product specifications, and troubleshooting guides. Ensure clarity, accuracy, and consistency in all technical documentation.
* Marketing Support Collaborate with the marketing team to develop technical content for marketing materials, such as brochures, application notes, papers, and case studies. Provide technical insights and support for marketing campaigns and initiatives.

**Qualifications and skills**
**Qualifications**

* Education Bachelor's or Master's in Biology, Chemistry, Pharmacy, Engineering, or a related field.
* Location - Mumbai/Gurgaon/Bangalore
* Experience Minimum of 5 years of relevant experience in technical service or support within the Pharmaceutical and/or Biopharmaceutical industry. Demonstrated ability to troubleshoot and resolve technical issues.
* Customer Relationship Management Proven track record in managing customer relationships and driving technical service excellence.
* Technical Knowledge Strong understanding of pharmaceutical products and their applications. Knowledge of unit operations and practices relevant to pharmaceutical customers and cGMP processes.
* Problem-Solving Skills Excellent problem-solving and troubleshooting skills. Ability to think critically and analytically to resolve complex technical issues.
* Communication Skills Strong communication and interpersonal skills, with the ability to explain technical concepts to non-technical users. Proficiency in written and verbal communication.
* Tools and Systems Experience with ticketing systems and remote support tools. Proficiency in using software and tools for technical support and documentation. Experience working in an SAP environment is desirable.
* Teamwork Ability to work independently and as part of a team in a fast-paced environment. Strong collaboration skills and a proactive approach to problem-solving.
* Travel Ability to travel up to 10% of the time.
* Skills
* Broad scientific knowledge base with a focus on microbial and biopharmaceutical manufacturing.
* Comfortable bridging R&D and Commercial enterprises to help reach organizational goals.
* Collaborative individual, adept at working with cross-functional teams within a matrix organization.
* Strong organizational and multi-tasking skills to meet delivery on competing priorities.
* Strong interpersonal, oral, and written communication, and presentation skills.
* Works independently, takes ownership of the role, is proactive and self-motivated.
* Agile individual, comfortable working in an ambiguous setting.
* Proficiency in Outlook, Excel/Word/PowerPoint, CRM software (preferred), JMP/Minitab/SPSS (preferred) and technical writing software’s
* Strong understanding and vigilance of confidentiality of both Kerry and customer IP.
* Able to travel independently and present technical information at trade shows and customer meetings.
* Excels at working in a diverse environment.

The Portfolio Support Specialist supports Brennan’s Digital Group professional services business across the Cloud, Data & AI and Business Applications practices. Reporting to the Digital Group Portfolio Manager, the role improves portfolio visibility, PPM adoption, data quality and operational discipline across Brennan’s project and portfolio management processes.
  
  
The role is expected to consistently use available AI tools to improve speed, accuracy and efficiency across PPM support, reporting, analysis, training material maintenance and continual improvement activities. This is not a traditional manual administration role; the successful candidate will proactively reduce repetitive effort, identify patterns, streamline tasks and use AI to deliver faster, more reliable portfolio support outcomes.
  
  
**Role Responsibilities**
**Project & Portfolio Management (PPM) Tool End-user Support**

* Provide first level support to end users of Brennan’s Project & Portfolio Management (PPM) tool, including how-to guidance, navigation support and assistance with day-to-day usage queries.
* Support onboarding of new starters by delivering basic PPM tool training and helping users understand required processes, data entry standards and project information hygiene expectations.
* Own, maintain and continually improve PPM training materials, including user guides, FAQs, work instructions and training handbooks.
* Troubleshoot level 1 PPM tool issues, triage user queries, capture recurring problems and escalate system or process issues where additional support is required.
* Use available AI tools to identify recurring PPM support issues, improve guidance materials and reduce repetitive user support effort.

**Service Pack Coordination**

* Coordinate a portfolio of small, simple service packs that do not require client-facing project management, ensuring delivery information remains accurate and current.
* Maintain service pack updates in Brennan’s PPM tool, including status, key dates, assigned resources, progress notes and closure information.
* Ensure resource planning tools are updated to reflect resource allocation, planned effort and delivery timing against each service pack.
* Monitor service pack progress and follow up with delivery resources or internal stakeholders to confirm updates, identify blockers and support timely completion.
* Maintain consistent information hygiene across service pack records so portfolio reporting, resource planning and operational visibility remain reliable.

**Digital Group Portfolio Manager Support**

* Provide ad-hoc support to the Digital Group Portfolio Manager across portfolio reporting, data analysis, administration and operational follow-up activities.
* Assist with preparing portfolio reports, dashboards, summaries and analysis using information from PPM, resource planning and other delivery management tools.
* Use available AI tools to identify recurring support themes, data quality gaps, reporting inconsistencies and process inefficiencies, then translate insights into practical improvement actions.
* Proactively identify continual improvement opportunities and maintain a backlog of initiatives to improve ways of working, system usage, data quality and portfolio support processes.
* Maintain all project management guidelines, playbooks and templates, ensuring the latest versions are available and accessible to all PMs.

**Stakeholder Engagement & Communication**

* Communicate clearly with PPM users, delivery teams, project managers and practice stakeholders to support accurate tool usage and timely updates.
* Respond to PPM user queries, provide simple guidance and escalate issues where further support is required.
* Follow up with internal stakeholders to keep service pack status, resource allocation and delivery information current.
* Use available AI tools to summarise support activity, service pack progress, blockers, data quality issues and recurring stakeholder themes into clear updates for the Digital Group Portfolio Manager.
* Maintain clear records of requests, actions, decisions and outcomes to support reporting and follow-up.

**Key Competencies And Qualifications Required**

* 5+ years’ experience working in portfolio, PMO, project coordination, project administration or professional services support environments, preferably within a technology services business.
* Demonstrated exposure to portfolio-level ways of working, including project governance, status reporting, data quality, resource planning, templates, playbooks and operational follow-up.
* Experience supporting users of project, portfolio or resource planning tools, including responding to how-to queries, assisting new users, maintaining training materials and troubleshooting basic issues.
* Experience maintaining accurate project, portfolio or operational data in tools and trackers, with strong attention to data quality, status updates, information hygiene and reporting accuracy.
* Exposure to resource planning, scheduling, capacity tracking or allocation management across multiple small work packages, projects or service activities.
* Experience working with geographically distributed stakeholders, with the ability to follow up actions, communicate clearly, manage competing priorities and escalate issues when required.
* Mandatory Skills and Technology
* Strong working knowledge of Microsoft Project Operations is mandatory, including project setup, project records, tasks, resource assignments, time or effort visibility, status information, reporting inputs and data quality management.
* Strong administration, coordination and follow-up skills, with the ability to maintain accurate records, track actions and keep portfolio information current.
* Confident supporting business users with project, portfolio and resource planning tools, including providing simple guidance, basic training and level 1 troubleshooting.
* Strong attention to detail and data quality, with the ability to identify gaps, inconsistencies or missing updates in PPM and resource planning tools.
* Proven ability to consistently use available AI tools to improve speed, accuracy and efficiency across reporting, analysis, support triage, documentation maintenance and continual improvement activities.
* Ability to own, maintain and continually improve user guides, FAQs, work instructions, training handbooks, PM guidelines, artefacts, playbooks and templates.

**Highly Desired Skills and Technology**

* Confident using Microsoft 365 tools, including Teams, Excel, PowerPoint, SharePoint and Planner, to support communication, reporting, tracking and administration.

* Ability to log, prioritise, track and follow up support requests through to resolution or escalation.
* Basic understanding of project lifecycle, resource planning, scheduling and reporting concepts required to support service pack coordination and portfolio visibility.

This engineering organization offers controls, Security & Fire and Energy solution.
  
  
**About Fire & Security Business**
5-8 years of wide JCI/Tyco and third-party system knowledge for design, detailed engineering and implementation of Fire Protection and Suppression system. Team provides the services and value-added solutions for the system and provides onsite & remote engineering support across the globe for engineering.
  
  
**What You Do**
The primary responsibility for this role is to work on end-to-end presales engineering activities of Fire protection & Suppression opportunities from various verticals (e.g., Transportation, Data Center, Commercial, Industries, Fit-outs, Key Accounts, etc.). You will be handling techno-Commercial activities of the projects covering various such as Fire Sprinkler, Hydrant, water spray, foam and gas suppression Systems etc. You should own the technical consideration to win the job and should be part of HOTO process to get the D&E and OPS approval for booking.

title: Power System Study Senior Expert in Renewable
description:
**ETAP empowers customers to make informed decisions throughout the life cycle of their projects with innovative software solutions for electrical systems. By applying ETAP solutions, customers experience continuous intelligence during design and engineering and into operations and maintenance using a unified electrical digital twin platform. ETAP supports customers in their digital transformation and sustainable energy transitions for a green and smart future, helping them to prioritize safety, maximize reliability, and stay resilient.**
**Our employees' passion for excellence, innovation, and customer satisfaction is our most-prized resource. If you share that passion — and want to be part of a company that leads the energy transition towards a cleaner and more resilient world for future generations — we invite you to join us!**
**ETAP is committed to creating a diverse work environment and is proud to be an Equal Opportunity Employer.**
**Job Title: PSS Expert in Renewable**
**Location: India or MEA**
**Employment Type:**
Full Time
  
  
**About The Role**
We are looking for a senior
**Power Systems & Renewable Energy Specialist**
with deep expertise in renewable grid integration, dynamic modeling, Power Plant Controllers (PPCs), inverter-based resources (IBRs), grid-code compliance, and real-time Hardware-in-the-Loop (HIL) validation.
  
  
The ideal candidate will bring a combination of
**power-system engineering, renewable-energy integration, control-system development, simulation, and technical project leadership**
experience. This role will work across utility-scale Solar PV, Wind, BESS, and hybrid renewable-energy projects, partnering with utilities, transmission operators, OEMs, inverter manufacturers, EPCs, and project developers
  
  
Key Responsibilities
  
  

* Lead power-system engineering, renewable-energy integration, and grid-compliance activities for utility-scale Solar PV, Wind, BESS, and hybrid renewable-energy projects.
* Provide technical leadership for Power Plant Controller (PPC), inverter control, and plant-level active/reactive power control solutions.
* Lead grid-integration and interconnection studies, including steady-state, dynamic, transient, contingency, and system-stability analysis.
* Develop, validate, and maintain power-system models using PSS/E, PSCAD/EMTDC, and other industry-standard simulation tools.
* Develop and validate dynamic and user-defined models for renewable plants, inverters, and PPCs.
* Design and validate PPC and inverter control strategies for normal operating conditions and grid disturbances, including voltage/frequency control and fault ride-through (FRT) requirements.
* Lead HIL testing and real-time simulation using platforms such as RTDS and OPAL-RT for inverter and PPC validation.
* Assess weak-grid and low-SCR conditions, voltage stability, dynamic performance, and controller interactions.
* Lead grid-code compliance assessments and validate performance through simulation and real-time testing.
* Coordinate technical activities across OEMs, inverter manufacturers, PPC suppliers, utilities, EPC contractors, and project owners.
* Lead technical discussions with utilities and transmission-system operators on grid interconnection, stability, protection, controls, and compliance requirements.
* Define technical requirements, review engineering deliverables, and ensure technical quality throughout project execution.
* Support projects from proposal and study definition through engineering, validation, commissioning, and customer acceptance.
* Provide technical mentoring and guidance to power-system engineers and project teams.
* Contribute to research and development, new modeling methodologies, and advanced renewable-grid integration solutions.

**Essential Qualifications & Technical Skills**

* Strong experience in power-system engineering and renewable-energy grid integration.
* Advanced proficiency in PSS/E.
* Strong experience with PSCAD/EMTDC and EMT/dynamic simulation.
* Experience with MATLAB/Simulink for control-system development and analysis.
* Experience developing and validating dynamic and user-defined models.
* Strong understanding of inverter-based resources, PPCs, grid-forming/grid-following controls, and renewable plant controls.
* Experience with grid-code requirements, interconnection studies, and system stability analysis.
* Programming experience in Fortran and/or C for model development and customization.
* Experience working with utilities, transmission operators, OEMs, or renewable-energy developers.

**Preferred / Additional Skills**

* Experience with RTDS / RSCAD and/or OPAL-RT.
* Experience with PowerWorld.
* Hands-on experience with Hardware-in-the-Loop (HIL) testing.
* Experience with weak-grid, low-SCR, voltage stability, and controller-interaction studies.
* Experience with BESS and hybrid renewable-energy systems.
* Experience leading technical projects or multidisciplinary engineering teams.
* Strong customer-facing and stakeholder-management skills.
* Experience preparing technical proposals, scopes of work, and engineering studies.
* Experience in research, development, and implementation of advanced power-system technologies.

What You'll Bring
  
  

* Strong analytical and problem-solving skills.
* Ability to translate complex power-system challenges into practical engineering solutions.
* Strong technical communication skills and the ability to engage effectively with customers, utilities, OEMs, and engineering teams.
* Ability to lead technical projects independently while mentoring and developing other engineers.
* A collaborative, hands-on approach to solving complex renewable-energy and grid-integration challenges.

**ETAP requires all successful applicants to undergo and pass a comprehensive background check before they start employment. Background checks will be conducted in accordance with local laws and may, subject to those laws, include proof of educational attainment, employment history verification, proof of work authorization, criminal records, identity verification, credit check. Certain positions dealing with sensitive and/or third party personal data may involve additional background check criteria.**
**ETAP is an Equal Opportunity Employer. We are committed to being an exemplary employer with an inclusive culture, developing a workplace environment where all our employees are treated with dignity and respect. We value diversity and the expertise that people from different backgrounds bring to our business.**
**Come and join ETAP to create the transformative technology that enables our customers to engineer a better world.**

title: Biochemist
description:
**Biochemist – AI Data Trainer**
**About The Role**
What if your expertise in protein folding, enzyme kinetics, or metabolic pathways could directly shape how the world's most advanced AI models think about science?
  
  
Alignerr partners with leading AI research labs to build and refine cutting-edge language models — and we need PhD-level Biochemists to help us get the science right. This is a fully remote, flexible contract role where your deep domain knowledge becomes the benchmark for AI accuracy.
  
  
No AI background required. Just bring your scientific rigor.
  
  

* Organization: Alignerr
* Type: Hourly Contract
* Location: Remote
* Commitment: 10–40 hours/week

**What You'll Do**

* Design Expert-Level Problems — Craft advanced biochemistry challenges spanning nucleic acid chemistry, proteomics, structural biology, and drug-target interactions to stress-test AI reasoning.
* Author Ground-Truth Solutions — Write rigorous, step-by-step scientific responses that serve as the gold standard for AI model training and benchmarking.
* Audit AI Outputs — Evaluate AI-generated biochemical pathways, molecular structures, and quantitative analyses for technical accuracy, logical consistency, and scientific soundness.
* Refine AI Reasoning — Identify flaws in AI thinking — such as incorrect stoichiometry, stereochemical errors, or flawed metabolic logic — and provide structured, actionable feedback to improve model performance.

**Who You Are**

* PhD-level expertise: You hold (or are in the final stages of completing) a PhD in Biochemistry, Molecular Biology, or a closely related discipline.
* Deep domain knowledge: You have strong command of at least one core area — structural biology, enzymology, cellular metabolism, bioinformatics, or molecular genetics.
* Precise communicator: You can translate highly technical biochemical concepts into clear, well-structured written explanations.
* Detail-oriented: You catch errors others miss — whether it's a miscalculated Km value or an incorrect stereocenter assignment.
* No AI experience required — we'll give you everything you need to get started.

**Nice to Have**

* Experience with data annotation, quality evaluation, or scientific peer review
* Familiarity with computational tools such as PyMOL, AlphaFold, or BLAST
* Background in science writing, technical documentation, or curriculum development

**Why Join Us**

* Make a real impact — Your scientific expertise directly improves how AI reasons about life sciences, with implications for research worldwide.
* Work on the frontier — Get hands-on exposure to advanced large language models and how they're trained and evaluated.
* Total flexibility — Work on your own schedule, fully remote, with no fixed hours or location requirements.
* Autonomy — Choose your own pace and projects that align with your expertise.
* Ongoing opportunity — Strong contributors are considered for contract extensions and additional projects.

title: Customer Support Associate - Technical 2nd Line
description:
**About ZDHC**
The ZDHC Foundation develops and implements the Roadmap to Zero Programme with a focus on reducing the chemical footprint of the Fashion Industry. We are the leading sustainability organisation driving sustainable chemistry, innovations and best practices in textile, apparel, leather and footwear manufacturing to protect consumers, workers and the environment. Through collaborative engagement, alignment and large-scale implementation, we take a holistic approach to sustainable chemical management and enable tangible progress in the wider industry through the delivery of guidelines, platforms and solutions, including capacity-building and innovation projects. For more information about ZDHC, see www.roadmaptozero.com and follow us on LinkedIn.
  
  
**ZDHC Vision and Mission**
The ZDHC Vision is a World in which better chemistry leads to the protection of life, land, air and water. The ZDHC Mission is to lead our global value chain to achieve the highest standard for sustainable chemical management, driving resource efficiency and circularity.
  
  
**Job Purpose**
The
**Customer Support Associate – Technical 2nd Line**
provides specialised technical support within the Customer Support Team, acting as the link between first-line Customer Support and the Platform Development Team.
  
  
The role investigates and resolves technical issues escalated by first-line support or other internal teams, ensuring that issues are accurately analysed, documented, prioritised and followed through to resolution. Working closely with the Platform Product Owner and Development Team, the role supports effective bug management, platform testing and the successful release of new functionalities and enhancements.
  
  
Through hands-on investigation, structured testing and close collaboration across teams, the role contributes to a reliable, user-friendly platform and a high-quality customer experience. The role is intended for candidates who combine strong customer-support capabilities with a genuine software development mindset.
  
  
**Key Roles And Responsibilities**
**Second-Line Technical Support & Troubleshooting**

* Provide second-line technical support for platform-related questions and issues escalated by first-line Customer Support and other internal teams.
* Investigate reported technical issues to understand and reproduce problems, distinguish between user-related issues and potential platform bugs, and identify possible root causes.
* Resolve technical support cases independently where possible and escalate issues requiring development support to the appropriate team.
* Identify recurring technical issues and patterns and proactively flag opportunities to improve platform functionality, user experience or support processes.

**Technical Skills & Platform Development Capabilities**

* Apply a strong technical understanding of modern web-based applications, including APIs, databases, authentication flows, application architecture and common integration patterns.
* Use practical development skills and experience with at least one modern programming language or web development framework to support technical troubleshooting and root-cause analysis, including reading and understanding source code.
* Investigate complex technical issues using browser developer tools, application logs, API requests and responses, database queries and other relevant debugging tools.
* Work closely with the Platform Product Owner and Development Team to clarify technical issues and support effective prioritisation and resolution.

**Bug Management, Testing & Quality Assurance**

* Create clear and complete technical tickets, including issue descriptions, reproduction steps, expected versus actual behaviour, supporting evidence and relevant user information.
* Track technical issues and bugs through to resolution and ensure relevant stakeholders are kept informed of progress and outcomes.
* Support the testing of new platform functionalities, features, enhancements and bug fixes before and after release.
* Conduct structured functional and regression testing and clearly document testing results, issues and observations.
* Verify resolved bugs and fixes before tickets are closed and confirm that the expected functionality is working correctly.

**Knowledge Sharing & Cross-Team Collaboration**

* Translate technical findings into clear and understandable information for first-line Customer Support and other non-technical colleagues.
* Support the development and maintenance of internal troubleshooting guidance, technical support documentation and relevant Knowledge Base content.
* Collaborate closely with Customer Support, Platform Development and other relevant teams to ensure an effective flow of information between users and technical teams.

**Qualifications & Experience**

* Relevant education or equivalent professional experience in customer support, technical support, IT, digital platforms or a related field.
* Previous experience in customer support, technical support, application support, software testing or a comparable role.
* Experience working with web-based platforms, software applications or digital products.
* Experience investigating and troubleshooting technical issues and translating findings into clear, actionable tickets.
* Experience with ticketing, issue-tracking or development tools; experience with tools such as Jira, Linear, Confluence, Notion, Asana or similar is an advantage.
* Experience with functional software testing, bug reproduction and/or regression testing is an advantage.
* Strong digital literacy and the ability to quickly understand new systems, functionalities and technical processes.
* Ability to communicate effectively with both technical and non-technical colleagues and translate between customer/user issues and technical requirements.
* Strong written and verbal English communication skills.
* Experience working in an international and cross-functional environment is an advantage.

**Competencies**

* Accountability — Take responsibility for actions and results, stay accountable for successes and failures, and ensure commitments and standards are met.
* Attention to Detail — Produce and review work carefully for accuracy, completeness, and consistency to ensure high standards.
* Communication — Share information, ideas, and expectations clearly and persuasively, and adapt style and content to the audience for understanding and impact.
* Customer Orientation — Understand, anticipate, and meet customer needs through empathy, effective communication, and responsiveness aligned with customer priorities.
* Problem-Solving — Anticipate and define problems, analyse root causes, evaluate alternatives, and implement practical, timely actions to resolve issues effectively.
* Software-Specific Competencies — Learn and apply relevant software and digital tools effectively to support processes, data management, and decision-making.
* Teamwork — Work cooperatively with others, communicate openly, support colleagues, manage conflict constructively, and focus on shared goals for collective results.

**What We Offer**
At ZDHC, we believe that a fulfilling career goes beyond a competitive salary. We are committed to creating a supportive and inspiring workplace where you feel valued, energised, and empowered to do your best work. That’s why we offer a comprehensive benefits package designed to support your growth, help you achieve your goals, and encourage strong connections with your team.
  
  

* 30 holidays a year, based on 40 hours a week
* Gym membership allowance - for your physical wellbeing
* Access to Open Up - for your mental wellbeing
* Hybrid and flexible working environment
* Support in setting up your workstation at home (if needed)
* High-speed internet costs reimbursed

description:
