Field Application Engineer – Robotics

Join the first company in India to design, manufacture and assemble robots and AMRs in-house. Learning robotics from the inside is a priceless opportunity.

Commission, program and demo cobots, industrial robots, AMRs, AGVs, humanoids and robot dogs, including Fairino, Yasaka and Unitree.

Location: Openings at Mumbai Factory, Pune Factory and Delhi region (HQ: Navi Mumbai, Koparkhairane), with customer-site travel

Department: Robotics & Industrial Automation

Employment Type: Full-time

Experience: 1–4 years (immediate joiners preferred)

The Role

You will install, commission, program and troubleshoot robotic systems at customer sites, across industrial robots, cobots, AMRs, AGVs, humanoids and robot dogs. You will work with customers and our sales, design and project teams to turn applications into running automation.

What You Will Do

• Install, commission, program and troubleshoot robots, cobots and mobile robots at customer sites, including AMR/AGV mapping and navigation.

• Deliver pick-and-place, material handling, palletizing, welding and machine tending applications.

• Integrate robots with PLC, HMI, servo, vision and other automation systems, and optimize cycle times.

• Run demos, application trials and customer training.

• Provide on-site service and support to keep customer operations running.

• Prepare service and commissioning reports and technical documentation.

• Coordinate with sales, design and project teams, and share field feedback with our in-house robot design team.

Must Have

• Diploma / B.E. / B.Tech in Mechanical, Electrical, Electronics, Mechatronics, Instrumentation, Robotics or Automation.

• 1–4 years in robotics, automation or field application engineering.

• Basic industrial robot programming knowledge.

• Strong troubleshooting, communication and customer-handling skills.

• Willingness to travel to customer sites.

Good to Have

• Knowledge of PLC, HMI, servo, sensors and industrial protocols such as Modbus, Profinet or EtherNet/IP.

• Experience with ABB, FANUC, KUKA, Yaskawa, Universal Robots or similar robots is a plus.

• AMR/AGV fleet setup, mapping and navigation; ROS experience is a plus.

• Machine vision, Python scripting or offline robot programming.

What You Will Learn

Robot and cobot programming and integration; real applications in welding, handling, palletizing and machine tending; PLC/HMI/servo integration; project execution and troubleshooting; and AMR/mobile robot deployment.

Why Luna

• Be part of an India first: Luna designs, manufactures and assembles robots and AMRs in-house. Work alongside the people who build them, plus Fairino, Yasaka and Unitree platforms. A priceless opportunity.

• Real ownership: take projects from first demo to live operation, with fast decisions and direct access to leadership.

• Grow as we grow: move into Senior Application Engineer, Robotics Specialist, Project Engineering or Field Application Manager roles.

• Keep learning: principal and OEM trainings, certifications, and cutting-edge mobile robotics.

• Exciting projects in factories, warehouses and new applications.

• Get rewarded: competitive compensation, performance incentives, travel support and a supportive, growing team.

Luna Technologies Pvt. Ltd., headquartered in Navi Mumbai (Koparkhairane), is the first company in India to design, manufacture and assemble robots and AMRs in-house. We also deliver industrial automation, motion control and mechatronics solutions with global technology partners.

title: Specialist, Strategic Market Insights and Thought Leadership (Health Care Sector) - Mumbai/Hyderabad
description:
**Summary**
**Position Summary**
**Specialist – Health Care Sector Research – Center for Health Solutions – Research & Insights**
The Deloitte Center for Health Solutions is one of the industry teams within the Research & Insights (MI&I) group, focusing primarily on the Life Sciences & Health Care industry. The Center's goals are:
  
  

* Deloitte Center for Health Solutions (DCHS) is Deloitte’s trusted source for actionable insights on the most pressing issues in life sciences and health care.
* Our mission is to turn evidence into influence—delivering research that challenges conventional wisdom, sparks dialogue and drives transformation across the health ecosystem.
* The Center brings together researchers, policy experts, and strategists to generate differentiated, data-driven thought leadership.
* As part of Deloitte’s Research & Insights organization within the Clients, Strategy and Growth function, DCHS works at the intersection of commercial, public sector, academic, and business to help our clients, and the world, make smarter, more sustainable decisions about health.

Learn more about the Center and have a peek into our work here – Deloitte Center for Health Solutions .
  
  
This role involves contributing to thought leadership and research projects across the full lifecycle—from design to delivery—examining critical challenges and opportunities in the health care sector across health providers and health insurers subsectors. Our Center focuses on key topics and campaigns including AI and tech-enabled transformation, care model transformation, workforce productivity, consumer engagement, and more.
  
  
The candidate will contribute to advancing the quality of the Center's research and thought-leadership work in the health care sector, with a focus on health providers and health insurers subsectors that include topics like affordability and cost of care, AI and tech-enabled transformation, care delivery transformation, patient experience and engagement, strategic margin growth, M&A and strategic partnerships, and the US regulatory and policy landscape (340B changes, Medicaid reform, Medicare rate updates, price transparency, AI-governance etc.). These include whitepapers, in-depth research reports, case studies, articles, data-based research tools, client presentations, and collaterals for specific client accounts. These deliverables would integrate information from a range of primary and secondary sources, including Deloitte subject-matter experts, primary research (surveys), publicly available data, third-party research, analyst reports, presentations, industry commentaries, and news articles.
  
  
**Responsibilities:**
As a Specialist focused on developing thought leadership, you will be required to –
  
  

* Work across diverse health care sector topics, quickly build subject-matter familiarity, synthesize complex information, and deliver high-quality research insights.
* Identify novel topics, areas and trends to focus on, based on extensive analysis of competition thoughtware/articles and importance of issues based on market studies, industry reports and tracking.
* Design research proposals, build consensus, and formulate a research plan.
* Interact with internal and external subject matter experts on industry topics and synthesize takeaways and findings into concise and well-structured narratives, assisting senior research leads to shape internal/external thought-leadership content and collaterals.
* Liaison with U.S. colleagues and senior researchers to understand, refine, and manage internal client expectations and priorities.
* Apply established research tools and methodologies to support business decision-making.
* Work on varied data sets (e.g., survey data, publicly available data sets) to derive data-driven insights.
* Identify and apply relevant analytical methods, partnering with data science and analytics professionals to derive actionable insights from large, complex datasets (Capital IQ, Pitchbook, Alphasense, Mergermarket, FDA, CMS datasets, O\*NET, KFF, public company filings) in support of health care research and business priorities.
* Demonstrate strong writing skills as required for thought leadership reports.
* Display strong consultative and engaging presentation skills.
* Support all aspects of engagement/project to ensure outcomes and meet deadlines.
* Assist senior researchers and practice leaders with internal briefings and external client meetings/webinars – by performing customized data analysis and presenting results and insights into client-ready briefing decks.
* Develop an understanding of Deloitte’s solutions, services, and offerings.

**Experience**
**Requisite experience and skills**

* 3-6 years of experience in supporting/managing research projects in health care topic areas.
* Experience working with US/global clients and teams is preferred. Since the job requires working closely with US-based colleagues, the ability to work across cultures is important.

**Industry/sector/subsector Skills**

* Business research/thought leadership development experience in the health care sector is preferred.
* Knowledge of U.S. health care sector, including key trends across providers, insurers, related health care segments, as well as impact of policy, and regulatory forces on the industry, is preferred.
* Familiarity with the impact of AI, advanced analytics, and other emerging technologies on health care business models, operations, workforce, care delivery will be an advantage.

**Technical Skills**

* Sound analytical skills with experience in one or more of the following research methods: Primary research (surveys), secondary research, academic research, and case study research.
* Strong data analysis skills with the ability to work with quantitative and qualitative data – interpret, analyze, visualize, and provide data-driven insights.
* Ability to use statistical and advanced data analysis methods to analyze large and complex datasets, including surveys.
* Ability to develop compelling and analytical data visualizations using one or more tools like Excel, Tableau, Power BI, or others.
* Strong verbal and written communication skills. Journalistic and narrative writing style is preferred, along with prior experience in report writing and research report development.
* Problem-solving and critical thinking skills to generate meaningful analytical insights.
* Broad understanding of strategy models and frameworks, and the ability to apply them to research problems.
* Ability to understand the impact of marketplace changes on the industry, sector, or sub-sector.
* Proficiency in using generative AI-based platforms and tools to elevate research discovery, data insights, analytical rigor, and business writing.
* Proficiency in using generative AI and related tools to identify early signals and trends shaping the market through continuous sensing will be preferred.
* Familiarity with building custom GPTs and custom gen-AI research tools will be an added advantage.

**The broader Deloitte Research and Insights team**
The Deloitte Research and Insights teams’ mission is to conduct research and analysis to develop compelling, forward-looking perspectives that enable clients to anticipate, prepare for, and respond to “what’s coming next.” The team plays an integral role in strengthening the firm’s strategic positioning by developing high-quality thoughtware from end to end, published on Deloitte Insights and Deloitte.com.
  
  
Their work includes:
  
  

* Managing relations with internal stakeholders.
* Using advanced data science and survey advisory capabilities to strengthen the credibility of insights.
* Using editorial and visualization capabilities to improve the stickiness of firm thoughtware.

**Qualifications, experience, work location, and timing**
Academic qualification: Master’s Degree like MBA, PGDM, Economics, Business Economics
  
  
Work experience: 3-6 years
  
  
Location: Hyderabad/Mumbai
  
  
Work hours: 11:00 AM – 8:00 PM IST
  
  
**Our purpose**
Deloitte’s purpose is to make an impact that matters for our people, clients, and communities. At Deloitte, purpose is synonymous with how we work every day. It defines who we are. Our purpose comes through in our work with clients that enables impact and value in their organizations, as well as through our own investments, commitments, and actions across areas that help drive positive outcomes for our communities.
  
  
**Our people and culture**
Our inclusive culture empowers our people to be who they are, contribute their unique perspectives, and make a difference individually and collectively. It enables us to leverage different ways of thinking, ideas and perspectives, and bring more creativity and innovation to help solve our clients’ most complex challenges. This makes Deloitte one of the most rewarding places to work.
  
  
**Professional development**
At Deloitte, professionals have the opportunity to work with some of the best and discover what works best for them. Here, we prioritize professional growth, offering diverse learning and networking opportunities to help accelerate careers and enhance leadership skills. Our state-of-the-art DU: The Leadership Center in India, located in Hyderabad, represents a tangible symbol of our commitment to the holistic growth and development of our people. Explore DU: The Leadership Center in India .
  
  
**Benefits To Help You Thrive**
At Deloitte, we know that great people make a great organization. Our comprehensive rewards program helps us deliver a distinctly Deloitte experience that helps that empowers our professionals to thrive mentally, physically, and financially—and live their purpose. To support our professionals and their loved ones, we offer a broad range of benefits. Eligibility requirements may be based on role, tenure, type of employment and/ or other criteria. Learn more about what working at Deloitte can mean for you.
  
  
**Recruiting tips**
From developing a stand out resume to putting your best foot forward in the interview, we want you to feel prepared and confident as you explore opportunities at Deloitte. Check out recruiting tips from Deloitte recruiters.

title: Digital Learning Developer + Instructional Designer
description:
**Company Description**
Come join us and make a difference in the world!
  
  
Discover more at www.necsws.com
  
  
**Job Description**
A Digital Learning Developer designs, develops, and implements engaging digital learning experiences and online training materials for employees or other learners. The role combines instructional design, multimedia development, learning technology, and content creation to deliver effective and interactive learning solutions.
  
  
**Key Responsibilities**

* Digital Learning Content Development
* Design and develop e-learning courses, interactive modules, and online training materials.
* Convert existing classroom training materials, presentations, and documents into digital learning content.
* Create videos, animations, simulations, quizzes, assessments, and interactive learning activities.
* Instructional Design
* Apply instructional design principles and adult learning methodologies.
* Develop learning objectives, storyboards, scripts, and course outlines.
* Structure content to improve learner engagement, knowledge retention, and learning outcomes.
* E-Learning Tools and Technologies
* Use authoring tools such as Articulate Storyline, Articulate Rise, Adobe Captivate, and other e-learning development platforms.
* Upload, publish, and maintain courses on Learning Management Systems (LMS).
* Ensure compatibility with SCORM, xAPI, and other digital learning standards, where required.
* Multimedia and Interactive Content
* Develop and edit audio, video, graphics, and animations for learning materials.
* Create responsive learning experiences for desktop, tablet, and mobile devices.
* Incorporate interactive elements to make learning content engaging and accessible.
* Collaboration and Stakeholder Management
* Work with subject matter experts (SMEs), trainers, instructional designers, and business teams to gather learning requirements.
* Review technical information and translate it into clear, learner-friendly content.
* Incorporate feedback and make revisions based on stakeholder and learner requirements.
* Quality Assurance and Testing
* Test courses for functionality, navigation, usability, and technical accuracy.
* Ensure content meets accessibility standards and organizational quality guidelines.
* Identify and resolve issues before publishing learning modules.

**Qualifications**
**Educational qualifications**

* Bachelor's degree in Instructional Design, Education, Educational Technology, Multimedia, Computer Science, or a related field.
* Relevant experience or certifications in e-learning development are an advantage.

**Technical Skills**

* E-learning authoring tools: Articulate Storyline 360, Articulate Rise 360,
* Multimedia tools: Adobe Creative Cloud, Canva, Camtasia, or similar applications.
* Understanding of SCORM, xAPI, responsive design, and accessibility standards.

**Professional Skills**

* Strong written and verbal communication.
* Creativity and attention to detail.
* Analytical thinking and problem-solving.
* Time management and ability to manage multiple projects.
* Collaboration with cross-functional teams.
* Ability to simplify complex information into engaging learning experiences.

**Additional Information**
Location: Mumbai
  
  
Working Hours: Full Time UK Hours

title: Senior Engineer - Technical Publication
description:
**Requisition Summary**
PACCAR India is seeking a skilled Senior Engineer - Technical Publication to join our team in Pune. In this role, you will develop, author, maintain, and publish operator manuals, service manuals, technical reference materials, programming guides, and quick reference guides using PACCAR's Content Lifecycle System (CLS).
  
  
This role will collaborate closely with subject matter experts to create structured XML/DITA-based content for print and digital publication, ensuring accuracy, consistency, and usability of technical information. Additionally, you will support translation, localization, and content distribution activities to deliver high-quality documentation across global markets while contributing to the continuous improvement of publication processes and standards.
  
  
At PACCAR, you'll be part of a purpose-driven organization recognized for engineering excellence, innovation, and a strong commitment to employee growth and well-being. We foster a collaborative and inclusive environment where your expertise is valued, your contributions make a meaningful impact, and your career can thrive as you help deliver world-class technical information that supports the future of transportation.
  
  
**Job Function / Responsibilities**

* Develop and maintain product service and operator documentation by translating inputs from subject matter experts into structured XML content using PACCAR's Content Lifecycle System (CLS).
* Research and analyze product information using inputs from subject matter experts, product teardowns, engineering specifications, and engineering schematics.
* Edit content to ensure compliance with legal, regulatory, and translation requirements.
* Develop clear and accurate technical documentation that supports customer understanding of PACCAR products, including vehicle operation, maintenance, and service procedures.
* Ensure product documentation is developed and published on schedule while adhering to PACCAR standards for accuracy, consistency, readability, usability, and quality.
* Support manual change management activities by analyzing backlogs, conducting research, and updating authoring tasks using established systems and processes.
* Collaborate with cross-functional stakeholders, including engineering, manufacturing, PACCAR Parts, Safety & Compliance, Legal, suppliers, dealers, customers, and external publication partners to gather information and ensure documentation accuracy.
* Contribute to continuous improvement initiatives that enhance documentation quality, authoring efficiency, and publication processes.

**Qualification**

title: Senior Medical Information Writer
description:
At EVERSANA, we are proud to be certified as a Great Place to Work across the globe. We’re fueled by our vision to create a healthier world. How? Our global team of more than 7,000 employees is committed to creating and delivering next-generation commercialization services to the life sciences industry. We are grounded in our cultural beliefs and serve more than 650 clients ranging from innovative biotech start-ups to established pharmaceutical companies. Our products, services and solutions help bring innovative therapies to market and support the patients who depend on them. Our jobs, skills and talents are unique, but together we make an impact every day. Join us!
  
  
Across our growing organization, we embrace diversity in backgrounds and experiences. Improving patient lives around the world is a priority, and we need people from all backgrounds and swaths of life to help build the future of the healthcare and the life sciences industry. We believe our people make all the difference in cultivating an inclusive culture that embraces our cultural beliefs. We are deliberate and self-reflective about the kind of team and culture we are building. We look for team members that are not only strong in their own aptitudes but also who care deeply about EVERSANA, our people, clients and most importantly, the patients we serve. We are EVERSANA.
  
  
**Job Description**
**THE POSITION:**
At EVERSANA, our integrated life sciences compliance team is taking a leading role in helping some of the most scientifically advanced Biopharma and research companies around the world to innovate novel therapies for rare, ultra-rare and a range of critical therapeutic areas including Oncology, Neurology, Immuno-oncology, Immunology, etc. This role is within the EVERSANA Compliance team, reporting directly to the Director, Medical Content Development and Medical Review. This person will also collaborate very closely with other team members within the EVERSANA Compliance Business Unit (Medical Information (MI), and Medical Affairs).
  
  
This position will support various types of clients including pharmaceutical, biotechnology, medical devices, digital therapeutics, and over-the-counter companies. This position is responsible for MI content development-related client engagements.
  
  
**Essential Duties And Responsibilities**
Our employees are tasked with delivering excellent business results through the efforts of their teams. These results are achieved by:
  
  

* Develop, review, and maintain scientifically accurate, evidence-based Medical Information (MI) content, including Scientific Response Documents (SRDs), Global Response Documents (GRDs), Customized Response Documents (CRDs), FAQs, cover letters, training materials, and other medical information and scientific communication resources.
* Independently manage the end-to-end MI content development lifecycle, including literature searches, synthesis of evidence, content authoring, incorporation of stakeholder feedback, document finalization, and coordination of Medical, Legal, and Regulatory (MLR) review processes.
* Serve as the primary content owner within document management systems (Veeva Vault Systems), ensuring accurate document upload, lifecycle management, version control, reference linking, annotation, and compliance with documentation standards and regulatory requirements.
* Conduct quality control and peer reviews, scientific data verification, and reference validation to ensure accuracy, consistency, scientific rigor, and compliance of MI deliverables.
* Manage translation requests and coordinate with external translation vendors to ensure timely delivery of high-quality, scientifically accurate, and locally compliant medical information materials.
* Participate in client-facing and internal meetings to provide scientific expertise, project updates, and recommendations on MI content and communication strategies.
* Support the development, review, and continuous enhancement of Standard Operating Procedures (SOPs), work instructions, templates, style guides, quality checklists, and process documentation to drive operational excellence and compliance.
* Ensure all medical information materials are scientifically balanced, evidence-based, compliant with applicable regulatory and company requirements, and aligned with industry best practices.
* Responsible for proactively flagging and managing any quality issues, and ensure timely corrective and preventive actions
* Stays knowledgeable of industry best practices and supports leadership team in evaluating and implementing new technologies and procedures to improve operational efficiency and quality of materials developed.
* Works collaboratively with other medical writers and creative teams across EVERSANA.
* Demonstrate a commitment to diversity, equity, and inclusion through continuous development, modeling inclusive behaviors, and proactively managing bias.
* All other duties as assigned.

**Expectations Of The Job**

* Responsible for delivering CLIENT DELIGHT
* Responsible for working collaboratively with EVERSANA medical information and medical affairs team and taking directions and feedback from management and clients
* Responsible for ensuring management and compliance with industry standards and codes

of practice
  
  

* Able to work independently to develop high-quality, scientifically accurate, strategically aligned, ethical, and compliant medical content
* Responsible to proactively flag and manage any quality issues, and ensure timely

corrective and preventive actions
  
  

* Hours: Able to work full time and be flexible with work scheduling as required by clients and management. (40+ hours per week, 5 days of the week)

**Minimum Knowledge, Skills And Abilities**
The requirements listed below are representative of the experience, education, knowledge, skill and/or abilities required.
  
  

* Education: Minimum bachelor’s degree in scientific discipline or healthcare; Master’s, PhD, or PharmD preferred
* Experience: Minimum of 2 years of MI writing and medical content development experience
* Exceptional communication skills include written, oral, interpersonal, and presentation skills including the ability to independently interpret and summarize complex results.
* Ability to effectively interface with all levels of management and staff and to succeed in a matrix team setting while meetings or exceeding timelines.
* Familiarity with AMA Style guide as well as an understanding of clinical research principles and applied statistics. Familiarity with International Committee of Medical Journal Editors (ICMJE), Good Publication Practices (GPP), and other medical publishing guidelines (e.g., Preferred Reporting Items for Systematic Reviews and Meta-Analyses (PRISMA), Strengthening the Reporting of Observational Studies in Epidemiology (STROBE), Consolidated Standards of Reporting Trials (CONSORT), etc.
* Proficient editing skills along with expertise in Microsoft Office, Acrobat and other applications.
* Experience conducting literature searches and working with tools such as PubMed, Ovid, Embase, etc.
* Experience working with reference management and citation software (e.g., EndNote, Mendeley, Citavi, etc.)
* Strong understanding of regulatory requirements and best practices in relationship to Medical Information, Medical Affairs and promotional and non-promotional materials review.
* Excellent project management skills and proven track record of being results driven; ability to manage
* Ability to conceptualize, design and deliver best in class solutions
* Highly principled – proves to be a professional of unquestionable integrity, credibility and character who demonstrates high moral and ethical behavior
* Collaboration – Ability to work cross functionally across EVERSANA business units and with various clients, including leadership and various departments and functions of our clients
* Agile learning – Ability to support and learn about multiple disease states and therapeutic areas

**Qualifications**

* Education: PharmD (or M. Pharm or M.S. Pharm), PhD, or MD
* Experience: Strong expertise in MI content development and scientific writing, with a track record of delivering accurate, evidence-based, and compliant medical communications.
* Broad therapeutic area experience with the ability to effectively manage diverse product portfolios and complex scientific content.
* Proficiency in Veeva Vault System, including document management, workflow administration, content promotion processes, and MLR review support.

**Additional Information**
All your information will be kept confidential according to EEO guidelines.
  
  
Our team is aware of recent fraudulent job offers in the market, misrepresenting EVERSANA. Recruitment fraud is a sophisticated scam commonly perpetrated through online services using fake websites, unsolicited e-mails, or even text messages claiming to be a legitimate company. Some of these scams request personal information and even payment for training or job application fees. Please know EVERSANA would never require personal information nor payment of any kind during the employment process. We respect the personal rights of all candidates looking to explore careers at EVERSANA.
  
  
From EVERSANA’s inception, Diversity, Equity & Inclusion have always been key to our success. We are an Equal Opportunity Employer, and our employees are people with different strengths, experiences, and backgrounds who share a passion for improving the lives of patients and leading innovation within the healthcare industry. Diversity not only includes race and gender identity, but also age, disability status, veteran status, sexual orientation, religion, and many other parts of one’s identity. All of our employees’ points of view are key to our success, and inclusion is everyone's responsibility.

• Assist in maintaining software user documentation and help platforms 
  
• Maintain a high level of power market knowledge, news, trends, and developments 
  
• Communicate market trends and customer requirements with the development team as needed 
  
• Assist Account Management with Retention calls and visits with clients 
  
• Assist in preparation and presentations for energy related tradeshows and conferences 
  
• Travel to client sites as required

**Qualifications, Skills & Experiences**

• Bachelor’s/Master’s degree:
**Electrical Engineering (Mandate)**
• Strong analytical and problem-solving skills with the ability to research and learn new techniques 
  
• Ability to articulate the business problem to be analyzed, quickly identify the critical elements of the problem, achieve a high-quality answer in a timely fashion, and synthesize answers to resonate with decision makers 
  
• Excellent communication skills, including strong verbal, presentation, and technical writing abilities 
  
• Team player, with the ability to be a self-starter and work independently as needed

**Education:**

• Demonstrated working knowledge of
**power systems, electricity/power**
**markets.**
• Knowledge of fundamental energy market analysis, capacity markets, environmental markets, demand side management/energy efficiency, electric utility resource planning approach
  
• Demonstrated working knowledge of SaaS products and experience troubleshooting issues with Cloud offerings 
  
• Demonstrated capability of effectively communicating complex ideas and analysis verbally, in document format (Word), and in presentation format (Power Point).
  
• Experience with computer and database management languages such as VBA, Python and SQL 
  
• Working knowledge of the
**Microsoft Office suite (Excel, PowerPoint, Word, etc.)**
• Experience with power market production cost and expansion planning models 
  
• Degree or certificate specializing in Power Markets.

**Working Hours**

The support team operates across shifts including:

* 1:00 PM – 10:00 PM IST
* 7:00 PM – 3:00 AM IST

You will initially commence on the 1pm to 10pm shift pattern. Please note that shift schedules are expected to change from January, and we are looking for candidates who are flexible and open to working across all shift patterns as required.

title: Content Research Intern - Industrial Psychology
description:

Mantishq Consultancy | Remote (Pune-based, 1–2 office visits/month)

About Mantishq

We are a behavioural science consultancy applying organisational psychology and neuroscience to workplace performance. Our work is evidence-led — every framework and tool we build is grounded in research.

The Role

Key Responsibilities

Read and synthesise research from industrial/organisational psychology, cognitive psychology and applied neuroscience

Distinguish findings that are genuinely actionable from those that are merely interesting

Write programme content — facilitator guides, workbooks, framework explainers and case studies

Translate complex research into plain language suitable for low-literacy, high-distraction audiences

Support the design of assessment tools, pocket cards and measurement frameworks

Attend internal design sessions and contribute research perspectives

**Who We're Looking For**

Final year Masters student or recently finished masters degree in Industrial/Organisational Psychology, Cognitive Psychology, Neuroscience or Applied Psychology

Genuine interest in applied research, translating evidence into practice

Strong writing ability, especially for non-specialist audiences

Curious, rigorous, and willing to challenge assumptions

Able to work independently in a remote setup

Fluency in English

**What's Desirable:**

Familiarity with frameworks such as Self-Determination Theory, SCARF or psychological safety

Interest in industrial or manufacturing contexts

Working knowledge of Hindi or Marathi

**Not required**
: prior work experience, publications, or specific software skills.

What You Will Learn

How to separate research that is interesting from research that is useful

Practical experience translating academic findings into tools for industrial audiences

Exposure to live client work with major manufacturing organisations

A portfolio of frameworks, content and tools you can point to

Working Arrangement

Duration 6 months

Location Remote; Pune-based preferred, 1–2 office visits per month

Stipend Available

Conversion to Full-Time

This internship is designed as a pathway to placement. Based on performance and fit, a full-time offer will be extended at the end of six months.

How to Apply

Send to sneha@mantishq.co.in:

Your CV (1–2 pages)

title: Scientific QA
description:

ACS International India is looking for a
**Scientific QA Associate**

**Chemistry, Scientific Content, Data Quality, and Software Testing**

**Collaboration & Learning**

**Educational Qualifications**

**Preferred**




+ M.Pharma (Pharmaceutical Chemistry / Pharmaceutics)

+ 0-2 years of experience in scientific content, chemistry, cheminformatics, data curation, scientific publishing, quality assurance, or related areas.

+ Ability to evaluate information for accuracy, completeness, and consistency.

**Technology Competencies**




+ Proficiency in Microsoft Office tools, especially Excel.

**Professional Competencies**




+ Learning agility and curiosity.
+ Effective communication skills.
+ Ability to work independently and collaboratively.

by

You would be required to coordinate with the UK engagement leaders and clients to implement ERP Tax solutions in Oracle.
  
  
To be successful in this role, you should be able to align the global Tax and Legal landscape with the business’ activities and proposed wider business processes. You will be the lynchpin between the Tax Function and IT Function, ensuring that we build the best Oracle design for Tax for the client. This will require the ability to explain complex terms to a variety of different stakeholders, and in a way that is relevant to each stakeholder group.

As a Tax-focused Oracle Consultant, you will be part of the tax workstream on our engagements. * Help build internal efficiencies and accelerators for the proposition

**Required-**

* Proficient in Oracle Fusion (experience of 4-7 years in Fusion & eBS combined) and/ or Oracle eBusiness Suite for Tax
* Experience in project implementation lifecycle (requirements gathering, design, build, test, go-live and support) with at least 2-3 end-to-end implementations of Oracle ERP for tax
* Client-facing experience required i.e., experience in handling clients on day-to-day basis during requirement gathering to User Acceptance Testing phase
* Basic accounting knowledge

* Able to work with Oracle support to flag/fix issues – raising SRs and conducting OWC to explain problems and discuss workarounds
* Proficient in preparing client-ready project deliverables i.e., requirement framework documents, key design decision documents, configuration documents, functional specification documents, test scripts and training guides
* Has knowledge of configuration migration through “Rapid Implementation Spreadsheet” and data migration through Oracle tools like ADFDi, Desktop Integrator, FBDi templates
* Proficient in planning work as per deadline and coordinating with the team to complete work within stipulated deadline
* Comfortable communicating with members from other workstreams and able to collaborate to discuss and test solutions which has cross-workstream dependencies
* Equipped with basic presentation skills, has an analytical approach to issues and able to analyse queries and respond to questions
* Superior verbal and written communication skills in English

**Preferred**

title: Senior Analyst, Data Glossary-3
description:
**Our Purpose**
*Mastercard powers economies and empowers people in 200+ countries and territories worldwide. Together with our customers, we’re helping build a sustainable economy where everyone can prosper. We support a wide range of digital payments choices, making transactions secure, simple, smart and accessible. Our technology and innovation, partnerships and networks combine to deliver a unique set of products and services that help people, businesses and governments realize their greatest potential.*
**Title And Summary**
Senior Analyst, Data Glossary-3
  
  
**Overview**
The Senior Analyst, Data Glossary is responsible for the glossary content creation within the enterprise data glossary for assigned data sets and domains. This includes curating the data to be included by ensuring the critical data elements are appropriately identified, categorizing and classifying data, applying business term naming and definition standards, facilitating the rationalization of business terms at an enterprise level across business units, and ensuring content is represented accurately within tooling. This individual will serve as a semantic subject matter expert for assigned data domains and/or data sets as Mastercard expands its data management program and strategy within the office of the Chief Data Officer (CDO).
  
  
This role is within the Data Management & Strategy team, with reporting structure up to the Chief Data Officer.
  
  
Role
  
  

* Coordinate and communicate with data subject matter experts and other stakeholders to curate and proof the content to be included in the data glossary for assigned data domains, ensuring business terms conform to standards.
* Normalize terms cross-functionally, ensuring no term duplicates, and facilitating consensus among competing stakeholders.
* Ensure content is loaded and maintained in enterprise tooling. Participate in the identification and implementation of controls to ensure glossary integrity.
* Collaborate closely with team members and cross-functional teams to ensure content and process alignment. Contribute to process automation and streamlining operational procedures.
* Assist in researching and evaluating external related standards.
* Align with established data categories and concepts that may be managed by other team members.
* Solicit and incorporate continuous feedback from communities of interest and other stakeholders to improve data semantic models while maintaining governance.
* Assist with the creation and maintenance of standards and best practices related to the data glossary, including business term naming and definition standards. Solicit and incorporate continuous feedback from the community and other stakeholders.
* Assist with the training of new data glossary resources.
* Coordinate with Operations & Technology support teams to report, track, and escalate any tool issues or defects impacting the performance or usability of the data glossary tools
* Serve as a data-driven change agent and advocate, persuading and influencing the organization at the grassroots level.

**All About You**

* Excellent writing skills, including the ability to concisely and precisely convey information to the intended audience in an easy to understand, unambiguous manner.
* Advanced Excel skills are desirable, intermediate required at a minimum.
* Demonstrated experience in working with data.
* Demonstrated experience with the application of standards.
* Hands-on experience with projects involving an enterprise glossary, thesaurus, or controlled vocabulary.
* Highly-motivated self-starter with the ability to multi-task between strategy-related work and tactical ‘in the trenches’ work, while working under deadlines. Ability to produce effective business results while under time pressures.
* Ability to understand and analyze complex information products, systems and processes and to break down complex concepts into clear articulated information to aid organizational understanding and identify common themes.
* Any experience related to data management or data governance including working with data dictionaries, metadata management solutions, data models, data lineage, data quality, data and analytics solutions, data categorization, defining the properties and relationships of concepts, data classification, and data issue tracking is an advantage.
* Strong interpersonal communication, relationship-building and presentation skills.
* Without direct authority, ability to motivate and influence others to achieve organization goals.
* Experience in the technology and/or finance industries is helpful.

**Corporate Security Responsibility**
All activities involving access to Mastercard assets, information, and networks comes with an inherent risk to the organization and, therefore, it is expected that every person working for, or on behalf of, Mastercard is responsible for information security and must:
  
  

* Abide by Mastercard’s security policies and practices;
* Ensure the confidentiality and integrity of the information being accessed;
* Report any suspected information security violation or breach, and
* Complete all periodic mandatory security trainings in accordance with Mastercard’s guidelines.

**About Springer Nature**
Springer Nature is one of the leading publishers of research in the world. We publish the largest number of journals and books and are a pioneer in open research. Through our leading brands, trusted for more than 180 years, we provide technology-enabled products, platforms and services that help researchers to uncover new ideas and share their discoveries, health professionals to stay at the forefront of medical science, and educators to advance learning. title: Warranty Claim Coordinator
description:
Job Title
  
  
Warranty Claim Coordinator
  
  
**Job Description**
**Warranty Claim Coordinator**
Location: Pune, India
  
  
Department: Lifecycle Services / Warranty
  
  
Company: Toyota Automated Logistics (TAL)
  
  
**About The Role**
As a Warranty Claim Coordinator, you will support the global warranty process for Toyota Automated Logistics’ warehousing solutions.
  
  
The role focuses on validating warranty claims, ensuring correct cost allocation and maintaining accurate warranty records. Warranty claims are typically registered by the Service Desk or other operational teams; your responsibility is to review, validate and process these claims in line with contractual warranty conditions and internal governance.
  
  
The position primarily supports the EU and APAC regions, with potential future support for North America and Canada. You will be part of a small team of two Warranty Claim Coordinators, ensuring continuous support and consistent claim handling across regions.
  
  
By analyzing claims and related data, you contribute to transparency in Cost of Non-Quality (CoNQ) and support the identification of systemic issues across the installed base.
  
  
As this is a newly established function and process, you will play an important role in helping to establish and further mature the warranty claim handling capability within the organization.
  
  
The Warranty Manager and capability owner is located at the global headquarters in Veghel, The Netherlands, and you will work closely together to ensure consistent global warranty governance and further strengthen claim quality, reporting and transparency.
  
  
**Key Responsibilities**

* Validate and process warranty claims registered by the Service Desk or operational teams.
* Assess claims against contractual warranty scope and internal guidelines.
* Ensure correct financial booking and cost allocation of warranty-related expenses.
* Ensure that all costs booked as warranty are reviewed and approved by the warranty function according to governance processes.
* Maintain accurate documentation of warranty claims and supporting evidence.
* Coordinate with Service teams regarding claim details and required documentation.
* Identify potential supplier-related defects and support supplier recovery together with Supply Quality.
* Provide structured warranty reporting and insights.
* Contribute to early detection of recurring or systemic issues.
* Support prioritization of systemic issues together with Solution Performance teams.
* Ensure compliance with internal warranty governance and policies.

**Technical Capabilities**

* Ability to analyze technical issues remotely using descriptions, photos and system information, identify the underlying problem and determine the appropriate warranty coverage based on contractual requirements.
* Ability to distinguish between defects, wear and tear, misuse or non-warranty situations based on available evidence and technical understanding.

**Qualifications & Experience**

* Bachelor’s degree in engineering or a comparable technical field is preferred. Strong technical understanding of complex systems and software is more important than the specific field of study.
* 7 to 10 years of experience in warranty management, service operations, quality engineering, technical support or similar technical roles.
* Strong knowledge of problem-solving techniques and root cause analysis, 8D, 5 Why, etc
* Experience with ERP or service management systems (JDE, Maximo or similar) is an advantage.
* Proven expertise in quality standards, methodologies, and regulatory compliance (e.g., ISO 9001, Lean, Six Sigma) is a plus
* Experience with automated logistics systems, industrial automation or material handling systems is a plus.
* Sound knowledge of First Article approval process (PPAP, PSW, Failure Modes and Effect Analysis-FMEA, Control Plans, work instructions) is a plus

**Communication & Collaboration**
**Strong Communication Skills In English Are Essential.**
Knowledge of additional European or APAC languages is an advantage.
  
  
Ability to collaborate effectively with international teams across service, engineering, quality and finance.
  
  
You will work closely with teams including:
  
  

* Lifecycle Services and Service Operations
* Supply Quality and Supplier Management
* Engineering and Technology teams
* Finance
* Solution Performance teams

**Skills & Profile**

* Proactive self-starter with strong sense of ownership
* Structured and detail-oriented working style
* Analytical mindset with strong data interpretation skills
* Ability to coordinate across multiple stakeholders and functions
* Technical understanding of automated logistics or warehouse systems
* Awareness of financial impact and cost allocation

**Travel**
Occasional travel to Veghel, The Netherlands, may be required for onboarding and alignment with the global warranty team.
  
  
**Why Join Us**
At Toyota Automated Logistics, you will contribute to improving lifecycle quality, strengthening warranty governance and increasing transparency in Cost of Non-Quality across our global installed base.
  
  
Your work will support consistent claim handling, better issue prioritization and stronger collaboration between service, engineering and quality teams.
  
  
**Diversity & inclusion**
Vanderlande is an equal opportunity/affirmative action employer. Qualified applicants will be considered without regards to race, religion, colour, national origin, gender, sexual orientation, age, marital status, or disability status.

title: Environment Specialist
description:

**AWE Young Leaders Fellowship | Founding Cohort 2026**

**Location:**
Remote, India

**Duration:**
12 Weeks

**Commitment:**
6–8 Hours per Week (Flexible)

About AWE

**AWE (Air • Water • Earth)**
is a citizen-led, evidence-based environmental initiative working to make environmental intelligence accessible, understandable, and actionable.

We believe meaningful environmental progress begins with credible information, informed citizens, and collaboration between communities, institutions, and businesses.

Our mission is to help turn environmental awareness into measurable action.

We are assembling our founding team of young researchers, innovators, storytellers, and changemakers who want to contribute to a cleaner, healthier, and more sustainable India.

About the Fellowship

**What if your next research project could help people understand an environmental problem affecting millions?**

**We're inviting curious, analytical, and environmentally conscious students to join AWE as Environmental Research & Data Intelligence Fellows**
.

You'll investigate real environmental challenges, explore publicly available datasets, analyze sustainability disclosures, and help transform complex information into research that citizens, communities, and decision-makers can understand.

This is an opportunity to gain practical research experience while contributing to an emerging environmental intelligence initiative.

Key Responsibilities

* **Environmental Research:**
  Investigate air pollution, water quality, waste management, resource consumption, and sustainability challenges across India.
* **Data Analysis:**
  Explore government datasets, scientific publications, environmental monitoring data, and public reports to identify meaningful patterns.
* **ESG & Sustainability Research:**
  Study corporate sustainability reports, Business Responsibility and Sustainability Reports (BRSR), and environmental performance indicators.
* **AI-Assisted Research:**
  Use Gemini-powered tools and other digital resources to accelerate research, analyze documents, and organize findings.
* **Evidence Verification:**
  Cross-check claims, validate sources, and ensure research findings are accurate, transparent, and properly referenced.
* **Research Reporting:**
  Prepare concise research briefs, environmental explainers, comparative studies, and evidence-based reports.
* **Cross-Functional Collaboration:**
  Work with AWE's communications, technology, and community teams to translate research into public awareness initiatives.

Who Can Apply?

We welcome undergraduate and postgraduate students from disciplines including:

* Environmental Science & Sustainability
* Data Science & Statistics
* Geography & Earth Sciences
* Economics & Public Policy
* Engineering & Technology
* Other relevant academic backgrounds

**No prior professional experience is required.**

**We're looking for individuals who demonstrate:**

* Genuine curiosity about environmental challenges.
* Strong analytical and critical-thinking abilities.
* An interest in research, data, and evidence-based problem-solving.
* Clear written communication skills.
* Willingness to learn new digital and AI-powered research tools.
* Reliability, initiative, and the ability to work independently.

Familiarity with Excel, Google Sheets, data visualization, scientific research, or AI tools is an advantage, but not mandatory.

What You'll Gain

**Real-World Research Experience**

**Work on practical environmental questions using publicly available evidence and datasets.**

**AI & Data Intelligence Exposure**

**Gain experience using modern AI-assisted research workflows, document analysis, and environmental data tools.**

**Portfolio-Worthy Contributions**

**Develop research briefs, reports, and analytical work that demonstrate your skills and can be included in your professional portfolio, subject to publication and confidentiality guidelines.**

**Multidisciplinary Collaboration**

**Work alongside students and contributors from research, technology, communications, policy, and sustainability backgrounds.**

**Recognition & Professional Development**

**Receive a fellowship completion certificate documenting your role, duration, and verified contributions, subject to successful completion.**

**Founding Team Experience**

**Contribute during the early development of AWE and help shape its research practices and future initiatives.**

Fellowship Structure

This is a
**voluntary, unpaid, project-based fellowship**
intended for students seeking practical learning, professional exposure, and an opportunity to contribute to environmental initiatives.

The fellowship requires approximately
**6–8 hours per week**
, with flexible scheduling to accommodate academic commitments.

Participation does not guarantee future paid employment.

Our Selection Challenge

As part of your application, we'd love to hear your answer to one question:

**"If you could investigate one environmental problem affecting your city or college, what would you investigate, and how would you find credible evidence?"**

**We're more interested in how you think than how impressive your résumé looks.**

How to Apply

Apply through this LinkedIn job posting.

Shortlisted applicants may be invited to complete a short research exercise or participate in a discussion.

**Be part of AWE's founding team. Help turn environmental evidence into meaningful action.**

* **AWE | Air • Water • Earth**

title: Independent Consultant, Market Shaping - Lead Exposure
description:
WJCF is an Indian non-profit organisation committed to saving lives by reducing the burden of disease and strengthening government-owned, high-quality health systems. Since 2007, WJCF has combined data-driven approaches and deep public health expertise with strong government partnerships to design, implement, and scale solutions across India’s national and state health programmes. We work for and at the service of governments — supporting the Ministry of Health & Family Welfare and State Departments of Health to build systems that are strong, sustainable, and led by Indian institutions.
  
  
As an Indian organisation, WJCF brings an unmatched depth of contextual understanding of India’s health system architecture, policy landscape, and implementation realities across diverse geographies and population groups. This local institutional credibility, combined with global technical rigour, is central to WJCF’s effectiveness as a partner to governments and donors.
  
  
Our work is built around four complementary roles as a Trusted Government Partner, co-designing programmes and strengthening health system architecture; as an Operational Partner, translating strategies into effective on-the-ground delivery; as a Market Shaper, improving the availability and affordability of health commodities; and as an Ecosystem Catalyst, convening governments, development partners, academia, and the private sector to drive solutions at scale.
  
  
WJCF’s programme portfolio spans thematic areas like hepatitis, HIV/AIDS, tuberculosis, vector-borne diseases), syphilis, cervical cancer, diabetes, maternal and childhood anaemia, immunisation, under-5 diarrhoea and pneumonia, sexual and reproductive health, Ayushman Bharat Pradhan Mantri - Jan Arogya Yojana (AB PM-JAY), Ayushman Bharat Digital Mission (ABDM), hypoxemia and oxygen, safe drinking water, sickle cell disease, presbyopia, lead poisoning, and cross cutting thematic areas like AI and Health, integrated disease surveillance, and climate and health. We currently support programmes across 19 states and union territories, with teams working at national, state, district, and sub-district levels.
  
  
Our people are our greatest asset. WJCF brings together a talented, diverse team of professionals from public health, analytics, consulting, healthcare, the development sector, and academia, all united by a shared commitment to improving health outcomes for the people of India. We are entrepreneurial, action-oriented, and deeply grounded in the communities and systems we work in. Our field teams collectively bring hundreds of years of experience managing public health programmes across the country.
  
  
WJCF collaborates with a range of international and domestic partners and donors to advance its mission, including an affiliation with the Clinton Health Access Initiative (CHAI), a global health organisation with which WJCF shares a common mission and values.
  
  
Programme Overview
  
  
Lead (Pb) exposure is a silent yet devastating global health crisis, particularly in low- and middle-income countries (LMICs). Research from UNICEF and other partners estimates that 1 in 2 children in LMICs have elevated blood lead levels, contributing neurological damage, reduced cognitive development, and a variety of health impacts.
  
  
Lead exposure in India arises from multiple sources, with leaded decorative paints and used lead-acid batteries (ULABs) representing the two most significant. Despite a regulatory limit of 90 ppm for lead in decorative paints, widespread non-compliance among SME manufacturers means lead chromate pigments continue to enter the paint supply chain. ULABs are the single largest source of secondary lead in India, with approximately 1.1 million metric tonnes generated annually across the automotive, telecom, inverter, and UPS sectors; informal recycling of spent batteries releases lead into surrounding communities, disproportionately affecting children.
  
  
WJCF has launched a new Lead Exposure Program, building on its proven market shaping capabilities and experience partnering with governments to address large-scale and cross-sectoral health challenges. Program priorities include
  
  

* Devising and implementing strategies to support paint SME manufacturers in transitioning from lead inputs to safer and sustainable alternatives (organic pigments)
* Scoping gaps and intervention areas for market-shaping opportunities across the lead exposure program, spanning diagnostics (pXRF), treatment (chelating agents), and source-side mitigation (plastics, other sources)

The incumbent will support across multiple market shaping workstreams as detailed below.
  
  
Position Details
  
  
We are seeking an analytically rigorous and entrepreneurial individual to support the design, implementation, and monitoring of WJCF’s market shaping interventions. The role involves market assessment, value chain analysis, stakeholder interviews, policy analysis, and financial modelling. It spans government, private sector, and civil society actors, and sits at the intersection of commercial strategy, environmental health, and government engagement.
  
  

* Location New Delhi, with domestic travel to pilot states.
* Duration Up to 6 months, extendable based on performance
* Market Strategies to Transition Paint SMEs to Safer Alternatives

**Transition to Lead-Free Paints**

* Support the scoping and implementation of targeted pilot interventions to enable industry transition to lead-free paints, including addressing SME barriers to transition, supply chain solutions, and related market-shaping measures.

**Pilot Planning & Design**

* Develop detailed pilot blueprints for selected interventions implementation plans, resource requirements, partnerships, budgets, timelines, risk assessments, and mitigation strategies.
* The intervention hypotheses under consideration are

+ Aggregate raw material demand Test the feasibility of aggregating demand from medium-sized paint manufacturers to secure lower-cost lead-free inputs and incentivize greater reformulation of paints to lead-free alternatives.
+ Leverage institutional procurement Identify high-volume institutional paint buyers and work with them to adopt lead-free procurement commitments, creating demand-side pressure for manufacturers to reformulate their products.

* Prepare implementation toolkits and support materials for roll-out as needed.

**Exploring Lead-Free Pigment Transitions in Non-Paint Sources**

* Mapping lead and lead-free pigment supply chains, assess switching barriers, and evaluate the feasibility of lead-free alternatives in other sources (plastics, turmeric)
* Identify opportunities and support concept to proposal writing, including defining and prioritizing intervention areas.
* Market Shaping for Portable XRF (pXRF)

**Accelerate access to affordable pXRF for research and routine government environmental testing**

* Conduct a supplier and distribution landscape of pXRF devices
* Assess device availability and pricing across suppliers
* Map demand with stakeholders, including current pXRF use and unmet needs
* Understand procurement pathways and regulatory frameworks
* Assess end-user needs to evaluate product-market fit
* Market shaping for Chelating Agents

**Enable access to affordable oral chelation therapy**

* Expanding access to chelation drugs through improved sourcing and procurement to reduce costs and enable addition in essential drug lists
* Assessing alternative formulations or delivery approaches that could improve affordability and feasibility in low-resource settings
* Cross-cutting

**Stakeholder Engagement and Reporting**

* Support proposal development, including concept notes, funding proposals, and progress reports.
* Support stakeholder management across donor, government, private sector, and civil society partners.
* Maintain programme tracking tools and contribute to milestone monitoring.
* Scope can potentially evolve basis developing understanding of the above lead exposure program areas
* Bachelor’s degree in business administration, economics, public policy, or a related field; a postgraduate degree is preferred.
* Minimum 3 years of relevant experience with a strong analytical focus, such as market assessment, supply chain analysis, commercial strategy, or policy analysis. Strategy consulting experience is preferred.
* Experience in primary research, such as stakeholder interviews, value chain mapping, or market assessments in complex, multi-stakeholder settings.
* Strong quantitative and qualitative analytical skills, and comfort building unit economics or financial models.
* Strong strategic thinking, with the ability to identify and pursue high-impact opportunities in complex, uncertain, and changing environments.
* Excellent written and verbal communication skills, with the ability to produce high-quality reports, briefs, and presentations for government, donors, and technical audiences.
* An entrepreneurial mindset, with the ability to work independently, lead workstreams end-to-end, and to propose and carry out new initiatives.

* Keyword Research: Conduct comprehensive keyword research, search intent analysis, keyword mapping, and competitor analysis.
* Technical SEO: Perform website audits, resolve crawling and indexing issues, optimize site architecture, improve Core Web Vitals, and implement structured data.

* Off-Page SEO: Develop ethical link-building strategies, acquire quality backlinks, and improve domain authority and website credibility.
* Content Strategy: Collaborate with content writers to develop SEO-friendly blogs, landing pages, service pages, and topic clusters.

* Performance Monitoring: Track organic traffic, rankings, conversions, impressions, and click-through rates.

* Team Collaboration: Coordinate with content, development, and digital marketing teams to implement SEO improvements.

* 4–7 years of hands-on experience in Search Engine Optimization.
* Strong practical experience in National SEO and International SEO.

* Knowledge of international targeting, hreflang tags, canonicalization, and country-specific SEO strategies.
* Strong understanding of XML sitemaps, robots.txt, redirects, structured data, and website architecture.
* Experience with keyword research, backlink analysis, rank tracking, and competitor benchmarking.
* Familiarity with WordPress or other content management systems.
* Strong analytical, communication, and problem-solving skills.
* Ability to manage multiple projects and deliver measurable SEO results.

**Key Performance Indicators (KPIs)**

Performance will be evaluated based on:

* Growth in organic traffic across national and international markets.

* Increase in qualified organic leads and conversions.
* Improvement in technical SEO health and website indexing.
* Growth in relevant, high-quality backlinks.
* Improvement in organic click-through rates and landing-page performance.

**Preferred Qualifications**

description:
Location: Kolkata

Date: Oct 21, 2026

**Job description**
-------------------

Requisition ID: 1744385

At EY, you’ll have the chance to build a career as unique as you are, with the global scale, support, inclusive culture and technology to become the best version of you. And we’re counting on your unique voice and perspective to help EY become even better, too. Join us and build an exceptional experience for yourself, and a better working world for all.

  

**EY-Consulting - Data and Analytics -Consultant — Collibra Data Intelligence Platform-GIG**

EY's Consulting Services is a unique, industry-focused business unit that provides a broad range of integrated services that leverage deep industry experience with strong functional and technical capabilities and product knowledge. EY’s financial services practice provides integrated Consulting services to financial institutions and other capital markets participants, including commercial banks, retail banks, investment banks, broker-dealers & asset management firms, and insurance firms from leading Fortune 500 Companies. Within EY’s Consulting Practice, Data and Analytics team solves big, complex issues and capitalize on opportunities to deliver better working outcomes that help expand and safeguard the businesses, now and in the future. This way we help create a compelling business case for embedding the right analytical practice at the heart of client’s decision-making.

  

**ROLE OVERVIEW**

We are looking for an experienced Data Governance Consultant with deep, hands-on expertise in the **Collibra Data Intelligence Platform** to lead the design, implementation and adoption of data governance capabilities across the enterprise. You will work directly with data owners, stewards, architects and business stakeholders to translate governance policy into a working Collibra implementation — operating model, metadata, lineage, workflows and data quality — and make it something the business actually uses.

This is a hands-on delivery role with strong client and stakeholder exposure. You will be equally comfortable configuring the platform and standing in front of a steering committee explaining why it matters.

  

**KEY RESPONSIBILITIES**

* Lead end-to-end implementation and configuration of the Collibra Data Intelligence Platform, including operating model design, communities, domains, asset types, relations, complex attributes and scopes.
* Design and build **Collibra workflows** (BPMN / Groovy) for data steward approvals, issue management, access requests and onboarding processes.
* Configure and manage the **Collibra Data Catalog**, business glossary, reference data and policy management modules.
* Implement technical and business lineage using **Collibra Lineage Harvester, Edge** and custom lineage ingestion.
* Integrate Collibra with enterprise source systems, data platforms and BI tools using the Collibra REST APIs, Edge connectors, Catalog connectors and JDBC ingestion.
* Define and operationalise data governance frameworks: roles and responsibilities, stewardship models, data ownership, policies and standards.
* Establish metadata ingestion pipelines and automate bulk metadata onboarding via APIs and import templates.
* Define and track data quality rules, KPIs and dashboards; support remediation of data quality issues with the relevant data owners.
* Support platform administration: user and group management, roles and permissions, environment promotion and release management.
* Run workshops, training and enablement sessions for stewards and business users to drive platform adoption.
* Produce solution design documents, configuration guides, runbooks and handover documentation.
* Provide advisory input on governance roadmap, maturity assessments and best practice to senior stakeholders.

  

**REQUIRED SKILLS & EXPERIENCE**

* **8+ years** of overall experience in data management, data governance or enterprise data platforms.
* **Proven, hands-on proficiency with the Collibra Data Intelligence Platform** — not just usage, but design and configuration across multiple implementations.
* Strong command of the Collibra operating model: asset types, domains, communities, attributes, relations, hierarchies and validation rules.
* Practical experience building and troubleshooting Collibra workflows (BPMN, Groovy scripting).
* Experience with Collibra Catalog, Business Glossary, Data Lineage, Data Helpdesk and Policy Manager.
* Working knowledge of Collibra Edge, Lineage Harvester and connector-based metadata ingestion.
* Solid experience with the Collibra REST API for automation, bulk operations and system integration.
* Strong SQL and a good understanding of data modelling, metadata management and data architecture concepts.
* Familiarity with data governance frameworks, data privacy and regulatory drivers (e.g. GDPR, BCBS 239, CCPA).
* Excellent stakeholder management, facilitation and written communication skills — able to work with both engineering teams and business leadership.
* Linux skills to manage the on-premise server components

  

**DESIRABLE SKILLS**

* **Collibra Data Quality (DQ)** — rule authoring, DQ job configuration, scorecards, and integration of DQ results back into the Collibra Data Catalog.
* **Python** — for API automation, metadata ingestion scripts and data quality validation.
* **Git** — version control for workflow artefacts, scripts and configuration-as-code; familiarity with branching strategies and CI/CD pipelines.
* **Snowflake** — cataloguing and lineage from Snowflake
* Exposure to cloud platforms (Azure) and modern data stack tooling (dbt, Airflow, Azure Data Factory, Databricks).
* Experience with other governance or DQ tools (Informatica, Alation, Ataccama, Great Expectations) for comparative context.
* API Development with Spring Boot
* Consulting background with experience running client-facing engagements and pre-sales support.

  

**QUALIFICATIONS & CERTIFICATIONS**

* Bachelor's degree in Computer Science, Information Systems, Engineering or a related field.
* **Collibra Ranger / Collibra Expert certification** strongly preferred (e.g. Collibra Certified Ranger, Data Steward, or Workflow Developer).

Certifications in Snowflake, cloud platforms or DAMA CDMP are an advantage.

  

**What working at EY offers**

At EY, we’re dedicated to helping our clients, from start–ups to Fortune 500 companies — and the work we do with them is as varied as they are.

You get to work with inspiring and meaningful projects. Our focus is education and coaching alongside practical experience to ensure your personal development. We value our employees and you will be able to control your own development with an individual progression plan. You will quickly grow into a responsible role with challenging and stimulating assignments. Moreover, you will be part of an interdisciplinary environment that emphasizes high quality and knowledge exchange. Plus, we offer:

* Support, coaching and feedback from some of the most engaging colleagues around
* Opportunities to develop new skills and progress your career
* The freedom and flexibility to handle your role in a way that’s right for you

  

**EY | Building a better working world**

Colgate-Palmolive Company is a global consumer products company operating in over 200 countries specialising in Oral Care, Personal Care, Home Care, Skin Care, and Pet Nutrition. Our products are trusted in more households than any other brand in the world, making us a household name!
  
  
Join Colgate-Palmolive, a caring, innovative growth company reimagining a healthier future for people, their pets, and our planet. Guided by our core values—Caring, Inclusive, and Courageous—we foster a culture that inspires our people to achieve common goals. Together, let's build a brighter, healthier future for all.

Championing product integrity and consumer trust, you will architect and deploy the site Quality Master Plan and Quality Manual across Colgate-Palmolive’s high-speed Sri City manufacturing plant. Partnering directly with shop-floor operations and global audit teams, you eliminate process variation and customer complaints. Based on-site in Sri City, you ensure every toothbrush manufactured meets world-class quality and safety standards.

* Develop, document, and maintain the site Quality Master Plan, Quality Manual, and Global Quality standards compliance.
* Conduct internal audit programs and participate in Divisional and Corporate Quality Audits to evaluate site quality effectiveness.
* Lead root cause analysis and CAPA closures for all Non-Conformance Reports (NCRs) in coordination with plant leadership.
* Manage the online Customer Response System (CRS), analyzing consumer complaints to drive continuous improvement.
* Monitor shop-floor quality KPIs and process capability to ensure all finished products fulfill KRSs (Key Release Specification) prior to market release.
* Deliver structured technical training and coaching to Quality Technicians, Operators, and plant line teams.

* Education: Bachelor's or Master's degree in Science or Technical stream (B.Sc / M.Sc / B.Tech) from a recognized university.
* Experience: 3 to 5 years of core experience in the FMCG industry with Quality & Production management responsibility.
* Quality Methodologies: Proven expertise in developing Quality Manuals, executing CAPA, NCR resolution, and process capability monitoring.
* Systems: Working knowledge of SAP (QM module), online CRS complaint management, and quality audit frameworks.

**Preferred Qualification & Experience**

* Industry: Experience in high-volume consumer goods (CPG/FMCG), oral care, or precision plastics manufacturing.
* Audit Expertise: Familiarity with international subsidiary benchmarking, cGMP, and EOHS site standards.
* Soft Skills: Exceptional training, coaching, and people facilitation capabilities with a strong decision-making mindset.
* Commercial Mindset: Understanding of plant financials, product commercialization bundles, and target cost delivery.
